Naye ebyo si bye baagala ddala; kwe kuwaba kwabwe oba ensobi zaabwe; era kirungi nti bigaanibwa. Bye baagala eby’ekisa birituuka mu maaso ga Mukama, era talibagaana. Mukama atugaana bye tusaba okumala ekiseera? Ekisuubizo kya leero kituzzeemu amaanyi tuddemu okusaba. Atugaanidde ddala? Tunaamwebazanga bwe tutyo, kubanga bulijjo kyali kye twagala nti atugaane bw’aba alaba ng’okugaana kye kisinga obulungi. Ku bintu ebimu, tusaba n’obuvumu bungi. Bye twagala ennyo bwe butukuvu, okuba ab’omugaso, okufaanana Kristo, okwetegekera Eggulu. Bino by’ebyo ekisa bye kyegomba so si butonde -- ebyo omuntu omutuukirivu by’ayagala so si muntu bumuntu. Katonda tajja kutukendeeza mu bintu bino, wabula alitukolera okusukkirira ddala. "Sanyukiranga mu Mukama, anaakuwanga omutima gwo bye gwetaaga." Leero, emmeeme yange, saba bingi! Apuli 16 BYONNA BIFUUKA BITUKUVU "Ku lunaku olwo ekigambo kino, KITUKUVU ERI MUKAMA KATONDA, kinaawandikibwa ku bide by’embalaasi" Zekkaliya 14:20 Lunaku lwa ssanyu ebintu byonna lwe biriwongebwa, n’ebide by’embalaasi lwe birivuga nti kitukuvu eri Mukama! Olunaku olwo lutuuse gye ndi. Ebintu byonna sibifuula bitukuvu eri Katonda? Engoye zino, bwe nzambala oba bwe nzeeyambula, tezijja kunzijukiza butuukirivu bwa Kristo Yesu, Mukama wange? Omulimu gwange tegujja kukolebwa nga gukolerwa Mukama? Singa leero engoye zange zifuuka byambalo bya bakabona, emmere yange n’efuuka ssaakalamentu, ennyumba yange n’efuuka yeekaalu, emmeeza yange n’efuuka kyoto, ebigambo byange ne bifuuka bubaane, nange ne nfuuka kabona! Mukama, tuukiriza ekisuubizo kyo, era waleme kubaawo gye ndi kintu kya muzizo oba ekitali kirongoofu. Ka nkisuubire mu kukkiriza. Bwe nkikkiriza nti bwe kiri, nnaayambibwa okukifuula bwe kityo. Nga bwe ndi nze kennyini eky’obugagga bwa Yesu, Mukama wange ayinza okubala byonna bye nnina, kubanga byonna bibye ddala; era mmaliridde okukikakasa nga bwe kiri mu ngeri gye nnaabikozesaamu leero. Okuva ku makya okutuusa akawungeezi njagala okuteekateeka ebintu byonna mu tteeka ery’essanyu era ettukuvu. Ebide byange birivuga -lwaki tebyandivuze? N’embalaasi zange zinaaba n’ebide -- ani alina eddembe ku bivuga ng’abatukuvu bwe balina? Naye ebide byange byonna, ennyimba zange, essanyu lyange, birifuuka bitukuvu, era birivuga erinnya lya "Katonda Omusanyufu." Apuli 17 ABALABE MU MIREMBE "Amakubo g’omuntu bwe gaba gasanyusa Mukama, aleetera abalabe b’omuntu oyo okubeera naye mu mirembe" Engero 16:7 Nteekwa okulaba nga amakubo gange gasanyusa Mukama. Ne bwe kiba bwe kityo nnaabanga n’abalabe; era oboolyawo, n’okusingawo kubanga nfuba okukola ekituufu. Naye nga kino kisuubizo! Mukama alifuula obusungu bw’omuntu okumutendereza, era alibukendeeza ne butanneeraliikiriza. Asobola okuziyiza omulabe obutankola kabi, ne bw’aba ng’akimaliridde. Ekyo kye yakola Labbaani, eyagoberera Yakobo, naye n’atayaŋŋanga kumukwatako. Oba asobola okukkakkanya obusungu bw’omulabe, n’amufuula ow’omukwano, nga bwe yakola Esawu, eyasisinkana Yakobo mu ngeri ey’oluganda, newaakubadde nga Yakobo yali atidde nti ajja kumutta n’ab’omu nnyumba ye n’ekitala. Mukama era asobola okufuula omulabe omukambwe ennyo ow’oluganda mu Kristo, era munne mu mulimu, nga bwe yakola Sawulo ow’e Taluso. Singa akikola mu buli mbeera omwoyo ogw’okuyigganya mwe gulabikira! Alina omukisa omuntu abalabe be abafuulibwa gy’ali ng’empologoma bwe zaali eri Danyeri mu bunnya, ezisirise era ez’emikwano! Bwe ndisisinkana okufa, okuyitibwa omulabe asembayo, nsaba mbeere mu mirembe. Ekisinga kye nfaako kibeere kusanyusa Mukama mu byonna. Singa nfuna okukkiriza n’obutukuvu; kubanga bino bye bisanyusa Oyo Ali Waggulu Ennyo! Apuli 18 TAKULEKA N’AKATONO "Bwe ntyo bwe nnaabeeranga naawe, sirikuleka wadde okukwabuulira" Yoswa 1:5 Ekigambo kino ekyagambibwa Yoswa kijjukirwa emirundi mingi; kye kikolo ky’ekigambo ekyo eky’Endagaano Empya nti, "Yagamba nti, Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono." Abaagalwa, obulamu obw’olutalo buli mu maaso gaffe, naye Mukama ow’Eggye ali naffe. Tuyitiddwa okukulembera abantu abangi naye abakyukakyuka? Ekisuubizo kino kitukakasa amagezi gonna n’obwegendereza bwonna bye tulyetaaga. Tulina okulwana n’abalabe ab’enkwe era ab’amaanyi? Wano waliwo amaanyi n’obuzira, obusobozi n’obuwanguzi. Tulina obusika obunene obw’okuwangula? Olw’akabonero kano tulituuka ku kigendererwa kyaffe; Mukama yennyini ali naffe. Twandibadde ba nnaku ddala singa Yakuwa ayinza okutulemererwa; naye, nga kino bwe kitasoboka n’akatono, empewo ez’okweraliikirira zeebasizibwa mu mpuku z’obwesigwa bwa Katonda. Tewali kiseera na kimu Mukama mw’alituleka. Kyonna ekinaabaawo, anaabanga ku ludda lwaffe. Mikwano gituvaako, obuyambi bwabwe buli ng’enkuba ya Apuli eyita mangu; naye Katonda mwesigwa, Yesu y’oyo ye emirembe gyonna, n’Omwoyo Omutukuvu abeera mu ffe. Jjangu, mutima gwange, beera muteefu era nga olina essuubi leero. Ebire biyinza okukuŋŋaana, naye Mukama asobola okubifuuwa ne bigenda. Nga Katonda bw’atalindemererwa, n’okukkiriza kwange tekujja kulemererwa; era nga bw’atalinjabulira, nange sirimwabulira. Singa mfuna okukkiriza okuwummudde! Apuli 19 OMUNOONYI OMUKUGU "Era bw’ati bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda nti, Nze kennyini ndinoonya endiga zange ne nzirabirira" Okuva 34:11 Kino akikola okusooka, abalonde be bwe baba nga bakyali ng’endiga ezibuze ezitamanyi Musumba wadde ekisibo. Nga kya kitalo Mukama bw’azuula abalonde be! Yesu mukulu ng’Omusumba anoonya, nga bw’ali omukulu ng’Omusumba alokola. Newaakubadde ng’abangi ku abo Kitaawe be yamuwa baatuuka kumpi ddala n’omulyango gwa ggeyeena, kyokka Mukama, ng’anoonya era ng’ayiiya, abazuula, n’abasemberera n’ekisa. Ffe yatunoonya n’atuzuula: tube n’essuubi eddungi ku abo be tutwalira mu kusaba, kubanga nabo alibazuula. Mukama addamu okukola bw’atyo, ezimu ku ndiga z’ekisibo kye bwe ziwaba ne ziva mu ddundiro ly’amazima n’obutukuvu. Ziyinza okugwa mu bukyamu obw’amaanyi, mu kibi ekinakuwaza, ne mu bukakanyavu obubi ennyo; naye Mukama, eyafuuka omuyima waazo eri Kitaawe, taliganya n’emu ku zo kugenda wala n’okutuuka okuzikirira. Aligoberera ezo, ng’akozesa okulabirira kwe n’ekisa kye, mu nsi ez’ewala, mu bifo eby’obwavu, mu bunnya obw’ekyama, ne mu buziba obw’okuggwaamu essuubi; taliffirwa n’emu ku zonna Kitaawe ze yamuwa. Eri Yesu, kya kitiibwa okunoonya n’okulokola ekisibo kyonna, nga tewali n’emu esigaddeyo. Nga kisuubizo kya kwegayirira, bwe mba nga mu ssaawa eno mpalirizibwa okukaaba nti "Ndi ng’endiga ebuze"! Apuli 20 LWA KUKKIRIZA SO SI LWA KUWULIRA "Abatuukirivu banaabeeranga balamu lwa kukkiriza" Abaruumi 1:17 Sijja kufa. Nsobola okukkiriza, era nzikiriza Mukama Katonda wange, era okukkiriza kuno kwe kunaankuuma nga ndi mulamu. Nandyagadde okubalibwa mu abo abatuukirivu mu bulamu bwabwe; naye ne bwe nnandibadde omutuukiridde, sandigezezzaako kubeera mulamu lwa butuukirivu bwange; nandinywerezza ku mulimu gwa Mukama Yesu, ne nsigala nga mbeera mulamu lwa kumukkiriza Ye, so si lwa kintu kirala kyonna. Ne bwe nnandisobodde okuwaayo omubiri gwange okwokebwa ku lwa Mukama wange Yesu, sandyesize buvumu bwange wadde obunywevu bwange, wabula nandisigadde nga mbeera mulamu lwa kukkiriza. "Singa mba mujulirwa ayokebwa ku muti, Nandikoowodde erinnya ly’Omulokozi wange; Nandisabye okusonyiyibwa ku lulwe, Ne sireeta nsonga ndala yonna." Okubeera omulamu lwa kukkiriza kya bukakafu era kya ssanyu okusinga nnyo okubeera omulamu lwa kuwulira oba lwa bikolwa. Ettabi, bwe libeera ku muzabbibu, libeera n’obulamu obusinga obwo bwe lyandibadde nabwo lyokka, ne bwe kyandisobose ettabi okubeera eddamu nga lyawukanyiziddwa ku kikolo. Okubeera omulamu nga nnywerera ku Yesu, nga byonna mbiggya mu Ye, kintu kiwoomu era kitukuvu. Bwe kiba nti n’abasingayo obutuukirivu kibagwanira okubeera abalamu mu ngeri eno, nze omwonoonyi omwavu si kisingawo? Mukama, nzikiriza. Kiŋŋwanira okukwesiga ddala. Kiki ekirala kye nsobola okukola? Okukwesiga bwe bulamu bwange. Nkiwulira nti bwe kityo bwe kiri. Kino nnaakinywererako n’okutuusa ku nkomerero. Apuli 21 KATONDA ASASULA "Oyo akwatirwa omwavu ekisa awola Mukama, era Mukama alimusasula olw’ekikolwa kye ekyo" Engero 19:17 Tulina okugabira abaavu olw’okubasaasira. Si lwa kulabibwa na kutenderezebwa, era si kusingawo lwa kufuna buyinza ku bo; wabula olw’okubalumirwa n’okubasaasira okutuufu, tuteekwa okubayamba. Tetusaanidde kusuubira kufuna kintu kyonna okuva mu baavu, wadde okwebazibwa; wabula tulina okutwala kye tukoze ng’ebbanja lye tuwoze Mukama. Ye y’akwata obuvunaanyizibwa bw’okusasula, era bwe tuba nga mu nsonga eno tutunuulira Ye, tetusaanidde kutunuulira oyo ow’okubiri. Nga kitiibwa kinene Mukama ky’atuwa bw’akkiriza okwewola ku ffe! Omusuubuzi alina Mukama mu bitabo bye eby’amabanja aba afunye omukisa gwa maanyi. Kyandibadde kya nnaku erinnya ery’ekitiibwa bwe lityo okuwandiikibwa ku bbanja ettono ennyo; ka tulifuule eddene. Omuntu omwetaavu asooka okuyita mu kkubo lino, ka tumuyambe. Ku by’okusasulwa, tetuyinza na kubirowoozaako, kyokka wano waliwo ebbaluwa ya Mukama ey’ebbanja ekwatiddwako omukono gwe. Erinnya lye litenderezebwe, ekisuubizo kye eky’okusasula kisinga zaabu ne ffeeza. Ebyaffe bitutunzeeko akatono olw’ebiseera ebizibu? Tuyinza n’obwetoowaze okutwala ebbaluwa eno ku Bbanka y’Okukkiriza. Waliwo omu ku basomi baffe abadde omukodo eri abaavu? Nga wa nnaku. Mukama amusonyiwe. Apuli 22 OBUYINZA OKUYIMUSA "Mukama azibula amaaso ga bamuzibe, era awanirira abazitoowereddwa" Zabbuli 146:8 Nzitoowereddwa? Kale ka njegayirire n’ekigambo kino eky’ekisa mu maaso ga Mukama. Ye ngeri ye, ye mpisa ye, kye kisuubizo kye, era kye kimusanyusa, okuyimusa abazitoowereddwa. Kye kinnyigiriza kaakano kwe kuwulira ekibi, n’omwoyo ogwennyamidde olw’ekyo? Kale omulimu gwa Yesu, mu nsonga eno, gwakolebwa era gwategekebwa okunzimusa ne ntuuka mu kuwummula. Ayi Mukama, nzimusa, olw’okusaasira kwo! Kwe kufiirwa okunakuwaza, oba embeera ezisereba ennyo? Nga wano nate Omubudaabudi yakwata omulimu ogw’okubudaabuda. Nga kya kisa gye tuli nti omu ku Basatu ab’Obusatu Obutukuvu afuuka Omubudaabudi! Omulimu guno gulikolebwa bulungi, kubanga Oyo ow’ekitiibwa bw’atyo yagufuula ogw’enjawulo ogw’okulabirira kwe. Abamu bazitoowereddwa nnyo nga Yesu yekka y’asobola okubasumulula mu bulwadde bwabwe, naye asobola, era ajja kukikola. Asobola okutuyimusa ne tutuuka ku bulamu obulungi, ku ssuubi, ne ku ssanyu. Emirundi mingi yakikola mu kugezesebwa okwayita, era ye Mulokozi ye omu, era aliddamu ebikolwa bye eby’okwagala okw’ekisa. Ffe abazitoowereddwa era abanakuwavu leero, tulituusibwa waggulu, n’abo abatuduulira kaakano baliswazibwa nnyo. Nga kya kitiibwa okuyimusibwa Mukama! Kigasa okuzitoowererwa tusobole okumanya obuyinza bwe obuyimusa. Apuli 23 TEWALI KUTYA KUFA "Alina amatu, awulire Omwoyo ky’agamba Ekkanisa ezo. Oyo awangula talifa mulundi gwakubiri" Okubikkulirwa 2:11 Okufa okusooka tuteekwa okukuyitamu, okuggyako nga Mukama ajjidde mu yeekaalu ye nga tebamanyiridde. Eri kino tubeere nga twetegese, nga tukulindirira awatali kutya, kubanga Yesu yafuula okufa, okuva mu mpuku ey’ekizikiza, ne kufuuka ekkubo erituusa mu kitiibwa. Ekya kutiibwa si kufa kwa kusooka, wabula okufa okwokubiri; si kwawukana kwa mwoyo n’omubiri, wabula okwawukana okw’enkomeredde okw’omuntu yenna ne Katonda. Kuno kwe kufa ddala. Okufa kuno kutta emirembe gyonna, essanyu, obusanyufu, n’essuubi. Katonda bw’aba nga tayo, byonna biba biweddewo. Okufa okufaanana bwe kutyo kubi nnyo okusinga obutabaawo n’akatono: kwe kubaawo nga tolina bulamu obufuula okubaawo okw’omugaso. Kale, olw’ekisa kya Katonda bwe tulwana okutuusa ku nkomerero, ne tuwangula mu lutalo olw’ekitiibwa, tewali kufa kwa kubiri kuyinza kututeekako olunwe lwakwo olunnyogovu. Tetulitya kufa wadde ggeyeena, kubanga tuliweebwa engule ey’obulamu etaliggwaawo. Nga kino kituzzaamu amaanyi mu lutalo! Obulamu obutaggwaawo busaanira olutalo olw’obulamu bwonna. Okuwona okulumizibwa okufa okwokubiri kintu ekisaanira okufubirira obulamu bwonna. Mukama, tuwe okukkiriza, tusobole okuwangula, olwo otuwe ekisa tusigale nga tetulumiziddwa, newaakubadde ng’ekibi ne Setaani batugoberera okumpi n’ebisinziiro byaffe! Apuli 24 EKISAANYIZO KY’OMUKISA "Muleete ekimu eky’ekkumi ekijjuvu mu nnyumba yange, ennyumba yange ebeeremu emmere, era mungezese, bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye, obanga siribaggulirawo ebituli eby’omu ggulu, ne mbawa omukisa ne gutabaako ne we guligya," Malaki 3:10 Bangi basoma ekisuubizo kino ne bakyegayirira nga tebafaayo ku kisaanyizo omukisa kwe gusuubizibwa. Tetuyinza kusuubira ggulu kugguka oba mukisa kufukibwa, okuggyako nga tuwa Mukama Katonda waffe n’omulimu gwe ebyo ebimugwanira. Tewandibaddewo bbula lya nsimbi eri emirimu emitukuvu, singa Abakristaayo bonna abeeyita bwe batyo baawa omugabo gwabwe ogubagwanira. Bangi baavu kubanga banyaga Katonda. N’Ekkanisa nnyingi zibulwa okukyalirwa Omwoyo kubanga zirumya abaweereza baazo enjala. Bwe wataba mmere ya mubiri eri abaweereza ba Katonda, tetusaanidde kwewuunya ng’obuweereza bwabwe bulimu emmere ntono nnyo eri emyoyo gyaffe. Emirimu gy’obuminsani bwe gyetaaga ebibagasa, n’omulimu gwa Mukama ne guziyizibwa olw’eggwanika eryerere, tuyinza tutya okusuubira okukulaakulana kw’emyoyo okungi? Kale nno! Kiki kye mpaddeyo mu nnaku zino? Mbadde mukodo eri Katonda wange? Mbadde nkendeeza ku bya Mulokozi wange? Kino tekisaana n’akatono. Ka mpe Mukama wange Yesu ekimu eky’ekkumi kye, nga nnyamba abaavu, era nga mpagira omulimu gwe, olwo ndyoke ndabe obuyinza bwe obw’okumpa omukisa mu bungi. Apuli 25 EKY’OKULEKERA ABAANA "Omuntu omutuukirivu, atambulira mu bulamu obutaliiko kyakunenyezebwa; ba mukisa abaana be abalimuddira mu bigere" Engero 20:7 Okweraliikirira olw’amaka gaffe kya buzaaliranwa, naye tuliba bagezi bwe tunaakufuula okufaayo ku mpisa zaffe ffennyini. Bwe tutambulira mu maaso ga Mukama mu bulamu obutaliiko kyakunenyezebwa, tulikola ekisingawo okuwa ezzadde lyaffe omukisa okusinga singa tubalekera ebyobugagga ebingi. Obulamu bwa kitaawe w’abaana obutukuvu bwe busika obw’obugagga eri batabani be. Omuntu omugolokofu alekera abasika be ekyokulabirako kye, era kino kyokka kiriba kirombe ky’obugagga obw’amazima. Nga bangi abasajja abasobola okulaba nti obuwanguzi bwabwe mu bulamu bwava mu kyokulabirako kya bazadde baabwe! Abalekera n’ettutumu lye. Abantu batulowooza obulungi okusingawo nga tuli batabani b’omusajja eyali ayinza okwesigibwa, abasikira omusuubuzi ow’ettutumu eddungi ennyo. Singa abavubuka bonna baali beeraliikirira okukuuma erinnya ly’amaka gaabwe! Okusinga byonna, alekera abaana be essaala ze n’omukisa gwa Katonda awulira okusaba, era bino bifuula ezzadde lyaffe okuba abasiimibwa mu baana b’abantu. Katonda alibalokola ne bwe tuliba nga twafa. Singa balokolebwa kaakano! Obwesimbu bwaffe buyinza okuba ekkubo Katonda ly’akozesa okulokola batabani baffe ne bawala baffe. Bwe balaba amazima g’eddiini yaffe nga gakakasibwa obulamu bwaffe, kiyinza okuba nti nabo balikkiriza Yesu ku lwabwe bennyini. Mukama, tuukiriza ekigambo kino eri ennyumba yange! Apuli 26 OKUKOLAGANA N’EKISA "Era mu byonna by’onookolanga, Mukama Katonda wo anaakuwanga omukisa" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 15:18 Mukama w’ennyumba Omuyisirayiri yalina okuta omuddu we mu kiseera ekituufu, era omuddu oyo bwe yavanga mu buweereza bwe, yalina okumutandikira obulamu n’omugabo omugazi. Kino kyalina okukolebwa n’omutima gwonna era n’essanyu, era olwo Mukama n’asuubiza okuwa ekikolwa ekyo eky’obugabi omukisa. Omwoyo gw’ekiragiro kino, era ddala n’amateeka ga Kristo gonna, gutusiba okuyisa obulungi abakozi. Tusaanidde okujjukira Mukama bw’atuyisizza, era nti ekyo kifuula ekyetaagisa ddala nti naffe tuyise abalala n’ekisa. Kigwanira abo abaana ba Katonda ow’ekisa okuba abagabi. Tuyinza tutya okusuubira Mukama waffe omukulu okutuwa omukisa mu mirimu gyaffe egy’obusuubuzi, nga tunyigiriza abo abatuweereza? Nga mukisa gwa maanyi ogutegekeddwa wano eri omutima omugabi! Okuweebwa omukisa mu byonna bye tukola kwe kuweebwa omukisa ddala. Mukama alitutuusaako omukisa guno ekitundu mu kukulaakulana, ekitundu mu mutima omumativu, n’ekitundu mu kuwulira okusiimibwa kwe, gwe mukisa ogusinga gyonna. Asobola okutuwuliza nti tuli wansi w’okulabirira kwe okw’enjawulo, era nti twetooloddwa okwagala kwe okw’enjawulo. Kino kifuula obulamu buno obw’oku nsi entandikwa ey’essanyu ey’obulamu obugenda okujja. Omukisa gwa Katonda gusinga obugagga. Guleeta obugagga era tagwongerako buyinike. Apuli 27 KATONDA AMALIRIZA OMULIMU GWE "Mukama alituukiriza ebyo by’anteekeddeteekedde" Zabbuli 138:8 Oyo eyatandika alyongera okukola omulimu ogukolebwa munda mu mwoyo gwange. Mukama afaayo ku buli kintu ekinkwatako. Byonna ebirungi kaakano, naye nga tebinnatuukirira, Mukama alibikuuma, alibirabirira, era alibituusa ku nkomerero. Kino kya kubudaabudibwa kunene. Sandisobodde kutuukiriza mulimu gwa kisa nzekka. Ekyo nkikakasa ddala, kubanga buli lunaku ndemererwa, era nnyweredde okutuusa kaakano kubanga Mukama y’annyambye. Singa Mukama andeka, byonna bye nnayitamu emabega byandibadde bya bwereere, ne nzikirira mu kkubo. Naye Mukama alyongera okumpa omukisa. Alituukiriza okukkiriza kwange, okwagala kwange, empisa zange, n’omulimu gw’obulamu bwange. Alikola kino kubanga yatandika omulimu mu nze. Ye yampa okufaayo kwe mpulira, era, mu ngeri emu, atuukirizza ebyegombo byange eby’ekisa. Talekaawo mulimu nga tegumalirizibwa; ekyo tekyandibadde kya kitiibwa kye, era tekyandimufaananye. Amanyi engeri ey’okutuukirizaamu enteekateeka ye ey’ekisa, era newaakubadde ng’obutonde bwange obubi, n’ensi, ne Setaani, byonna bikolagana okumuziyiza, sibuusabuusa kisuubizo kye. Alituukiriza ebyo by’anteekeddeteekedde, era ndimutendereza emirembe gyonna. Mukama, omulimu gwo ogw’ekisa gugende mu maaso katono leero! Apuli 28 KIFUUKA KYA MBALI ZOMBI "Nnaabeeranga mu bo era natambuliranga mu bo, nnaabeeranga Katonda waabwe, nabo banaabeeranga bantu bange" 2 Abakkolinso 6:16 Wano waliwo okwegatta okwa mbali zombi. Buli omu wa munne. Katonda gwe mugabo gw’abantu be, n’abantu abalonde gwe mugabo gwa Katonda waabwe. Abatukuvu basanga mu Katonda ekintu kyabwe ekisinga, era Ye abatwala ng’eky’obugagga kye eky’enjawulo. Nga kirombe kya kubudaabudibwa ekiri mu nsonga eno eri buli mukkiriza! Embeera eno ey’essanyu ey’okwegatta okwa mbali zombi eleeta okufaayo okwa mbali zombi. Katonda anaalowoozanga ku bantu be bulijjo, nabo banaamulowoozangako bulijjo. Leero Katonda wange alintuukiriza byonna; nze nsobola kumukolera ki? Ebirowoozo byange bisaanidde okudda gy’ali, kubanga Ye andowoozaako. Ka nkakase nti bwe kityo bwe kiri, so si kumatira na kukkiriza bukkirizi nti bwe kisaanidde okuba. Kino nate kireeta okussa ekimu okwa mbali zombi. Katonda abeera mu ffe, naffe tubeera mu Ye; atambula naffe, naffe tutambula ne Katonda. Nga kwe kwegatta okw’essanyu! Singa mfuna ekisa okuyisa Mukama nga Katonda wange: okumwesiga n’okumuweereza, ng’obwakatonda bwe bwe busaanira! Singa nsobola okwagala, okusinza, okugulumiza n’okugondera Yakuwa mu mwoyo ne mu mazima! Kino kye kyegombo ky’omutima gwange. Bwe ndikituukako, nga nzudde eggulu lyange. Mukama, nnyamba! Beera Katonda wange ng’onnyamba okukumanya nga Katonda wange, ku lwa Yesu. Apuli 29 WEERABIRE ERA OSONYIWE "Toyogera nti, 'Nzija kukusasula olw’ekibi kino!' Lindirira Mukama alikuyamba" Engero 20:22 Toyanguyiriza. Leka obusungu bukkakkane. Toyogera kigambo era tokola kintu kya kwesasuza. Ojja kukola mu butagezi ddala bw’okwata omuggo n’olwana entalo zo ggwe kennyini; era, mazima ddala, tojja kulaga mwoyo gwa Mukama Yesu. Kya kitiibwa okusingawo okusonyiwa, n’oleka ekyonoono ne kiyitawo. Okuleka ekikuyisiddwa obubi ne kikuzimbira mu kifuba, n’okulowooza ku kwesasuza, kwe kuleka ebiwundu eby’edda nga bikyayasamye, n’okuleetawo ebiggya. Kirungi okwerabira n’okusonyiwa. Oboolyawo ogamba nti oteekwa okukolawo ekintu, si ekyo n’ofiirwa nnyo; kale kola ekisuubizo ky’enkya eno kye kikuwa amagezi: "Lindirira Mukama alikuyamba." Amagezi gano tegaakusasuze nsimbi, naye ga muwendo okusinga ennyo. Beera mukkakkamu era musirise. Lindirira Mukama: mubuulire ekikuluma: yanjuluza ebbaluwa ya Labusake mu maaso ga Mukama, era ekyo kyokka kiriwummuza ebirowoozo byo ebizitoowereddwa. Ate era, waliwo ekisuubizo nti, "Alikuyamba." Katonda alikuzuulira ekkubo ery’okuwonamu. Bw’alikikola, ggwe nange tetuyinza kuteebereza, naye ajja kukikola. Mukama bw’akulokola, kino kiriba kirungi nnyo okusinga okuyingira mu nnyombo ez’obusirusiru, n’okwesiiga obukyafu ng’omeggana n’abatali balongoofu. Tosunguwala nate. Omusango gwo guleke eri Omulamuzi wa bonna. Apuli 30 EMPEERA Y’OYO AWANGULA "Oyo awangula ndimuwa ku maanu eyakwekebwa. Era ndimuwa ejjinja eryeru eriwandiikiddwako erinnya eriggya eritamanyiddwa muntu mulala yenna wabula oyo aliweereddwa" Okubikkulirwa 2:17 Ggwe mutima gwange, weekubirize okunyiikirira mu lutalo olutukuvu, kubanga empeera y’obuwanguzi nnene. Leero tulya ku mmere ey’omu ggulu egwa okwetooloola olusiisira lwaffe; emmere ey’omu ddungu, emmere eva mu ggulu, emmere etakendeera eri abatambuze abagenda e Kanani. Naye waliwo ekituterekeddwa mu Kristo Yesu, eddaala ery’obulamu obw’omwoyo erisingako obuwanvu, n’emmere yaalyo nga kaakano ekyakwekeddwa ku byo bye tumanyi. Mu kibya ekya zaabu ekyaterekebwa mu ssanduuko mwalimu ekitundu kya maanu ekyakwekebwa, ne bwe kyamala emyaka mingi nga kiterekeddwa tekyavunda. Tewali n’omu eyakirabako; kyakwekebwa awamu n’essanduuko ey’endagaano, mu Watukuvu w’Awatukuvu. Bwe kityo, obulamu bw’omukkiriza obusingayo bukwekeddwa mu Kristo mu Katonda. Tunaatera okubutuukako. Bwe tulimala okufuulibwa abawanguzi olw’ekisa kya Mukama waffe Yesu, tulirya ku mmere ya Kabaka, ne tuliira ku by’okulya eby’obwakabaka ebiwooma. Tuliriira ku Yesu. Ye "maanu eyakwekebwa" yaffe, era ye maanu ey’omu ddungu. Ye byonna mu byonna gye tuli mu mbeera yaffe esinga okuba waggulu, ne mu esinga okuba wansi. Atuyamba okulwana, atuwa obuwanguzi, n’oluvannyuma Ye yennyini y’afuuka empeera yaffe. Mukama, nnyamba okuwangula.

fields.title: Omwezi gwa Maayi
fields.body_html:
Maayi 1

EBIJJUDDE OLUYIMBA

"Ensozi n’obusozi nabyo ne bitandika okuyimba nga bibalabye, n’emiti gyonna ne gitendereza n’essanyu" Isaaya 55:12

Ekibi bwe kisonyiyibwa, ennaku yaffe esinga obunene eba eggwaawo, n’essanyu lyaffe erya nnamaddala ne litandika. Essanyu Mukama ly’awa abo be yatabaganya naye liba lingi nnyo ne liyiika, ne lijjuza ebitonde byonna okujaguza. Ensi eno ey’ebintu ebirabika erimu ennyimba ezikwekeddwa munda, era omutima ogwazzibwa obuggya gumanyi engeri y’okuziggyamu ne guzifuula eddoboozi. Obutonde ye nnanga, era omuntu aliko ekisa azuula ebifuumbiro byayo, n’abiteekako engalo ze, n’azuukusa ensi yonna n’ebigirimu okuyimba mu kutegeeragana okw’okutendereza. Ensozi n’obusozi, n’ebintu ebirala ebinene, bye bifaanana ng’amaloboozi aga wansi ag’ekibiina ky’abayimbi; ate emiti egy’omu kibira, n’ebintu byonna ebiramu, bye bikwata oluyimba lwennyini olw’ennyimba ennyuvu.

Ekigambo kya Katonda bwe kikulaakulana mu ffe, n’emyoyo ne girokolebwa, olwo buli kimu kirabika nga kijjudde oluyimba. Bwe tuwulira okwatula kw’abakkiriza abato, n’obujulirwa bw’abatukuvu abayigirizibwa obulungi, tusanyuka nnyo ne kituwaliriza okutendereza Mukama, era olwo kirabika ng’enjazi n’obusozi, n’ebibira n’ennimiro, biddamu amaloboozi g’essanyu lyaffe, ne bifuula ensi ekibiina ky’abakubi b’ebivuga. Mukama, ku lunaku luno olw’essanyu olwa Maayi, ntwala mu nsi yo ejjudde ennyimba, nga njjudde okutendereza ng’akanyonyi akayimba mu bujjuvu.

Maayi 2

OKUSIGA MU MWOYO

"Oyo asiga eri omwoyo, alikungula obulamu obutaggwaawo" Abaggalatiya 6:8

Okusiga kulabika ng’omulimu ogufiirwa, kubanga tuteeka eŋŋaano ennungi mu ttaka ne tutagiddamu kugiraba. Okusiga eri Omwoyo kulabika ng’omulimu ogw’ebirooto, ogutaliimu; kubanga tweefiiriza, ne tulabika nga tetulina kye tufunamu. Naye bwe tusiga eri Omwoyo nga tufuba okubeera abalamu eri Katonda, nga tunoonya okugondera Katonda by’ayagala, era nga twewaayo okukuza ekitiibwa kye, tetulisiga bwereere. Obulamu bwe buliba empeera yaffe, obulamu obutaggwaawo. Buno tubunyumirwa wano bwe tuyingira mu kumanya Katonda, mu kussa ekimu ne Katonda, ne mu kusanyukira Katonda. Obulamu buno bukulukuta ng’omugga ogweyongera okukka wansi n’okugaziwa, okutuusa lwe butututusa ku nnyanja ey’essanyu eritaliiko kkomo, obulamu bwa Katonda gye bubeera obwaffe emirembe n’emirembe.

Leero tuleme kusiga eri omubiri gwaffe, kubanga amakungula galiba kuvunda, kubanga omubiri bulijjo gudda eyo; naye n’okwefuga okutukuvu tubeere abalamu ku lw’ebigendererwa ebisinga obukulu, ebisinga obulongoofu, n’ebisinga okuba eby’omwoyo, nga tunoonya okuwa Mukama waffe omutukuvu ennyo ekitiibwa nga tugondera Omwoyo we ow’ekisa ekingi. Nga galiba makungula ga ngeri ki bwe tulikungula obulamu obutaggwaawo! Nga biriba binywa bya ssanyu eritaggwaawo ebirikungulwa! Ng’amakungula ago galiba mbaga ki! Mukama, tufuule abakunguzi ab’engeri eyo, ku lw’Omwana wo.

Maayi 3

WULIRIZA AKABONERO

"Awo olunaatuuka bw’onoowulira abakumba ku masanso g’emitugunda, oyanguwe okulumba, kubanga ekyo kinaategeeza nti Mukama akukulembedde okuzikiriza eggye ly’Abafirisuuti" 2 Samwiri 5:24

Waliwo obubonero obw’okutambula kwa Mukama obulina okututambuza. Omwoyo wa Katonda akuntira gy’ayagala, era tuwulira okuwuuma kwe. Ekyo kye kiseera ffe okunyiikira okusinga bwe tuli bulijjo. Tuteekwa okukwata akaseera ako aka zaabu, ne tukakozesa nga bwe tusobola. Kya ffe okulwana n’Abafirisuuti ebiseera byonna; naye Mukama yennyini bw’atukulembera, olwo tulina okubeera abazira mu lutalo mu ngeri ey’enjawulo.

Empewo yakunta ku masanso g’emiti, Dawudi n’abasajja be ne bakitwala ng’akabonero ak’okulumba, era bwe baakumba, Mukama yennyini n’azikiriza Abafirisuuti. Kale singa leero Mukama atuwa omwagaanya okumwogerako eri mikwano gyaffe bangi! Tubeere bulindaala okukozesa omwagaanya ogw’essuubi bwe gujja. Ani amanyi, leero luyinza okuba olunaku olw’amawulire amalungi; ekiseera eky’okuwangula emyoyo. Tutege amatu gaffe okuwulira okuwuuma kw’empewo, n’ebirowoozo byaffe bibeere nga byetegese okugondera akabonero. Ekisuubizo kino, "Mukama akukulembedde," tekimala okutuzzaamu amaanyi okwesimba ng’abasajja? Mukama nga bw’atukulembera, tetusobola kudda nnyuma.

Maayi 4

OBUWANGUZI MU KUGWA

"Tonjeeyereza ggwe omulabe wange, kubanga wadde ngudde, nnaayimuka. Ne bwe naatuula mu kizikiza, Mukama anaabeera ekitangaala kyange" Mikka 7:8

Kino kiyinza okwogera ebiri mu mutima gw’omusajja oba omukazi alinnyiririrwa era ajoogebwa. Omulabe waffe ayinza okuzikiza ekitangaala kyaffe okumala ekiseera. Waliwo essuubi eddene gye tuli mu Mukama; era bwe tuba tumwesiga, nga tunywerera ku bwesimbu bwaffe, ekiseera kyaffe eky’okugwa n’eky’ekizikiza kinaatera okuggwaawo. Okuvuma kw’omulabe kwa kaseera buseera. Mukama ajja kufuula mangu okuseka kwabwe okukungubaga, n’okusinda kwaffe akufuule okuyimba.

Ne bwe kiba nti omulabe omukulu ow’emyoyo atuwangula okumala akaseera, nga bwe yawangula abasajja abatusinga obulungi, kyokka tugume omwoyo, kubanga tujja kumuwangula mu bbanga ttono. Tujja kuyimuka okuva mu kugwa kwaffe, kubanga Katonda waffe tagudde, era ajja kutuyimusa. Tetujja kusigala mu kizikiza, wadde nga kaakano tukituddemu; kubanga Mukama waffe ye nsulo y’ekitangaala, era ajja kutuleetera mangu olunaku olw’essanyu. Tuleme kuggwaamu ssuubi, wadde okubuusabuusa. Nnamuziga bw’akyuka omulundi gumu, ali wansi ennyo aba waggulu. Zibasanze abaseka kaakano, kubanga balikungubaga ne bakaaba, okwenyumiriza kwabwe bwe kulifuulibwa okuswazibwa okutaggwaawo. Naye balina omukisa abatukuvu bonna abali mu nnaku, kubanga Katonda alibasanyusa.

Maayi 5

LWAKI OSIGALA MU BUSIBE?

"Mukama Katonda wo anaakusaasiranga n’akuzza mu mbeera yo ennungi" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 30:3

Abantu ba Katonda bennyini bayinza okwetunda mu busibe olw’ekibi. Kino kibala kikaawa nnyo, eky’omulandira ogukaawa ennyo. Nga buba busibe bwa ngeri ki, omwana wa Katonda bw’atundibwa mu kibi, n’asibwa enjegere za Setaani, n’aggyibwako eddembe lye, n’anyagibwa amaanyi ge mu kusaba, n’essanyu lye mu Mukama! Twekuume tuleme kuyingira mu busibe obw’engeri eyo; naye bwe kiba nga kimaze okututuukako, tuleme n’akatono okuggwaamu essuubi.

Naye tetuyinza kusibibwa mu buddu emirembe gyonna. Mukama Yesu yasasula omuwendo munene nnyo olw’okununulibwa kwaffe, n’olwekyo tayinza kutuleka mu mukono gw’omulabe. Ekkubo ery’eddembe lye lino: "Dda eri Mukama Katonda wo." Gye twasooka okusanga obulokozi gye tulibusangira nate. Wansi w’omusaalaba gwa Kristo nga twatula ekibi kyaffe, tulisangayo okusonyiyibwa n’okuwonyezebwa. Ate era, Mukama ayagala tugondere eddoboozi lye ng’ebyo byonna bye yatulagira bwe biri, era kino tulina okukikola n’omutima gwaffe gwonna n’emmeeme yaffe yonna, olwo obusibe bwaffe bulyoke buggweewo.

Emirundi mingi okwennyamira mu mwoyo n’ennaku ennyingi ez’emmeeme biggwaawo amangu ddala nga tulese ebifaananyi byaffe ne tuvuunamira mu buwulize mu maaso ga Katonda omulamu. Tetulina kubeera basibe. Tusobola okuddayo mu bukungu bwa Sayuuni, era mangu ddala. Mukama, tuzze mu mbeera yaffe ennungi!

Maayi 6

EDDAGALA LY’OBUGGYA

"Omutima gwo gulemenga okukwatirwa aboonoonyi obuggya, kyokka nyiikira okutya Mukama ebbanga lyonna. Mazima ddala onoobanga n’essuubi mu biseera eby’omu maaso, n’essuubi lyo eryo teririggwaawo" Engero 23:17, 18

Bwe tulaba ababi nga bagaggawala, tutera okubakwatirwa obuggya. Bwe tuwulira oluyoogaano lw’okujaguza kwabwe, ng’omwoyo gwaffe gwe guzitowa, tubeera nga tulowooza nti bo be balina obulungi. Kino kya busirusiru era kya kibi. Singa tubamanyi obulungi, era naddala singa tujjukira enkomerero yaabwe, twandibasaasidde.

Eddagala ly’obuggya liri mu kubeera nga tumanyi bulijjo nti Katonda ali naffe, nga tumusinza era nga tussa ekimu naye olunaku lwonna, olunaku ne bwe lulabika nga luwanvu lutya. Eddiini ey’amazima esitula emmeeme n’egitwala mu kifo ekya waggulu, okusalawo gye kufuukira okutegeerekeka obulungi, n’okwegomba gye kulinnyisibwa. Eggulu bwe lyeyongera mu bulamu bwaffe, ensi gye tweyongera obutagyegomba. Okutya Katonda kugoba obuggya bw’abantu.

Ekitta obuggya ddala kwe kulowooza n’obukkakkamu ku biseera eby’omu maaso. Obugagga n’ekitiibwa by’abatatya Katonda kirabika kya bwereere. Okulabika kuno okw’amalala kumyansa okumala essaawa emu, n’oluvannyuma ne kuzikira. Omwonoonyi agaggawadde afuna ki mu bugagga bwe omusango bwe gumutuukako? Naye omuntu atya Katonda, enkomerero ye ya mirembe na mukisa, era tewali n’omu ayinza kumunyaga ssanyu lye; kale, aleke obuggya, ajjule okumatira okuwoomerera.

Maayi 7

EKIBI KIREME KUSIGALAWO

"Tewaabeerengawo kintu na kimu ku ebyo ebinaabanga bimaze okukolimirwa ky’onoosangibwanga nakyo, bwe butyo obusungu bwa Mukama obunaabanga obungi ennyo bunakkakkananga; anaakukwatirwanga ekisa, n’akulaganga okwagala kwe, n’akwongeranga okwala, nga bwe yalayirira bajjajjaabo" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 13:17

Isirayiri yalina okuwangula ebibuga ebyasinza ebifaananyi, n’okuzikiriza omunyago gwonna, nga batwala ekintu kyonna ekyayonoonebwa okusinza ebifaananyi ng’ekintu ekikolimiddwa ekiteekwa okwokebwa omuliro. Kale, Abakristaayo balina okuyisa ekibi eky’engeri zonna mu ngeri y’emu. Tetuteekwa kukkiriza mpisa mbi n’emu kusigalawo. Kaakano lutalo lwa kufa n’okuwona n’ebibi eby’engeri zonna n’obunene bwonna, oba eby’omubiri, oba eby’ebirowoozo, oba eby’omwoyo. Okuleka ekibi kuno tetukutwala ng’okusaanira okusaasirwa, naye tukutwala ng’ekibala eky’ekisa kya Katonda, kye tutayagala kubulwa n’akatono.

Katonda bw’atufuula abatasaasira bibi byaffe, olwo aba atusaasira nnyo. Bwe tusunguwalira ekibi, Katonda aba takyatusunguwalira. Bwe twongera okufuba okulwanyisa obutali butuukirivu, Mukama yongera emikisa gyaffe. Ekkubo ery’emirembe, ery’okukula, ery’obukuumi, n’ery’essanyu mu Kristo Yesu liri mu kugoberera ebigambo bino: "Tewaabeerengawo kintu na kimu ku ebyo ebinaabanga bimaze okukolimirwa ky’onoosangibwanga nakyo." Mukama, ndongoosa leero. Okusaasirwa, okukulaakulana, okwala, n’essanyu, mazima biriweebwa abo abaggyawo ekibi n’obumalirivu obw’amaanyi.

Maayi 8

ABAKOZI BEETAAGIBWA

"Nammwe mugende mukole mu nnimiro yange ey’emizabbibu, era nnaabasasula empeera ebasaanira" Matayo 20:7

Weewaawo, mu nnimiro ya Kristo ey’emizabbibu mulimu omulimu gw’abakaddiye. Y’essaawa ekkumi n’emu, naye era akkiriza tukole. Nga kino kisa kya ngeri ki! Mazima buli musajja omukadde asaanidde okwanguyiriza okukkiriza okuyita kuno! Abantu bwe bakaddiwa, tewaba n’omu abeetaaga ng’abakozi; bagenda okuva mu dduuka erimu okudda mu ddala, ba nnannyini mirimu ne batunuulira envi zaabwe, ne banyeenya emitwe. Naye Yesu apangisa abakadde, era abasasula n’empeera ennungi! Kino kya kusaasira ddala. Mukama, yamba abakaddiye okwewaayo mu kuweereza kwo awatali kulwa n’essaawa emu.

Naye Mukama alisasula abakadde abaweddemu amaanyi empeera? Tokibuusabuusa. Agamba nti alikuwa ekigwanidde bw’onookola mu nnimiro ye. Mazima alikuwa ekisa wano n’ekitiibwa eyo. Alikuwa okubudaabudibwa kaakano n’okuwummula ekigenda okujja; amaanyi agenkana olunaku lwo, n’okulaba ekitiibwa ekiro eky’okufa bwe kirituuka. Ebyo byonna Mukama Yesu alibiwa buwi omukadde akyuse nga bw’abiwa oyo ayingira mu kuweereza kwe mu buvubuka bwe.

Ka ntegeeze kino omusajja omukadde oba omukazi omukadde atannalokoka, era nsabe Mukama akiwe omukisa, ku lwa Yesu. Abantu ab’engeri eyo mbasanga wa? Nja kubeera mulindaala okubanoonya, mbabuulire amawulire n’ekisa.

Maayi 9

OKWESIGA KUTEGEEZA SSANYU

"Mu ye emitima gyaffe mwe gijaguliza, kubanga twesiga erinnya lye ettukuvu" Zabbuli 33:21

Omulandira gw’okukkiriza guzaala ekimuli ky’essanyu ery’omu mutima. Tuyinza obutasooka kusanyuka, naye lijja mu kiseera kyalyo. Twesiga Mukama nga tunakuwadde, era mu kiseera ekituufu addamu obwesige bwaffe mu ngeri nti okukkiriza kwaffe kufuuka kutuukirira, ne tusanyukira Mukama. Okubuusabuusa kuzaala okweraliikirira, naye okwesiga kutegeeza ssanyu ku nkomerero.

Obukakafu Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bw’ayogera mu lunyiriri luno mu butuufu kisuubizo ekikwatiddwa mu mikono gy’obwesige obutukuvu. Nga twetaaga ekisa okukifuula ekyaffe! Bwe tuba nga tetusanyuka mu kaseera kano, naye tujja kusanyuka, nga Katonda wa Dawudi bw’ali Katonda waffe mu butuufu.

Tufumiitirize ku linnya lya Mukama ettukuvu, tulyoke tumwesige obulungi era tusanyuke mangu. Mu mpisa ze mutukuvu, mwenkanya, wa mazima, wa kisa, mwesigwa era takyukakyuka. Katonda ow’engeri eyo tasaanidde kwesigibwa? Wa magezi gonna, ayinzabyonna, era abeera buli wamu; tetuyinza kumwesiga n’essanyu? Weewaawo, tujja kukikola kaakano, era tukikole awatali kwekengera. Yakuwa-Yire alitugabirira, Yakuwa-Salumu aliweereza emirembe, Yakuwa-Tsidkenu alituwa obutuukirivu, Yakuwa-Samma alibeera kumpi emirembe gyonna, era mu Yakuwa-Nissi tuliwangula buli mulabe. Abo abamanyi erinnya lyo banaakwesiganga; n’abo abakwesiga banaakusanyukiranga, Ayi Mukama.

Maayi 10

TYA KATONDA YEKKA

"Kyetuva twogera n’obuvumu nti, 'Mukama ye mubeezi wange, siityenga, omuntu ayinza kunkola ki?'" Abaebbulaniya 13:6

Olw’okuba Katonda talitulekanga era talitwabulira n’akatono, bye tulina bisaanidde okutumala. Mukama bw’aba waffe, tetuyinza kusigala nga tetulina mukwano, oba obugagga, oba ekifo eky’okubeeramu. Obukakafu buno buyinza okutuleetera okuwulira nga tetwesigamye ku bantu n’akatono. Nga tuli wansi w’obukuumi obw’ekitiibwa bwe butyo, tetukemebwa kwekulukuunya mu maaso ga bannaffe, nga tubasaba olukusa okuyita obulamu bwaffe obwaffe; wabula kye twogera tukyogera n’obuvumu, era tetutya kuwakanyizibwa.

Atya Katonda talina kirala kya kutya. Tusaanidde okutya Mukama omulamu n’entiisa ey’ekitiibwa bwe kityo nti ebitiisa byonna omuyigganya asingayo amalala by’ayinza okukozesa bitaba na kikolwa kyonna ku ffe okusinga okufuuwa kw’empewo. Omuntu mu nnaku zino tasobola kutukola bingi nga bwe yali asobola omutume bwe yawandiika olunyiriri oluli waggulu w’olupapula luno. Ebyuma eby’okubonyaabonyeza n’emiti egy’okwokerako biweddewo. Omuzira Paapa tasobola kwokya batambuze kaakano. Abagoberezi b’abayigiriza ab’obulimba bwe bagezaako okutuduula n’okutunyooma mu ngeri enkambwe, tekitwewuunyisa, kubanga abantu b’ensi eno tebasobola kwagala zadde lya mu ggulu. Kale ki? Tuteekwa okugumira okunyoomebwa kw’ensi. Tekumenya magumba. Katonda ng’atuyamba, tubeere bavumu, era ensi bw’esunguwala ka esunguwale, naye ffe tetugitya.

Maayi 11

LINDIRIRA EBY’ENKOMERERO

"Gaadi alirumbibwa ogubiina gw’abanyazi, naye ye, alibafubutukira emabega." Olubereberye 49:19

Abamu ku ffe tubadde ng’ekika kya Gaadi. Abalabe baffe okumala akaseera baatusukkirira obungi, baatulumba ng’ogubiina gw’abanyazi. Weewaawo, era mu kaseera ako baatuwangula; ne bajaguza nnyo olw’obuwanguzi bwabwe obw’akaseera obutono. Bwe batyo baakakasa bukakasa nti ekitundu ekisooka eky’obusika bw’ennyumba kyaffe ddala, kubanga abantu ba Kristo, nga Ddaani, balirumbibwa ogubiina. Okuwangulwa kuno kulumya nnyo, era twandiggyiddwaamu essuubi singa tetwakkiriza lwa kukkiriza olunyiriri olw’okubiri olw’omukisa gwa kitaffe nti, "naye ye, alibafubutukira emabega." "Byonna biba birungi ebiggwa obulungi," bw’atyo omutontomi w’ensi bwe yagamba; era yayogera mazima. Olutalo terusalirwa musango olw’obuwanguzi oba okuwangulwa okusooka, wabula olw’ekyo ekibaawo "ku nkomerero." Mukama aliwa amazima n’obutuukirivu obuwanguzi "ku nkomerero"; era, nga Mr. Bunyan bw’agamba, ekyo kitegeeza emirembe n’emirembe, kubanga tewali kiyinza kujja luvannyuma lwa nkomerero.

Kye twetaaga bwe bugumiikiriza obutakoowa mu kukola obulungi, n’obwesige obw’emirembe mu Muduumizi waffe ow’ekitiibwa. Kristo, Mukama waffe Yesu, ayagala okutuyigiriza obukugu bwe obutukuvu obw’okunyweza amaaso ng’ejjinja eggumu okuyita mu mulimu oba mu kubonaabona okutuusa lwe tusobola okugamba nti, "Kiwedde." Aleruuya. Obuwanguzi! Obuwanguzi! Tukkiriza ekisuubizo. "Naye ye, alibafubutukira emabega."

Maayi 12

ABAWEEREZA BASSIBWAMU EKITIIBWA

"Buli alabirira omutiini alirya ku bibala byagwo, n’oyo aweereza mukama we alissibwamu ekitiibwa" Engero 27:18

Alabirira omutiini afuna ettiini olw’okutegana kwe, n’oyo aweereza mukama we omulungi afuna ekitiibwa nga ye mpeera ye. Mazima Mukama Yesu ye mukama asingira ddala obulungi, era kitiibwa okukkirizibwa okukola ekikolwa ekisingayo obutono ku lulwe. Okuweereza bakama abamu kwe kulabirira omuti ogw’ebibala ebikaawa n’okulya ebibala ebyo ebikaawa ng’empeera yo; naye okuweereza Mukama wange Yesu kwe kulabirira omutiini ogw’ettiini ezisingayo okuwoomerera. Okumuweereza mu kwokka kwe kusanyuka, okunyiikira mu kwo kwe kukuzibwa, okukulaakulana mu kwo bwe bulamu obw’omukisa wano wansi, n’empeera yaakwo kye kitiibwa waggulu.

Ebitiibwa byaffe ebisingayo obukulu birikungaanyizibwa mu kiseera ekyo ettiini lwe zinaaba zeengedde, mu nsi ejja. Bamalayika abatuweereza kaakano balitutwala eka omulimu gw’olunaku lwaffe bwe guliba guwedde. Eggulu, Yesu gy’ali, lye liriba ennyumba yaffe ey’ekitiibwa, essanyu ery’olubeerera gwe guliba omugabo gwaffe ogw’ekitiibwa, ne Mukama yennyini ye aliba munnaffe ow’ekitiibwa. Ani ayinza okutegeera amakulu gonna ag’ekisuubizo kino nti, "oyo aweereza mukama we alissibwamu ekitiibwa"?

Mukama, nnyamba okuweereza Mukama wange. Ka ndeke ekirowoozo kyonna eky’ekitiibwa okutuusa essaawa ggwe kennyini lw’olinzisaamu ekitiibwa. Omwoyo wo Omutukuvu anfuule omukozi era omuweereza omwetoowaze era omugumiikiriza!

Maayi 13

OBUDDE BUNAATERA OKUKYA

"Era ndimuwa emmunyeenye ey’enkya" Okubikkulirwa 2:28

Okutuusa obudde nga bukedde n’ebisiikirize nga biddukidde ddala, nga mukisa gwa maanyi okulaba mu Yesu "emmunyeenye ey’enkya"! Nzijukira bwe twasoma mu mpapula z’amawulire olugero olw’obusa nti emmunyeenye ey’e Besirekemu yali erabiseeko nate. Bwe twabuuliriza ne tukizuula nti yali "emmunyeenye ey’enkya" yokka; naye ate era tewali nsobi nnene eyali ekoleddwa.

Ekisinga obulungi kwe kulaba Yesu ng’enjuba; naye bwe tutasobola kukikola, ekiddirira mu bulungi kwe kumulaba ng’emmunyeenye eyo eragula obudde, era eraga nti ekitangaala eky’olubeerera kiri kumpi. Bwe mba leero siri kyonna kye nsuubira okuba, naye ndaba Yesu, era ekyo kinkakasa nti lumu ndifaanana nga ye. Okulaba Yesu olw’okukkiriza gwe musingo ogw’okumulaba mu kitiibwa kye n’okufuulibwa okufaanana ekifaananyi kye. Bwe mba mu ssaawa eno sirina kitangaala kyonna na ssanyu lyonna bye nnandyegombye, naye ndibifuna; kubanga nga bwe ndaba emmunyeenye ey’enkya, bwe ntyo bwe ndiraba obudde nga bukedde. Emmunyeenye ey’enkya tebeera wala n’enjuba.

Jjangu, mwoyo gwange, Mukama akuwadde emmunyeenye ey’enkya? Onywerera ku mazima, n’ekisa, n’essuubi, n’okwagala Mukama by’akuwadde? Kale mu kino olina emmambya ey’ekitiibwa ekijja. Oyo akuwangulisa obubi, n’akunyweza mu butuukirivu, mu ekyo akuwadde emmunyeenye ey’enkya.

Maayi 14

OKULONGOOSA OKW’OKUWONYA

"Mujje, tudde eri Mukama. Atutaaguddetaagudde, naye alituwonya; atuleeseeko ebiwundu, naye ebiwundu alibinyiga Koseya 6:1

Empisa ya Mukama kwe kutaagulataagula nga tannawonya. Kuno kwe kwagala okw’amazima okw’omutima gwe, era kwe kulongoosa okukakafu okw’omukono gwe. Era aleetako ebiwundu nga tannabinyiga, kubanga bwe kitaba bwe kityo gwandibadde mulimu gutali mukakafu. Amateeka gakulembera Enjiri; okuwulira obwetaavu kukulembera okubuweebwa. Omusomi kaakano ali wansi w’omukono gw’Omwoyo ogulumiriza era ogubetenta? Afunye omwoyo ogw’obuddu ate atye? Kino kye kisooka ekigasa, ekikulembera okuwonyezebwa n’okunyigibwa ebiwundu okw’Enjiri okw’amazima.

Toggwaamu ssuubi, mutima omwagalwa, wabula jja eri Mukama n’ebiwundu byo byonna ebitaagulataaguddwa, n’ebinuubule ebiddugavu, n’amabwa agakulukuta. Ye yekka asobola okuwonya, era asanyukira okukikola. Mulimu gwa Mukama waffe okunyiga ebiwundu by’abalina emitima egimenyese, era agukola n’obukugu obw’ekitiibwa. Tetulwawo, wabula amangu ago tudde eri Mukama gwe twava ne tubula. Tumulage ebiwundu byaffe ebyasamye, era tumwegayirire amanye omulimu gwe ye kennyini, era agumalirize. Omulongoosa asala omuntu, n’alyoka aleka omulwadde we okukulukuta omusaayi n’afa? Mukama alimenya ennyumba yaffe enkadde, n’alyoka agaana okutuzimbira esinga obulungi? Wali weeyongezaako ennaku z’emyoyo emyavu egyeraliikirira awatali nsonga? Ekyo kibeere wala naawe, Ayi Mukama.

Maayi 15

EBIFO BYA KATONDA EBYA WAGGULU

"Nnaamukuumanga, kubanga amanyi erinnya lyange Zabbuli 91:14

Mukama kino akiŋŋamba nze? Weewaawo, bwe mba nga mmanyi erinnya lye. Mukama yeebazibwe, siri mugwira gy’ali. Mmugezezza, era mmukakasizza, era mmumanyi, era, noolwekyo, mmwesiga. Mmanyi erinnya lye nga Katonda akyawa ekibi, kubanga olw’amaanyi g’Omwoyo we agalumiriza nnayigirizibwa nti talibuusa maaso ku bubi n’akatono. Naye era mmumanyi nga Katonda asonyiwa ekibi mu Kristo Yesu, kubanga ansonyiye ebyonoono byonna. Erinnya lye bwe bwesigwa, era nkimanyi, kubanga tandekangako n’akatono newankubadde ebizibu byange byanneeyongerako.

Okumanya kuno kirabo kya kisa, era Mukama akufuula ensonga lwaki awa ekirabo eky’ekisa ekirala, kwe kugamba, okumussa waggulu. Kino kisa ku kisa. Weetegereze nti bwe tulinnya waggulu ku lwaffe, ekifo ekyo kiyinza okuba eky’akabi; naye Mukama bw’atussaayo, kiba kya mirembe. Ayinza okutuyimusa okutuuka ku kugasa okw’amaanyi, ku bumanyirivu obw’ekitalo, ku kukulaakulana mu kuweereza, ku bukulembeze mu bakozi, ku kifo kya kitaawe mu baana abato. Bw’atakikola, ayinza okutussa waggulu olw’okussa ekimu okw’okumpi, n’okutegeera okutangaavu, n’obuwanguzi obutukuvu, n’okusuubira okw’ekisa okw’ekitiibwa eky’olubeerera. Katonda bw’atussa waggulu, Setaani yennyini tasobola kutuwanula. Kale singa kino kibeera bwe kityo gye tuli olunaku lwonna lwa leero!

Maayi 16

TUFUNA NGA BWE TUGABA

"Balina omukisa ab’ekisa, kubanga abo balikwatirwa ekisa" Matayo 5:7

Tekisaana nti omuntu atayagala kusonyiwa asonyiyibwe, era n’oyo atayagala kugabira baavu ebyetaago bye tebirimalibwa. Katonda alitupimira n’ebipimo byaffe ffe, era abo ababadde bakama abakambwe era ababanja abakambwe balikizuula nti Mukama alibayisa n’obukambwe. "Abo abatalina kisa, nabo tebalikwatirwa kisa."

Olunaku lwa leero tugezeeko okugaba n’okusonyiwa. Tujjukire ebiragiro ebibiri -- okugumira n’okwezibiira. Tubeere ba kisa, era abakkakkamu, era abagonvu. Tuleme kuteeka makulu makambwe ku bikolwa by’abantu, wadde okukaayana ennyo mu by’obusuubuzi, wadde okutandika enkaayana ez’obusirusiru, wadde okuba abazibu okusanyusa. Mazima twagala okuweebwa omukisa, era twagala n’okukwatirwa ekisa: tubeere ba kisa, tulyoke tukwatirwe ekisa. Tutuukirize ekisaanyizo, tulyoke tufune omukisa ogwo. Okuba ow’ekisa si mulimu gusanyusa? Temuli buwoomerevu bungi nnyo okusinga okusunguwala n’okuba omukodo? Kale, waliwo omukisa mu kintu kyennyini! Ate era, okukwatirwa ekisa mpeera ya bugagga. Kiki ekirala okuggyako ekisa ekifuga byonna ekyandiyinzizza okuleeta ekisuubizo ng’ekyo? Tukwatirwa munnaffe omuntu ekisa mu bupeesa obutono, Mukama n’atusonyiwa ''ebbanja eryo lyonna.''

Maayi 17

TEKYETAAGISA KWEKEKKEREZA

"Abatuukirivu balisikira ebirungi" Engero 28:10

Ekitabo ky’Engero era Kitabo kya Bisuubizo. Ebisuubizo bisaanidde okuba engero mu bantu ba Katonda. Kino kya kitalo nnyo. Tumanyidde okulowooza ku birungi byaffe ng’ebitulindiridde mu biseera ebijja, naye wano tutegeezebwa nti tulibirina mu ngalo zaffe.

Obukyayi n’obukuusa bwonna obw’abalabe baffe tebuyinza kutuzikiriza: baligwa mu kinnya kye baasima. Obusika bwaffe bwatukakasibwako nnyo nga tetuliggalirwa bweru waabwo, wadde okukyamizibwa okuva mu kkubo ne tubusubwa.

Naye kaakano tulina ki? Tulina omuntu ow’omunda omuteefu olw’omusaayi gwa Yesu ogw’omuwendo. Tulina okwagala kwa Katonda okututeekeddwako okutakyuka n’akatono. Tulina obuyinza eri Katonda mu kusaba mu biseera byonna eby’obwetaavu. Tulina okulabirira kwa Katonda okutukuuma, ne bamalayika ba Katonda okutuweereza, era, okusinga byonna, Omwoyo wa Katonda okubeera mu ffe. Mu butuufu, ebintu byonna byaffe. "Oba bintu ebya kaakano, oba ebijja, byonna byammwe.'' Yesu waffe. Weewaawo, Obusatu Obutukuvu obw’obwakatonda mu bumu bwaffe. Aleruuya. Tuleme kunyiiga na kwemulugunya, na kwekekkereza na kwekooya ng’abaddu, kubanga tulina ebirungi mu ngalo zaffe. Tubeere ku Katonda waffe era tumusanyukire olunaku lwonna. Tuyambe, Ayi Mwoyo Mutukuvu!

Maayi 18

OKUFIIRWA KUWANGULWA

"Ndibaddizaawo byonna enzige bye zaalya mu myaka egyo" Yoweeri 2:25

Weewaawo, emyaka egyo egyayonooneka gye tusindira girituddizibwa. Katonda asobola okutuwa ekisa ekingi ennyo nga tulijjuza ennaku zaffe ezisigaddewo n’okuweereza okungi okuliba okuliwa ku myaka egyo egy’obutazaalibwa buggya gye tukungubagira mu kwenenya okw’obwetoowaze.

Enzige ez’okudda ennyuma, n’ez’okwagala ensi, n’ez’obubuguumirize, kaakano tuzitwala ng’ekibonyoobonyo eky’entiisa. Kale singa tezaatusemberera n’akatono! Mukama mu kusaasira kwe kaakano azigyeewo, era tujjudde obunyiikivu okumuweereza. Erinnya lye lyebazibwe, tusobola okukungula amakungula g’ebisa eby’omwoyo agaliggyawo obugumba bwaffe obw’edda. Olw’ekisa ekingi tusobola okufuula obumanyirivu bwaffe obukaawa okuba obw’omugaso, ne tubukozesa okulabula abalala. Tusobola okweyongera okusimba emirandira mu buwombeefu, ne mu kwesigama ng’abaana abato, ne mu bulamu obw’omwoyo obw’okwenenya, olw’ebisobyo byaffe eby’edda. Bwe tuba abeegendereza, n’abanyiikivu, n’abagonvu okusingawo, tuliganyulwa mu kufiirwa kwaffe okunakuwaza. Emyaka egyayonooneka, olw’ekyamagero eky’okwagala, gisobola okuddizibwa. Kirabika ng’ekirabo ekinene ennyo? Tukikkirize, era tukibeereko, era tuyinza n’okukituukako, nga Peetero bwe yafuuka omuntu ow’omugaso okusingawo obwemanyi bwe nga buwonyezeddwa olw’obunafu bwe bwe yazuula. Mukama, tuyambe olw’ekisa kyo.

Maayi 19

TUSOBOLA OKWOGERERA KATONDA

"Noolwekyo kino Mukama ky’agamba nti, Bwe muneenenya, ndibakomyawo musobole okumpeereza; bwe mulyogera ebigambo ebisaana so si ebitasaanidde, mulibeera boogezi bange." Yeremiya 15:19

Yeremiya omunaku! Naye lwaki tugamba bwe tutyo? Nnabbi oyo eyakaabanga yali omu ku baweereza ba Katonda abasingayo obulungi, era Katonda yamuwa ekitiibwa okusinga bangi. Yakyayibwa olw’okwogera amazima. Ekigambo ekyamuwoomeranga ennyo kyali kikaawa eri abo abaakiwuliranga, naye Mukama we yamusiima. Yalagirwa okunywerera mu bwesigwa bwe, olwo Mukama n’ayongera okwogerera mu ye. Yalina okukolagana n’abantu n’obuvumu era n’amazima, n’okukola omulimu gwa Mukama ogw’okuwewa abeeyita abakkiriza ab’omulembe gwe, olwo Mukama n’amuwa ekigambo kino nti, "Mulibeera boogezi bange."

Nga kitiibwa kinene! Buli mubuulizi, weewaawo, buli mukkiriza, tasaanidde kukyegomba? Katonda okwogerera mu ffe, nga kya kitalo! Tunaayogeranga amazima ag’enkalakkalira era amalongoofu; era tunaagoogeranga n’amaanyi. Ekigambo kyaffe tekiriddayo bwereere; kiriba mukisa eri abo abakikkiriza, n’abo abakigaana baliba beetuusaako akabi. Emimwa gyaffe giririisa bangi. Tulizuukusa abeebase ne tuyita abafu okudda mu bulamu.

Ayi omusomi omwagalwa, saba kibeere bwe kityo eri abaweereza ba Mukama waffe bonna abatumiddwa.

Maayi 20

TETULINA KUBUUSABUUSA

"Ndikukulembera ne ntereeza ebifo ebigulumivu. Ndimenyaamenya emiryango egy’ebikomo ne ntemaatema ebisiba eby’ekyuma." Isaaya 45:2

Kino kyali kya Kuulo; naye kya lubeerera busika bw’abaweereza ba Mukama bonna ab’omwoyo. Ka tugende mu maaso mu kukkiriza, n’ekkubo lyaffe lirituteekebwateekebwa. Enkyukakyuka n’obukyamu bw’obukujjukujju bw’abantu n’amagezi ga Setaani birituterezebwa; tetuliba na kugoberera makubo gaabyo agakyamakyama. Emiryango egy’ebikomo girimenyebwa, n’ebisiba eby’ekyuma ebyagisiba biritemebwatemebwa. Tetulyetaaga kyuma kya kumenya miryango wadde omutayimbwa: Mukama yennyini alitukolera ekitasoboka, n’ekitasuubirwa kiribeera kya mazima.

Tuleme kutuula wansi mu kutya okw’obuti. Tunyiikire okugenda mu maaso mu kkubo ery’obuvunaanyizibwa; kubanga Mukama akyogedde nti, "Ndikukulembera." Si kyaffe kubuuza lwaki; ekyaffe kwe kuguma ne tufubutuka mu maaso. Mulimu gwa Mukama, era ye alitusobozesa okugukola: ebiziyiza byonna biteekwa okuggwaawo mu maaso ge. Teyagamba nti, "Ndimenyaamenya emiryango egy’ebikomo?" Kiki ekiyinza okulemesa ekigendererwa kye oba okuziyiza ebiragiro bye? Abo abaweereza Katonda balina eby’obugagga ebitakoma. Ekkubo liggule eri okukkiriza newankubadde nga liggaliddwa eri amaanyi g’omuntu. Yakuwa bw’ayogera nti, "Ndikikola," nga bw’akyogera emirundi ebiri mu kisuubizo kino, tetulina kubuusabuusa.

Maayi 21

ENKUBA AWATALI BIRE? NEDDA!

"Ebire bwe bijjula amazzi, bitonnyesa enkuba ku nsi." Omubuulizi 11:3

Kale lwaki tutya ebire ebizikiza eggulu lyaffe kaakano? Kituufu, okumala akaseera bikweka enjuba, naye enjuba tezikidde; ejja kwaka nate mu bbanga ttono. Mu kiseera ekyo ebire ebyo ebiddugavu bijjudde amazzi; era gye bikoma okuddugala, gye bikoma okuba ng’ebigenda okutonnyesa enkuba ennyingi. Tuyinza tutya okufuna enkuba awatali bire?

Ebizibu byaffe bulijjo bitureetedde emikisa, era bulijjo biriba bwe bityo. Ge magaali amaddugavu agatwala ekisa ekitangaavu. Ebire bino biritonnyesa mu bbanga ttono, na buli kamuddo akagonvu kalisanyuka olw’enkuba eyo. Katonda waffe ayinza okutunnyika mu nnaku, naye talituzikiriza mu busungu; nedda, alituzzaamu amaanyi n’okusaasira. Ebbaluwa z’okwagala kwa Mukama waffe emirundi mingi zitujjira mu mabaasa ag’enkoona enzirugavu. Amagaali ge gawuuma, naye gatikkiddwa ebirungi. Omuggo gwe gumulisa ebimuli ebiwooma n’ebibala ebiriisa. Tuleme kweraliikirira lwa bire, wabula tuyimbe kubanga ebimuli bya Maayi bitutuukako nga biyita mu bire n’enkuba bya Apuli.

Ayi Mukama, ebire ye nfuufu y’ebigere byo! Nga oli kumpi nnyo ku lunaku olw’ebire n’ekizikiza! Okwagala kukulaba, ne kusanyuka. Okukkiriza kulaba ebire nga bitonnyesa amazzi gaabyo ne bisanyusa obusozi enjuyi zonna.

Maayi 22

OLUYIMBA LW’OBWESIGE

"Newaakubadde nga neetooloddwa ebizibu, naye ggwe okuuma obulamu bwange; ogolola omukono gwo eri abalabe bange abakambwe, era omukono gwo ogwa ddyo ne gumponya." Zabbuli 138:7

Okutambula wakati mu bizibu kya nnaku. Nedda, kutambula kwa mukisa, kubanga kulina ekisuubizo eky’enjawulo. Mpa ekisuubizo, olwo ekizibu kiba kiki? Mukama wange anjigiriza ki wano okwogera? Kino: "Ggwe okuuma obulamu bwange." Ndifuna obulamu obusingawo, amaanyi agasingawo, okukkiriza okusingawo. Emirundi mingi tekiba bwe kityo, nti ekizibu kituzzaamu obulamu, ng’empewo ennyogovu bw’ekola omuntu bw’aba anaatera okuzirika?

Abalabe bange nga basunguwadde, naddala omulabe omukulu! Ngolole omukono gwange nnwanyise abalabe bange? Nedda, omukono gwange gusinga kukozesebwa bulungi mu kuweereza Mukama wange. Ate era tekyetaagisa, kubanga Katonda wange alikozesa omukono gwe ogutuuka wala, era alibakola ekisinga nnyo ekyo kye nnandisobodde singa nnagezaako. "Okuwoolera eggwanga kwange, nze ndisasula," bw’ayogera Mukama. Alimponya n’omukono gwe ogwa ddyo ogw’amaanyi n’amagezi, ate kiki ekirala kye nnyinza okwegomba?

Jjangu, mutima gwange, weeyogereko ekisuubizo kino okutuusa lw’onaasobola okukikozesa ng’oluyimba lw’obwesige bwo, ekibudaabuda mu bwannamunigina bwo. Saba ozzibwemu obulamu ggwe kennyini, ebirala obirekere Mukama, akutuukiririza ebintu byonna.

Maayi 23

OKWESIGA KATONDA MU BUJJUVU

"Kubanga anaawonyanga eyeetaaga bw’anaamukoowoolanga, n’omwavu ne kateeyamba ataliiko mwasirizi." Zabbuli 72:12

Eyeetaaga akaaba; kiki ekirala ky’ayinza okukola? Okukaaba kwe kuwulirwa Katonda; kiki ekirala ky’alina okukola? Omusomi eyeetaaga atandike okukaaba kaakano, kubanga ekyo kye kiriba amagezi ge. Tokaabira mu matu ga mikwano, kubanga ne bwe baba basobola okukuyamba, kiba lwa kubanga Mukama ye abasobozesa. Ekkubo erisinga obumpi kwe kugenda butereevu eri Katonda, n’okuleka okukaaba kwo kutuuke mu maaso ge. Atambula butereevu y’asinga okudduka obulungi: ddukira eri Mukama, so si eri ebiyambi eby’okubiri.

"Zinsanze!" okaaba nti, "Sirina mukwano wadde omuyambi." Ekyo kirungi n’okusingawo; osobola okwesiga Katonda mu mbeera zombi -- ng’atalina bya kumuyamba era ng’atalina bamuyamba. Obwetaavu bwo obubiri bufuule okwegayirira kwo okubiri. Ne mu bisaasira eby’omu nsi muno osobola okulindirira Katonda, kubanga afaayo ku baana be mu nsonga zino ez’akaseera. Ate ku byetaago eby’omwoyo, ebisinga byonna obuzito, Mukama aliwulira okukaaba kwo, era alikuwonya n’akuwa by’weetaaga.

Ayi mukwano gwange omwavu, gezesa Katonda wo omugagga. Ayi ggwe atalina yakuyamba, weesigame ku buyambi bwe. Tannanemako, era nkakasa nti talikulemako. Jjangu ng’omusabiriza, Katonda talikugaana buyambi. Jjangu nga tolina kya kwegayiririra okuggyako ekisa kye. Yesu ye Kabaka, alikuleka ofe olw’okubulwa? Ki! Kino wakyerabidde?

Maayi 24

OMU YE ABASINGA OBUNGI!

"Omuntu omu ku mmwe agoba abantu lukumi, kubanga Mukama Katonda wammwe yaabalwanirira nga bwe yabasuubiza." Yoswa 23:10

Lwaki tubala emitwe? Omuntu omu ng’ali ne Katonda ye asinga obungi newankubadde nga ku ludda olulala waliwo lukumi. Oluusi abayambi baffe bayinza okuba abangi ennyo Katonda n’atasobola kukolera nabo, nga bwe kyali ku Gidyoni, ataasobola kukola kintu kyonna okutuusa lwe yayongera amaanyi g’eggye lye ng’akendeeza ku muwendo gwalyo. Naye amaggye ga Mukama tegaba matono nnyo. Katonda bwe yayagala okutandikawo eggwanga, yayita Ibulaamu yekka n’amuwa omukisa. Bwe yayagala okuwangula Falaawo ow’amalala, teyakozesa maggye, wabula Musa ne Alooni bokka. "Obuweereza bw’omuntu omu," ng’abagezigezi abamu bwe babuyita, bukozeseddwa Mukama nnyo okusinga ebibinja ebitendekeddwa n’abakulu baabyo. Abayisirayiri bonna awamu baatta abangi nga Samusooni yekka bwe yatta? Sawulo n’amaggye ge batta enkumi zaabwe, naye Dawudi n’atta emitwalo gye.

Mukama asobola okuleka omulabe n’abeera n’amaanyi agasingawo ennyo, naye n’amuwangula. Bwe tuba n’okukkiriza, tuba ne Katonda, ate ebibiina by’abantu bye biki? Embwa y’omusumba emu esobola okugoba mu maaso gaayo ekisibo ky’endiga ekinene. Bwe Mukama yakutuma, Ayi ow’oluganda, amaanyi ge galituukiriza ekigendererwa kye eky’obwakatonda. Noolwekyo, weesige ekisuubizo, era beera muvumu nnyo.

Maayi 25

EGGWANIKA LYA KATONDA

"Mukama alikuggulirawo eggwanika lye ery’obugagga bwe ery’eggulu." Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:12

Kino kisooka kwogera ku nkuba. Mukama aligiwa mu kiseera kyayo. Enkuba kye kifaananyi ky’ebizzaamu amaanyi byonna eby’omu ggulu Mukama by’ali omwetegefu okuwa abantu be. Singa wajja enkuba ennyingi okuzzaamu amaanyi obusika bwa Mukama!

Tulabika nga tulowooza nti eggwanika lya Katonda liyinza kuggulwawo nnabbi omukulu yekka nga Eriya, naye si bwe kiri, kubanga ekisuubizo kino kya beesigwa bonna mu Isirayiri, era, mu butuufu, kya buli omu ku bo. Ayi mukwano gwange omukkiriza, "Mukama alikuggulirawo eggwanika lye ery’obugagga bwe ery’eggulu." Naawe oyinza okulaba eggulu nga liggule, n’oyingizaamu omukono gwo n’oggyamu omugabo gwo, weewaawo, n’omugabo gwa baganda bo bonna abakwetoolodde. Saba ky’oyagala, era tolimma, bw’onoonywerera mu Kristo, n’ebigambo bye ne binywerera mu ggwe.

Okutuusa kaakano tonnamanya bya bugagga bya Mukama wo byonna, naye alibikuggulirawo eri okutegeera kwo. Mazima tonnanyumirwa bujjuvu bwa bugagga bwa ndagaano ye, naye aliluŋŋamya omutima gwo mu kwagala kwe, n’akubikkulira Yesu mu ggwe. Mukama yekka y’asobola okukukolera kino; naye ekisuubizo kye kye kino, era bw’onoogonderanga eddoboozi lye n’obunyiikivu, n’okola by’ayagala, obugagga bwe obuli mu kitiibwa mu Kristo Yesu buliba bubwo.

Maayi 26

EBINTU EBYA BULIJJO BIWEEBWA OMUKISA

"Oweerezanga Mukama Katonda wo yekka, emmere yo n’amazzi go ndyoke mbiwe omukisa." Okuva 23:25

Nga kisuubizo kya kitalo! Okuweereza Katonda kyokka kya ssanyu ddene. Naye nga kya mukisa gwa njawulo okuba n’omukisa gwa Mukama nga gutuliko mu bintu byonna! Ebintu byaffe ebisinga okuba ebya bulijjo bifuuka bya mukisa bwe tuba ffe kennyini nga twewaddeyo eri Mukama. Mukama waffe Yesu yaddira omugaati n’aguwa omukisa; laba, naffe tulya ku mugaati oguweereddwa omukisa. Yesu yawa amazzi omukisa n’agafuula wayini: amazzi ge tunywa gatusingira wala wayini yonna abantu gwe basanyukira nayo; buli ttondo lirimu omukisa. Omukisa gwa Katonda guli ku muntu wa Katonda mu buli kintu, era gulibeera naye buli kiseera.

Kiki singa tulina mmere na mazzi gokka! Naye era mmere na mazzi ebiweereddwa omukisa. Emmere n’amazzi tujja kubifuna. Ekyo kitegeerekeka, kubanga biteekwa okubaawo Katonda alyoke abiwe omukisa. "Aliweebwa emmere, n’amazzi tegalimuggwaako." Katonda ng’ali ku mmeeza yaffe, tetukoma ku kusaba mukisa, wabula tuba tugufunye. Si ku kyoto kyokka wabula ne ku mmeeza w’atuwera omukisa. Aweereza bulungi abo abamuweereza obulungi. Omukisa guno ogw’oku mmeeza si gwa bbanja, wabula gwa kisa. Mazima, waliwo ekisa eky’emirundi esatu; atuwa ekisa okumuweereza, olw’ekisa kye n’atuliisa emmere, era n’oluvannyuma mu kisa kye n’agiwa omukisa.

Maayi 27

NG’OBULAMU BWE BULI -- N’EBIBALA BWE BIRI

"Kubanga bwe muba n’ebyo ne byeyongera obungi, bibafuula ba mugaso era ababala ebibala olw’okutegeera Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo." 2 Peetero 1:8

Bwe twagala okugulumiza Mukama waffe nga tubala ebibala, tuteekwa okuba n’ebintu ebimu munda mu ffe; kubanga tewali kiyinza kutuvaamu nga tekisoose kubeera munda mu ffe. Tuteekwa okutandika n’okukkiriza, gwe musingi gw’empisa ennungi zonna; n’oluvannyuma n’obunyiikivu tukwongereko obulungi, okutegeera, okwefuganga, n’obugumiikiriza. Awamu n’ebyo tuteekwa okuba n’okutya Katonda n’okufaayo ku booluganda. Bino byonna nga bigatiddwa awamu mazima ddala birituleetera okubala, ng’ebibala by’obulamu bwaffe, ebirimba by’omugaso, era tetuliba bamanyi bagayaavu obugayaavu, wabula abakozi ab’amazima ab’Ekigambo. Ebintu bino ebitukuvu tebiteekwa kubeera mu ffe kyokka, wabula okweyongera obungi, bwe kitaba ekyo tunaaba bagumba. Ebibala kwe kuyiika kw’obulamu, era tuteekwa okusooka okujjula nga tetunnaba kuyiika.

Tulabye abantu ab’ebitone ebingi n’emikisa emingi abatasobolanga kukola kirungi kya mazima mu kukyusa emyoyo; era oluvannyuma lw’okwekenneenya ennyo tuzudde nti baali babulwa ebisa ebimu ebyetaagibwa ddala mu kubala ebibala. Mu mugaso ogw’amazima, ebisa bisinga ebitone. Ng’omuntu bw’ali, n’omulimu gwe bwe guli. Bwe twagala okukola obulungi okusingawo tuteekwa okuba abalungi okusingawo. Ekyawandiikibwa kino kibeere kabonero ka kisa eri abeeyita abakkiriza abatabala bibala, nange kennyini.

Maayi 28

JJUKIZA KATONDA EKISUUBIZO KYE

"Naye waŋŋamba nti, Nnaakugaggawazanga." Olubereberye 32:12

Lino ly’ekkubo ery’enkalakkalira ery’okuwangula mu kusaba eri Mukama. Tusobola okumujjukiza n’obwetoowaze ekyo kye yayogera. Katonda waffe omwesigwa talivaako kigambo kye, so talikireka nga tekituukiridde; naye ayagala abantu be okumubuuza, n’okumujjukiza ekisuubizo kye. Kino kizzaamu amaanyi okujjukira kwabwe, kizzaamu obulamu okukkiriza kwabwe, era kizza buggya essuubi lyabwe. Ekigambo kya Katonda kiweebwa, si ku lulwe, wabula ku lwaffe. Ebigendererwa bye binywevu, era teyeetaaga kintu kyonna kumusiba ku nteekateeka ye ey’okukolera abantu be ebirungi; naye atuwa ekisuubizo okutunyweza n’okutubudaabuda. Noolwekyo ayagala tukyegayiririre, ne tumugamba nti, "Waŋŋamba."

"Nnaakugaggawazanga" gwe musingi gw’ebigambo bya Mukama byonna eby’ekisa. Teeka essira ery’enjawulo ku bugumu bw’ekigambo "Nnaakugaggawazanga." Alitukolera ebirungi, ebirungi eby’amazima, ebirungi eby’olubeerera, ebirungi byokka, buli kirungi. Alitufuula abalungi, era kino kye kutukolera ebirungi mu kigero ekisingayo ddala. Alituyisa nga bw’ayisa abatukuvu be nga tukyali wano, era ekyo kirungi. Mangu ddala alitutwala tubeere ne Yesu n’abalonde be bonna, era ekyo kirungi okusinga byonna. Nga tulina ekisuubizo kino mu mitima gyaffe tetwetaaga kutya Esawu asunguwavu, wadde omuntu omulala yenna. Mukama bw’anaatukolera ebirungi, ani ayinza okutukola akabi?

Maayi 29

ABAVUBI BAMUGOBERERA

"Yesu n’abagamba nti, Mujje mungoberere nange ndibafuula abavubi b’abantu!" Makko 1:17

Lwa kugoberera Yesu kwokka lwe tusobola okufuna omutima gwaffe kye gwegomba, ne tuba ab’omugaso ogw’amazima eri bannaffe. Nga twegomba nnyo okuba abavubi ba Yesu abawangula! Twandiwaddeyo obulamu bwaffe okuwangula emyoyo. Naye tukemebwa okugezaako enkola Yesu ze yali tasobola kugezaako. Tunaakkiriza ekirowoozo kino eky’omulabe? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, tuyinza okusiiwuula amazzi, naye tetulikwata byennyanja. Tuteekwa okugoberera Yesu bwe tuba twagala okuwangula. Enkola ez’okusanyusa abantu, eby’okwesanyusaamu, n’ebirala ng’ebyo -- bino kugoberera Yesu? Tusobola okuteebereza Mukama Yesu ng’akuŋŋaanya ekibiina ng’akozesa engeri ng’ezo ezikozesebwa ennyo kaakano? Ekiva mu nkola ng’ezo kiki? Ekivaamu si kintu Yesu ky’alibala ku lunaku olukulu olw’enkomerero.

Tuteekwa okunywerera ku kubuulira kwaffe nga Mukama waffe bwe yakola, kubanga mu ngeri eno emyoyo mwe girokolerwa. Tuteekwa okubuulira enjigiriza ya Mukama waffe, n’okulangirira Enjiri enzijuvu era ey’obwereere; kubanga eryo lye kiragala emyoyo mwe gikwatirwa. Tuteekwa okubuulira n’obukkakkamu bwe, obuvumu bwe, n’okwagala kwe; kubanga ekyo kye kyama ky’okuwangula emitima gy’abantu. Tuteekwa okukola wansi w’okufukibwako amafuta okw’obwakatonda, nga twesigama ku Mwoyo Omutukuvu. Bwe tutyo, nga tugoberera Yesu, so nga tetumukulemberamu, wadde okumuvaako, tuliba bavubi b’abantu.

Maayi 30

OKULENGERA OKUTUKUVU

"Naye mbagamba nti, okuva ne kaakano mugenda kulaba Omwana w’Omuntu ng’atudde ku mukono ogwa ddyo ogwa Katonda, ng’akomawo ku bire eby’eggulu." Matayo 26:64

Ayi Mukama, wali mu mbeera yo esinga okuba ey’awansi bwe wayimirizibwa mu maaso g’abakuyigganya ng’omuzzi w’emisango! Naye amaaso g’okukkiriza kwo gaasobola okulengera okuyita mu kuswazibwa kwo okw’ekiseera ekyo ne gatuuka mu kitiibwa kyo eky’omu maaso. Bigambo ki bino, "Naye -- okuva ne kaakano"! Nnandyagadde okukoppa okulengera kwo okutukuvu, ne wakati mu bwavu, oba obulwadde, oba okuwaayiriza, nange ŋŋambe nti, "Naye -- okuva ne kaakano." Mu kifo ky’obunafu, olina obuyinza bwonna; mu kifo ky’ensonyi, ekitiibwa kyonna; mu kifo ky’okusekererwa, okusinzibwa kwonna. Omusaalaba gwo tegusiikirizza kumasamasa kw’engule yo, so n’amalusu tegoonoonye bulungi bwa maaso go. Wabula gamba nti, ogulumizibwa era oweebwa ekitiibwa n’okusingawo olw’okubonaabona kwo.

Kale, Mukama, nange nnandyagadde okufuna obuvumu okuva mu "okuva ne kaakano." Nnandyerabidde okubonaabona kwa kaakano mu buwanguzi obw’omu maaso. Nnyamba ng’onnuŋŋamya mu kwagala kwa Kitaawo ne mu bugumiikiriza bwo ggwe kennyini, bwe ntyo bwe nsekererwa olw’erinnya lyo nneme kunyeenyezebwa, wabula ndowooze nnyo n’okusingawo ku by’omu maaso, era, bwe ntyo, ndowooze kitono ku bya leero. Mangu ddala nnaaba naawe ne ndaba ekitiibwa kyo. Noolwekyo, sikwatibwa nsonyi, wabula ŋŋamba mu mmeeme yange ey’omunda ddala nti, "Naye -- okuva ne kaakano."

Maayi 31

"MUGUME"

"Mu nsi muno mujja kubonaabona, naye mugume, kubanga Nze mpangudde ensi." Yokaana 16:33

Ebigambo bya Mukama wange bya mazima ku bikwata ku kubonaabona. Nnina omugabo gwange ogwakwo awatali kubuusabuusa kwonna. Omuggo ogukuba eŋŋaano tegwawanikibwa wala, so sisobola kusuubira nti gulissibwa wabbali nga nkyagalamidde mu gguuliro. Nsobola ntya okusuubira okuba nga ndi waka mu nsi y’omulabe, okusanyuka nga ndi mu buwaŋŋanguse, oba okuwummula nga ndi mu ddungu? Kino si kiwummulo kyange. Kino kye kifo eky’ekikoomi, n’ekyuma eky’okuweesa, n’ennyondo. Ebyantuukako bikwatagana n’ebigambo bya Mukama wange.

Nneetegereza bw’andagira nti "mugume." Zinsanze! Ntera nnyo okuggwaamu essuubi. Omwoyo gwange gwanguwa okukka bwe ngezesebwa ennyo. Naye siteekwa kuwaayo eri enneewulira eno. Mukama wange bw’andagira okuguma, siteekwa kwewaayo kuggwaamu maanyi.

Nsonga ki gy’akozesa okunzizaamu amaanyi? Bwe buwanguzi bwe ye kennyini. Agamba nti, "Nze mpangudde ensi." Olutalo lwe lwali luzibu nnyo okusinga olwange. Sinnalwanagana kutuusa ku kuyiwa musaayi. Lwaki nziggwaamu essuubi ery’okuwangula? Laba, mmeeme yange, omulabe yamala dda okuwangulwa. Nnwanyisa omulabe eyakubibwa dda. Ayi nsi, Yesu yamala dda okukuwangula; ne mu nze, olw’ekisa kye, alikuwangula nate. Noolwekyo ngumye, ne nnyimbira Mukama wange awangula.
fields.body_text: Maayi 1 EBIJJUDDE OLUYIMBA "Ensozi n’obusozi nabyo ne bitandika okuyimba nga bibalabye, n’emiti gyonna ne gitendereza n’essanyu" Isaaya 55:12 Ekibi bwe kisonyiyibwa, ennaku yaffe esinga obunene eba eggwaawo, n’essanyu lyaffe erya nnamaddala ne litandika. Essanyu Mukama ly’awa abo be yatabaganya naye liba lingi nnyo ne liyiika, ne lijjuza ebitonde byonna okujaguza. Ensi eno ey’ebintu ebirabika erimu ennyimba ezikwekeddwa munda, era omutima ogwazzibwa obuggya gumanyi engeri y’okuziggyamu ne guzifuula eddoboozi. Obutonde ye nnanga, era omuntu aliko ekisa azuula ebifuumbiro byayo, n’abiteekako engalo ze, n’azuukusa ensi yonna n’ebigirimu okuyimba mu kutegeeragana okw’okutendereza. Ensozi n’obusozi, n’ebintu ebirala ebinene, bye bifaanana ng’amaloboozi aga wansi ag’ekibiina ky’abayimbi; ate emiti egy’omu kibira, n’ebintu byonna ebiramu, bye bikwata oluyimba lwennyini olw’ennyimba ennyuvu. Ekigambo kya Katonda bwe kikulaakulana mu ffe, n’emyoyo ne girokolebwa, olwo buli kimu kirabika nga kijjudde oluyimba. Bwe tuwulira okwatula kw’abakkiriza abato, n’obujulirwa bw’abatukuvu abayigirizibwa obulungi, tusanyuka nnyo ne kituwaliriza okutendereza Mukama, era olwo kirabika ng’enjazi n’obusozi, n’ebibira n’ennimiro, biddamu amaloboozi g’essanyu lyaffe, ne bifuula ensi ekibiina ky’abakubi b’ebivuga. Mukama, ku lunaku luno olw’essanyu olwa Maayi, ntwala mu nsi yo ejjudde ennyimba, nga njjudde okutendereza ng’akanyonyi akayimba mu bujjuvu. Maayi 2 OKUSIGA MU MWOYO "Oyo asiga eri omwoyo, alikungula obulamu obutaggwaawo" Abaggalatiya 6:8 Okusiga kulabika ng’omulimu ogufiirwa, kubanga tuteeka eŋŋaano ennungi mu ttaka ne tutagiddamu kugiraba. Okusiga eri Omwoyo kulabika ng’omulimu ogw’ebirooto, ogutaliimu; kubanga tweefiiriza, ne tulabika nga tetulina kye tufunamu. Naye bwe tusiga eri Omwoyo nga tufuba okubeera abalamu eri Katonda, nga tunoonya okugondera Katonda by’ayagala, era nga twewaayo okukuza ekitiibwa kye, tetulisiga bwereere. Obulamu bwe buliba empeera yaffe, obulamu obutaggwaawo. Buno tubunyumirwa wano bwe tuyingira mu kumanya Katonda, mu kussa ekimu ne Katonda, ne mu kusanyukira Katonda. Obulamu buno bukulukuta ng’omugga ogweyongera okukka wansi n’okugaziwa, okutuusa lwe butututusa ku nnyanja ey’essanyu eritaliiko kkomo, obulamu bwa Katonda gye bubeera obwaffe emirembe n’emirembe. Leero tuleme kusiga eri omubiri gwaffe, kubanga amakungula galiba kuvunda, kubanga omubiri bulijjo gudda eyo; naye n’okwefuga okutukuvu tubeere abalamu ku lw’ebigendererwa ebisinga obukulu, ebisinga obulongoofu, n’ebisinga okuba eby’omwoyo, nga tunoonya okuwa Mukama waffe omutukuvu ennyo ekitiibwa nga tugondera Omwoyo we ow’ekisa ekingi. Nga galiba makungula ga ngeri ki bwe tulikungula obulamu obutaggwaawo! Nga biriba binywa bya ssanyu eritaggwaawo ebirikungulwa! Ng’amakungula ago galiba mbaga ki! Mukama, tufuule abakunguzi ab’engeri eyo, ku lw’Omwana wo. Maayi 3 WULIRIZA AKABONERO "Awo olunaatuuka bw’onoowulira abakumba ku masanso g’emitugunda, oyanguwe okulumba, kubanga ekyo kinaategeeza nti Mukama akukulembedde okuzikiriza eggye ly’Abafirisuuti" 2 Samwiri 5:24 Waliwo obubonero obw’okutambula kwa Mukama obulina okututambuza. Omwoyo wa Katonda akuntira gy’ayagala, era tuwulira okuwuuma kwe. Ekyo kye kiseera ffe okunyiikira okusinga bwe tuli bulijjo. Tuteekwa okukwata akaseera ako aka zaabu, ne tukakozesa nga bwe tusobola. Kya ffe okulwana n’Abafirisuuti ebiseera byonna; naye Mukama yennyini bw’atukulembera, olwo tulina okubeera abazira mu lutalo mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Empewo yakunta ku masanso g’emiti, Dawudi n’abasajja be ne bakitwala ng’akabonero ak’okulumba, era bwe baakumba, Mukama yennyini n’azikiriza Abafirisuuti. Kale singa leero Mukama atuwa omwagaanya okumwogerako eri mikwano gyaffe bangi! Tubeere bulindaala okukozesa omwagaanya ogw’essuubi bwe gujja. Ani amanyi, leero luyinza okuba olunaku olw’amawulire amalungi; ekiseera eky’okuwangula emyoyo. Tutege amatu gaffe okuwulira okuwuuma kw’empewo, n’ebirowoozo byaffe bibeere nga byetegese okugondera akabonero. Ekisuubizo kino, "Mukama akukulembedde," tekimala okutuzzaamu amaanyi okwesimba ng’abasajja? Mukama nga bw’atukulembera, tetusobola kudda nnyuma. Maayi 4 OBUWANGUZI MU KUGWA "Tonjeeyereza ggwe omulabe wange, kubanga wadde ngudde, nnaayimuka. Ne bwe naatuula mu kizikiza, Mukama anaabeera ekitangaala kyange" Mikka 7:8 Kino kiyinza okwogera ebiri mu mutima gw’omusajja oba omukazi alinnyiririrwa era ajoogebwa. Omulabe waffe ayinza okuzikiza ekitangaala kyaffe okumala ekiseera. Waliwo essuubi eddene gye tuli mu Mukama; era bwe tuba tumwesiga, nga tunywerera ku bwesimbu bwaffe, ekiseera kyaffe eky’okugwa n’eky’ekizikiza kinaatera okuggwaawo. Okuvuma kw’omulabe kwa kaseera buseera. Mukama ajja kufuula mangu okuseka kwabwe okukungubaga, n’okusinda kwaffe akufuule okuyimba. Ne bwe kiba nti omulabe omukulu ow’emyoyo atuwangula okumala akaseera, nga bwe yawangula abasajja abatusinga obulungi, kyokka tugume omwoyo, kubanga tujja kumuwangula mu bbanga ttono. Tujja kuyimuka okuva mu kugwa kwaffe, kubanga Katonda waffe tagudde, era ajja kutuyimusa. Tetujja kusigala mu kizikiza, wadde nga kaakano tukituddemu; kubanga Mukama waffe ye nsulo y’ekitangaala, era ajja kutuleetera mangu olunaku olw’essanyu. Tuleme kuggwaamu ssuubi, wadde okubuusabuusa. Nnamuziga bw’akyuka omulundi gumu, ali wansi ennyo aba waggulu. Zibasanze abaseka kaakano, kubanga balikungubaga ne bakaaba, okwenyumiriza kwabwe bwe kulifuulibwa okuswazibwa okutaggwaawo. Naye balina omukisa abatukuvu bonna abali mu nnaku, kubanga Katonda alibasanyusa. Maayi 5 LWAKI OSIGALA MU BUSIBE? "Mukama Katonda wo anaakusaasiranga n’akuzza mu mbeera yo ennungi" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 30:3 Abantu ba Katonda bennyini bayinza okwetunda mu busibe olw’ekibi. Kino kibala kikaawa nnyo, eky’omulandira ogukaawa ennyo. Nga buba busibe bwa ngeri ki, omwana wa Katonda bw’atundibwa mu kibi, n’asibwa enjegere za Setaani, n’aggyibwako eddembe lye, n’anyagibwa amaanyi ge mu kusaba, n’essanyu lye mu Mukama! Twekuume tuleme kuyingira mu busibe obw’engeri eyo; naye bwe kiba nga kimaze okututuukako, tuleme n’akatono okuggwaamu essuubi. Naye tetuyinza kusibibwa mu buddu emirembe gyonna. Mukama Yesu yasasula omuwendo munene nnyo olw’okununulibwa kwaffe, n’olwekyo tayinza kutuleka mu mukono gw’omulabe. Ekkubo ery’eddembe lye lino: "Dda eri Mukama Katonda wo." Gye twasooka okusanga obulokozi gye tulibusangira nate. Wansi w’omusaalaba gwa Kristo nga twatula ekibi kyaffe, tulisangayo okusonyiyibwa n’okuwonyezebwa. Ate era, Mukama ayagala tugondere eddoboozi lye ng’ebyo byonna bye yatulagira bwe biri, era kino tulina okukikola n’omutima gwaffe gwonna n’emmeeme yaffe yonna, olwo obusibe bwaffe bulyoke buggweewo. Emirundi mingi okwennyamira mu mwoyo n’ennaku ennyingi ez’emmeeme biggwaawo amangu ddala nga tulese ebifaananyi byaffe ne tuvuunamira mu buwulize mu maaso ga Katonda omulamu. Tetulina kubeera basibe. Tusobola okuddayo mu bukungu bwa Sayuuni, era mangu ddala. Mukama, tuzze mu mbeera yaffe ennungi! Maayi 6 EDDAGALA LY’OBUGGYA "Omutima gwo gulemenga okukwatirwa aboonoonyi obuggya, kyokka nyiikira okutya Mukama ebbanga lyonna. Mazima ddala onoobanga n’essuubi mu biseera eby’omu maaso, n’essuubi lyo eryo teririggwaawo" Engero 23:17, 18 Bwe tulaba ababi nga bagaggawala, tutera okubakwatirwa obuggya. Bwe tuwulira oluyoogaano lw’okujaguza kwabwe, ng’omwoyo gwaffe gwe guzitowa, tubeera nga tulowooza nti bo be balina obulungi. Kino kya busirusiru era kya kibi. Singa tubamanyi obulungi, era naddala singa tujjukira enkomerero yaabwe, twandibasaasidde. Eddagala ly’obuggya liri mu kubeera nga tumanyi bulijjo nti Katonda ali naffe, nga tumusinza era nga tussa ekimu naye olunaku lwonna, olunaku ne bwe lulabika nga luwanvu lutya. Eddiini ey’amazima esitula emmeeme n’egitwala mu kifo ekya waggulu, okusalawo gye kufuukira okutegeerekeka obulungi, n’okwegomba gye kulinnyisibwa. Eggulu bwe lyeyongera mu bulamu bwaffe, ensi gye tweyongera obutagyegomba. Okutya Katonda kugoba obuggya bw’abantu. Ekitta obuggya ddala kwe kulowooza n’obukkakkamu ku biseera eby’omu maaso. Obugagga n’ekitiibwa by’abatatya Katonda kirabika kya bwereere. Okulabika kuno okw’amalala kumyansa okumala essaawa emu, n’oluvannyuma ne kuzikira. Omwonoonyi agaggawadde afuna ki mu bugagga bwe omusango bwe gumutuukako? Naye omuntu atya Katonda, enkomerero ye ya mirembe na mukisa, era tewali n’omu ayinza kumunyaga ssanyu lye; kale, aleke obuggya, ajjule okumatira okuwoomerera. Maayi 7 EKIBI KIREME KUSIGALAWO "Tewaabeerengawo kintu na kimu ku ebyo ebinaabanga bimaze okukolimirwa ky’onoosangibwanga nakyo, bwe butyo obusungu bwa Mukama obunaabanga obungi ennyo bunakkakkananga; anaakukwatirwanga ekisa, n’akulaganga okwagala kwe, n’akwongeranga okwala, nga bwe yalayirira bajjajjaabo" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 13:17 Isirayiri yalina okuwangula ebibuga ebyasinza ebifaananyi, n’okuzikiriza omunyago gwonna, nga batwala ekintu kyonna ekyayonoonebwa okusinza ebifaananyi ng’ekintu ekikolimiddwa ekiteekwa okwokebwa omuliro. Kale, Abakristaayo balina okuyisa ekibi eky’engeri zonna mu ngeri y’emu. Tetuteekwa kukkiriza mpisa mbi n’emu kusigalawo. Kaakano lutalo lwa kufa n’okuwona n’ebibi eby’engeri zonna n’obunene bwonna, oba eby’omubiri, oba eby’ebirowoozo, oba eby’omwoyo. Okuleka ekibi kuno tetukutwala ng’okusaanira okusaasirwa, naye tukutwala ng’ekibala eky’ekisa kya Katonda, kye tutayagala kubulwa n’akatono. Katonda bw’atufuula abatasaasira bibi byaffe, olwo aba atusaasira nnyo. Bwe tusunguwalira ekibi, Katonda aba takyatusunguwalira. Bwe twongera okufuba okulwanyisa obutali butuukirivu, Mukama yongera emikisa gyaffe. Ekkubo ery’emirembe, ery’okukula, ery’obukuumi, n’ery’essanyu mu Kristo Yesu liri mu kugoberera ebigambo bino: "Tewaabeerengawo kintu na kimu ku ebyo ebinaabanga bimaze okukolimirwa ky’onoosangibwanga nakyo." Mukama, ndongoosa leero. Okusaasirwa, okukulaakulana, okwala, n’essanyu, mazima biriweebwa abo abaggyawo ekibi n’obumalirivu obw’amaanyi. Maayi 8 ABAKOZI BEETAAGIBWA "Nammwe mugende mukole mu nnimiro yange ey’emizabbibu, era nnaabasasula empeera ebasaanira" Matayo 20:7 Weewaawo, mu nnimiro ya Kristo ey’emizabbibu mulimu omulimu gw’abakaddiye. Y’essaawa ekkumi n’emu, naye era akkiriza tukole. Nga kino kisa kya ngeri ki! Mazima buli musajja omukadde asaanidde okwanguyiriza okukkiriza okuyita kuno! Abantu bwe bakaddiwa, tewaba n’omu abeetaaga ng’abakozi; bagenda okuva mu dduuka erimu okudda mu ddala, ba nnannyini mirimu ne batunuulira envi zaabwe, ne banyeenya emitwe. Naye Yesu apangisa abakadde, era abasasula n’empeera ennungi! Kino kya kusaasira ddala. Mukama, yamba abakaddiye okwewaayo mu kuweereza kwo awatali kulwa n’essaawa emu. Naye Mukama alisasula abakadde abaweddemu amaanyi empeera? Tokibuusabuusa. Agamba nti alikuwa ekigwanidde bw’onookola mu nnimiro ye. Mazima alikuwa ekisa wano n’ekitiibwa eyo. Alikuwa okubudaabudibwa kaakano n’okuwummula ekigenda okujja; amaanyi agenkana olunaku lwo, n’okulaba ekitiibwa ekiro eky’okufa bwe kirituuka. Ebyo byonna Mukama Yesu alibiwa buwi omukadde akyuse nga bw’abiwa oyo ayingira mu kuweereza kwe mu buvubuka bwe. Ka ntegeeze kino omusajja omukadde oba omukazi omukadde atannalokoka, era nsabe Mukama akiwe omukisa, ku lwa Yesu. Abantu ab’engeri eyo mbasanga wa? Nja kubeera mulindaala okubanoonya, mbabuulire amawulire n’ekisa. Maayi 9 OKWESIGA KUTEGEEZA SSANYU "Mu ye emitima gyaffe mwe gijaguliza, kubanga twesiga erinnya lye ettukuvu" Zabbuli 33:21 Omulandira gw’okukkiriza guzaala ekimuli ky’essanyu ery’omu mutima. Tuyinza obutasooka kusanyuka, naye lijja mu kiseera kyalyo. Twesiga Mukama nga tunakuwadde, era mu kiseera ekituufu addamu obwesige bwaffe mu ngeri nti okukkiriza kwaffe kufuuka kutuukirira, ne tusanyukira Mukama. Okubuusabuusa kuzaala okweraliikirira, naye okwesiga kutegeeza ssanyu ku nkomerero. Obukakafu Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli bw’ayogera mu lunyiriri luno mu butuufu kisuubizo ekikwatiddwa mu mikono gy’obwesige obutukuvu. Nga twetaaga ekisa okukifuula ekyaffe! Bwe tuba nga tetusanyuka mu kaseera kano, naye tujja kusanyuka, nga Katonda wa Dawudi bw’ali Katonda waffe mu butuufu. Tufumiitirize ku linnya lya Mukama ettukuvu, tulyoke tumwesige obulungi era tusanyuke mangu. Mu mpisa ze mutukuvu, mwenkanya, wa mazima, wa kisa, mwesigwa era takyukakyuka. Katonda ow’engeri eyo tasaanidde kwesigibwa? Wa magezi gonna, ayinzabyonna, era abeera buli wamu; tetuyinza kumwesiga n’essanyu? Weewaawo, tujja kukikola kaakano, era tukikole awatali kwekengera. Yakuwa-Yire alitugabirira, Yakuwa-Salumu aliweereza emirembe, Yakuwa-Tsidkenu alituwa obutuukirivu, Yakuwa-Samma alibeera kumpi emirembe gyonna, era mu Yakuwa-Nissi tuliwangula buli mulabe. Abo abamanyi erinnya lyo banaakwesiganga; n’abo abakwesiga banaakusanyukiranga, Ayi Mukama. Maayi 10 TYA KATONDA YEKKA "Kyetuva twogera n’obuvumu nti, 'Mukama ye mubeezi wange, siityenga, omuntu ayinza kunkola ki?'" Abaebbulaniya 13:6 Olw’okuba Katonda talitulekanga era talitwabulira n’akatono, bye tulina bisaanidde okutumala. Mukama bw’aba waffe, tetuyinza kusigala nga tetulina mukwano, oba obugagga, oba ekifo eky’okubeeramu. Obukakafu buno buyinza okutuleetera okuwulira nga tetwesigamye ku bantu n’akatono. Nga tuli wansi w’obukuumi obw’ekitiibwa bwe butyo, tetukemebwa kwekulukuunya mu maaso ga bannaffe, nga tubasaba olukusa okuyita obulamu bwaffe obwaffe; wabula kye twogera tukyogera n’obuvumu, era tetutya kuwakanyizibwa. Atya Katonda talina kirala kya kutya. Tusaanidde okutya Mukama omulamu n’entiisa ey’ekitiibwa bwe kityo nti ebitiisa byonna omuyigganya asingayo amalala by’ayinza okukozesa bitaba na kikolwa kyonna ku ffe okusinga okufuuwa kw’empewo. Omuntu mu nnaku zino tasobola kutukola bingi nga bwe yali asobola omutume bwe yawandiika olunyiriri oluli waggulu w’olupapula luno. Ebyuma eby’okubonyaabonyeza n’emiti egy’okwokerako biweddewo. Omuzira Paapa tasobola kwokya batambuze kaakano. Abagoberezi b’abayigiriza ab’obulimba bwe bagezaako okutuduula n’okutunyooma mu ngeri enkambwe, tekitwewuunyisa, kubanga abantu b’ensi eno tebasobola kwagala zadde lya mu ggulu. Kale ki? Tuteekwa okugumira okunyoomebwa kw’ensi. Tekumenya magumba. Katonda ng’atuyamba, tubeere bavumu, era ensi bw’esunguwala ka esunguwale, naye ffe tetugitya. Maayi 11 LINDIRIRA EBY’ENKOMERERO "Gaadi alirumbibwa ogubiina gw’abanyazi, naye ye, alibafubutukira emabega." Olubereberye 49:19 Abamu ku ffe tubadde ng’ekika kya Gaadi.
