Twayawulibwa olw’ekiragiro kya Katonda, olw’okugulibwa, n’olw’okuyitibwa, era obumanyirivu bwaffe obw’omunda butufudde okwawukana nnyo ku bantu b’ensi; kale ekifo kyaffe tekiri mu Katale kaabwe k’Ebitaliimu, wadde mu Kibuga kyabwe eky’Okuzikirira, wabula mu kkubo ekifunda abatambuze bonna ab’amazima gye bateekwa okugoberera Mukama waabwe.

Kino tekiyinza kutukkiriza na kututamwa n’okuduulirwa ensi kwokka, wabula kiyinza n’okutuleetera okubikkiriza n’essanyu nga bye bitundu by’omugabo gwaffe ogw’endagaano. Amannya gaffe tegali mu kitabo kye kimu, tetuli za nsigo emu, tetugenda mu kifo kye kimu, wadde okwesiga omuluŋŋamya omu, kale kirungi nti tetuli ba mu muwendo gwabwe. Tusangibwe bwokka mu muwendo gw’abanunule, era tumativu okuba ab’enjawulo n’abali bokka okutuusa ku nkomerero.

Sebuttemba 27

EKITANGAALA EKYA KATONDA MU KIZIKIZA

"Okoleezezza ettaala yange." Zabbuli 18:28

Kiyinzika nti emmeeme yange etudde mu kizikiza; era kino bwe kiba kya mwoyo, tewali maanyi ga muntu gasobola kundeetera ekitangaala. Yeebazibwe Katonda! Asobola okwakisa ekizikiza kyange, era amangwago n’akoleeza ettaala yange. Ne bwe mba nga nzingiziddwa "ekizikiza ekiyinza n’okuwulikika," kyokka asobola okumenya ekizikiza, n’amangwago n’akimulisa okumpituka.

Ekisa kye kiri nti bw’akoleeza ettaala tewali asobola kugizikiza, so tegenda kuzikira olw’obutaba na maafuta, wadde okwokerera yokka olw’essaawa okuyita. Ettaala Mukama ze yakoleeza ku lubereberye zikyaka ne kaakano. Ettaala za Mukama ziyinza okwetaaga okusalibwako, naye tazizikiza.

Kale nno, ng’akanyonyi akayimba ekiro, ka nyimbe mu kizikiza. Okusuubira kunompa ennyimba, n’essuubi lisikke oluyimba. Mu bbanga ttono ndisanyukira ettaala Katonda gy’akoleezezza. Kaakano ndi munafu era nkooye. Oboolyawo mbeera y’obudde, oba obunafu bw’omubiri, oba okwewuunya olw’akabi akatujjidde amangu; naye ekyaleeta ekizikiza kyonna, Katonda yekka y’alireeta ekitangaala. Amaaso gange gali ku ye yekka. Mu bbanga ttono ndiba n’ettaala za Mukama nga zaakira okumpituka; ate mu maaso, mu kiseera kye ekirungi, ndibeera gye batakyeetaaga ttaala wadde ekitangaala ky’enjuba. Aleruuya!

Sebuttemba 28

OMULIMU GUWEDDE; WUMMULIRA MU YE

"Naye Katonda atusuubizza olunaku olwa Ssabbiiti lwe tuliwummula, newaakubadde nga terunnatuuka." Abaebbulaniya 4:9

Katonda ateeseteese Ssabbiiti, era abamu bateekwa okuyingira mu yo. Abo be yasooka okubuulira tebaayingira olw’obutakkiriza; kale Ssabbiiti eyo esigalira abantu ba Katonda. Dawudi yagiyimba; naye kyamugwanira okukwata ku ddoboozi eritali lya ssanyu, kubanga Isirayiri baagaana okuwummula kwa Katonda. Yoswa teyasobola kukuwa, so ne Kanani teyakuwaayo: kusigalira abakkiriza.

Kale nno, mujje, tufubire okuyingira mu kuwummula kuno. Tuveeko okutegana okukooya okw’ekibi n’okwefaako. Tulekeraawo okwesiga kwonna, ne mu mirimu egyo egiyinza okugambibwako nti, "Birungi nnyo." Tulina egiri egyo? Wadde bwe kiri, tuveeko emirimu gyaffe ffe, nga Katonda bwe yava ku gigye. Kaakano tufune essanyu mu mulimu ogutuukiridde ogwa Mukama waffe Yesu. Byonna bituukiriziddwa mu bujjuvu: obwenkanya tebukyetaaga kirala. Emirembe emingi gwe mugabo gwaffe mu Kristo Yesu.

Ku bikwata ku kulabirira kwa Katonda, omulimu gw’ekisa mu mwoyo, n’omulimu gwa Mukama mu myoyo gy’abalala, tusuule emigugu gino ku Mukama, tuwummulire mu ye. Mukama bw’atuwa ekikoligo okusitula, akikola tulyoke tufune okuwummula nga tukisitudde. Olw’okukkiriza tufuba okuyingira mu kuwummula kwa Katonda, era tulekulira okuwummula kwonna okw’okwematiza oba okugayaala. Yesu yennyini ye kuwummula okutuukiridde era tujjuzibwa okutuuka ku mabbali mu ye.

Sebuttemba 29

OKUGULUMIZA KRISTO YESU

"Oyo agenda kungulumiza, kubanga agenda kubategeeza bye nnaamubuuliranga." Yokaana 16:14

Omwoyo Omutukuvu yennyini tayinza kugulumiza Mukama Yesu okusinga okutulaga ebintu bya Kristo ye. Yesu ye kutenderezebwa kwe okusinga obulungi. Tewali kumuwunda okuggyako ne zaabu ye ye.

Omubudaabudi atulaga ekyo ky’aweereddwa okuva eri Mukama waffe Yesu. Tetulaba kintu bulungi okutuusa lw’akibikkula. Alina engeri y’okubikkula ebirowoozo byaffe, n’okubikkula Ebyawandiikibwa, era mu ngeri eno emirundi ebiri ayolekera Mukama waffe eri ffe. Waliwo obukugu bungi mu kwoleka ensonga, era obukugu obwo bwa Mwoyo ow’amazima mu ngeri esingira ddala waggulu. Atulaga ebintu byennyini. Kino kya nkizo nnene, ng’abo abamanyi abanyumirwa okwolesebwa okutukuvu bwe bamanyi.

Tunoonye okwakira kw’Omwoyo; si okumatiza okwegomba kwaffe okumanya, wadde okutuleetera essanyu ery’obuntu, wabula okugulumiza Mukama Yesu. Woowe, singa tubeera n’endowooza ennuŋŋamu ku ye! Endowooza empitirivu ereetera Mukama waffe ow’omuwendo okunyoomebwa. Woowe, singa tubeera n’ebifaananyi ebilaba obulungi eby’omuntu we, n’omulimu gwe, n’ekitiibwa kye, tulyoke tuleekaanire ettendo lye n’omutima n’emmeeme! Awali omutima ogugaggawaziddwa okuyigiriza kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu waliwo Omulokozi agulumizibwa okusukka okwogera. Jjangu, Ayi Mwoyo Omutukuvu, ekitangaala eky’omu ggulu, otulage Yesu Mukama waffe!

Sebuttemba 30

OKWASAMYA EMIMWA GYAFFE

"Yasamya akamwa ko, nange nnaakajjuza." Zabbuli 81:10

Nga kwe kuzzaamu amaanyi mu kusaba! Endowooza yaffe ey’obuntu yandituleese okusaba ebintu ebitono kubanga bye tusaanira bitono nnyo; naye Mukama ayagala tusabe emikisa emikulu. Okusaba kwandibadde kwangu ng’okwasamya akamwa; kwandibadde kwogera okwa bulijjo, okutakakibwa. Omuntu bw’aba nga anyiikivu, asamya akamwa ke, era ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe kitukubiriza okuba abanyiikivu mu kwegayirira kwaffe.

Naye era kitegeeza nti tuyinza okuguma mu maaso ga Katonda, ne tusaba emikisa emingi era eminene okuva mu mikono gye. Soma olunyiriri lwonna, olabe ensonga: "Nze Mukama Katonda wo, eyakuggya mu nsi y’e Misiri. Yasamya akamwa ko, nange nnaakajjuza." Olw’okuba Mukama atuwadde bingi bwe bityo, atuyita okusaba ebisingawo, weewaawo, okusuubira ebisingawo.

Laba obunyonyi obuto mu bisu byabwo bwe bulabika ng’obwa kamwa kokka nnyina bw’ajja okubuliisa. Kibe bwe kityo ne gye tuli. Tuyingize ekisa mu buli mulyango. Tukinywe ng’ekyangwe bwe kinuuna amazzi mwe kigalamidde. Katonda mwetegefu okutujjuza singa naffe tuba beetegefu okujjuzibwa. Obwetaavu bwaffe butwasamye emimwa gyaffe; obunafu bwaffe butuleetere okwasamya emimwa gyaffe n’okuwejjawejja; weewaawo, okutya kwaffe kutwasamye emimwa gyaffe n’okukaaba ng’omwana. Akamwa akaasamiddwa kalijjuzibwa Mukama yennyini. Kibe bwe kityo gye tuli, Ayi Mukama, olwa leero.
fields.body_text: Sebuttemba 1 OKUBEERA MU KUGONDERA, MU KWAGALA "Bwe munaagonderanga ebiragiro byange olwo munaabanga munyweredde mu kwagala kwange." Yokaana 15:10 Ebintu bino tebiyinza kwawukana -- okubeera mu kugondera, n’okubeera mu kwagala kwa Yesu. Obulamu obufugibwa Kristo bwokka bwe buyinza okukakasa nti tuli be Mukama waffe asanyukira. Tuteekwa okukwata ekiragiro kya Mukama waffe bwe tuba twagala okwenyumiriza mu kwagala kwe. Bwe tuba tubeera mu kibi, tetuyinza kubeera mu kwagala kwa Kristo. Awatali butukuvu obusanyusa Katonda, tetuyinza kusanyusa Yesu. Oyo atafaayo ku butukuvu, tamanyi kintu ku kwagala kwa Yesu. Okweyagalira okw’okwagala kwa Mukama waffe, nga tukitegeera, kintu kya buguumu bungi. Kikwatibwako ekibi n’obutukuvu mangu nnyo okusinga ekyuma ekipima ebbugumu bwe kikwatibwako obunnyogovu n’ebbugumu. Bwe tuba n’omutima omuwombeefu, era nga twegendereza mu birowoozo, mu bigambo, ne mu bulamu okussa ekitiibwa mu Mukama waffe Yesu, olwo tufuna obubonero bw’okwagala kwe obutabalika. Bwe tuba twagala okwongera essanyu eryo, tuteekwa okwongera obutukuvu. Mukama Yesu tajja kutukweka maaso ge okuggyako nga ffe tumukwese amaaso gaffe. Ekibi kye kikola ekire ekiziba Enjuba yaffe: bwe tunaabanga abagondezi abeegendereza era abeewaddeyo ddala, tunaayinza okutambulira mu kitangaala, nga Katonda bw’ali mu kitangaala, ne tubeera mu kwagala kwa Yesu mu bukakafu nga Yesu bw’abeera mu kwagala kwa Kitaawe. Kino kye kisuubizo ekiwoomerera ekirimu "bwe" ow’amaanyi. Mukama, ka mbeere n’ekigambo "bwe" kino mu mukono gwange; kubanga ng’ekisumuluzo, kisumulula essanduuko eno. Sebuttemba 2 GOBERERA OMANYE "Tumanye Mukama; tunyiikire okumumanya." Koseya 6:3 Si mu kaseera kamu, wabula mpolampola, bwe tunaatuuka ku kumanya okutukuvu, era omulimu gwaffe kwe kugumiikiriza n’okuyiga katono katono. Tetusaana kuggwaamu ssuubi, wadde ng’okukulaakulana kwaffe kuyinza okuba okw’empola, kubanga tugenda kumanya. Mukama, eyafuuka Omuyigiriza waffe, tajja kutuleka, ne bwe tuba nga tutegeera mpola nnyo; kubanga si kya kitiibwa kye nti obusirusiru bw’omuntu ku ngeri yonna businga amagezi ge. Mukama asanyukira okugeziwaza oyo atalina magezi. Omulimu gwaffe kwe kunywerera ku nsonga yaffe enkulu, n’okugobererera okumanya, si njigiriza eno oba eri ey’enjawulo, wabula Yakuwa yennyini. Okumanya Kitaffe, Omwana, n’Omwoyo, Katonda ow’Obusatu Obutukuvu, kuno kwe kuba obulamu obutaggwaawo: ka tunywerere ku kino, kubanga mu ngeri eno tunaafuna okuyigirizibwa okutuukiridde. Nga tugobererera okumanya Mukama, tuyiga okuwonyezebwa oluvannyuma lw’okuyuzibwa, okusibibwa oluvannyuma lw’okukubibwa, n’obulamu oluvannyuma lw’okufa. Okumanyiira kutuukiriza omulimu gwakwo bwe kumala nga omutima gugoberera ekkubo lya Mukama Ayinzabyonna. Ggwe mmeeme yange, nywerera ku Yesu, gobererera okumanya Katonda mu Yesu, olwo onootuuka ku kumanya Kristo, okusinga byonna eby’okuyiga obulungi. Omwoyo Omutukuvu anaakuluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna. Kino si gwe mulimu gwe ogw’ekisa? Mwesige atuukirize gwo. Sebuttemba 3 OKUVA MU KUFA OKW’OMWOYO "Kale mulimanya nga nze Mukama, era nga nammwe muli bantu bange, bwe ndyasamya amalaalo gammwe ne mbazuukiza." Ezeekyeri 37:13 Mazima kiteekwa kubeera bwe kityo: abo abaweebwa obulamu okuva mu bafu tebalema kutegeera mukono gwa Mukama mu kuzuukira ng’okwo. Kuno kwe kukyuka okusinga obukulu era okw’ekitalo okusinga byonna omuntu by’ayinza okuyitamu -- okuggyibwa mu ntaana ey’okufa okw’omwoyo, n’asobozesebwa okusanyukira mu kitangaala n’eddembe ery’obulamu obw’omwoyo. Tewali ayinza kukola kino wabula Katonda omulamu, Mukama era omuwi w’obulamu. Woowe nze! Nnyo bwe nzijukira bwe nnali ngalamidde mu kiwonvu ekijjudde amagumba amakalu, nga nkalu nga gomu ku go! Lwali lulungi olunaku ekisa eky’obuwa ekyereere n’eky’obwakabaka lwe kyatuma omusajja wa Katonda okumpungira eby’obunnabbi! Katonda agulumizibwe olw’okwesisiwala ekigambo ekyo eky’okukkiriza kwe kyaleeta mu magumba amakalu. Ekyasingawo omukisa kwe kussa okw’omu ggulu okwava mu mpewo ennya okwannamya! Kaakano mmanyi Omwoyo omulamya ogwa Yakuwa atafa emirembe gyonna. Mazima Yakuwa ye Katonda omulamu, kubanga yannamya. Obulamu bwange obuggya, ne mu kunyolwa ne mu nnaku zaabwo, bunkakasa nti Mukama ayinza okutta n’okulamya. Ye Katonda yekka. Ye byonna ebikulu, eby’ekisa, n’eby’ekitiibwa, era emmeeme yange ennamuddwa emusinza nga Oyo Omukulu, Ndi-nga-bwe-Ndi. Ekitiibwa kyonna kibeere ku linnya lye ettukuvu! Nga bwe ndiba omulamu ndimutendereza. Sebuttemba 4 OBUWANGUZI AWATALI LUTALO "Naye ab’ennyumba ya Yuda ndibaagala, era ndibalokola, si na kasaale, newaakubadde ekitala, newaakubadde entalo, newaakubadde embalaasi newaakubadde abeebagala embalaasi, wabula nze kennyini Mukama Katonda waabwe nze ndibaagala era ne mbalokola." Koseya 1:7 Kigambo kya muwendo! Yakuwa yennyini y’anaawonya abantu be mu bunene bw’okusaasira kwe, naye tajja kukikola na makubo ga bulijjo. Abantu balwawo okuwa Katonda ekitiibwa ekigwanira erinnya lye. Bwe bagenda mu lutalo n’ekitala n’akasaale, ne bawangula, basaana okutendereza Katonda waabwe; naye tebakikola, wabula batandika okugulumiza omukono gwabwe ogwa ddyo, ne beenyumiririza mu mbalaasi zaabwe n’abeebagala embalaasi. Olw’ensonga eno Yakuwa waffe emirundi mingi asalawo okulokola abantu be awatali makubo ga kubiri, ekitiibwa kyonna kiryoke kibeere kye yekka. Kale, ggwe mutima gwange, tunuulira Mukama yekka, so si muntu. Suubira okulaba Katonda n’obulungi obw’enkizo bwe wataba n’omulala gw’oyinza okutunuulira. Bwe mba nga sirina mukwano, nga sirina muwi wa magezi, nga sirina n’omu annyweza, ka nneeyongere okuba n’obwesige singa nsobola okuwulira nti Mukama yennyini ali ku ludda lwange; weewaawo, ka nsanyuke bw’ampa obuwanguzi awatali lutalo, ng’ekyawandiikibwa bwe kirabika okutegeeza. Lwaki nsaba embalaasi n’abeebagala embalaasi singa Yakuwa yennyini ansaasira, era n’ayimusa omukono gwe okunkuuma? Lwaki neetaaga akasaale oba ekitala singa Katonda anaalokola? Ka nneesige, so nneme kutya, okuva leero n’okutuusa emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina. Sebuttemba 5 ALI NANGE BULI GYE MBEERA "Mukama anaabeera nammwe." 2 Ebyomumirembe 20:17 Kuno kwali kusaasira kunene eri Yekosafaati, kubanga ekibiina kinene kyali kimulumbye; era kunaaba kusaasira kunene gye ndi, kubanga nnina obwetaavu bunene, so sirina maanyi wadde amagezi. Mukama bw’anaabeera nange, si nsonga nnyo ani anaandeka. Mukama bw’anaabeera nange, ndiwangula mu lutalo lw’obulamu, era nga bwe ndyeyongera okugezesebwa bwe ndyeyongera okuba n’obuwanguzi obw’ekitiibwa. Nnaamanya ntya nti Mukama ali nange? Mazima ali nange singa nange ndi naye. Bwe nneesiga obwesigwa bwe, ne nzikiriza ebigambo bye, ne ngondera ebiragiro bye, mazima ali nange. Bwe mba ku ludda lwa Setaani, Katonda ali kunkontana, so tekiyinza kuba bulala; naye bwe mba nga mbeera okussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa, nnaba nkakafu nti anampa ekitiibwa. Nkakasa ddala nti Katonda ali nange singa Yesu ye Mulokozi wange omu yekka. Bwe mba nga nteeka emmeeme yange mu mikono gy’Omwana wa Katonda we omu yekka, kale nnaba nkakafu nti Kitaawe anaakozesa amaanyi ge gonna okunkuuma, Omwana we aleme kuswazibwa. Singa nnina okukkiriza okunywerera ku kyawandiikibwa ekimpi naye ekiwoomerera ekya leero! Ayi Mukama, tuukiriza ekigambo kino eri omuddu wo! Beera nange mu nnyumba, mu luguudo, mu nnimiro, mu dduuka, mu bantu, ne bwe mba bw’omu. Beera era n’abantu bo bonna. Sebuttemba 6 OMUTIMA OGW’AMAANYI "Lindirira Mukama. Ddamu amaanyi, ogume omwoyo. Weewaawo, lindirira Mukama." Zabbuli 27:14 Lindirira! Lindirira! Okulindirira kwo kubeere ku Mukama! Asaanira okulindirirwa. Taswaza mmeeme erindirira. Bw’oba olindirira, gumira omwoyo gwo. Suubira obulokozi obunene, era beera mwetegefu okutendereza Katonda olw’obwo. Ekisuubizo ekisaana okukusanyusa kiri wakati mu lunyiriri -- "ogume omwoyo." Kino kigenda butereevu mu kifo w’oyagalira obuyambi. Omutima bwe guba omulamu, ekitundu ekirala kyonna eky’omubiri kinaakola bulungi. Omutima gwetaaga okutebenkezebwa n’okusanyusibwa; era ebyo byombi binajja singa gugumizibwa. Omutima ogw’amaanyi guwummula era gusanyuka, era gutuusa amaanyi mu muntu yenna. Tewali mulala ayinza okutuuka ku ssuwa eyo ey’ekyama ey’obulamu, gwe mutima, okugufukamu amaanyi. Oyo yekka eyagukola y’asobola okugunyweza. Katonda ajjudde amaanyi, era, noolwekyo, asobola okugawa abo abaagetaaga. Woowe, guma omwoyo; kubanga Mukama anaakuwa amaanyi ge, era onooba muteefu mu kibuyaga, era musanyufu mu nnaku. Oyo eyawandiika ennyiriri zino asobola okuwandiika nga Dawudi bwe yakola--"Weewaawo, lindirira Mukama." Mazima nkyogera. Mmanyi olw’okumanyiira okuwanvu era okw’ekika nti kirungi gye ndi okulindirira Mukama. Sebuttemba 7 OKUTUUKA KW’EKISA EKY’OBUYINZABYONNA "Mu kifo ky’okuyitibwa abatali bantu bange, baliyitibwa, baana ba Katonda omulamu." Koseya 1:10 Ekisa eky’obwakabaka kisobola okufuula abagwira okuba abaana, era wano Mukama alangirira ekigendererwa kye eky’okukola bwe kityo eri abajeemu, n’abamanyisa ky’akoze. Ggwe omusomi omwagalwa, Mukama akikoze mu mbeera yange; akukoledde ekifaanana bwe kityo? Kale ka tukwatagane emikono n’emitima mu kutendereza erinnya lye erisaanira okusinzibwa. Abamu ku ffe twali abatatya Katonda ddala nnyo, ekigambo kya Mukama ne kyogera ddala mazima eri omuntu waffe ow’omunda n’omutima gwaffe nti, "Temuli bantu bange." Mu nnyumba ya Katonda, ne mu maka gaffe ffe, bwe twasoma Bayibuli, guno gwe gwali eddoboozi ly’Omwoyo wa Katonda mu mmeeme zaffe nti, "Temuli bantu bange." Mazima lyali ddoboozi ery’ennaku erisalira omusango. Naye kaakano, mu bifo bye bimu, okuva mu buweereza bwe bumu ne mu Byawandiikibwa bye bimu, tuwulira eddoboozi eryogera nti, "Muli baana ba Katonda omulamu." Tuyinza okusiima okumala olw’ekyo? Si kya kitalo? Tekituwa ssuubi ku balala? Ani ali ewala n’ekisa eky’obuyinzabyonna? Tuyinza tutya okuggwaamu essuubi ku muntu yenna, nga Mukama atukoledde enkyukakyuka ey’ekitalo bwe kityo mu ffe? Oyo eyakuuma ekisuubizo kino ekimu ekinene anaakuuma na buli ekirala; kyeva, ka tweyongereyo mu maaso n’ennyimba ez’okusinza n’obwesige. Sebuttemba 8 EKIMENYEDDE N’EKINYOOKA "Talimenya lumuli lubetentefu oba okuzikiza olutambi olwaka empola ennyo." Isaaya 42:3 Kale nnyinza okusuubira okuyisibwa n’obukwatampola okuva eri Mukama wange. Mazima, neewulira nga ndi munafu, nga nsiba, nga siriimu mugaso ng’olumuli. Omuntu yagamba nti, "Sikufaako wadde katono," era ebigambo, wadde nga tebaali bya kisa, tebyali bikyamu. Woowe! Ndi mubi okusinga olumuli olukula ku mugga, kubanga olwo waakiri lusobola okuyimusa omutwe gwalwo. Nnabetentebwa, nnabetentebwa nnyo, nnabetentebwa ku bunaku. Tewali nnyimba mu nze kaakano; waliwo olwatika oluta okuvaamu eddoboozi lyonna ery’ennyimba. Woowe nze! Naye Yesu tajja kummenya; era bw’atagenda kunkola bwe kityo, kale sifaayo nnyo ku ekyo abalala kye bagezaako okukola. Ayi Mukama omuwoomerevu era ow’ekisa, neekweka wansi w’obukuumi bwo, ne nneerabira ebiwundu byange! Mazima nange nsaanira okugeraageranyizibwa n’"olutambi olwaka empola ennyo," olw’ekitangaala kyalwo kigenze, ne kusigalawo mukka gwalwo gwokka. Ntya nti ndi kya kwesittaza okusinga okuba ekigasa. Okutya kwange kuŋŋamba nti Setaani afuuwidde ekitangaala kyange, n’andekera omukka ogw’ekyenyinyalwa, era nti Mukama wange anaatera okunzikiza. Naye ntegeera nti wadde nga mu mateeka waaliwo ebisalako ebisirinza, tewaaliwo bizikiza; era Yesu tajja kunzikiza; noolwekyo, nnina essuubi. Mukama, nkumira buggya, era onsobozese okwaka olw’ekitiibwa kyo, n’olw’okutendereza obukwatampola bwo. Sebuttemba 9 OKUTYA KULINA EKIFO KYAKWO "Alina omukisa omuntu atya Mukama ebbanga lyonna." Engero 28:14 Okutya Mukama kwe ntandikwa era kwe musingi gw’eddiini yonna ey’amazima. Awatali ntiisa entukuvu n’okussaamu Katonda ekitiibwa, tewali we wanywerera empisa endala ennungi ennyo. Oyo emmeeme ye etasinza, talibeerera mu butukuvu. Alina omukisa oyo awulira okutya okw’obuggya okukola ekibi. Okutya okutukuvu tekutunula nga tekunnabuuka kyokka, wabula ne nga tekunnaba na kutambula. Kutya obukyamu, kutya okulagajjalira omulimu, kutya okukola ekibi. Kutya ab’oluwenda olubi, emboozi enjenjeevu, n’enkola erimu okubuusabuusa. Kino tekifuula muntu munaku, wabula kimuleetera essanyu. Omukuumi eyeegendereza wa mukisa okusinga omuserikale eyeebaka ku mulimu gwe. Oyo alaba obubi mu maaso n’abudduka wa mukisa okusinga oyo atambula obutafaayo n’azikirizibwa. Okutya Katonda kisa kya kasirise ekikulembera omuntu mu kkubo ery’enjawulo, kwe kyawandiikibwako nti, "Teribaayo mpologoma, so teririnnyayo nsolo yonna nkambwe." Okutya n’endabika yokka ey’ekibi nkola nnongoosa, esobozesa omuntu, ng’ayita mu maanyi g’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okukuuma ebyambalo bye nga tebiriiko bbala okuva mu nsi. Mu ngeri zombi oyo "atya ebbanga lyonna" afuulibwa wa mukisa. Sulemaani yali agezezza byombi, okwagala eby’ensi n’okutya okutukuvu: mu kimu n’asangamu obutaliimu, mu kirala n’asangamu essanyu. Tuleme kuddamu kugezesa kwe, wabula ka tunywerere ku ky’asazeeko. Sebuttemba 10 OKUYINGIRA; OKUFULUMA "Onoobanga n’omukisa ng’oyingira era onoobanga n’omukisa ng’ofuluma" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:6 Emikisa egy’amateeka tegyaggyibwawo. Yesu yanyweza ekisuubizo kino bwe yeetikka ekibonerezo. Bwe nkuuma amateeka ga Mukama wange, nsobola okwenyweza ekisuubizo kino awatali kubuusabuusa. Olunaku luno nnaayingira mu nnyumba yange awatali kutya bigambo bibi, era nnaayingira mu kasenge kange nga nsuubira okuwulira amawulire amalungi okuva eri Mukama wange. Siritya kwekebera nze kennyini, wadde okwekenneenya ebifa ku mirimu gyange n’obwegendereza. Nnina emirimu mingi egy’okukola munda, mu mmeeme yange; ayi, waliwo omukisa ku byonna, omukisa gwa Mukama Yesu, eyasuubiza okubeera nange. Kinsaanidde era okufuluma. Okutya kunkubiriza okwegomba okusigala munda, obutaddayo mu nsi eyonoona. Naye kinsaanidde okufuluma mu kuyitibwa kwange, era kinsaanidde okufuluma ndyoke mbeere ow’omugaso eri baganda bange, era ow’okugasa abatatya Katonda. Kinsaanidde okuba omukuumi w’okukkiriza era omulwanyi ku bubi. Ayi, waliwo omukisa ku kufuluma kwange olunaku luno! Mukama, ka nnende gy’ontwala, ku bubaka bwo, wansi w’ekiragiro kyo, era mu maanyi g’Omwoyo wo. Mukama Yesu, yingira wamu nange obeere omugenyi wange; oluvannyuma tambule nange, era okoze omutima gwange gwake nga oyogera nange mu kkubo. Sebuttemba 11 ABABONAABONA BAFUUKA ABAKKIRIZA ABANYWEVU "Kirungi omuntu okwetikka ekikoligo kye mu buvubuka bwe" Okukungubaga 3:27 Kino kiri ng’ekisuubizo. Kibadde kirungi, kirungi, era kijja kubeera kirungi gye ndi okwetikka ekikoligo. Nga nkyali muto nnalina okuwulira obuzito bw’okulumirizibwa olw’ebibi, era okuva olwo bubadde omugugu ogugaggawaza emmeeme. Nnandyagadde Enjiri bwe nti singa ssaayiga mu kumanya okw’ennyo obwetaavu bw’obulokozi obuva mu kisa? Yabezi yali wa kitiibwa okusinga baganda be kubanga nnyina yamuzaala mu nnaku, era abo ababonaabona nnyo nga bazaalibwa eri Katonda bafuuka abakkiriza abanywevu mu kisa kya Katonda ekifuga. Ekikoligo eky’okunenyezebwa kya kunyiiza, naye kiteekateeka omuntu olw’ekitiibwa eky’omu maaso. Tasaanira kuba mukulembeze oyo atayiseemu mu kunyoomebwa. Okutenderezebwa kutamiiza singa tekusookeddwako kuvumibwa. Abasajja abatuuka ku bukulu awatali kulwana batera okugwa mu buswavu. Ekikoligo eky’okubonaabona, okwennyamira, n’okukola ennyo ekiyitiridde tekisaana kunoonyezebwa; naye Mukama bw’akituteekako nga tukyali bato kitera okukuza empisa egulumiza Katonda era eweesa Ekkanisa omukisa. Jjangu, mmeeme yange, kutamya ensingo yo; situla omusaalaba gwo. Kyali kirungi gye w’oli bwe wali muto, tekijja kukukola kabi kaakano. Ku lwa Yesu, gwetikke n’essanyu. Sebuttemba 12 ATE ENNYUMBA YANGE? "Kkiriza Mukama waffe Yesu onoolokolebwa, ggwe n’ennyumba yo yonna" Ebikolwa by’Abatume 16:31 Enjiri eno eyaweebwa omuntu eyalina ekitala ku bulago bwe y’Enjiri gye ndi. Yandinsaanidde singa mba nfa, era ye byonna bye nneetaaga nga nkyali mulamu. Nvaako nze kennyini, n’ekibi, n’endowooza yonna ey’okwesiima kwange, ne nneesiga Mukama Yesu ng’Omulokozi Katonda gwe yawa. Mmukkiririzaamu, mmwesigama, mmusembeza abeere byonna gye ndi. Mukama, ndokoddwa, era nnaalokolebwa emirembe gyonna, kubanga nzikiririza mu Yesu. Erinnya lyo litenderezebwe olw’ekyo. Nsobole buli lunaku okulaga mu bulamu bwange nti ndokoddwa okuva mu kwefaako, n’okwagala ensi, na buli ngeri ya bubi. Naye ebigambo ebyo ebisembayo ebifa ku "nnyumba" yange: Mukama, sijja kumatira na kitundu kya kisuubizo ng’ekyo kye wawa kijjuvu. Nkwegayiridde, lokola ab’omu maka gange bonna. Lokola abasinga okumpi n’abaagalwa. Kyusa abaana, n’abazzukulu, bwe mba nnabo. Kwatirwa ekisa abaddu bange, ne bonna ababeera mu nnyumba yange, oba abankolera. Onsuubiza kino nze kennyini bwe nzikiriza Mukama Yesu; nkwegayiridde okole nga bw’oyogedde. Nnandyogedde mu kusaba kwange buli lunaku amannya g’aboluganda bange bonna, bakadde, abaana, mikwano, ab’ekika, abaddu, ne sikuwummuza okutuusa ekigambo ekyo lwe kirituukirira, "n’ennyumba yo yonna." Sebuttemba 13 OMUSULO GW’EGGULU "Eggulu lye linaatonnyezanga omusulo" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 33:28 Ekyo omusulo gw’Ebuvanjuba kye guli eri obutonde, bwe gutyo n’obuyinza bw’Omwoyo bwe buli mu nsi ey’ekisa. Nga ngwetaaga nnyo! Awatali Mwoyo wa Katonda ndi kintu ekikaze era ekiwotose. Nnennyika, nkala, nfa. Omusulo guno nga gunziza obuggya n’essanyu! Bwe nfuna omukisa gwagwo mpulira nga nsanyufu, omulamu, nga nnina amaanyi, era nga ngulumizibbwa. Sirina kirala kye njagala. Omwoyo Omutukuvu andeetera obulamu, ne byonna obulamu bye bwetaaga. Ebirala byonna awatali musulo gw’Omwoyo tebiriiko makulu gye ndi: mpulira, nsoma, nsaba, nnyimba, nnenda ku mmeeza ey’Ekijjulo Ekitukuvu, ne siraba mukisa gwonna okutuusa Omwoyo Omutukuvu lw’anzijira. Naye bw’antonnyeza omusulo, buli kkubo ery’ekisa liba ddungi era lya mugaso. Nga kino kisuubizo kya ngeri ki gye ndi! "Eggulu lye linaatonnyezanga omusulo." Nnaakyalirwa ekisa. Sirirekebwa mu kkalu lyange erya buli lunaku, oba mu bbugumu ery’ensi eryokya, oba mu kibuyaga eky’okukemebwa kwa Setaani. Ayi, singa mu kaseera kano kennyini mpulira omusulo gwa Mukama omuwombeefu, ogutategeerekeka, ogutobya! Lwaki nnema? Oyo eyankola ne mba mulamu ng’omuddo bwe guli mu ddundiro, anankola nga bw’akola omuddo; anampeewo obuggya okuva waggulu. Omuddo tegusobola kusaba musulo nga nze bwe nkola. Mazima, Mukama akyalira ekimera ekitasaba anaddamu omwana we amwegayirira. Sebuttemba 14 AKABONERO AK’OKUSIIMIBWA KWA KATONDA "Alina omukisa omuntu agumira okukemebwa, kubanga bw’alimala okusiimibwa aliweebwa engule ey’obulamu Katonda gye yasuubiza abo abamwagala" Yakobo 1:12 Weewaawo, alina omukisa ng’akyagumira okukemebwa. Tewali liiso lisobola kukiraba okutuusa nga lifukiddwako eddagala ery’amaaso ery’omu ggulu. Naye ateekwa okukigumira, so tajeemera Katonda, wadde okukyama okuva mu bwesimbu bwe. Alina omukisa oyo ayise mu muliro, n’atazikirizibwa ng’eky’obulimba. Okugezesebwa bwe kuwera, olwo ne wajja akabonero ak’okusiimibwa kwa Katonda -- "engule ey’obulamu." Ng’ekyo Mukama kye yagamba nti, "Ka abeere mulamu; apimiddwa ku minzaani, so tasangiddwa ng’abulako." Obulamu ye mpeera: si kubaawo bukabaawo kwokka; wabula okubaawo okutukuvu, okw’essanyu, era okwa nnamaddala, okutuukirira ekigendererwa kya Katonda ekitufaako. Dda, engeri ey’obulamu obw’omwoyo obusingako awamu n’essanyu ekola engule eri abo abaayise n’obulungi mu kugezesebwa okusinga obungi okw’okukkiriza n’okwagala. Mukama yasuubiza engule ey’obulamu abo abamwagala. Abaagalana ne Mukama bokka be baligumira mu kiseera eky’okugezesebwa; abalala baliggwaamu amaanyi oba banyiige, oba badde ennyuma mu nsi. Jjangu, mutima gwange, omwagala Mukama wo? Mu mazima? Mu buziba? Mu bujjuvu? Kale okwagala okwo kulikemebwa; naye amazzi amangi tegakumalaawo, so n’emigga tegiyinza kukumalawo. Mukama, okwagala kwo kuliise okwange okutuusa ku nkomerero. Sebuttemba 15 OBWEKWEKERO OBUSINGA OBUKUUMI "Era omuntu aliba ng’ekifo eky’okwekwekamu empewo, ng’ekiddukiro okuva eri kibuyaga." Isaaya 32:2 OMUSAJJA ono gw’ali ffenna tumumanyi. Yandibadde ani okuggyako Omuntu owookubiri, Mukama eyava mu ggulu, Omusajja ow’ennaku, Omwana w’Omuntu? Nga abadde kifo kya kwekwekamu eri abantu be! Yeetikka amaanyi gonna ag’empewo yekka, bw’atyo n’awa obwekwekero abo abeekweka mu ye. Bwe tutyo twadduka obusungu bwa Katonda, era bwe tutyo tulyewala obusungu bw’abantu, okweraliikirira okw’obulamu buno, n’okutya okufa. Lwaki tuyimirira mu mpewo ng’ate tusobola okugivaamu mangu era mu bukakafu nga twekweka emabega wa Mukama waffe? Ka tudduke gy’ali olunaku luno, tube n’emirembe. Emirundi mingi empewo eya bulijjo ey’emitawaana yeeyongera amaanyi n’efuuka kibuyaga, ng’eyeraliikiriza buli kimu mu maaso gaayo. Ebintu ebyalabika ng’ebinywevu era ebyesimbu binyeenya mu kibuyaga, era okugwa okw’ebyesige byaffe eby’omubiri kungi era kunene. Mukama waffe Yesu, Omusajja ow’ekitiibwa, ye kiddukiro ekitasuulwa wansi. Mu ye tulaba kibuyaga ng’ayitawo, naye ffe ffennyini tuwummulira mu mirembe egisanyusa. Olunaku luno ka twekweke butyo mu kifo kyaffe eky’okwekwekamu, tutuule tuyimbe wansi w’obukuumi bw’Ekiddukiro kyaffe. Ayi Yesu Omukisa! Ayi Yesu Omukisa! Nga bwe tukwagala! Kituufu okukwagala, kubanga oli bwekweko gye tuli mu kiseera eky’omuyaga. Sebuttemba 16 EMPEERA YA KAKAFU "Ddala ddala mbagamba nti buli aliwa omu ku baana bano abato egiraasi y’amazzi agannyogoga olw’erinnya ly’omuyigiriza talirema kuweebwa mpeera ye." Matayo 10:42 Kale, ekyo nsobola okukikola. Nsobola okukola ekikolwa eky’ekisa eri omuweereza wa Mukama. Mukama amanyi nti mbaagala bonna, era nnandikitutte nga kitiibwa okunaaza ebigere byabwe. Ku lwa Mukama waabwe nnyagala abayigirizwa. Nga Mukama wa kisa okwogera ku kikolwa ekitono ennyo bwekityo -- "okuwa omuntu egiraasi y’amazzi agannyogoga byokka"! Kino nsobola okukikola, ne bwe mba omwavu: kino nnyinza okukikola, ne bwe mba wa wansi: kino nnaakikola n’essanyu ddala. Kino, ekirabika ekitono ennyo, Mukama akiraba -- akiraba nga kikoleddwa eri asembayo mu bagoberezi be. Kirabika si nsimbi, wadde obukugu, wadde obungi, bye atunuulira, wabula ekigendererwa: ekyo kye tukolera omuyigirizwa, kubanga muyigirizwa, Mukama we akiraba, era akisasula. Tatuwa mpeera olw’obusaanidde bw’ekyo kye tukola, wabula ng’obugagga bw’ekisa kye bwe buli. Mpa egiraasi y’amazzi agannyogoga, ye n’ampa okunywa ku mazzi amalamu. Mpa omu ku baana be abato, ye n’ankwata ng’omu ku bo. Yesu afuna ensonga ey’okugaba kwe okungi mu ekyo ekisa kye kye kinkoze, era agamba nti, "Talirema kuweebwa mpeera ye." Sebuttemba 17 NG’ENKINDU N’OMUVULE "Abatuukirivu balyegolola ng’enkindu, ne bakula ne bawanvuwa ng’emivule gy’e Lebanooni" Zabbuli 92:12 Emiti gino tegitendekebwa so tegisalibwa muntu: enkindu n’emivule gy’"emiti gya Mukama," era gikula olw’okulabirira kwe; bwe kityo bwe kiri eri abatukuvu ba Mukama, be yeerabirira yekka. Emiti gino gibeera girabika bulungi ennaku zonna, era gya kulabika kirungi mu biseera byonna eby’omwaka. Abakkiriza si mulundi gumu batukuvu ate omulundi omulala nga tebatya Katonda: bayimirira mu bulungi bwa Mukama mu mbeera zonna ez’obudde. Buli wamu emiti gino gyewuunyisa: tewali n’omu asobola okutunuulira ensi eriyo enkindu oba emivule nga tassizza mwoyo gwe ku miti gino egy’ekikabaka. Abagoberezi ba Yesu be balabibwa abalaba bonna: ng’ekibuga ekiri ku lusozi tekiyinza kukwekebwa. Omwana wa Katonda akula ng’enkindu, essindika amaanyi gaayo gonna waggulu mu mpagi emu eyimiridde awatali ttabi na limu. Mpagi erina omutwe ogw’ekitiibwa. Terina kukula ku ddyo wadde ku kkono, wabula esindika amaanyi gaayo gonna eri eggulu, n’ebala ebibala byayo okumpi n’eggulu nga bwe kisoboka. Mukama, tuukiriza ekifaananyi kino mu nze. Omuvule gugumira embuyaga zonna, ne gukulira okumpi n’omuzira ogutaggwaawo, nga Mukama yennyini agujjuza omubisi ogukuuma omutima gwagwo nga gubuguma n’amatabi gaagwo nga ganywevu. Mukama, ka kibe bwe kityo gye ndi, nkwegayiridde. Amiina. Sebuttemba 18 OBUKUUMI OBUJJUVU "Bye yayogera ku Benyamini nti Omwagalwa wa Mukama Katonda abeerenga wanywevu, Katonda Ali Waggulu ng’amwebulungudde bulijjo, omwagalwa anaagalamiranga wakati ku bibegabega bye" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 33:12 Weewaawo, tewali bukuumi bwenkana obwo obuva mu kubeera okumpi ne Katonda. Eri omwagalwa we asinga, Mukama tasobola kufuna kifo kikakafu wadde ekikuuma okusinga. Ayi Mukama, ka mbeere bulijjo wansi w’ekisiikirize kyo, okumpi n’embiriizi zo ezaafumitibwa. Nnandisemberedde nnyo gy’oli, Mukama wange; era bwe mba nnaasembera ddala okumpi naawe, nnandibeeredde eyo emirembe gyonna. Nga ekibikka kya ngeri ki Mukama ky’awa abalonde be! Si kasolya kalungi ke kalimubikka, wadde ekisenge ekiziyiza ebibombe, wadde n’ekiwaawaatiro kya malayika, wabula Yakuwa yennyini. Tewali kisobola kututuukako nga tubikkiddwa bwe tutyo. Ekibikka kino Mukama alikituwa olunaku lwonna, ne bwe luwanvuwa lutya. Mukama, ka mbeere olunaku luno nga ntegeera nti ndi wansi w’ekibikka kino eky’okwagala, eweema eno ey’obuyinza obw’obwakabaka. Ekigambo ekyokusatu kitegeeza nti Mukama mu yeekaalu ye yandibadde abeera mu nsozi za Benyamini, oba nti Mukama yandibadde ali awo omugugu gwa Benyamini we gwandissiddwa, oba kitegeeza nti tusitulibwa ku bibegabega bya Oyo Ataggwaawo? Kyonna kye kiba, Mukama y’awagira era y’amaanyi g’abatukuvu be. Mukama, ka nkusanyukirenga obuyambi bwo bulijjo, olwo n’emikono gyange ginaamala gye ndi. Sebuttemba 19 ENSONGA EY’OKUYIMBA "Mukama Katonda ali naawe, ow’amaanyi alokola: alikusanyukira, alikukkakkanyiza mu kwagala kwe, alikusanyukira n’okuyimba." Zeffaniya 3:17 Ekigambo kino nga kya kitalo! Yakuwa Katonda ng’ali wakati mu bantu be mu kitiibwa kyonna eky’amaanyi ge! Okubeerawo kuno kwokka kumala okutuleetera emirembe n’essuubi. Eby’obugagga eby’amaanyi agatakoma bitereke mu Yakuwa waffe, era abeera mu kkanisa ye; kale abantu be baleekaanire essanyu. Tetulina kubeerawo kwe kwokka, naye era yeenyigidde mu mulimu gwe omulonde ogw’obulokozi. "Alokola." Bulijjo alokola: erinnya lye Yesu aliggya mu kino. Tuleme kutya kabi konna, kubanga w’amaanyi okulokola. Naye kino si kye kyokka. Abeera bw’omu emirembe gyonna; ayagala, awummulira mu kwagala, era talirekera kwagala. Okwagala kwe kumuleetera essanyu. Ne mu mwagalwa we afunamu ensonga ey’oluyimba. Kino kya kitalo nnyo. Katonda bwe yatonda ebintu teyayimba, wabula n’agamba nti "birungi nnyo"; naye bwe yajja ku bikwata ku kununula, olwo Obusatu Obutukuvu ne buwulira essanyu eryayolesebwa mu luyimba. Kirowoozeeko, weewuunye! Yakuwa Yesu ayimbira omugole we omulonde oluyimba olw’obugole. Gy’ali ye kwagala kwe, essanyu lye, ekiwummulo kye, n’oluyimba lwe. Ayi Mukama Yesu, olw’okwagala kwo okutapimika gy’oli, tuyigirize okukwagala, okusanyukira mu ggwe, n’okukuyimbira zabbuli yaffe ey’obulamu. Sebuttemba 20 OKWEWAAYO OKUJJUVU "Abantu bo balyewaayo bokka mu ggye lyo ng’ekiseera ky’olutalo kituuse." Zabbuli 110:3 Yeebazibwe Katonda ow’ekisa olw’okuba nga bwe kiri! Alina abantu be yalonda okuva edda okuba omugabo gwe ogw’enjawulo. Bano mu buzaaliranwa balina emitima emikakanyavu ng’egy’abaana ba Adamu abalala abajeemu; naye olunaku olw’amaanyi ge bwe lutuuka, n’ekisa ne kyoleka obuyinza bwakyo obutakoma, bafuuka abeetegefu okwenenya n’okukkiriza Yesu. Tewali alokolebwa nga tayagadde, naye okwagala kufuulibwa okwewaayo mu ngeri ennungi. Buyinza ki obw’ekitalo buno, obutabonaabonya kwagala, kyokka ne bukufuga! Katonda takutula kkufulu, wabula agisumulula n’ekisumuluzo ekikulu kye asobola yekka okukozesa. Kaakano tuli beetegefu okubeera, okukola, oba okubonaabona nga Mukama bw’ayagala. Bwe tuba nga tujeemye ekiseera kyonna, kimwetaagisa kwe kutujjira n’amaanyi, era amangwago tudduka mu kkubo ery’ebiragiro bye n’omutima gwaffe gwonna. Olunaku luno lubeere lwa maanyi gye ndi mu kikolwa ekirungi olw’ekitiibwa kya Katonda n’obulungi bwa bantu bannange! Mukama, ndi mwetegefu; siyinza kusuubira nti luno lunaku olw’amaanyi go? Ndi mu mikono gyo ddala; mwetegefu, weewaawo, ayagala ennyo, okukozesebwa ggwe olw’ebigendererwa byo ebitukuvu. Ayi Mukama, tondeka kukaaba nti, "Ne bwe njagala okukola ekirungi, tewali kirungi kye nkola," wabula mpa amaanyi nga bw’ompa n’okwagala. Sebuttemba 21 EBIGEZO BITUWE OMUKISA "Nga tumanyi ng’okubonaabona kutuyigiriza okugumiikiriza." Abaruumi 5:3 Kino kisuubizo mu bulamba ne bwe kitaba mu ngeri ya kisuubizo. Twetaaga okugumiikiriza, era wano tulaba engeri y’okukufuna. Kubanga tuyiga kugumiikiriza nga tugumiikiriza, nga bwe tuyiga okuwuga nga tuwuga. Toyinza kuyiga buyinzi obwo ku lukalu, wadde okuyiga okugumiikiriza awatali kabi. Si kirungi okubonaabona olw’okufuna obuteefu bw’omutima obulungi obukkiriza mu kutebenkera byonna Katonda by’ayagala? Naye ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe kyoleka ekintu eky’enjawulo, ekitali ng’obuzaaliranwa bwe buli, wabula eky’eggulu. Okubonaabona mu bwako kwokka kuleeta obusungu, obutakkiriza, n’obujeemu. Kyokka olw’amagezi amatukuvu ag’ekisa kwe kufuulibwa okukolamu okugumiikiriza mu ffe. Tetuwuula ŋŋaano okumalawo enfuufu: kyokka omuwuulo gw’okubonaabona gukola kino ku gguuliro lya Katonda. Tetunyeenya muntu olw’okumuwummuza, kyokka bw’atyo Mukama bw’akola n’abaana be. Mazima kino si ngeri ya muntu, naye kyongera nnyo ku kitiibwa kya Katonda waffe ow’amagezi gonna. Woowe, singa mbeera n’ekisa okuleka ebigezo byange okumpa omukisa! Lwaki nnandyagadde okuziyiza omulimu gwabyo ogw’ekisa? Mukama, nkusaba oggyewo okubonaabona kwange, naye nkwegayirira emirundi kkumi okusinga oggyewo obutagumiikiriza kwange. Mukama Yesu ow’omuwendo, n’omusaalaba gwo siigira ekifaananyi ky’okugumiikiriza kwo ku mutima gwange. Sebuttemba 22 EMIGGA EMIGAZI AWATALI MAATO GA NTALO "Weewaawo Mukama aliba Amaanyi gaffe era aliba ekifo eky’emigga emigazi n’ensulo engazi. Temuliyitamu lyato newaakubadde ekyombo ekinene tekiriseeyeeyeramu." Isaaya 33:21 Mukama alibeera gye tuli ekintu ekisinga obulungi awatali bizibu ebiseemu okugoberera ebintu eby’ensi ebisinga obulungi. Ekibuga bwe kiba n’emigga emigazi, kisobola okulumbibwa amaato ag’enkasi n’ebyombo ebirala eby’entalo. Naye Mukama bwe yeeyoleka obungi bw’obugabirizi bwe mu kifaananyi kino, yeegendereza n’aggyawo entiisa ekifaananyi kye kiyinza okuleeta. Yeebazibwe olw’okwagala kwe okutuukiridde! Mukama, bw’ompa obugagga ng’emigga emigazi, toleka lyato ery’enkasi kujja mu kifaananyi ky’okwagala ensi oba amalala. Bw’ompa obulamu obulungi obungi n’emyoyo emisanyufu, toleka "ekyombo ekinene" eky’obwangu bw’omubiri kuseeyeeya nga kirinnya ku mataba agakulukuta. Bwe mbeera n’obuwanguzi mu buweereza obutukuvu, obugazi ng’omugga Rhine ogw’e Bugirimaani, kyokka nneme kulaba lyato ery’okweraga n’okwesiga kwennyini nga liseeyeeya ku mayengo ag’omugaso gwange. Ne bwe nnaaba omusanyufu ennyo okwenyumiririza mu kitangaala ky’amaaso go omwaka ku mwaka, kyokka nneme kunyooma abatukuvu bo abanafu, wadde okukkiriza endowooza ey’obutaliimu ey’okutuukirira kwange yennyini okuseeyeeya ku migga emigazi egy’obukakafu bwange obujjuvu. Mukama, mpa omukisa oguleeta obugagga, ogutaleeta nnaku wadde okwongera ku kibi. Sebuttemba 23 OKULOKOLEBWA MU NFUUFU N’EBISUSUNKU "Kubanga ndiwa ekiragiro, ennyumba ya Isirayiri erinyeenyezebwa mu mawanga gonna, ng’emmere ey’empeke bwe kuŋŋutibwa mu kakuŋŋunta era tewaliba kayinja akaligwa wansi." Amosi 9:9 Omulimu gw’okukuŋŋunta gukyagenda mu maaso. Buli gye tugenda, tukyawewebwa era tukukuŋŋuntibwa. Mu nsi zonna abantu ba Katonda bagezesebwa "ng’emmere ey’empeke bwe kuŋŋutibwa mu kakuŋŋunta." Oluusi Setaani akwata akakuŋŋunta, n’atunyeenya waggulu ne wansi n’amaanyi mangi, ng’ayagala nnyo okutumalawo emirembe gyonna. Obutakkiriza tebulwawo kutabula mutima gwaffe n’ebirowoozo byaffe n’entiisa yaabwo etewummula. Ensi nayo ewaayo omukono gwayo mu mulimu gwe gumu, n’etunyeenyeza ku ddyo ne ku kkono n’amaanyi mangi. Ekisinga obubi, ekkanisa, nga bw’eri eyeewaanyisizza ennyo, ejja n’eyongera amaanyi amakambwe ku mulimu gw’okukuŋŋunta. Kale, kale! Kigende mu maaso. Bwe kityo ebisusunku bwe byawulibwa ku ŋŋaano. Bwe kityo ŋŋaano bw’alokolebwa okuva mu nfuufu n’ebisusunku. Era nga kisa kinene kituba mu kyawandiikibwa, "tewaliba kayinja akaligwa wansi"! Byonna ebirungi, eby’amazima, eby’ekisa birikuumibwa. Tewali n’omu ku bakkiriza abasembayo aligwa, wadde omukkiriza yenna okufiirwa ekintu kyonna ekisaanira okuyitibwa okufiirwa. Tuligumibwa bwe tutyo mu kukuŋŋunta okutuusa lwe kirituba kwongera kwa nkizo eri ffe mu Kristo Yesu. Sebuttemba 24 OMUGGA OGUWA OBULAMU "Buli kiramu tekirifa yonna omugga gye guyita." Ezeekyeri 47:9 Amazzi amalamu, mu kwolesebwa kwa nnabbi, gaakulukuta ne gayingira mu Nnyanja Enfu, ne gatwala obulamu, wadde mu nnyanja eyo etakulukuta. Ekisa gye kigenda, obulamu obw’omwoyo bwe bivaamu amangu era emirembe gyonna. Ekisa kikulukuta mu buyinza nga Katonda bw’ayagala, nga omugga mu kukyama kwagwo kwonna bwe gugoberera okwagala kwagwo; era buli gye kituuka tekilinda bulamu kukijjira, wabula kitonda obulamu n’okukulukuta kwakyo okuzza obulamu. Woowe, singa kufukirira mu nguudo zaffe, ne kwanjaala mu bifo byaffe ebyavu! Woowe, singa kaakano kajja mu nnyumba yange, ne kalinnya okutuusa buli kisenge lwe kijjula amazzi! Mukama, leka amazzi amalamu gakulukutire eri ab’omu maka gange ne mikwano gyange, era galeme kumpitako. Nsuubira nti mmaze okuganywako; naye njagala okunaabiramu, weewaawo, okuwugiramu. Ayi Mulokozi wange, njagala obulamu mu bujjuvu. Jjangu gye ndi, nkwegayiridde, okutuusa buli kitundu ky’obuntu bwange lwe kiba n’amaanyi era nga kikola nnyo. Katonda omulamu, nkwegayiridde, onjijjuze obulamu bwo wennyini. Ndi kaggwa akalanga, akkalu; jjangu onfuule omulamu ne, ng’omuggo gwa Alooni, mpulukuke ne nnyumbuluka ne mbala ebibala olw’ekitiibwa kyo. Onzizeemu obulamu, ku lwa Mukama wange Yesu. Amiina. Sebuttemba 25 SSADDAAKA ESIIMIDDWA "Singa Mukama Katonda yabadde wa kututta, teyandisiimye kiweebwayo ekyokebwa n’ekiweebwayo eky’empeke okuva gye tuli, newaakubadde okutulaga ebintu bino byonna." Balam 13:23 Kino kika kya kisuubizo ekiggibwa mu magezi. Kya kusalawo okuggibwa mu bintu ebikakasibwa. Tekyali kya kuba nti Mukama yali abikkulidde Manowa ne mukazi we nti balizaalirwa omwana, ate ng’alina mu mutima gwe okubazikiriza. Omukazi yalowooza bulungi, era tunaakola bulungi bwe tunaagoberera enkola ye ey’okuwakana. Kitaffe akkirizza ssaddaaka enkulu ey’e Kalvari, era yeeyolese nga kimusanyusizza; kaakano ayinza atya okusanyukira okututta? Lwaki wabaawo eyayimirira mu kifo kyaffe singa omwonoonyi ateekwa okuzikirira? Ssaddaaka ya Yesu esiimiddwa ekomya entiisa. Mukama atulaze okulondebwa kwaffe, okufuulibwa abaana be, okugatta kwaffe ne Kristo, n’okufumbirwa Omwagalwa: kaakano ayinza atya okutuzikiriza? Ebisuubizo bijjudde emikisa, egyetaagisa okuba nga tukuumibwa okutuusa ku bulamu obutaggwaawo. Tekisoboka Mukama okutusuula, kyokka n’atuukiriza endagaano ye. Ebyayita bitukakasa, n’ebijja bituzzaamu obwesige. Tetulifa, wabula tuliba balamu; kubanga tulabye Yesu, era mu ye tulabye Kitaffe olw’okwakira kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Olw’okulaba kuno okuleeta obulamu tuteekwa okuba abalamu emirembe gyonna. Sebuttemba 26 MU BANUNULE "Ndaba abantu abeeyawuddeko abateerowooza kuba ng’erimu ku mawanga." Okubala 23:9 Ani ayagala okubeera mu mawanga, n’okubalibwa nago? Weewaawo, ne ekkanisa eyeeyita ey’abakkiriza eri bw’etyo nti okugoberera Mukama mu bujjuvu munda mu nsalo zaayo kizibu nnyo. Waliwo okutabulwa n’okutabikwa kungi nnyo, ne kireetera omuntu emirundi mingi okussa ekikkowe olw’"ekifo eky’okusula mu ddungu eddene ennyo." Kya kakafu nti Mukama ayagala abantu be okutambulira mu kkubo eryawukanako eri ensi, n’okuvaamu mu bukakafu n’enjawulo. Twayawulibwa olw’ekiragiro kya Katonda, olw’okugulibwa, n’olw’okuyitibwa, era obumanyirivu bwaffe obw’omunda butufudde okwawukana nnyo ku bantu b’ensi; kale ekifo kyaffe tekiri mu Katale kaabwe k’Ebitaliimu, wadde mu Kibuga kyabwe eky’Okuzikirira, wabula mu kkubo ekifunda abatambuze bonna ab’amazima gye bateekwa okugoberera Mukama waabwe. Kino tekiyinza kutukkiriza na kututamwa n’okuduulirwa ensi kwokka, wabula kiyinza n’okutuleetera okubikkiriza n’essanyu nga bye bitundu by’omugabo gwaffe ogw’endagaano. Amannya gaffe tegali mu kitabo kye kimu, tetuli za nsigo emu, tetugenda mu kifo kye kimu, wadde okwesiga omuluŋŋamya omu, kale kirungi nti tetuli ba mu muwendo gwabwe. Tusangibwe bwokka mu muwendo gw’abanunule, era tumativu okuba ab’enjawulo n’abali bokka okutuusa ku nkomerero. Sebuttemba 27 EKITANGAALA EKYA KATONDA MU KIZIKIZA "Okoleezezza ettaala yange." Zabbuli 18:28 Kiyinzika nti emmeeme yange etudde mu kizikiza; era kino bwe kiba kya mwoyo, tewali maanyi ga muntu gasobola kundeetera ekitangaala. Yeebazibwe Katonda! Asobola okwakisa ekizikiza kyange, era amangwago n’akoleeza ettaala yange. Ne bwe mba nga nzingiziddwa "ekizikiza ekiyinza n’okuwulikika," kyokka asobola okumenya ekizikiza, n’amangwago n’akimulisa okumpituka. Ekisa kye kiri nti bw’akoleeza ettaala tewali asobola kugizikiza, so tegenda kuzikira olw’obutaba na maafuta, wadde okwokerera yokka olw’essaawa okuyita. Ettaala Mukama ze yakoleeza ku lubereberye zikyaka ne kaakano. Ettaala za Mukama ziyinza okwetaaga okusalibwako, naye tazizikiza. Kale nno, ng’akanyonyi akayimba ekiro, ka nyimbe mu kizikiza. Okusuubira kunompa ennyimba, n’essuubi lisikke oluyimba. Mu bbanga ttono ndisanyukira ettaala Katonda gy’akoleezezza. Kaakano ndi munafu era nkooye. Oboolyawo mbeera y’obudde, oba obunafu bw’omubiri, oba okwewuunya olw’akabi akatujjidde amangu; naye ekyaleeta ekizikiza kyonna, Katonda yekka y’alireeta ekitangaala. Amaaso gange gali ku ye yekka. Mu bbanga ttono ndiba n’ettaala za Mukama nga zaakira okumpituka; ate mu maaso, mu kiseera kye ekirungi, ndibeera gye batakyeetaaga ttaala wadde ekitangaala ky’enjuba. Aleruuya! Sebuttemba 28 OMULIMU GUWEDDE; WUMMULIRA MU YE "Naye Katonda atusuubizza olunaku olwa Ssabbiiti lwe tuliwummula, newaakubadde nga terunnatuuka." Abaebbulaniya 4:9 Katonda ateeseteese Ssabbiiti, era abamu bateekwa okuyingira mu yo. Abo be yasooka okubuulira tebaayingira olw’obutakkiriza; kale Ssabbiiti eyo esigalira abantu ba Katonda. Dawudi yagiyimba; naye kyamugwanira okukwata ku ddoboozi eritali lya ssanyu, kubanga Isirayiri baagaana okuwummula kwa Katonda. Yoswa teyasobola kukuwa, so ne Kanani teyakuwaayo: kusigalira abakkiriza. Kale nno, mujje, tufubire okuyingira mu kuwummula kuno. Tuveeko okutegana okukooya okw’ekibi n’okwefaako. Tulekeraawo okwesiga kwonna, ne mu mirimu egyo egiyinza okugambibwako nti, "Birungi nnyo." Tulina egiri egyo? Wadde bwe kiri, tuveeko emirimu gyaffe ffe, nga Katonda bwe yava ku gigye. Kaakano tufune essanyu mu mulimu ogutuukiridde ogwa Mukama waffe Yesu. Byonna bituukiriziddwa mu bujjuvu: obwenkanya tebukyetaaga kirala. Emirembe emingi gwe mugabo gwaffe mu Kristo Yesu. Ku bikwata ku kulabirira kwa Katonda, omulimu gw’ekisa mu mwoyo, n’omulimu gwa Mukama mu myoyo gy’abalala, tusuule emigugu gino ku Mukama, tuwummulire mu ye. Mukama bw’atuwa ekikoligo okusitula, akikola tulyoke tufune okuwummula nga tukisitudde. Olw’okukkiriza tufuba okuyingira mu kuwummula kwa Katonda, era tulekulira okuwummula kwonna okw’okwematiza oba okugayaala. Yesu yennyini ye kuwummula okutuukiridde era tujjuzibwa okutuuka ku mabbali mu ye. Sebuttemba 29 OKUGULUMIZA KRISTO YESU "Oyo agenda kungulumiza, kubanga agenda kubategeeza bye nnaamubuuliranga." Yokaana 16:14 Omwoyo Omutukuvu yennyini tayinza kugulumiza Mukama Yesu okusinga okutulaga ebintu bya Kristo ye. Yesu ye kutenderezebwa kwe okusinga obulungi. Tewali kumuwunda okuggyako ne zaabu ye ye. Omubudaabudi atulaga ekyo ky’aweereddwa okuva eri Mukama waffe Yesu. Tetulaba kintu bulungi okutuusa lw’akibikkula. Alina engeri y’okubikkula ebirowoozo byaffe, n’okubikkula Ebyawandiikibwa, era mu ngeri eno emirundi ebiri ayolekera Mukama waffe eri ffe. Waliwo obukugu bungi mu kwoleka ensonga, era obukugu obwo bwa Mwoyo ow’amazima mu ngeri esingira ddala waggulu. Atulaga ebintu byennyini. Kino kya nkizo nnene, ng’abo abamanyi abanyumirwa okwolesebwa okutukuvu bwe bamanyi. Tunoonye okwakira kw’Omwoyo; si okumatiza okwegomba kwaffe okumanya, wadde okutuleetera essanyu ery’obuntu, wabula okugulumiza Mukama Yesu. Woowe, singa tubeera n’endowooza ennuŋŋamu ku ye! Endowooza empitirivu ereetera Mukama waffe ow’omuwendo okunyoomebwa. Woowe, singa tubeera n’ebifaananyi ebilaba obulungi eby’omuntu we, n’omulimu gwe, n’ekitiibwa kye, tulyoke tuleekaanire ettendo lye n’omutima n’emmeeme! Awali omutima ogugaggawaziddwa okuyigiriza kw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu waliwo Omulokozi agulumizibwa okusukka okwogera. Jjangu, Ayi Mwoyo Omutukuvu, ekitangaala eky’omu ggulu, otulage Yesu Mukama waffe! Sebuttemba 30 OKWASAMYA EMIMWA GYAFFE "Yasamya akamwa ko, nange nnaakajjuza." Zabbuli 81:10 Nga kwe kuzzaamu amaanyi mu kusaba! Endowooza yaffe ey’obuntu yandituleese okusaba ebintu ebitono kubanga bye tusaanira bitono nnyo; naye Mukama ayagala tusabe emikisa emikulu. Okusaba kwandibadde kwangu ng’okwasamya akamwa; kwandibadde kwogera okwa bulijjo, okutakakibwa. Omuntu bw’aba nga anyiikivu, asamya akamwa ke, era ekyawandiikibwa kyaffe kitukubiriza okuba abanyiikivu mu kwegayirira kwaffe. Naye era kitegeeza nti tuyinza okuguma mu maaso ga Katonda, ne tusaba emikisa emingi era eminene okuva mu mikono gye. Soma olunyiriri lwonna, olabe ensonga: "Nze Mukama Katonda wo, eyakuggya mu nsi y’e Misiri. Yasamya akamwa ko, nange nnaakajjuza." Olw’okuba Mukama atuwadde bingi bwe bityo, atuyita okusaba ebisingawo, weewaawo, okusuubira ebisingawo. Laba obunyonyi obuto mu bisu byabwo bwe bulabika ng’obwa kamwa kokka nnyina bw’ajja okubuliisa. Kibe bwe kityo ne gye tuli. Tuyingize ekisa mu buli mulyango. Tukinywe ng’ekyangwe bwe kinuuna amazzi mwe kigalamidde. Katonda mwetegefu okutujjuza singa naffe tuba beetegefu okujjuzibwa. Obwetaavu bwaffe butwasamye emimwa gyaffe; obunafu bwaffe butuleetere okwasamya emimwa gyaffe n’okuwejjawejja; weewaawo, okutya kwaffe kutwasamye emimwa gyaffe n’okukaaba ng’omwana. Akamwa akaasamiddwa kalijjuzibwa Mukama yennyini. Kibe bwe kityo gye tuli, Ayi Mukama, olwa leero.

fields.title: Omwezi gwa Okitobba
fields.body_html:
Okitobba 1

ENDAGAANO GY’AJJUKIRA

"Agabira abamutya emmere; era ajjukira endagaano ye buli kiseera." Zabbuli 111:5

Abo abatya Katonda tebalina kya kutya kya bwetaavu. Mu myaka gino gyonna emiwanvu, Mukama bulijjo abadde afunira abaana be emmere, oba nga bali mu ddungu, oba ku kagga Kerisi, oba mu buwaŋŋanguse, oba wakati mu njala. Okutuusa kaakano Mukama atuwadde emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku, era tetubuusabuusa nti ajja kweyongera okutuliisa okutuusa lwe tutaliba na kwetaaga kirala.

Ku by’emikisa emisukkulumu era eminene egy’endagaano ey’ekisa, taalekenga kubituwa nga embeera yaffe bw’eyagala. Ajjukira nti ye yakola endagaano eyo, era tayisaayisa nga eyagigejjererwa. Agijjukira ne bwe tumusunguwaza okututta. Ajjukira okutwagala, okutukuuma, n’okutubudaabuda, nga bwe yeeyama okukola. Ajjukira buli kimu ku ebyo bye yeeyama, wadde akatono ennyo, era takkiriza na kigambo kye na kimu kugwa wansi.

Ffe tetujjukira Katonda waffe nga bwe kigwanidde, naye ye atujjukira n’ekisa. Tayinza kwerabira Mwana we, Omuyima w’Endagaano, wadde Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, atuukiriza endagaano n’obunyiikivu, wadde ekitiibwa kye ye, ekisibiddwa ku ndagaano. Kyeva omusingi gwa Katonda gunywera, era tewali mukkiriza aliba afiirwa obusika bwe obw’obwakatonda, obubwe olw’endagaano ey’omunnyo.

Okitobba 2

OKUBUDAABUDA KU LUGENDO OLW’EKA

"Yusufu n’agamba baganda be nti, Nnaatera okufa, naye Katonda alibakyalira n’abalinnyisa okubaggya mu nsi eno; n’abatwala mu nsi gye yalayirira Ibulayimu, ne Isaaka ne Yakobo." Olubereberye 50:24

Yusufu yali eri baganda be ng’okulabirira kwa Katonda okwafuuka omuntu. Ba Yusufu baffe bonna baafa, era eby’okubudaabuda olukumi bifiira wamu nabo. Misiri teyaddayo kuba nga bw’eyali eri Isirayiri ng’oluvannyuma lwa Yusufu okufa, era n’ensi teyinza kuddamu kuba eri abamu ku ffe nga bwe yali ng’abaagalwa baffe bakyali balamu.

Naye laba obulumi bw’okufa okwo okunakuwavu bwe bwakendeezebwa! Baalina ekisuubizo nti Katonda omulamu alibakyalira. Okukyalirwa Yakuwa! Nga kya kisa nnyo! Nga kya kubudaabuda! Nga Ggulu ku nsi! Ayi Mukama, tukyalire olwa leero; wadde nga ddala tetusaanira ggwe okuyingira mu nju yaffe.

Naye waaliwo n’ebisingawo ebyasuubizibwa: Mukama yandibaggyeemu. Baalisanga mu Misiri okwanirizibwa okw’obunnyogovu Yusufu ng’amaze okufa; weewaawo, kyandibafuukidde ennyumba ey’obuddu. Naye tekyali kya kubeera bwe kityo emirembe gyonna; bandigivuddemu olw’obulokozi obw’obwakatonda, ne batambulira mu nsi ey’ekisuubizo. Tetulikaabira wano emirembe gyonna. Tuliyitibwa eka mu nsi ey’ekitiibwa okwegatta n’abaagalwa baffe. Kyeva, "buli omu agumyenga munne n’ebigambo ebyo."

Okitobba 3

ABALAGA OBULUNGI BWA MUKAMA

"Nze ndikulaba n’amaaso mu butuukirivu era ndimatira, bwe ndiraba obwenyi bwo nga nzuukuse." Zabbuli 17:15

Omugabo gw’abantu abalala gujjuza emibiri gyabwe, ne gugaggawaza abaana baabwe, naye omugabo gw’omukkiriza gwa ngeri ndala. Abantu ab’ensi eno balina obugagga bwabwe mu nsi eno, naye abantu ab’ensi ejja batunula waggulu era ewala.

Ebyaffe bya ngeri bbiri. Tulina okubeerawo kwa Katonda wano n’ekifaananyi kye oluvannyuma. Wano tulaba obwenyi bwa Mukama mu butuukirivu, kubanga tuweereddwa obutuukirivu mu Kristo Yesu. Nga kya ssanyu okulaba obwenyi bwa Katonda eyatabaganyizibwa naffe! Ekitiibwa kya Katonda mu bwenyi bwa Yesu Kristo kituwa Eggulu ku nsi, era kirituwa Eggulu ery’Eggulu waggulu.

Naye okulaba si kwe kukoma: tuli ba kufuulibwa ekyo kye tutunuulira. Tunaasula akaseera, ne tulyoka tuzuukuka ne tweesanga nga endabirwamu eziraga obulungi bwa Mukama waffe. Okukkiriza kulaba Katonda n’okutunula okukyusa. Omutima gutwala ekifaananyi kya Yesu mu buziba bwagwo, okutuusa engeri ya Yesu lw’eteekebwa ku mwoyo. Kuno kwe kumatira. Okulaba Katonda n’okumufaanana -- kiki ekirala kye nnyinza okwegomba? Obwesige bwa Dawudi obw’amazima wano, ku bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, bufuulibwa ekisuubizo kya Mukama. Nkikkiriza. Nkisuubira. Mukama, kituukirize. Amiina.

Okitobba 4

EKISIKA EKY’AMAANYI

"Bwe ndiwanikibwa okuva mu nsi, ndiwalulira bonna gye ndi." Yokaana 12:32

Mujje, mmwe abakozi, mugume omwoyo. Mutya nti temuyinza kusika kibiina. Mugezeeko okubuulira Omulokozi eyakomererwa, eyazuukira, era eyalinnya mu ggulu; kubanga guno gwe "musika" omukulu ennyo ogwali gulaze mu bantu. Kiki ekyakusika okudda eri Kristo okuggyako Kristo? Kiki ekikusika okudda gy’ali kaakano okuggyako ye yennyini omulungi? Bw’oba wasikibwa okudda mu ddiini olw’ekintu ekirala kyonna, mangu ddala oliwalulwa okuvaamu; naye Yesu akukutte, era anaakukuuma okutuusa ku nkomerero. Kale, lwaki obuusabuusa amaanyi ge ag’okusika abalala? Genda n’erinnya lya Yesu eri abo abaabadde bakakanyavu, olabe oba teribasika.

Tewali muntu wa ngeri yonna atasobola kusikibwa maanyi gano. Abakadde n’abato, abagagga n’abaavu, abatamanyi n’abayigirivu, aboonoonefu oba ab’engeri ennungi -- abantu bonna balivaayo bawulire amaanyi agasika. Yesu ye kisika kyokka. Tuleme okulowooza ku kirala kyonna. Ennyimba tezirisika muntu eri Yesu, so si buweereza bwa bigambo, so si kuwakana, so si mikolo gya ddiini, so si luyoogaano. Yesu yennyini y’ateekwa okusika abantu okudda gy’ali; era Yesu amala ku mulimu ogwo mu mbeera zonna. Toluubirizibwa nkola z’obukumpanya ez’ekiseera kino; naye ng’abakozi ba Mukama mukolere mu ngeri ye, era musike n’emiguwa gya Mukama gennyini. Sika okudda eri Kristo, era sika ku bwa Kristo, kubanga olwo Kristo alisika ku bubwe mu ggwe.

Okitobba 5

KU KIRAGIRO KYA KATONDA

"Abantu ba Isirayiri abalisigalawo balibeera wakati mu mawanga agabeetoolodde, babe ng’omusulo oguva eri Mukama, ng’obukubakuba obutonnyeredde ku muddo obutalindirira muntu oba abaana b’abantu." Mikka 5:7

Bwe kiba nga kino kya mazima ku Isirayiri ow’omu mubiri, kirisingawo okuba amazima ku Isirayiri ow’omwoyo, abantu ba Katonda abakkiriza. Abatukuvu bwe baba nga bwe kibagwanira, baba mukisa ogutabalika eri abo be basaasaanyizibbwamu.

Bali ng’omusulo; kubanga mu ngeri ya kasirise, etatawaanya, bawummuza abo abaabeetoolodde. Mu kasirise naye n’obuyinza, baweereza obulamu, okukula, n’essanyu by’abo ababeera nabo. Nga bava butiribiri mu Ggulu, nga bamasamasa ng’amayinja ag’omuwendo mu njuba, abasajja n’abakazi ab’ekisa balabirira abanafu n’abatalina kya kubalirwa okutuusa buli kasubi lwe kafuna ettondo lyako ery’omusulo. Newaakubadde nga bato ng’obuntu obw’omuntu kinnoomu, bwe begatta, bamala ku bigendererwa by’okwagala Mukama by’atuukiriza okuyita mu bo. Amatondo g’omusulo gatuukiriza okuwummuza ennimiro engazi. Mukama, tufuule ng’omusulo!

Abantu abatya Katonda bali ng’enkuba etonnya ku kiragiro kya Katonda awatali kukkirizibwa na luukusa lwa muntu. Bakolera Katonda ka abantu bakyagale oba nedda; tebasaba lukusa lwa muntu okusinga enkuba bw’etakola. Mukama, tufuule bwe tutyo, ab’obuvumu era abanguyi mu buweereza bwo buli we tunaasindikibwa.

Okitobba 6

OBUKULEMBEZE BW’OMULUŊŊAMYA WAFFE

"Naye Omwoyo ow’amazima, bw’alijja alibaluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna." Yokaana 16:13

Amazima gali ng’empuku ennene gye twagala okuyingira, naye tetusobola kugiyita ffekka. Ku mulyango gwayo gaaka era gamasamasa; naye bwe twandyagadde okugenda mu maaso ne tunoonyereza mu bifo byayo eby’omunda ennyo, twetaaga omuluŋŋamya, oba tulyebuza. Omwoyo Omutukuvu, amanyi amazima gonna mu bujjuvu, ye muluŋŋamya alondeddwa ow’abakkiriza bonna ab’amazima, era abakulembera nga bwe basobola okugumira, okuva mu kisenge ekimu eky’omunda okudda mu kirala, balyoke balabe ebintu bya Katonda eby’omunda ennyo, n’ekyama kye ne kibategeererwa.

Nga kino kisuubizo kya ngeri ki eri omuntu eyeebuuza mu buwombeefu! Twagala okumanya amazima, n’okuyingira mu go. Tumanyi nti ffe twanguyirwa okukyama, era tuwulira obwetaavu obunene obw’omuluŋŋamya. Tusanyuka nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu azze era abeera mu ffe. Yeetoowaza n’atubeerera omuluŋŋamya, era tukkiriza obukulembeze bwe n’essanyu. Twagala okuyiga "amazima gonna," tuleme okuba ab’oluuyi lumu era abatali benkanya. Tetwagala kubeera batamanyi kitundu kyonna eky’okubikkulirwa lwa kubanga kyandituviirako okubulwa omukisa, oba okwonoona. Omwoyo gwa Katonda gujja gutuluŋŋamye mu mazima gonna: ka tuwulirize ebigambo bye n’emitima egiwulira, tugoberere obukulembeze bwe.

Okitobba 7

BULIJJO YE ASOOKA MU NKOLAGANA

"Yesu abakulembeddemu okugenda e Ggaliraaya. Eyo gye mulimulabira nga bwe yabagamba." Makko 16:7

Gye yalonda okusisinkana abayigirizwa be, eyo gye yandibaddewo mu kiseera ekituufu. Yesu akuuma endagaano ye ey’okusisinkana. Bw’asuubiza okutusisinkana ku ntebe ey’okusaasira, oba mu kusinza okw’olwatu, oba mu mpisa entukuvu, tuyinza okwesiga nti aliba eyo. Tuyinza mu bubi okwewala ekifo ekyalondebwa okukuŋŋaanirako, naye ye takikola. Agamba nti, "Abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe"; tayogera nti "Eyo gye ndibeera," wabula agamba nti, "Ndiwo dda."

Yesu bulijjo ye asooka mu nkolagana: "Abakulembera." Omutima gwe guli n’abantu be, essanyu lye liri mu bo, era talwako kubasisinkana. Mu nkolagana yonna, atukulembera.

Naye yeeraga eri abo abamugoberera: "Eyo gye mulimulabira." Okulaba okw’essanyu! Tetufaayo kulaba muntu buntu asinga bonna, naye okulaba YE kwe kujjuzibwa essanyu n’emirembe. Era tulimulaba, kubanga asuubiza okujja eri abo abamukkiriza, n’okweraga gye bali. Weesige nti bwe kiriba bwe kityo, kubanga buli kimu akikola ng’ekigambo kye eky’ekisuubizo bwe kiri: "nga bwe yabagamba." Nyweeza ku bigambo ebyo eby’enkomerero, era okakase nti okutuusa ku nkomerero alikukolera "nga bwe yabagamba."

Okitobba 8

TOLIBEERA WEKKA

"Ataliddayo kuyitibwa nti, Eyalekebwa" Isaaya 62:4

"Eyalekebwa" kigambo kya nnaku. Kivuga ng’ekide ky’okuziika. Kye kijjukizo ky’ennaku ezisingayo obungi, era obunnabbi bw’ebibi ebisingayo obubi. Obuziba obw’ennaku busamaala mu kigambo ekyo "Eyalekebwa." Okulekebwa oyo eyeeyama ekitiibwa kye! Okulekebwa mukwano gwo gw’omaze ebbanga ddene ng’omugezesezza era ng’omwesiga! Okulekebwa ow’oluganda omwagalwa! Okulekebwa kitaawo ne nnyoko! Okulekebwa bonna! Kino ddala kya kabi, naye kiyinza okugumiikirizibwa singa Mukama anaatulonda.

Naye kiba kitya okuwulira ng’olekeddwa Katonda? Lowooza ku kkaaba erisinga obukaawa, "Katonda wange, Katonda wange, lwaki onjabulidde?" Waliwo lwe twali tulozezzaako mu ngeri yonna omususa n’ekikaawa eky’"Eyalekebwa," mu makulu ago? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, ka twegayirire Mukama waffe atununule mu kuddiŋŋana kwonna okw’ennaku etayogerekeka bwe etyo. Woowe, ekizikiza ekifaanana ng’ekyo kireme kuddayo emirembe gyonna! Abantu mu bukyayi baayogera ku mutukuvu nti, "Katonda amulese, ka tumugobe tumukwate." Naye bwe kyali bulijjo bwa bulimba. Ekisa kya Mukama eky’okwagala kirikaka abalabe baffe abakambwe okulya ebigambo byabwe, oba, wakiri, okusirika.

Ekikontanya n’ebyo byonna kye kigambo ekyo ekisukkuluma, Hephzibah -- "Mukama akusanyukira." Kino kifuula okukaaba okuzina. Abo abaali baloota nti balekeddwa bawulire Mukama ng’agamba nti, "Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono.''

Okitobba 9

KIKI EKITUKUZA EBIWEEBWAYO BYAFFE?

"Awo kabona anaddiranga ku musaayi, n’agusiiga ku mayembe ag’oku kyoto okwoterezebwa obubaane obw’akawoowo, ekiri mu Weema ey’Okukuŋŋaanirangamu mu maaso ga Mukama." Ebyabaleevi 4:7

Ekyoto eky’obubaane kye kifo abatukuvu we bawaayo okusaba kwabwe n’ettendo lyabwe; era kya ssanyu okukirowoozaako nga kimansiddwako omusaayi ogwa Ssaddaaka enkulu. Kino kye kifuula okusinza kwaffe kwonna okukkirizibwa eri Yakuwa: alaba omusaayi gwa Mwana we, era kyava akkiriza ekitiibwa kye tumuwa.

Kirungi gye tuli okussa amaaso gaffe ku musaayi ogw’ekiweebwayo ekimu olw’ekibi. Ekibi kyetabika ne mu bintu byaffe ebitukuvu, era okwenenya kwaffe okusinga obulungi, okukkiriza, okusaba, n’okwebaza tebyandikkiriziddwa Katonda singa si lwa muwendo gwa ssaddaaka ey’okutangirira. Bangi banyooma "omusaayi"; naye gye tuli gwe musingi gw’okubudaabudibwa n’essuubi. Ekiri ku mayembe ag’ekyoto kigendererwa okuba mu maaso gaffe mu lwatu bwe tusemberera Katonda. Omusaayi guwa amaanyi okusaba, era kyeguva guba ku mayembe ag’ekyoto. Guli "mu maaso ga Mukama," era kyeguva kigwana okuba mu maaso gaffe. Guli ku kyoto nga tetunnaleeta bubaane; guliwo okutukuza ebiweebwayo byaffe n’ebirabo.

Mujje, ka tusabe n’obwesige, kubanga Ssaddaaka eweereddwayo, omuwendo guwoleddwayo, omusaayi guli munda w’eggigi, era okusaba kw’abakkiriza kuteekwa okuba okuwoomerera eri Mukama.

Okitobba 10

OLUGGI OLUGGULE OLW’EMPULIRAGANYA NE KATONDA

"Laba nkugguliddewo oluggi, omuntu yenna lw’atayinza kuggala" Okubikkulirwa 3:8

Abatukuvu ababeera abeesigwa eri amazima ga Katonda balina oluggi oluggule mu maaso gaabwe. Ggwe emmeeme yange, osazeewo okubeera omulamu n’okufa ng’onywerera ku ekyo Mukama ky’abikkulidde mu Kigambo kye, kale mu maaso go we luyimiridde oluggi luno oluggule.

Nnaayingira nga mpita mu luggi oluggule olw’empuliraganya ne Katonda. Ani anaŋŋaana? Yesu aggyeewo ekibi kyange, n’ampa obutuukirivu bwe, kale nsobola okuyingira awatali kuziyizibwa. Mukama, nkola bwe ntyo olw’ekisa kyo.

Nnina era mu maaso gange oluggi oluggule oluyingira mu byama by’Ekigambo. Nsobola okuyingira mu bintu ebiwanvu ebya Katonda. Okulondebwa, Okwegatta ne Kristo, Okukomawo omulundi ogw’okubiri -- bino byonna biri mu maaso gange, era nsobola okubinyumirwa. Tewali kisuubizo wadde enjigiriza ebiggaliddwa gye ndi kaakano.

Oluggi oluggule olw’okusemberera Katonda luli mu maaso gange mu kyama, n’oluggi oluggule olw’okuba ow’omugaso mu lwatu. Katonda anampulira; Katonda anankozesa. Oluggi lugguliddwawo olw’olugendo lwange olw’okugenda mu maaso eri ekkanisa eri waggulu, n’olw’empuliraganya yange eya buli lunaku n’abatukuvu ab’oku nsi kuno. Abamu bayinza okugezaako okunsibira munda oba okunzigala ebweru, naye byonna bya bwereere.

Amangwago ndiraba oluggi oluggule oluyingira mu Ggulu: omulyango ogw’olulu gwe gunaaba ekkubo lyange ery’okuyingira, ne ndyoka ngenda eri Mukama wange era Kabaka wange, ne mbeera ne Katonda nga nsibiddwa munda emirembe gyonna.

Okitobba 11

OKUBEERA N’EDDEMBE OKUTAMBULA

"Ndibafuula ba maanyi mu Mukama era nabo balitambulira mu linnya lyange, bw’ayogera Mukama." Zekkaliya 10:12

Eky’okusanyusa abatukuvu abalwadde. Baweddemu amaanyi, era batya nti tebalivaayo ku kitanda eky’okubuusabuusa n’okutya; naye Omusawo Omukulu asobola okuggyawo obulwadde, era n’okuggyawo obunafu obuvudde mu bwo. Alizzaamu amaanyi abanafu. Kino alikikola mu ngeri esinga obulungi, kubanga kiriba "mu Yakuwa." Amaanyi gaffe gasinga obulungi nga gali mu Katonda okusinga nga gali mu ffe ffennyini. Mu Mukama galeeta empuliraganya, mu ffe ffennyini gandireese amalala. Mu ffe ffennyini gandibadde matono ennaku, naye mu Katonda tegalina kkomo.

Amaanyi bwe gaweebwa, omukkiriza agakozesa. Atambulira mu linnya lya Mukama. Nga kya ssanyu okutambula ebweru oluvannyuma lw’obulwadde, era nga kya ssanyu okuba ow’amaanyi mu Mukama oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera eky’okulemala! Mukama awa abantu be eddembe okutambula, n’obwerere obw’omunda okukozesa eddembe eryo. Atufuula abaami: tetuli baddu abatamanyi kuwummula, era abatalaba bintu, naye tuli ba ddembe okutambula mpola mu nsi ya Emmanweri yonna.

Jjangu, ggwe omutima gwange, toddayo kuba mulwadde na munakuwavu, Yesu akulagira obeere ow’amaanyi, era otambule ne Katonda mu kufumiitiriza okutukuvu. Gondera ekigambo kye eky’okwagala.

Okitobba 12

AKABONERO AK’EKISA EKY’ENDAGAANO

"Mukama Katonda wo alikomola omutima gwo, n’omutima gwa bazzukulu bo, bw’otyo oyagalanga Mukama Katonda wo n’omutima gwo gwonna, n’emmeeme yo yonna, olyoke obeerenga omulamu." Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 30:6

Wano tusoma ku kukomola okw’amazima.

Weetegereze eyakukola: "Mukama Katonda wo." Ye yekka y’asobola okukola ku mutima gwaffe mu ngeri esobola, n’aggyawo obw’omubiri n’obucaafu bwagwo. Okutufuula okwagala Katonda n’omutima gwaffe gwonna n’emmeeme yaffe yonna kya kyamagero eky’ekisa Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka ky’asobola okukola. Tuteekwa okutunuulira Mukama yekka olw’ekino era tuleme okumatizibwa n’ekitatuuka ku ekyo.

Weetegereze ekifo okukomola kuno gye kukolerwa. Si kwa mubiri, wabula kwa mwoyo. Ke kabonero akateekwa ddala ak’endagaano ey’ekisa. Okwagala Katonda kye kabonero ekitasangulika eky’ezzadde eryalondebwa; olw’envumbo eno ey’ekyama okulondebwa okw’ekisa kukakasibwa eri omukkiriza. Tuteekwa okwegendereza tuleme okwesiga mpisa za kungulu, wabula okuteekebwako envumbo mu mutima olw’omulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu.

Weetegereze ky’evaamu -- "olyoke obeerenga omulamu." Okulowooza eby’omubiri kwe kufa. Mu kuwangula omubiri mwe tusanga obulamu n’emirembe. Bwe tussa omwoyo gwaffe ku bintu eby’Omwoyo, tunaabeera balamu. Ayi, Yakuwa, Katonda waffe, atuukirize omulimu gwe ogw’ekisa ku butonde bwaffe obw’omunda, tulyoke tube abalamu eri Mukama mu ngeri esinga okujjula n’esinga obukulu.

Okitobba 13

SINGA, N’EKISUUBIZO EKISATU

"Abantu bange abatuumiddwa erinnya lyange bwe baneetowazanga, ne basaba, ne banoonya amaaso gange, ne bakyuka okuleka amakubo gaabwe amakyamu, kale nnaawuliranga nga nsinziira mu ggulu ne nsonyiwa ekibi kyabwe era ne mponya ensi yaabwe." 2 Ebyomumirembe 7:14

Newankubadde nga tuyitibwa erinnya lya Mukama, kyokka tuli basajja na bakazi aboonoona. Nga kya kisa nnyo nti Katonda waffe mwetegefu okusonyiwa! Buli lwe twonoona, tuyanguwe okugenda ku ntebe ey’okusaasira eya Katonda waffe, nga tunoonya okusonyiyibwa.

Tuteekwa okwetoowaza. Tetusaanidde kwetoowaza olw’ekituufu nti oluvannyuma lw’okufuna okwagala okungi bwe kityo naye tukyayonoona? Ayi Mukama, tuvuunama mu maaso go mu nfuufu, era tukkiriza obutasiima bwaffe obw’amaanyi. Ayi, obuswavu bw’ekibi! Ayi, obuswavu bwakyo emirundi musanvu mu bantu abaayagalibwa nnyo nga ffe bwe tubadde!

Ekiddako, tuteekwa okusaba okusaasirwa, okulongoosebwa, n’okununulibwa okuva mu maanyi g’ekibi. Ayi Mukama, tuwulire ne kaakano, so toziyiza kukaaba kwaffe.

Mu kusaba kuno tuteekwa okunoonya amaaso ga Mukama. Atulese olw’ebisobyo byaffe, era tuteekwa okumwegayirira akomewo. Ayi Mukama, tutunuulire ng’oyita mu Mwana wo Yesu, era abaddu bo obamwenyukire.

Awamu n’ekyo tuteekwa okukyuka ffennyini okuva mu bubi, Katonda tayinza kutukyukira wabula nga ffe tukyuse okuva mu kibi.

Awo we lijjira ekisuubizo ekisatu eky’okuwulira, okusonyiwa, n’okuwonya. Kitaffe, otuwe ebyo mangu ago olwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo.

Okitobba 14

OBUTAKWATIBWA NSONYI EMIREMBE GYONNA

"Buli muntu alinjatulira mu maaso g’abantu, nange ndimwatulira mu maaso ga Kitange ali mu ggulu." Matayo 10:32

Ekisuubizo eky’ekisa! Kya ssanyu kinene gye ndi okwatula Mukama wange. Ne bwe biba ebisobyo byange bye biryawo bitya, sikwatibwa nsonyi za Yesu, so sitya kulangirira njigiriza z’omusaalaba gwe. Ayi Mukama, obutuukirivu bwo sibukwese munda mu mutima gwange.

Nga kirungi essuubi ekyawandiikibwa kye kinteekera mu maaso! Mikwano bandeka ne balabe basanyuka, naye Mukama taleka muddu we. Awatali kubuusabuusa Mukama wange anankkiriza n’okuno, era anampa obubonero obuggya nti ansiima. Naye wajja olunaku lwe nnaayimirira mu maaso ga Kitaffe omukulu. Nga kya ssanyu okulowooza nti Yesu alinjatulira olwo! Aligamba nti, "Omuntu ono yanneesiga ddala, era yali mwetegefu okuvumibwa ku lw’erinnya lyange; kyenva mmwatula nti wange." Olunaku olulala omusajja omukulu yafuulibwa knight, Kabaka omukazi n’amuwa olukoba olw’amayinja ag’omuwendo; naye ekyo kigasa ki? Kiriba kitiibwa okusinga ebitiibwa byonna, Mukama Yesu okutwatulira mu maaso g’Oyo Ow’ekitiibwa ow’obwakatonda ali mu Ggulu. Nneme okukwatibwa ensonyi okwatula Mukama wange. Nneme okukkiriza okusirika okwa buti, wadde okukkiriza okukwaŋŋana okw’omutima omunafu. Nnaaswala okwatula Oyo asuubiza okunjatula?

Okitobba 15

OKUWANIRIRWA OLW’OKULYA

"Nga Kitange eyantuma bw’ali omulamu, nange bwe ndi omulamu ku bwa Kitange, noolwekyo oyo alya ku nze naye aliba mulamu ku bwange." Yokaana 6:57

Tubeera balamu olw’okwegatta kwaffe n’Omwana wa Katonda. Nga Omutabaganya Katonda-omuntu, Mukama Yesu abeera omulamu ku bwa Kitaawe eyeetuula yekka eyamutuma, era mu ngeri y’emu tubeera balamu olw’Omulokozi eyatuzza obulamu. Oyo ali nsibuko y’obulamu bwaffe ye era y’abuwanirira. Obulamu buwanirirwa okuyita mu kulya. Tuteekwa okuwanirira obulamu obw’omwoyo n’emmere ey’omwoyo, era emmere eyo ey’omwoyo ye Mukama Yesu. Si bulamu bwe, oba okufa kwe, oba obuvunaanyizibwa bwe, oba omulimu gwe, oba ekigambo kye kyokka, wabula Ye yennyini, ng’azingiramu bino byonna. Ku Yesu, Ye yennyini, kwe tulya.

Kino kitulaga mu Kijjulo kya Mukama, naye kituganyulwa ddala nga tufumiitiriza ku Mukama waffe, ne tumukkiririza mu kukkiriza okumwetwalira, ne tumutwala munda mu ffe olw’okwagala, ne tumufuula omu naffe olw’amaanyi g’obulamu obw’omunda. Tumanyi kye kitegeeza okulya ku Yesu, naye tetusobola kukyogera wadde okukiwandiika. Ekisinga amagezi kwe kukikola, era okukikola nga tweyongera. Tukubirizibwa okulya bingi, era kinaatugasa nnyo awatali kkomo okukola bwe tutyo nga Yesu ye mmere yaffe era ye kyokunywa kyaffe.

Mukama, nkwebaza kubanga kino, ekyetaagisa mu bulamu bwange obuggya, era kye kya ssanyu kyakyo ekisinga. Kale, mu ssaawa eno ndya ku ggwe.

Okitobba 16

OKUBA OMU NE KRISTO YESU

"Kubanga Nze ndi mulamu, era nammwe muliba balamu." Yokaana 14:19

Yesu afudde obulamu bw’abamukkiririza obw’amazima nga bulamu bwe bwennyini. Nga bwe kiri eky’amazima nti Omutwe mulamu, n’ebitundu nabyo biba biramu. Singa Yesu tazuukira mu bafu, olwo tuli bafu mu bibi byaffe; naye olwokuba nti azuukidde, abakkiriza bonna bazuukidde mu ye. Okufa kwe kwaggyawo ebibi byaffe, ne kusumulula ebisiba ebyatunywezanga wansi w’omusango gw’okufa. Okuzuukira kwe kukakasa okuweebwa obutuukirivu kwaffe: tusonyiyiddwa, era okusaasira kwogera nti, "Mukama aggyeewo ekyonoono kyo era toofe."

Yesu afudde obulamu bw’abantu be obw’emirembe gyonna nga bulamu bwe bwennyini. Bayinza batya okufa ng’akyali mulamu, nga bali omu naye? Olwokuba nti tafa nate, era okufa tekukyamufuga, bwe batyo tebalidda nate mu ntaana z’ebibi byabwe eby’edda, wabula baliba balamu eri Mukama mu bulamu obuggya. Ayi ggwe omukkiriza, bw’oba, wansi w’okukemebwa okunene, otya nti olunaku olumu oligwa mu mukono gw’omulabe, kino kikuzzeemu amaanyi. Toolifiirwa bulamu bwo obw’omwoyo, kubanga bukwekeddwa ne Kristo mu Katonda. Tobuusabuusa butafa bwa Mukama wo; kyeva tolowooza nti alikuleka ofe, kubanga oli omu naye. Ensonga eraga obulamu bwo bwe bulamu bwe, era ku ekyo toyinza kubaako kutya; kyeva wummulira mu Mukama wo omulamu.

Okitobba 17

OKUTYA OKUTUKUVU

"Oyo awuliriza ebimulagirwa aliweebwa empeera." Engero 13:13

Okussa ekitiibwa okutukuvu mu Kigambo kya Katonda kukendedde nnyo. Abantu beerowooza okuba n’amagezi okusinga Ekigambo kya Mukama, ne bakisalira omusango. "Naye nze si bwe nakolanga, olw’okutya Katonda." Tukkiriza Ekitabo ekyaluŋŋamizibwa Omwoyo nga tekiriimu nsobi, era twoleka ekitiibwa kye tukiwa olw’obuwulize bwaffe. Tetutya kutiisibwa Kigambo, naye tulina okukitya ng’omwana bw’atya kitaawe. Tetutya bibonerezo byakyo, kubanga tulina okutya ebiragiro byakyo.

Okutya kuno okutukuvu okw’ekiragiro kuleeta okuwummula okw’obuwombeefu, okusinga wala obuwoomu obw’obutafaayo obw’amalala. Kufuuka omuluŋŋamya gye tuli mu ntambula yaffe; ekiziyiza bwe tuba tuserengeta, n’ekikubiriza bwe tuba twambuka. Nga tukuumiddwa okuva mu bubi era nga tuluŋŋamizibwa mu butuukirivu olw’ekitiibwa kye tuwa ekiragiro, tufuna emmeeme enteefu, nga luzzi lwa nvinnyo; okuwulira nti tetuvunaanyizibwa, nga bwe kuba obulamu obuva mu bafu; n’obwesige nti tusanyusa Katonda, nga ye ggulu ku nsi kuno. Abatatya Katonda bayinza okuduulira ekitiibwa kyaffe ekinene eri Ekigambo kya Mukama; naye ekyo kigasa ki? Empeera ey’okuyitibwa kwaffe okw’ekitiibwa etumatiza kimala. Empeera z’obuwulize zituleetera okunyoomereza okuduula kw’omunyoomi.

Okitobba 18

AMAZIGA, N’OLUVANNYUMA AMAKUNGULA AG’ESSANYU

"Abo abasiga nga bakaaba amaziga, baliyimba ennyimba ez’essanyu nga bakungula." Zabbuli 126:5

Ebiseera eby’okukaaba bituufu okusigira: tetwagala ttaka kuba likalu nnyo. Ensigo ennyike mu maziga ag’okweraliikirira okw’amaanyi erimera mangu. Omunnyo ogw’amaziga ag’okusaba gunaawa ensigo ennungi akawoowo akanaagikuuma eri envunyu: amazima agayogerwa n’obunyiikivu obungi galina obulamu obw’emirundi ebiri. Mu kifo ky’okulekera awo okusiga olw’okukaaba kwaffe, ka twongere okufuba kubanga ekiseera kirungi nnyo.

Ensigo yaffe ey’omu ggulu teyandisigiddwa bulungi nga tuseka. Ennaku enkulu n’okufaayo ku myoyo gy’abalala kwe kugenderako okusaanira okuyigiriza okutya Katonda okusinga buli kintu ekiringa okusaaga. Tuwulidde ku basajja abaagenda ku lutalo n’omutima omwangu, naye baawangulwa; era bwe kityo bwe kiri emirundi mingi eri abo abasiga mu ngeri y’emu.

Kale jjangu, ggwe omutima gwange, weyongere okusiga mu kukaaba kwo, kubanga olina ekisuubizo eky’amakungula ag’essanyu. Olikungula. Ggwe kennyini oliraba ebivudde mu mulimu gwo. Kino kirikutuukako mu kigero ekinene ennyo ne kikuleetera essanyu, ekyo amakungula amatono, amakalu, era amabi bye gatandiyinzizza kukola. Amaaso go bwe ganaaba nga gazibye olw’amaziga aga ffeeza, olowooze ku ŋŋaano eza zaabu. Gumira n’essanyu okutegana n’okunyolwa okwa kaakano; kubanga olunaku olw’amakungula lulikusasula mu bujjuvu.

Okitobba 19

OKUKANGAVVULA OKUGEREDDWA

"Ndibakangavvula n’obwenkanya" Yeremiya 30:11

Okulekebwa nga tokangavvulwa kyandibadde kabonero ka kabi: kyandikakasizza nti Mukama agambye nti, "Yeegasse n’abasinza ebifaananyi, mumuleke abeere yekka." Katonda aleme kukkiriza kino kubeera mugabo gwaffe! Okukulaakulana okutaliiko kizibu kintu ekireeta okutya n’okukankana. Bonna Katonda b’ayagala n’okwagala okungi, y’abanenya n’okubakangavvula: naye abo b’atassaamu kitiibwa, abaleka ne beegejjesa awatali kutya, ng’ente ez’okuttibwa. Mu kwagala Kitaffe ow’omu ggulu mw’akozesa oluga ku baana be.

Naye laba, okukangavvula kuli "n’obwenkanya": atuwa okwagala okutaliiko kkomo, naye okukangavvula "n’obwenkanya." Nga bwe kyali mu mateeka ag’edda, tewaali Muyisirayiri eyandifunye okusinga "emisago amakumi ana ng’oggyeko gumu, ekyakakasa okubala n’obwegendereza n’okukendeeza ku kubonaabona, bwe kityo bwe kiri eri buli muntu abonyaabonyezebwa mu nnyumba ey’okukkiriza--buli lubetenta lubalibwa. Bwe bwenkanya bw’amagezi, obwenkanya bw’okusaasira, obwenkanya bw’okwagala, kwe kukangavvula kwaffe bwe kugereddwa. Kikafuuwe ffe okujeemera ebiragiro ebya Katonda bwe bityo. Mukama, bw’oyimirira okugera amatondo ag’obukaawa mu kikompe kyange, kiŋŋwanidde okukikkiriza n’essanyu okuva mu mukono gwo, ne nkinywa nga bwe ondagira, nga njogera nti, "By’oyagala bikolebwe."

Okitobba 20

OKUVA MU BULI KIBI

"Alirokola abantu bonna mu bibi byabwe" Matayo 1:21

Mukama, ndokola mu bibi byange. Olw’erinnya lyo Yesu, nzikirizibwa okusaba bwe ntyo. Ndokola mu bibi byange eby’edda, omuze gwabyo guleme kunsiba busibe. Ndokola mu bibi ebinzaalirwa, nleme kufuuka muddu wa bunafu bwange. Ndokola mu bibi ebiri bulijjo mu maaso gange, nleme kufiirwa okubikyawa. Ndokola mu bibi eby’ekyama; ebibi bye sitegeera olw’obutaba na kitangaala. Ndokola mu bibi ebiddiŋŋana mangu era ebyewuunyisa: nneme okusuulibwa wansi olw’okugwibwa amaanyi okw’okukemebwa. Ndokola, Mukama, mu buli kibi. Tokkiriza kibi kyonna kunfuga."

Ggwe wekka gw’oyinza okukola kino. Sisobola kukutula njegere zange oba okutta abalabe bange. Omanyi okukemebwa, kubanga wakemebwa. Omanyi ekibi, kubanga wetikka obuzito bwakyo. Omanyi engeri y’okundabirira mu kiseera kyange eky’olutalo; oyinza okundokola nneme okukola kibi, era okundokola bwe mba nga nkoze ekibi. Kisuubizibwa mu linnya lyo lyennyini nti olikola kino, era nkwegayirira leero nkakase obunnabbi buno. Nneme okuwaayo eri obusungu, oba amalala, oba okuggwaamu essuubi, oba engeri yonna ey’obubi; naye ondokole mu butukuvu bw’obulamu, erinnya lyo Yesu liryoke ligulumizibwe mu nze ennyo.

Okitobba 21

OKUKUBISAAMU KWA KATONDA

"Asembayo okuba owa wansi alyala n’aba lukumi, n’asembayo obutono afuuke eggwanga ery’amaanyi. Nze Mukama, ndikyanguya mu biseera byakyo." Isaaya 60:22

Emirimu gya Mukama emiretwa gitandika ku katono, era tegiba na kabi olw’ekyo. Obunafu buyigiriza okukkiriza, busintuza Katonda, era buleetera erinnya lye ekitiibwa. Muwe omuwendo ebisuubizo eby’okweyongera! Empeke ya kaamulali ye nsinga obutono mu mpeke zonna, kyokka efuuka ekimera ekiri ng’omuti, nga kirina amatabi ebinyonyi eby’omu ggulu mwe bizimba ebisu. Tuyinza okutandika n’omu, era oyo "owa wansi," kyokka "alyala n’aba lukumi." Mukama mukugu nnyo mu kukubisaamu. Emirundi emeka gye yagamba omuddu we ali obwomu nti, "Nnaakwaza!" Mwesige Mukama, mmwe ab’omu n’ababiri; kubanga anaabeera wakati mu mmwe bwe munaakuŋŋaanira mu linnya lye.

"Asembayo obutono." Kiki ekiyinza okunyoomebwa okusinga mu maaso g’abo ababala emitwe ne bapima amaanyi! Kyokka guno gwe musingi gw’eggwanga ekkulu. Emmunyeenye emu yokka y’esooka okwaka akawungeezi, naye mangu ago eggulu lijjula ettabaaza ezitabalika.

So tetusaanidde kulowooza nti okweyongera kuli wala, kubanga ekisuubizo kigamba nti, "Nze Mukama, ndikyanguya mu biseera byakyo." Tewaabeewo kwanguyiriza kw’amangu ago, ng’okwo kwe tulaba mu nkuŋŋaana ezijjudde okusasamala; byonna biribeera mu biseera byabyo ebituufu; kyokka tewaabeewo kulwawo. Mukama bw’ayanguya, embiro ze za kitiibwa.

Okitobba 22

SINZIIRA KU KISUUBIZO KYE

"Kale nno okkirize okuwa ennyumba ey’omuddu wo omukisa enywerere mu maaso go ennaku zonna, kubanga ggwe Ayi Mukama Katonda oyogedde, era ennyumba ey’omuddu wo eneebanga n’omukisa ennaku zonna." 2 Samwiri 7:29

Kino kisuubizo ekyegayiriddwa, era bwe kityo kituyigiriza emirundi ebiri. Buli kigambo Mukama Katonda ky’ayogedde tusaanidde okukikkiriza nga kya mazima ddala, ne tulyoka tukyegayiririra ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka.

Nga kiwoomerera okujuliza ebyo Katonda waffe ky’ayogedde! Nga kya muwendo okukozesa "noolwekyo" ekisuubizo kye kitegeeza, nga Dawudi bw’akola mu lunyiriri luno!

Tetusaba lwa kubuusabuusa, wabula lwa kukkiriza. Okusaba awatali kukkiriza tekisaanira baana ba Mukama. Nedda, Mukama, tetuyinza kukubuusabuusa: tukakasibwa nti buli kigambo kyo gwe musingi ogwesigika ogw’okusuubira okusingayo. Tujja gy’oli ne tugamba nti, "Okole nga bwe wasuubiza." Wa omukisa ennyumba y’omuddu wo. Wonya abalwadde baffe; lokola abo abalengalenga; komyawo abo ababula; nyweza abo ababeera mu kukutya. Mukama, tuwe emmere n’ebyokwambala ng’ekigambo kyo bwe kiri. Yamba emirimu gyaffe; naddala wangaaza okufuba kwaffe okumanyisa Enjiri yo mu kitundu kyaffe. Fuula abaddu baffe abaddu bo, n’abaana baffe abaana bo. Leka omukisa gukulukute eri emirembe egigenda okujja, era ng’ekika kyaffe kyonna bwe kikyaliwo ku nsi kibeere nga kikwesigwa. Ayi Mukama Katonda, "ennyumba ey’omuddu wo eweebwe omukisa."

Okitobba 23

AMAKUNGULA G’EKITANGAALA, N’ESSANYU

"Omusana gwe gwakira abatuukirivu, n’abalina omutima ogw’amazima bajjula essanyu." Zabbuli 97:11

Obutuukirivu bulikuwaza omuwendo omungi eri omuntu abunywereramu mu buli kabi, naye ku nkomerero bulyesasulira era buliddizaawo amagoba agatakoma. Obulamu obutukuvu buli ng’okusiga ensigo: bingi bifuluma, era bulabika ng’abiziikidde mu ttaka, nga tebiddayo kukuŋŋaanyizibwa. Tukyama bwe tunoonya amakungula amangu ago; naye ensobi eno ya bwabuntu, kubanga kirabika nga tekisoboka kuziika kitangaala. Kyokka ekitangaala "kisigibwa," bw’ekigamba ekyawandiikibwa. Kigalamidde nga tekirabika: tewali akiraba, kisigiddwa. Tumanyidde ddala nti lulituuka ne kyeraga.

Tukakasa ddala nti Mukama ateeseteese amakungula eri abo abasiga ekitangaala, era baligakungula, buli muntu ku bubwe. Olwo essanyu lyabwe lirijja. Ebinywa by’essanyu olw’ensigo ez’ekitangaala. Omutima gwabwe gwali mugolokofu mu maaso ga Mukama, wadde ng’abantu tebaabawa kitiibwa olw’ekyo, naye ne babavuma: baali batuukirivu, wadde ng’abo ababeetoolodde babalanga ng’abaawukanya. Baalina okulindirira, ng’abalimi bwe balindirira ebibala eby’omuwendo eby’ensi: naye ekitangaala kyabasigirwa, era essanyu lyali litegekebwa ku lwabwe Mukama ow’amakungula.
