Mugume amaanyi, baganda bange! Tetwetaaga kwanguyiriza. Ka tunyweze emmeeme zaffe n’obugumiikiriza, kubanga mangu ago emmeeme zaffe zirifuna ekitangaala n’essanyu.

Okitobba 24

OBUNYWEVU MU KUTYA KATONDA

"Ndikufuula ekisenge eri abantu bano, ekisenge ekinywezebbwa eky’ekikomo. Balikulwanyisa naye tebalikuwangula, kubanga ndi naawe, okukununula, n’okukulokola, bw’ayogera Mukama' Yeremiya 15:20

Obunywevu mu kutya n’okukkiriza Katonda bufuula omuntu ng’ekisenge eky’ekikomo, tewali ayinza kukimenya oba kukyasa. Mukama yekka y’ayinza okukola abo; naye twetaaga abantu ng’abo mu kkanisa, ne mu nsi, naye naddala ku kituuti.

Emirembe gino egy’obukuusa ginaalwanyisa n’amaanyi gonna abantu ab’amazima abatakyukakyuka. Tewali kirabika kunyiiza Setaani n’ezzadde lye ng’okusalawo n’obukakafu. Balumba obunywevu obutukuvu nga Abasuuli bwe baazingiza ebibuga ebiriko bbugwe. Essanyu liri nti tebayinza kuwangula abo Katonda b’afudde ab’amaanyi mu buyinza bwe. Nga batwalibwa buli mpewo ey’enjigiriza, abalala kye kyokka kwe kufuuyibwako, ne bagenda; naye abo abaagala enjigiriza ez’ekisa, kubanga balina ekisa eky’enjigiriza, bayimirira ng’enjazi wakati mu nnyanja ezisiikuuse.

Obunywevu buno buva wa? "Ndi naawe, bw’ayogera Mukama": eyo ye ddiba entuufu. Yakuwa alirokola n’awonya emmeeme ennywevu okuva mu kulumbibwa kwonna okw’omulabe. Eggye lituulumbye, naye Mukama ow’Eggye ali naffe. Tetwaŋŋanga kuva ku kifo kyaffe wadde akatono; kubanga Mukama yennyini y’atunyweza mu kifo kyaffe, era eyo gye tulibeerera emirembe gyonna.

Okitobba 25

KATONDA ASOOKE, EBIRALA BIGATTIBWEKO

"Naye musooke munoonye obwakabaka bwa Katonda n’obutuukirivu bwe, ebyo byonna mulibyongerwako." Matayo 6:33

Laba Bayibuli nga bw’etandika: "Ku lubereberye Katonda." Obulamu bwo butandike mu ngeri y’emu. Noonya n’emmeeme yo yonna, okusooka era okusinga byonna, obwakabaka bwa Katonda, ng’ekifo eky’obwenkanya bwo, n’obutuukirivu bwe ng’empisa ez’obulamu bwo. Ebisigadde biriva eri Mukama yennyini nga tobyeraliikirira. Byonna ebyetaagibwa mu bulamu buno ne mu kutya Katonda "mulibyongerwako."

Nga kino kisuubizo kya ngeri ki! Emmere, ebyokwambala, amaka, n’ebirala, Katonda yeeyama okubikugattako ng’omunoonya. Ffaayo ku mirimu gye, naye y’anaafaayo ku gyo. Bw’oba weetaaga empapula n’akaguwa, obiweebwa awamu bw’ogula ebintu ebikulu ennyo; bwe kityo bwe kityo byonna bye twetaaga eby’omu nsi tulibigattibwako awamu n’obwakabaka. Oyo omusika w’obulokozi taafe njala; n’oyo ayambaza emmeeme ye obutuukirivu bwa Katonda, Mukama tayinza kumuleka na mubiri gwereere. Vaawo ggwe okweraliikirira okumira. Ssaayo omwoyo gwo gwonna ku kunoonya Mukama. Okuyaayaana bwavu, n’okweraliikirira nnaku: okwesiga Katonda kye kyobugagga, n’okufaanana Katonda gwe musika ogw’omu ggulu. Mukama, nkunoonya, ndabike gy’oli.

Okitobba 26

OLW’AFFE

"Olw’abalonde be ennaku ezo zirikendezebwako" Matayo 24:22

Olw’abalonde be, Mukama akuuma emisango mingi, n’akendeeza egirala. Mu kubonaabona okunene, omuliro gwandyiye byonna singa si lwa kussa ekitiibwa ku balonde be, Mukama n’azikiza olulimi lw’omuliro. Bwe kityo, ng’alokola abalonde be olwa Yesu, era akuuma n’olulyo olw’abantu olw’abalonde be.

Nga kitiibwa kya ngeri ki ekiweebwa abatukuvu! Nga basaanidde okukozesa n’obunyiikivu obuyinza bwabwe eri Mukama waabwe! Aliwulira okusaba kwabwe olw’aboonoonyi, n’awa omukisa okufuba kwabwe olw’obulokozi bwabwe. Awa abakkiriza omukisa balyoke babeere mukisa eri abo abali mu butakkiriza. Aboonoonyi bangi balamu olw’okusaba kwa maama, oba mukyala, oba muwala, Mukama gw’assaamu ekitiibwa.

Tukozesezza bulungi obuyinza obw’enjawulo Mukama bw’atwesigisa? Tusabira ensi yaffe, n’amawanga amalala, n’omulembe guno? Mu biseera eby’entalo, enjala, ne kawumpuli, tuyimirira ng’abawolereza, nga twegayirira nti ennaku zikendezebweko? Tukungubagira mu maaso ga Katonda okubunyuuka kw’obutakkiriza, n’obukyamu, n’obwenzi? Twegayirira Mukama waffe Yesu okukendeeza obufuzi bw’ekibi ng’ayanguyiza okulabika kwe okw’ekitiibwa? Ka tufukamire, era tuleme okuwummula okutuusa Kristo lw’alirabika.

Okitobba 27

OKUWEEREZA KWE, AMAASO GE, ERINNYA LYE

"Abaddu be balimuweereza, era banaalabanga amaaso ge, n’erinnya lye liriwandiikibwa mu byenyi byabwe." Okubikkulirwa 22:3, 4

Emikisa esatu emironde giribeera gyaffe mu nsi ey’ekitiibwa.

"Abaddu be balimuweereza." Tewaabeewo bakama balala abatujooga, tewaabeewo buweereza bulala butunakuwaza. Tuliweereza Yesu bulijjo, mu bujjuvu, awatali kukoowa, era awatali kusobya. Guno gwe ggulu eri omutukuvu: mu bintu byonna okuweereza Mukama Kristo, n’okuba nga atulaba ng’abaddu be, kwe kwegomba kwa mmeeme yaffe okw’emirembe gyonna.

"Era banaalabanga amaaso ge." Kino kifuula okuweereza okusanyusa: mazima, gwe mpeera ey’okuweereza eya kaakano. Tulimanya Mukama waffe, kubanga tulimulaba nga bw’ali. Okulaba amaaso ga Yesu kye kisa ekisinga omuddu wa Mukama omwesigwa ennyo ky’ayinza okusaba. Kiki Musa kye yandisabye okusinga -- "Ka ndabe amaaso go"?

"N’erinnya lye liriwandiikibwa mu byenyi byabwe." Batunuulira Mukama waabwe okutuusa erinnya lye lwe likubibwa ku byenyi byabwe ng’ekifaananyi. Bategeerwa Ye, era nabo bamutegeera. Akabonero ak’ekyama ak’ekisa eky’omunda kakula ne kafuuka akabonero akalabika mu lwatu ak’enkolagana eyeeyanjudde.

Ayi Mukama, tuwe ebintu bino ebisatu mu ntandikwa yaabyo wano, tulyoke tubifune mu bujjuvu bwabyo mu kifo kyo eky’essanyu!

Okitobba 28

EBIBI EBY’OBUTAMANYA

"Bwe batyo banaasonyiyibwanga; kubanga baasobya mu butagenderera" Okubala 15:25

Olw’obutamanya bwaffe, tetutegeera bulungi bibi byaffe eby’obutamanya. Kyokka tuyinza okukakasa nti bingi, mu ngeri z’okukola ebitasaana n’okulekera awo ebisaana. Tuyinza okuba nga tukola n’omutima omulongoofu, ng’okuweereza Katonda, ekyo Ye ky’atalagira, era ky’atayinza kukkiriza.

Mukama amanyi buli kimu ku bibi bino eby’obutamanya. Kino kiyinza okututya, kubanga mu bwenkanya alituvunaana ebyonoono bino; naye ku luuyi olulala, okukkiriza kulaba essanyu mu nsonga eno, kubanga Mukama alifuba okulaba nti ebbala lye tutalaba lyoza. Alaba ekibi alyoke akyongereko okukiraba ng’akisuula emabega we.

Okubudaabudibwa kwaffe okukulu kwe kuti Yesu, kabona ow’amazima, atangiridde ekibiina kyonna eky’abaana ba Isirayiri. Okutangirira okwo kukakasa okusonyiyibwa kw’ebibi ebitamanyiddwa. Omusaayi gwe ogw’omuwendo gutunaazaako ekibi kyonna. Ka kibe nga amaaso gaffe gakiraba ne tukikaabira oba nedda, Katonda akirabye, Kristo akitangiridde, Omwoyo akakasa okusonyiyibwa kwakyo, bwe kityo tulina emirembe egy’engeri esatu.

Ayi Kitange, ntendereza okumanya kwo okw’obwakatonda, okutalaba byonoono byange byokka, naye era okumteekerateekera ekitangiriro ekimponya omusango gwabyo, ne nga sinnaba na kumanya nti ndina omusango.

Okitobba 29

KUUMA ENJAWULO

"Nzija kussaawo enjawulo wakati w’abantu bange n’abantu bo. Ekyamagero kino kijja kubaawo enkeera." Okuva 8:23

Falaawo alina abantu be, ne Mukama alina abantu be. Bano bayinza okubeera wamu, ne balabika ng’abenkanankana, naye waliwo enjawulo wakati waabwe, era Mukama aligyeyoleka. Si lwa mirembe gyonna ekintu kimu kirituuka bonna mu ngeri y’emu, naye waabeewo enjawulo nnene wakati w’abantu b’ensi n’abantu Yakuwa be yeeroboza.

Kino kiyinza okubaawo mu kiseera eky’emisango, Mukama bw’afuuka ekifo ekitukuvu eky’abatukuvu be. Kirabika nnyo mu kukyusibwa kw’abakkiriza ng’ekibi kyabwe kiggyibbwawo, ate ng’abatakkiriza basigala mu kusalirwa omusango. Okuva mu kaseera ako, bafuuka olulyo olw’enjawulo, bajja wansi w’okukangavvula okuggya, ne beeyagalira emikisa emiggya. Amaka gaabwe, okuva mu kiseera ekyo, teganyigirizibwa bibinja by’ebibi ebisaasaanya ebyonoona ne bibonyaabonya Abamisiri. Bakuumibwa okuva mu bucaafu bw’okwegomba, okuluma kw’okweraliikirira, obwonoonefu bw’obulimba, n’okubonyaabonya okw’ettima ekukambwe, ebisaanyaawo amaka mangi.

Weesige, ggwe omukkiriza agezesebbwa, nti wadde ng’olina ebizibu byo, olokolebwa mu bibinja by’ebibi ebisingako obubi, ebijjula amaka n’emitima gy’abaddu b’Omulangira w’ensi. Mukama assizaawo enjawulo; laba ng’okuuma enjawulo eyo mu mwoyo, mu kigendererwa, mu mpisa ne mu banno.

Okitobba 30

OKUNAAZIBWA OKUJJUVU

"Ndibamaansirako amazzi amayonjo, era ndibaggyako obutali bulongoofu bwammwe bwonna n’okuva ku bakatonda abalala bonna, ne mbafuula abalongoofu." Ezeekyeri 36:25

Nga essanyu lino lya maanyi! Oyo eyatunaaza n’omusaayi gwa Yesu era alitunaaza n’amazzi ag’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Katonda akyogedde, era bwe kityo bwe kiteekwa okuba, "Mulibeera abalongoofu." Mukama, tuwulira era tukungubagira obutali bulongoofu bwaffe, era kizzaamu amaanyi okukakasibwa n’akamwa ko wennyini nti tulibeera abalongoofu. Ayi, singa okikola mangu!

Alitulokola mu bibi byaffe ebisingayo obubi. Okugolokoka kw’obutakkiriza, n’okwegomba okulimba okulwanyisa emmeeme, ebirowoozo ebibi eby’amalala, n’okusendasenda kwa Setaani okuvvoola erinnya ettukuvu -- bino byonna birifulumizibwa ne bitaddayo emirembe gyonna.

Era alitunaaza okuva mu bakatonda baffe bonna, oba aba zaabu oba ab’ebbumba: okwagala kwaffe okutali kulongoofu, n’okwagala kwaffe okuyitiridde ku ekyo ekiri ekirongoofu mu kyennyini. Ekyo kye twafuula katonda kirimenyebwa ne kituvaako, oba ffe tulimenyebwa ne tukivaako.

Katonda ye ayogera ku ekyo Ye kennyini ky’alikola. Noolwekyo ekigambo kino kinywevu era kya kakafu, era tuyinza n’obuvumu okusuubira ekyo kye kitukakasa. Okunaazibwa mukisa gwa ndagaano, era endagaano etegekeddwa mu bintu byonna era ya kakafu.

Okitobba 31

OMULAMU OKUTUUSA OMULIMU LWE GULIGGWA

"Sijja kufa, wabula nzija kuba mulamu, ndyoke ntegeeze ebyo byonna Mukama by’akoze." Zabbuli 118:17

Buno bukakafu bulungi! Awatali kubuusabuusa bwasinziira ku kisuubizo, ekyawuubaawuubibwa munda mu mutima gw’Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli, kye yakwata ne yeeyagala. Embeera yange eri ng’eya Dawudi? Nnennyamidde kubanga omulabe anvuma? Waliwo ekibiina ekinnwanyisa, ne batono ku luuyi lwange? Obutakkiriza bunnagira ngalamire ne nfa mu kuggwaamu essuubi -- omuntu awanguddwa, aswazibbwa? Abalabe bange batandika okunsimira entaana?

Kale kiki? Nnyinze okuwuliriza okwama kw’okutya, ne nva mu lutalo, ne ndeka n’essuubi lyonna? Kikafuuwe. Wakyaliwo obulamu mu nze: "Sijja kufa." Amaanyi galidda ne gaggyawo obunafu bwange: "Nzija kuba mulamu." Mukama mulamu, era nange ndiba mulamu. Akamwa kange kalyasamizibwa nate: "Nnaategeeza ebyo byonna Mukama by’akoze." Yee, era ndyogera ku kuzibu okwa kaakano ng’ekyokulabirako ekirala eky’obwesigwa n’okwagala okukola eby’amagero okwa Mukama Katonda wange. Abo abandyagala okumpima olw’essanduuko yange balinde katono; kubanga "Mukama ambonerezza nnyo, naye tandese kufa." Ekitiibwa kibeere eri erinnya lye emirembe gyonna! Ndi omulamu okutuusa omulimu gwange lwe guliggwa. Okutuusa Mukama lw’anaakyagala, tewali ntaana eyinza kunziba.
fields.body_text: Okitobba 1 ENDAGAANO GY’AJJUKIRA "Agabira abamutya emmere; era ajjukira endagaano ye buli kiseera." Zabbuli 111:5 Abo abatya Katonda tebalina kya kutya kya bwetaavu. Mu myaka gino gyonna emiwanvu, Mukama bulijjo abadde afunira abaana be emmere, oba nga bali mu ddungu, oba ku kagga Kerisi, oba mu buwaŋŋanguse, oba wakati mu njala. Okutuusa kaakano Mukama atuwadde emmere yaffe eya buli lunaku, era tetubuusabuusa nti ajja kweyongera okutuliisa okutuusa lwe tutaliba na kwetaaga kirala. Ku by’emikisa emisukkulumu era eminene egy’endagaano ey’ekisa, taalekenga kubituwa nga embeera yaffe bw’eyagala. Ajjukira nti ye yakola endagaano eyo, era tayisaayisa nga eyagigejjererwa. Agijjukira ne bwe tumusunguwaza okututta. Ajjukira okutwagala, okutukuuma, n’okutubudaabuda, nga bwe yeeyama okukola. Ajjukira buli kimu ku ebyo bye yeeyama, wadde akatono ennyo, era takkiriza na kigambo kye na kimu kugwa wansi. Ffe tetujjukira Katonda waffe nga bwe kigwanidde, naye ye atujjukira n’ekisa. Tayinza kwerabira Mwana we, Omuyima w’Endagaano, wadde Omwoyo we Omutukuvu, atuukiriza endagaano n’obunyiikivu, wadde ekitiibwa kye ye, ekisibiddwa ku ndagaano. Kyeva omusingi gwa Katonda gunywera, era tewali mukkiriza aliba afiirwa obusika bwe obw’obwakatonda, obubwe olw’endagaano ey’omunnyo. Okitobba 2 OKUBUDAABUDA KU LUGENDO OLW’EKA "Yusufu n’agamba baganda be nti, Nnaatera okufa, naye Katonda alibakyalira n’abalinnyisa okubaggya mu nsi eno; n’abatwala mu nsi gye yalayirira Ibulayimu, ne Isaaka ne Yakobo." Olubereberye 50:24 Yusufu yali eri baganda be ng’okulabirira kwa Katonda okwafuuka omuntu. Ba Yusufu baffe bonna baafa, era eby’okubudaabuda olukumi bifiira wamu nabo. Misiri teyaddayo kuba nga bw’eyali eri Isirayiri ng’oluvannyuma lwa Yusufu okufa, era n’ensi teyinza kuddamu kuba eri abamu ku ffe nga bwe yali ng’abaagalwa baffe bakyali balamu. Naye laba obulumi bw’okufa okwo okunakuwavu bwe bwakendeezebwa! Baalina ekisuubizo nti Katonda omulamu alibakyalira. Okukyalirwa Yakuwa! Nga kya kisa nnyo! Nga kya kubudaabuda! Nga Ggulu ku nsi! Ayi Mukama, tukyalire olwa leero; wadde nga ddala tetusaanira ggwe okuyingira mu nju yaffe. Naye waaliwo n’ebisingawo ebyasuubizibwa: Mukama yandibaggyeemu. Baalisanga mu Misiri okwanirizibwa okw’obunnyogovu Yusufu ng’amaze okufa; weewaawo, kyandibafuukidde ennyumba ey’obuddu. Naye tekyali kya kubeera bwe kityo emirembe gyonna; bandigivuddemu olw’obulokozi obw’obwakatonda, ne batambulira mu nsi ey’ekisuubizo. Tetulikaabira wano emirembe gyonna. Tuliyitibwa eka mu nsi ey’ekitiibwa okwegatta n’abaagalwa baffe. Kyeva, "buli omu agumyenga munne n’ebigambo ebyo." Okitobba 3 ABALAGA OBULUNGI BWA MUKAMA "Nze ndikulaba n’amaaso mu butuukirivu era ndimatira, bwe ndiraba obwenyi bwo nga nzuukuse." Zabbuli 17:15 Omugabo gw’abantu abalala gujjuza emibiri gyabwe, ne gugaggawaza abaana baabwe, naye omugabo gw’omukkiriza gwa ngeri ndala. Abantu ab’ensi eno balina obugagga bwabwe mu nsi eno, naye abantu ab’ensi ejja batunula waggulu era ewala. Ebyaffe bya ngeri bbiri. Tulina okubeerawo kwa Katonda wano n’ekifaananyi kye oluvannyuma. Wano tulaba obwenyi bwa Mukama mu butuukirivu, kubanga tuweereddwa obutuukirivu mu Kristo Yesu. Nga kya ssanyu okulaba obwenyi bwa Katonda eyatabaganyizibwa naffe! Ekitiibwa kya Katonda mu bwenyi bwa Yesu Kristo kituwa Eggulu ku nsi, era kirituwa Eggulu ery’Eggulu waggulu. Naye okulaba si kwe kukoma: tuli ba kufuulibwa ekyo kye tutunuulira. Tunaasula akaseera, ne tulyoka tuzuukuka ne tweesanga nga endabirwamu eziraga obulungi bwa Mukama waffe. Okukkiriza kulaba Katonda n’okutunula okukyusa. Omutima gutwala ekifaananyi kya Yesu mu buziba bwagwo, okutuusa engeri ya Yesu lw’eteekebwa ku mwoyo. Kuno kwe kumatira. Okulaba Katonda n’okumufaanana -- kiki ekirala kye nnyinza okwegomba? Obwesige bwa Dawudi obw’amazima wano, ku bw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu, bufuulibwa ekisuubizo kya Mukama. Nkikkiriza. Nkisuubira. Mukama, kituukirize. Amiina. Okitobba 4 EKISIKA EKY’AMAANYI "Bwe ndiwanikibwa okuva mu nsi, ndiwalulira bonna gye ndi." Yokaana 12:32 Mujje, mmwe abakozi, mugume omwoyo. Mutya nti temuyinza kusika kibiina. Mugezeeko okubuulira Omulokozi eyakomererwa, eyazuukira, era eyalinnya mu ggulu; kubanga guno gwe "musika" omukulu ennyo ogwali gulaze mu bantu. Kiki ekyakusika okudda eri Kristo okuggyako Kristo? Kiki ekikusika okudda gy’ali kaakano okuggyako ye yennyini omulungi? Bw’oba wasikibwa okudda mu ddiini olw’ekintu ekirala kyonna, mangu ddala oliwalulwa okuvaamu; naye Yesu akukutte, era anaakukuuma okutuusa ku nkomerero. Kale, lwaki obuusabuusa amaanyi ge ag’okusika abalala? Genda n’erinnya lya Yesu eri abo abaabadde bakakanyavu, olabe oba teribasika. Tewali muntu wa ngeri yonna atasobola kusikibwa maanyi gano. Abakadde n’abato, abagagga n’abaavu, abatamanyi n’abayigirivu, aboonoonefu oba ab’engeri ennungi -- abantu bonna balivaayo bawulire amaanyi agasika. Yesu ye kisika kyokka. Tuleme okulowooza ku kirala kyonna. Ennyimba tezirisika muntu eri Yesu, so si buweereza bwa bigambo, so si kuwakana, so si mikolo gya ddiini, so si luyoogaano. Yesu yennyini y’ateekwa okusika abantu okudda gy’ali; era Yesu amala ku mulimu ogwo mu mbeera zonna. Toluubirizibwa nkola z’obukumpanya ez’ekiseera kino; naye ng’abakozi ba Mukama mukolere mu ngeri ye, era musike n’emiguwa gya Mukama gennyini. Sika okudda eri Kristo, era sika ku bwa Kristo, kubanga olwo Kristo alisika ku bubwe mu ggwe. Okitobba 5 KU KIRAGIRO KYA KATONDA "Abantu ba Isirayiri abalisigalawo balibeera wakati mu mawanga agabeetoolodde, babe ng’omusulo oguva eri Mukama, ng’obukubakuba obutonnyeredde ku muddo obutalindirira muntu oba abaana b’abantu." Mikka 5:7 Bwe kiba nga kino kya mazima ku Isirayiri ow’omu mubiri, kirisingawo okuba amazima ku Isirayiri ow’omwoyo, abantu ba Katonda abakkiriza. Abatukuvu bwe baba nga bwe kibagwanira, baba mukisa ogutabalika eri abo be basaasaanyizibbwamu. Bali ng’omusulo; kubanga mu ngeri ya kasirise, etatawaanya, bawummuza abo abaabeetoolodde. Mu kasirise naye n’obuyinza, baweereza obulamu, okukula, n’essanyu by’abo ababeera nabo. Nga bava butiribiri mu Ggulu, nga bamasamasa ng’amayinja ag’omuwendo mu njuba, abasajja n’abakazi ab’ekisa balabirira abanafu n’abatalina kya kubalirwa okutuusa buli kasubi lwe kafuna ettondo lyako ery’omusulo. Newaakubadde nga bato ng’obuntu obw’omuntu kinnoomu, bwe begatta, bamala ku bigendererwa by’okwagala Mukama by’atuukiriza okuyita mu bo. Amatondo g’omusulo gatuukiriza okuwummuza ennimiro engazi. Mukama, tufuule ng’omusulo! Abantu abatya Katonda bali ng’enkuba etonnya ku kiragiro kya Katonda awatali kukkirizibwa na luukusa lwa muntu. Bakolera Katonda ka abantu bakyagale oba nedda; tebasaba lukusa lwa muntu okusinga enkuba bw’etakola. Mukama, tufuule bwe tutyo, ab’obuvumu era abanguyi mu buweereza bwo buli we tunaasindikibwa. Okitobba 6 OBUKULEMBEZE BW’OMULUŊŊAMYA WAFFE "Naye Omwoyo ow’amazima, bw’alijja alibaluŋŋamya mu mazima gonna." Yokaana 16:13 Amazima gali ng’empuku ennene gye twagala okuyingira, naye tetusobola kugiyita ffekka. Ku mulyango gwayo gaaka era gamasamasa; naye bwe twandyagadde okugenda mu maaso ne tunoonyereza mu bifo byayo eby’omunda ennyo, twetaaga omuluŋŋamya, oba tulyebuza. Omwoyo Omutukuvu, amanyi amazima gonna mu bujjuvu, ye muluŋŋamya alondeddwa ow’abakkiriza bonna ab’amazima, era abakulembera nga bwe basobola okugumira, okuva mu kisenge ekimu eky’omunda okudda mu kirala, balyoke balabe ebintu bya Katonda eby’omunda ennyo, n’ekyama kye ne kibategeererwa. Nga kino kisuubizo kya ngeri ki eri omuntu eyeebuuza mu buwombeefu! Twagala okumanya amazima, n’okuyingira mu go. Tumanyi nti ffe twanguyirwa okukyama, era tuwulira obwetaavu obunene obw’omuluŋŋamya. Tusanyuka nti Omwoyo Omutukuvu azze era abeera mu ffe. Yeetoowaza n’atubeerera omuluŋŋamya, era tukkiriza obukulembeze bwe n’essanyu. Twagala okuyiga "amazima gonna," tuleme okuba ab’oluuyi lumu era abatali benkanya. Tetwagala kubeera batamanyi kitundu kyonna eky’okubikkulirwa lwa kubanga kyandituviirako okubulwa omukisa, oba okwonoona. Omwoyo gwa Katonda gujja gutuluŋŋamye mu mazima gonna: ka tuwulirize ebigambo bye n’emitima egiwulira, tugoberere obukulembeze bwe. Okitobba 7 BULIJJO YE ASOOKA MU NKOLAGANA "Yesu abakulembeddemu okugenda e Ggaliraaya. Eyo gye mulimulabira nga bwe yabagamba." Makko 16:7 Gye yalonda okusisinkana abayigirizwa be, eyo gye yandibaddewo mu kiseera ekituufu. Yesu akuuma endagaano ye ey’okusisinkana. Bw’asuubiza okutusisinkana ku ntebe ey’okusaasira, oba mu kusinza okw’olwatu, oba mu mpisa entukuvu, tuyinza okwesiga nti aliba eyo. Tuyinza mu bubi okwewala ekifo ekyalondebwa okukuŋŋaanirako, naye ye takikola. Agamba nti, "Abantu ababiri oba abasatu bwe banaakuŋŋaananga mu linnya lyange, nange nnaabeeranga awo wakati waabwe"; tayogera nti "Eyo gye ndibeera," wabula agamba nti, "Ndiwo dda." Yesu bulijjo ye asooka mu nkolagana: "Abakulembera." Omutima gwe guli n’abantu be, essanyu lye liri mu bo, era talwako kubasisinkana. Mu nkolagana yonna, atukulembera. Naye yeeraga eri abo abamugoberera: "Eyo gye mulimulabira." Okulaba okw’essanyu! Tetufaayo kulaba muntu buntu asinga bonna, naye okulaba YE kwe kujjuzibwa essanyu n’emirembe. Era tulimulaba, kubanga asuubiza okujja eri abo abamukkiriza, n’okweraga gye bali. Weesige nti bwe kiriba bwe kityo, kubanga buli kimu akikola ng’ekigambo kye eky’ekisuubizo bwe kiri: "nga bwe yabagamba." Nyweeza ku bigambo ebyo eby’enkomerero, era okakase nti okutuusa ku nkomerero alikukolera "nga bwe yabagamba." Okitobba 8 TOLIBEERA WEKKA "Ataliddayo kuyitibwa nti, Eyalekebwa" Isaaya 62:4 "Eyalekebwa" kigambo kya nnaku. Kivuga ng’ekide ky’okuziika. Kye kijjukizo ky’ennaku ezisingayo obungi, era obunnabbi bw’ebibi ebisingayo obubi. Obuziba obw’ennaku busamaala mu kigambo ekyo "Eyalekebwa." Okulekebwa oyo eyeeyama ekitiibwa kye! Okulekebwa mukwano gwo gw’omaze ebbanga ddene ng’omugezesezza era ng’omwesiga! Okulekebwa ow’oluganda omwagalwa! Okulekebwa kitaawo ne nnyoko! Okulekebwa bonna! Kino ddala kya kabi, naye kiyinza okugumiikirizibwa singa Mukama anaatulonda. Naye kiba kitya okuwulira ng’olekeddwa Katonda? Lowooza ku kkaaba erisinga obukaawa, "Katonda wange, Katonda wange, lwaki onjabulidde?" Waliwo lwe twali tulozezzaako mu ngeri yonna omususa n’ekikaawa eky’"Eyalekebwa," mu makulu ago? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, ka twegayirire Mukama waffe atununule mu kuddiŋŋana kwonna okw’ennaku etayogerekeka bwe etyo. Woowe, ekizikiza ekifaanana ng’ekyo kireme kuddayo emirembe gyonna! Abantu mu bukyayi baayogera ku mutukuvu nti, "Katonda amulese, ka tumugobe tumukwate." Naye bwe kyali bulijjo bwa bulimba. Ekisa kya Mukama eky’okwagala kirikaka abalabe baffe abakambwe okulya ebigambo byabwe, oba, wakiri, okusirika. Ekikontanya n’ebyo byonna kye kigambo ekyo ekisukkuluma, Hephzibah -- "Mukama akusanyukira." Kino kifuula okukaaba okuzina. Abo abaali baloota nti balekeddwa bawulire Mukama ng’agamba nti, "Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono.'' Okitobba 9 KIKI EKITUKUZA EBIWEEBWAYO BYAFFE? "Awo kabona anaddiranga ku musaayi, n’agusiiga ku mayembe ag’oku kyoto okwoterezebwa obubaane obw’akawoowo, ekiri mu Weema ey’Okukuŋŋaanirangamu mu maaso ga Mukama." Ebyabaleevi 4:7 Ekyoto eky’obubaane kye kifo abatukuvu we bawaayo okusaba kwabwe n’ettendo lyabwe; era kya ssanyu okukirowoozaako nga kimansiddwako omusaayi ogwa Ssaddaaka enkulu. Kino kye kifuula okusinza kwaffe kwonna okukkirizibwa eri Yakuwa: alaba omusaayi gwa Mwana we, era kyava akkiriza ekitiibwa kye tumuwa. Kirungi gye tuli okussa amaaso gaffe ku musaayi ogw’ekiweebwayo ekimu olw’ekibi. Ekibi kyetabika ne mu bintu byaffe ebitukuvu, era okwenenya kwaffe okusinga obulungi, okukkiriza, okusaba, n’okwebaza tebyandikkiriziddwa Katonda singa si lwa muwendo gwa ssaddaaka ey’okutangirira. Bangi banyooma "omusaayi"; naye gye tuli gwe musingi gw’okubudaabudibwa n’essuubi. Ekiri ku mayembe ag’ekyoto kigendererwa okuba mu maaso gaffe mu lwatu bwe tusemberera Katonda. Omusaayi guwa amaanyi okusaba, era kyeguva guba ku mayembe ag’ekyoto. Guli "mu maaso ga Mukama," era kyeguva kigwana okuba mu maaso gaffe. Guli ku kyoto nga tetunnaleeta bubaane; guliwo okutukuza ebiweebwayo byaffe n’ebirabo. Mujje, ka tusabe n’obwesige, kubanga Ssaddaaka eweereddwayo, omuwendo guwoleddwayo, omusaayi guli munda w’eggigi, era okusaba kw’abakkiriza kuteekwa okuba okuwoomerera eri Mukama. Okitobba 10 OLUGGI OLUGGULE OLW’EMPULIRAGANYA NE KATONDA "Laba nkugguliddewo oluggi, omuntu yenna lw’atayinza kuggala" Okubikkulirwa 3:8 Abatukuvu ababeera abeesigwa eri amazima ga Katonda balina oluggi oluggule mu maaso gaabwe. Ggwe emmeeme yange, osazeewo okubeera omulamu n’okufa ng’onywerera ku ekyo Mukama ky’abikkulidde mu Kigambo kye, kale mu maaso go we luyimiridde oluggi luno oluggule. Nnaayingira nga mpita mu luggi oluggule olw’empuliraganya ne Katonda. Ani anaŋŋaana? Yesu aggyeewo ekibi kyange, n’ampa obutuukirivu bwe, kale nsobola okuyingira awatali kuziyizibwa. Mukama, nkola bwe ntyo olw’ekisa kyo. Nnina era mu maaso gange oluggi oluggule oluyingira mu byama by’Ekigambo. Nsobola okuyingira mu bintu ebiwanvu ebya Katonda. Okulondebwa, Okwegatta ne Kristo, Okukomawo omulundi ogw’okubiri -- bino byonna biri mu maaso gange, era nsobola okubinyumirwa. Tewali kisuubizo wadde enjigiriza ebiggaliddwa gye ndi kaakano. Oluggi oluggule olw’okusemberera Katonda luli mu maaso gange mu kyama, n’oluggi oluggule olw’okuba ow’omugaso mu lwatu. Katonda anampulira; Katonda anankozesa. Oluggi lugguliddwawo olw’olugendo lwange olw’okugenda mu maaso eri ekkanisa eri waggulu, n’olw’empuliraganya yange eya buli lunaku n’abatukuvu ab’oku nsi kuno. Abamu bayinza okugezaako okunsibira munda oba okunzigala ebweru, naye byonna bya bwereere. Amangwago ndiraba oluggi oluggule oluyingira mu Ggulu: omulyango ogw’olulu gwe gunaaba ekkubo lyange ery’okuyingira, ne ndyoka ngenda eri Mukama wange era Kabaka wange, ne mbeera ne Katonda nga nsibiddwa munda emirembe gyonna. Okitobba 11 OKUBEERA N’EDDEMBE OKUTAMBULA "Ndibafuula ba maanyi mu Mukama era nabo balitambulira mu linnya lyange, bw’ayogera Mukama." Zekkaliya 10:12 Eky’okusanyusa abatukuvu abalwadde. Baweddemu amaanyi, era batya nti tebalivaayo ku kitanda eky’okubuusabuusa n’okutya; naye Omusawo Omukulu asobola okuggyawo obulwadde, era n’okuggyawo obunafu obuvudde mu bwo. Alizzaamu amaanyi abanafu. Kino alikikola mu ngeri esinga obulungi, kubanga kiriba "mu Yakuwa." Amaanyi gaffe gasinga obulungi nga gali mu Katonda okusinga nga gali mu ffe ffennyini. Mu Mukama galeeta empuliraganya, mu ffe ffennyini gandireese amalala. Mu ffe ffennyini gandibadde matono ennaku, naye mu Katonda tegalina kkomo. Amaanyi bwe gaweebwa, omukkiriza agakozesa. Atambulira mu linnya lya Mukama. Nga kya ssanyu okutambula ebweru oluvannyuma lw’obulwadde, era nga kya ssanyu okuba ow’amaanyi mu Mukama oluvannyuma lw’ekiseera eky’okulemala! Mukama awa abantu be eddembe okutambula, n’obwerere obw’omunda okukozesa eddembe eryo. Atufuula abaami: tetuli baddu abatamanyi kuwummula, era abatalaba bintu, naye tuli ba ddembe okutambula mpola mu nsi ya Emmanweri yonna. Jjangu, ggwe omutima gwange, toddayo kuba mulwadde na munakuwavu, Yesu akulagira obeere ow’amaanyi, era otambule ne Katonda mu kufumiitiriza okutukuvu. Gondera ekigambo kye eky’okwagala. Okitobba 12 AKABONERO AK’EKISA EKY’ENDAGAANO "Mukama Katonda wo alikomola omutima gwo, n’omutima gwa bazzukulu bo, bw’otyo oyagalanga Mukama Katonda wo n’omutima gwo gwonna, n’emmeeme yo yonna, olyoke obeerenga omulamu." Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 30:6 Wano tusoma ku kukomola okw’amazima. Weetegereze eyakukola: "Mukama Katonda wo." Ye yekka y’asobola okukola ku mutima gwaffe mu ngeri esobola, n’aggyawo obw’omubiri n’obucaafu bwagwo. Okutufuula okwagala Katonda n’omutima gwaffe gwonna n’emmeeme yaffe yonna kya kyamagero eky’ekisa Omwoyo Omutukuvu yekka ky’asobola okukola. Tuteekwa okutunuulira Mukama yekka olw’ekino era tuleme okumatizibwa n’ekitatuuka ku ekyo. Weetegereze ekifo okukomola kuno gye kukolerwa. Si kwa mubiri, wabula kwa mwoyo. Ke kabonero akateekwa ddala ak’endagaano ey’ekisa. Okwagala Katonda kye kabonero ekitasangulika eky’ezzadde eryalondebwa; olw’envumbo eno ey’ekyama okulondebwa okw’ekisa kukakasibwa eri omukkiriza. Tuteekwa okwegendereza tuleme okwesiga mpisa za kungulu, wabula okuteekebwako envumbo mu mutima olw’omulimu gw’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Weetegereze ky’evaamu -- "olyoke obeerenga omulamu." Okulowooza eby’omubiri kwe kufa. Mu kuwangula omubiri mwe tusanga obulamu n’emirembe. Bwe tussa omwoyo gwaffe ku bintu eby’Omwoyo, tunaabeera balamu. Ayi, Yakuwa, Katonda waffe, atuukirize omulimu gwe ogw’ekisa ku butonde bwaffe obw’omunda, tulyoke tube abalamu eri Mukama mu ngeri esinga okujjula n’esinga obukulu. Okitobba 13 SINGA, N’EKISUUBIZO EKISATU "Abantu bange abatuumiddwa erinnya lyange bwe baneetowazanga, ne basaba, ne banoonya amaaso gange, ne bakyuka okuleka amakubo gaabwe amakyamu, kale nnaawuliranga nga nsinziira mu ggulu ne nsonyiwa ekibi kyabwe era ne mponya ensi yaabwe." 2 Ebyomumirembe 7:14 Newankubadde nga tuyitibwa erinnya lya Mukama, kyokka tuli basajja na bakazi aboonoona. Nga kya kisa nnyo nti Katonda waffe mwetegefu okusonyiwa! Buli lwe twonoona, tuyanguwe okugenda ku ntebe ey’okusaasira eya Katonda waffe, nga tunoonya okusonyiyibwa. Tuteekwa okwetoowaza. Tetusaanidde kwetoowaza olw’ekituufu nti oluvannyuma lw’okufuna okwagala okungi bwe kityo naye tukyayonoona? Ayi Mukama, tuvuunama mu maaso go mu nfuufu, era tukkiriza obutasiima bwaffe obw’amaanyi. Ayi, obuswavu bw’ekibi! Ayi, obuswavu bwakyo emirundi musanvu mu bantu abaayagalibwa nnyo nga ffe bwe tubadde! Bwe kityo, ng’alokola abalonde be olwa Yesu, era akuuma n’olulyo olw’abantu olw’abalonde be. Nga kitiibwa kya ngeri ki ekiweebwa abatukuvu! Nga basaanidde okukozesa n’obunyiikivu obuyinza bwabwe eri Mukama waabwe! Aliwulira okusaba kwabwe olw’aboonoonyi, n’awa omukisa okufuba kwabwe olw’obulokozi bwabwe. Awa abakkiriza omukisa balyoke babeere mukisa eri abo abali mu butakkiriza. Aboonoonyi bangi balamu olw’okusaba kwa maama, oba mukyala, oba muwala, Mukama gw’assaamu ekitiibwa. Tukozesezza bulungi obuyinza obw’enjawulo Mukama bw’atwesigisa? Tusabira ensi yaffe, n’amawanga amalala, n’omulembe guno? Mu biseera eby’entalo, enjala, ne kawumpuli, tuyimirira ng’abawolereza, nga twegayirira nti ennaku zikendezebweko? Tukungubagira mu maaso ga Katonda okubunyuuka kw’obutakkiriza, n’obukyamu, n’obwenzi? Twegayirira Mukama waffe Yesu okukendeeza obufuzi bw’ekibi ng’ayanguyiza okulabika kwe okw’ekitiibwa? Ka tufukamire, era tuleme okuwummula okutuusa Kristo lw’alirabika. Okitobba 27 OKUWEEREZA KWE, AMAASO GE, ERINNYA LYE "Abaddu be balimuweereza, era banaalabanga amaaso ge, n’erinnya lye liriwandiikibwa mu byenyi byabwe." Okubikkulirwa 22:3, 4 Emikisa esatu emironde giribeera gyaffe mu nsi ey’ekitiibwa. "Abaddu be balimuweereza." Tewaabeewo bakama balala abatujooga, tewaabeewo buweereza bulala butunakuwaza. Tuliweereza Yesu bulijjo, mu bujjuvu, awatali kukoowa, era awatali kusobya. Guno gwe ggulu eri omutukuvu: mu bintu byonna okuweereza Mukama Kristo, n’okuba nga atulaba ng’abaddu be, kwe kwegomba kwa mmeeme yaffe okw’emirembe gyonna. "Era banaalabanga amaaso ge." Kino kifuula okuweereza okusanyusa: mazima, gwe mpeera ey’okuweereza eya kaakano. Tulimanya Mukama waffe, kubanga tulimulaba nga bw’ali. Okulaba amaaso ga Yesu kye kisa ekisinga omuddu wa Mukama omwesigwa ennyo ky’ayinza okusaba. Kiki Musa kye yandisabye okusinga -- "Ka ndabe amaaso go"? "N’erinnya lye liriwandiikibwa mu byenyi byabwe." Batunuulira Mukama waabwe okutuusa erinnya lye lwe likubibwa ku byenyi byabwe ng’ekifaananyi. Bategeerwa Ye, era nabo bamutegeera. Akabonero ak’ekyama ak’ekisa eky’omunda kakula ne kafuuka akabonero akalabika mu lwatu ak’enkolagana eyeeyanjudde. Ayi Mukama, tuwe ebintu bino ebisatu mu ntandikwa yaabyo wano, tulyoke tubifune mu bujjuvu bwabyo mu kifo kyo eky’essanyu! Okitobba 28 EBIBI EBY’OBUTAMANYA "Bwe batyo banaasonyiyibwanga; kubanga baasobya mu butagenderera" Okubala 15:25 Olw’obutamanya bwaffe, tetutegeera bulungi bibi byaffe eby’obutamanya. Kyokka tuyinza okukakasa nti bingi, mu ngeri z’okukola ebitasaana n’okulekera awo ebisaana. Tuyinza okuba nga tukola n’omutima omulongoofu, ng’okuweereza Katonda, ekyo Ye ky’atalagira, era ky’atayinza kukkiriza. Mukama amanyi buli kimu ku bibi bino eby’obutamanya. Kino kiyinza okututya, kubanga mu bwenkanya alituvunaana ebyonoono bino; naye ku luuyi olulala, okukkiriza kulaba essanyu mu nsonga eno, kubanga Mukama alifuba okulaba nti ebbala lye tutalaba lyoza. Alaba ekibi alyoke akyongereko okukiraba ng’akisuula emabega we. Okubudaabudibwa kwaffe okukulu kwe kuti Yesu, kabona ow’amazima, atangiridde ekibiina kyonna eky’abaana ba Isirayiri. Okutangirira okwo kukakasa okusonyiyibwa kw’ebibi ebitamanyiddwa. Omusaayi gwe ogw’omuwendo gutunaazaako ekibi kyonna. Ka kibe nga amaaso gaffe gakiraba ne tukikaabira oba nedda, Katonda akirabye, Kristo akitangiridde, Omwoyo akakasa okusonyiyibwa kwakyo, bwe kityo tulina emirembe egy’engeri esatu. Ayi Kitange, ntendereza okumanya kwo okw’obwakatonda, okutalaba byonoono byange byokka, naye era okumteekerateekera ekitangiriro ekimponya omusango gwabyo, ne nga sinnaba na kumanya nti ndina omusango. Okitobba 29 KUUMA ENJAWULO "Nzija kussaawo enjawulo wakati w’abantu bange n’abantu bo. Ekyamagero kino kijja kubaawo enkeera." Okuva 8:23 Falaawo alina abantu be, ne Mukama alina abantu be. Bano bayinza okubeera wamu, ne balabika ng’abenkanankana, naye waliwo enjawulo wakati waabwe, era Mukama aligyeyoleka. Si lwa mirembe gyonna ekintu kimu kirituuka bonna mu ngeri y’emu, naye waabeewo enjawulo nnene wakati w’abantu b’ensi n’abantu Yakuwa be yeeroboza. Kino kiyinza okubaawo mu kiseera eky’emisango, Mukama bw’afuuka ekifo ekitukuvu eky’abatukuvu be. Kirabika nnyo mu kukyusibwa kw’abakkiriza ng’ekibi kyabwe kiggyibbwawo, ate ng’abatakkiriza basigala mu kusalirwa omusango. Okuva mu kaseera ako, bafuuka olulyo olw’enjawulo, bajja wansi w’okukangavvula okuggya, ne beeyagalira emikisa emiggya. Amaka gaabwe, okuva mu kiseera ekyo, teganyigirizibwa bibinja by’ebibi ebisaasaanya ebyonoona ne bibonyaabonya Abamisiri. Bakuumibwa okuva mu bucaafu bw’okwegomba, okuluma kw’okweraliikirira, obwonoonefu bw’obulimba, n’okubonyaabonya okw’ettima ekukambwe, ebisaanyaawo amaka mangi. Weesige, ggwe omukkiriza agezesebbwa, nti wadde ng’olina ebizibu byo, olokolebwa mu bibinja by’ebibi ebisingako obubi, ebijjula amaka n’emitima gy’abaddu b’Omulangira w’ensi. Mukama assizaawo enjawulo; laba ng’okuuma enjawulo eyo mu mwoyo, mu kigendererwa, mu mpisa ne mu banno. Okitobba 30 OKUNAAZIBWA OKUJJUVU "Ndibamaansirako amazzi amayonjo, era ndibaggyako obutali bulongoofu bwammwe bwonna n’okuva ku bakatonda abalala bonna, ne mbafuula abalongoofu." Ezeekyeri 36:25 Nga essanyu lino lya maanyi! Oyo eyatunaaza n’omusaayi gwa Yesu era alitunaaza n’amazzi ag’Omwoyo Omutukuvu. Katonda akyogedde, era bwe kityo bwe kiteekwa okuba, "Mulibeera abalongoofu." Mukama, tuwulira era tukungubagira obutali bulongoofu bwaffe, era kizzaamu amaanyi okukakasibwa n’akamwa ko wennyini nti tulibeera abalongoofu. Ayi, singa okikola mangu! Alitulokola mu bibi byaffe ebisingayo obubi. Okugolokoka kw’obutakkiriza, n’okwegomba okulimba okulwanyisa emmeeme, ebirowoozo ebibi eby’amalala, n’okusendasenda kwa Setaani okuvvoola erinnya ettukuvu -- bino byonna birifulumizibwa ne bitaddayo emirembe gyonna. Era alitunaaza okuva mu bakatonda baffe bonna, oba aba zaabu oba ab’ebbumba: okwagala kwaffe okutali kulongoofu, n’okwagala kwaffe okuyitiridde ku ekyo ekiri ekirongoofu mu kyennyini. Ekyo kye twafuula katonda kirimenyebwa ne kituvaako, oba ffe tulimenyebwa ne tukivaako. Katonda ye ayogera ku ekyo Ye kennyini ky’alikola. Noolwekyo ekigambo kino kinywevu era kya kakafu, era tuyinza n’obuvumu okusuubira ekyo kye kitukakasa. Okunaazibwa mukisa gwa ndagaano, era endagaano etegekeddwa mu bintu byonna era ya kakafu. Okitobba 31 OMULAMU OKUTUUSA OMULIMU LWE GULIGGWA "Sijja kufa, wabula nzija kuba mulamu, ndyoke ntegeeze ebyo byonna Mukama by’akoze." Zabbuli 118:17 Buno bukakafu bulungi! Awatali kubuusabuusa bwasinziira ku kisuubizo, ekyawuubaawuubibwa munda mu mutima gw’Omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli, kye yakwata ne yeeyagala. Embeera yange eri ng’eya Dawudi? Nnennyamidde kubanga omulabe anvuma? Waliwo ekibiina ekinnwanyisa, ne batono ku luuyi lwange? Obutakkiriza bunnagira ngalamire ne nfa mu kuggwaamu essuubi -- omuntu awanguddwa, aswazibbwa? Abalabe bange batandika okunsimira entaana? Kale kiki? Nnyinze okuwuliriza okwama kw’okutya, ne nva mu lutalo, ne ndeka n’essuubi lyonna? Kikafuuwe. Wakyaliwo obulamu mu nze: "Sijja kufa." Amaanyi galidda ne gaggyawo obunafu bwange: "Nzija kuba mulamu." Mukama mulamu, era nange ndiba mulamu. Akamwa kange kalyasamizibwa nate: "Nnaategeeza ebyo byonna Mukama by’akoze." Yee, era ndyogera ku kuzibu okwa kaakano ng’ekyokulabirako ekirala eky’obwesigwa n’okwagala okukola eby’amagero okwa Mukama Katonda wange. Abo abandyagala okumpima olw’essanduuko yange balinde katono; kubanga "Mukama ambonerezza nnyo, naye tandese kufa." Ekitiibwa kibeere eri erinnya lye emirembe gyonna! Ndi omulamu okutuusa omulimu gwange lwe guliggwa. Okutuusa Mukama lw’anaakyagala, tewali ntaana eyinza kunziba.

fields.title: Omwezi gwa Novemba
fields.body_html:
Novemba 1

OKUTUUKIRIRA N’OKUKUUMIBWA

"Oyo eyabayita mwesigwa era alikituukiriza." 1 Basessaloniika 5:24

Alikola ki? Alitutukuza ddala. Laba olunyiriri olukulembera. Alyeeyongera n’omulimu ogw’okututukuza okutuusa lwe tulituukirira mu buli kitundu. Alikuuma "omwoyo gwaffe gwonna, n’emmeeme yaffe n’omubiri gwaffe, nga tebiriiko kya kunenyezebwa okutuusa ku lunaku olw’okujja kwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo." Talituleka kugwa mu kisa, wadde okufugibwa ekibi. Nga bino birungi bya kitalo! Kituufu tusaanidde okusinza oyo agaba ebirabo ebitayogerekeka ng’ebyo.

Ani alikola kino? Mukama eyatuyita okutuggya mu kizikiza n’okutuyingiza mu kitangaala kye eky’ekitalo, okutuggya mu kufa okw’ekibi n’okutuyingiza mu bulamu obutaggwaawo mu Kristo Yesu. Ye yekka y’asobola okukola kino: okutuukirira n’okukuumibwa okwenkana awo kuyinza kuva eri Katonda ow’ekisa kyonna.

Lwaki alikikola? Kubanga "mwesigwa" -- mwesigwa eri ekisuubizo kye ye kennyini kye yeeyama okulokola omukkiriza; mwesigwa eri Omwana we, empeera ye nga kwe kuleeta abantu be gy’ali nga tebaliiko kamogo; mwesigwa eri omulimu gwe yatandika mu ffe olw’okuyitibwa kwaffe okw’amaanyi. Si bwesigwa bwabwe bo, wabula bwe bwesigwa bwa Mukama, abatukuvu kwe beesiga.

Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, wano waliwo embaga ennene ey’okutandikirako omwezi omunyivu. Ebweru wayinza okubaawo olufu, naye munda musaanidde okubaawo omusana.

Novemba 2

OBUGAGGA OBW’OMU GGULU

"Tewaliiwo kirungi na kimu ky’ataawa abo abatambulira mu makubo ge nga tebaliiko kyakunenyezebwa." Zabbuli 84:11

Waliwo ebintu bingi ebisanyusa Mukama by’ayinza okutuggyako, naye "tewaliiwo kirungi na kimu." Ye y’asinga bonna okumanya ekitugasa. Ebintu ebimu mazima birungi, era bino tuyinza okubifuna nga tubisabira mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe.

Obutukuvu kirungi, era buno alibukolera mu ffe awatali muwendo. Obuwanguzi ku mpisa embi, obusungu obungi, n’empisa ez’ekibi, aligituwa n’essanyu, era tetusaanidde kusigala nga tetulina buwanguzi obwo.

Obukakafu obujjuvu alibutuwa, n’enkolagana ey’oku lusegere naye ye kennyini, n’okuyingira mu mazima gonna, n’obuvumu awamu n’obuwanguzi ku ntebe ey’okusaasira. Bwe tuba nga tetulina bino, kiva mu kubulwa okukkiriza okubifuna, so si mu kutayagala kwa Katonda kutuwa. Emirembe, omwoyo ogw’omu ggulu, obugumiikiriza obungi, n’okwagala okwaka -- byonna bino alibiwa abo abanyiikira mu butukuvu.

Naye tegeera bulungi nti kitugwanira "kutambula mu bugolokofu." Tewaba kukyamu na nkola nkyamu; tewaba bukuusa wadde bulimba. Bwe tutambula mu bukyamu Katonda tasobola kutuwa mikisa, kubanga ekyo kyandibadde kusiima kibi. Ekkubo ery’obugolokofu lye kkubo ery’obugagga obw’omu ggulu -- obugagga obunene ennyo ne butwalira mu kirungi kyonna.

Nga kino kisuubizo kya kwegayirira mu kusaba! Tufukamire.

Novemba 3

MU KISEERA KYA KATONDA

"Kubanga okwolesebwa okwo kujja mu kiseera kyakwo ekigere. Kwogera ku by’enkomerero ate si kwa bulimba. Bwe kunaaba ng’okuluddewo, mukulindirire, kujja kutuukirira, tekugya kulwa." Kaabakuuku 2:3

Okusaasira kuyinza okulabika ng’okuluddewo, naye kwa kakafu. Mukama, mu magezi ge agatalema, yateekawo ekiseera eky’okufuluma kw’amaanyi ge ag’ekisa, era ekiseera kya Katonda kye kisinga obulungi. Ffe tuli ba bwangu; okwolesebwa okw’omukisa kusiikuula okwegomba kwaffe, ne kwanguya okuyaayaana kwaffe; naye Mukama ajja kukwata ku biseera bye yateekawo. Tasooka kiseera kye; tasembera nnyuma.

Ekigambo kya Katonda wano kyogerwako ng’ekintu ekiramu ekigenda okwogera, era ekigenda okujja. Tekiba nnukuta nfu, nga bwe tukemebwa okutya nga tumaze ebbanga ddene nga tulindirira okutuukirira kwakyo. Ekigambo ekiramu kiri mu kkubo nga kiva eri Katonda omulamu, era wadde nga kiyinza okulabika ng’ekiroddewo, mu butuufu tekiroddewo. Eggaali y’omukka ya Katonda teekwerererwa. Nsonga ya kugumiikiriza bugumiikiriza, era mangu ago tuligenda okwerolera ffe bennyini obwesigwa bwa Mukama. Tewali kisuubizo kye na kimu ekiryagwa; "si kwa bulimba." Tewali kisuubizo kye ekirisirikira; "kwogera." Nga kiryogera ebizzaamu amaanyi eri okutu olukkiriza! Tewali kisuubizo kye ekyetaaga kuzzibwa buggya ng’ebbaluwa etasoboddwa kusasulwa ku lunaku lwe yagwiririra -- "tekugya kulwa."

Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, toyinza kulindirira Katonda wo? Wummuliranga mu ye era sirikira mu mirembe egitayogerekeka.

Novemba 4

SIMA ENSALOSALO

"N’ayogera nti, Bw’ati bw’ayogera Mukama nti, Musime ensalosalo mu kiwonvu kino. Mukama agamba nti, Temuulabe mbuyaga wadde enkuba, naye ekiwonvu kino kijja kujjula amazzi, era mmwe munaanywa, n’ente zammwe zinaanywa, n’ebisolo byammwe ebirala nabyo binywe." 2 Bassekabaka 3:16, 17

Amaggye asatu gaali gagenda kufa nnyonta, Mukama n’ayingira wakati. Newaakubadde nga teyaweereza kire wadde nkuba, kyokka yawa amazzi mangi. Taleeta bugagga bwe ku nkola za bulijjo, naye asobola okwewuunyisa abantu be n’ebipya eby’amagezi n’amaanyi. Bwe tutyo tuleetebwa okulaba Katonda okusinga ku ekyo enkola eza bulijjo kye zandyoledde. Newaakubadde nga Mukama tayinza kutulabikira mu ngeri gye tusuubira, oba gye twagala, oba gye tulowooza, kyokka mu ngeri emu oba endala ajja kutulabirira. Kya mukisa mungi gye tuli okugulumizibwa okusinga okutunuulira ensibuko ez’oku bbali, tulyoke tutunuulire amaaso g’Ensibuko Ennene Esooka.

Olwa leero tulina ekisa ekimala okusima ensalosalo omukisa gwa Katonda mwe guyinza okukulukutira? Zisanze! Emirundi mingi tulemwa okwoleka okukkiriza okwa mazima era okukolebwako. Olwa leero tubeere beetegefu okulindirira okuddibwamu okusaba kwaffe. Ng’omwana eyagenda mu lukuŋŋaana okusabira enkuba bwe yatwala eky’okwewogomamu enkuba; bwe tutyo naffe mu mazima era mu ngeri ey’okukolebwako tusuubire Mukama okutuwa omukisa. Tujjuze ekiwonvu ensalosalo era tusuubire okuzirabako zonna nga zijjudde.

Novemba 5

EBIRUMYA BIJJA KUKOMA

"Kubanga sirirumiriza bantu bange emirembe n’emirembe era siribasunguwalira bbanga lyonna. Kubanga omutima gw’omuntu gwandigwereddewo mu maaso gange nga ndaba, emmeeme y’omuntu nze gye nakola." Isaaya 57:16

Kitaffe ali mu ggulu anoonya kutuyigiriza, so si kutuzikiriza. Okutunyiigira kwe kulina ekigendererwa eky’ekisa gye tuli. Talibeera bulijjo ng’atulwanyisa. Tulowooza nti Mukama alwawo mu kutukangavvula kwe, naye ekyo kiva ku kubanga ffe tetugumiikiriza. Okusaasira kwe kubeerera emirembe gyonna, naye okunyiiga kwe si kutyo. Ekiro kiyinza okulwawo nga kizitowa, naye ku nkomerero kiteekwa okuwa ekifo emisana emisanyufu. Ng’okunyiiga bwe kuba kwa kiseera buseera, bwe kutyo n’obusungu obukuvaamu bwa kaseera katono. Mukama ayagala abalonde be ennyo n’atayinza kubasunguwalira bulijjo.

Singa yatukolanga bulijjo nga bw’atukola oluusi, twandizirikidde ddala, ne tuserengeta awatali ssuubi eri emiryango gy’okufa. Guma omwoyo, ggwe omutima omwagalwa! Mukama anaatera okukomya okunenya kwe. Gumira, kubanga Mukama anaakuwanirira, era anaakuyisa. Oyo eyakukola amanyi nga bw’oli omunafu, ne nga bw’osobola okugumira ebitono. Anaakwata mpola ekyo kye yabumba n’obwegendereza obungi. Noolwekyo, totya olw’okubonaabona okw’omu kaseera kano, kubanga kwanguwa okutuuka ku biseera eby’essanyu ebijja. Oyo eyakukuba y’anaakuwonya; obusungu bwe obutono bunaddirirwa okusaasira okungi.

Novemba 6

OKUSANYUKA N’OKWEGOMBA

"Sanyukiranga mu Mukama, anaakuwanga omutima gwo bye gwetaaga." Zabbuli 37:4

Okusanyukira mu Katonda kulina amaanyi agakyusa, era kugulumiza omuntu okusukka okwegomba okw’ensonyi okw’obuzaale bwaffe obwagwa. Okusanyukira mu Yakuwa si kuwoomerera kwokka mu kwokka, naye kuwoomya emmeeme yonna, okutuusa okwegomba kw’omutima lwe kufuuka kwenkanidde Mukama okusobola okusuubiza awatali kubuusabuusa okukutuukiriza. Kuno si kwe kusanyuka okukulu okubumba okwegomba kwaffe okutuusa lwe kufaanana ng’okwegomba kwa Katonda?

Enkola yaffe ey’obusirusiru kwe kwegomba, oluvannyuma ne tutandika okukola kufuna kye twegomba. Tetukola mu ngeri ya Katonda, y’okumusooka okunoonya, oluvannyuma ne tusuubira ebintu byonna okwongerwako. Bwe tunaaleka omutima gwaffe okujjuzibwa Katonda okutuusa lwe gunaakuluka essanyu, awo Mukama yennyini y’anaalabirira nti tetuubuleko kirungi kyonna. Mu kifo ky’okugenda ebweru okunoonya essanyu, tusigale eka ne Katonda, era tunywe amazzi okuva mu luzzi lwaffe ffe. Asobola okutukolera ebisukka nnyo ku mikwano gyaffe gyonna. Kirungi okumatira ne Katonda yekka okusinga okutambulatambula nga tweraliikirira era nga twegomba ebintu ebitono eby’ekiseera n’eby’ensi. Okumala akaseera tuyinza okufuna okumenyeka kw’emitima; naye singa bino bituleeta okumpi ne Mukama, biba bintu bya kusiimibwa nnyo, kubanga ku nkomerero binaatufunira okutuukirira kw’okwegomba kwaffe kwonna okutuufu.

Novemba 7

OKWETOOWAZA OKW’AMAZIMA KUWEEBWA EMPEERA

"Oyo eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa." Lukka 18:14

Tekyandibadde kizibu gye tuli okwetoowaza, kubanga kiki kye tulina okwenyumiririza? Tusaanidde okutwala ekifo ekya wansi ennyo nga tetulagiddwa kukikola. Bwe tuba abategeevu era abeesimbu tunaaba batono mu maaso gaffe ffe. Naddala mu maaso ga Mukama nga tusaba tunaafuuka ekitaliimu. Awo tetusobola kwogera ku birungi bye tukoze, kubanga tetuliiko: okwegayirira kwaffe kwokka kuteekwa kudda eri okusaasira: "Katonda, onsaasire, nze omwonoonyi."

Wano waliwo ekigambo ekisanyusa okuva ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka. Tuligulumizibwa Mukama singa twetoowaza. Gye tuli ekkubo eridda waggulu lya kuserengeta. Bwe twambulwa obweyagalize, tunaabikkibwa okwetoowaza, era kino kye kyambalo ekisinga obulungi. Mukama anaatugulumiza mu mirembe n’essanyu ery’omu mutima; anaatugulumiza okutuyingiza mu kumanya Ekigambo kye n’enkolagana naye ye kennyini; anaatugulumiza mu kusanyukira okusonyiyibwa okwa kakafu n’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Mukama assa ekitiibwa kye ku abo abasobola okukyambala olw’ekitiibwa ky’Oyo akiwa. Awa okuba ow’omugaso, okukkirizibwa, n’obuyinza eri abo abataakwewaanirize, naye abanaatoowazibwa olw’okutegeera obuvunaanyizibwa obunene. Newaakubadde Katonda newaakubadde omuntu tabaako gw’ayagala kugulumiza asituka yekka; naye Katonda n’abantu abalungi bombi begatta okussa ekitiibwa ku muntu omuwombeefu ow’omuwendo.

Ayi Mukama, nzike mu bwange nnyini ndyoke nsituke mu ggwe.

Novemba 8

OBUNENE BW’EKISA

"Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu." 2 Abakkolinso 12:9

Obunafu bwaffe tusaanidde okubutwala nga bwa muwendo kubanga bugulawo ekifo eri amaanyi ga Katonda. Twandibadde tetumanyanga maanyi ga kisa singa tetwawulira bunafu bw’obuzaale bwaffe. Mukama atenderezebwe olw’eriggwa erittwa mu mubiri, n’omubaka wa Setaani, bwe bitutwala eri amaanyi ga Katonda.

Kino kigambo kya muwendo okuva ku mimwa gya Mukama waffe ye kennyini. Kiseseza omuwandiisi w’ekitabo kino olw’essanyu. Ekisa kya Katonda kimmala nze! Ndowooza mazima kimmala. Eggulu terimala kinyonyi, n’ennyanja teemala kyennyanja? Oyo Amala byonna amala okwetaaga kwange okusinga obunene. Oyo amala ensi n’Eggulu mazima asobola okutuukiriza embeera y’envunyu emu enaku nga nze.

Kale, ka twesigame ku Katonda waffe n’ekisa kye. Bw’ataggyaawo nnaku yaffe, anaatusobozesa okugigumira. Amaanyi ge ganaatuyiwibwamu okutuusa envunyu lw’eneewuula ensozi; era ekitaliimu kinaawangula abo bonna abagulumivu era ab’amaanyi. Kirungi gye tuli okuba n’amaanyi ga Katonda okusinga agaffe ffe; kubanga singa twabadde ba maanyi emirundi lukumi okusinga bwe tuli, byonna byandivuddemo bwereere mu maaso g’omulabe; ne singa twandisobodde okuba abanafu okusinga bwe tuli, ekitasoboka nnyo, kyokka twandisobodde okukola byonna mu Kristo.

Novemba 9

OKUMANYA OKWETAAGISA

"Era zirimanya nga nze Mukama Katonda waazo, ndi wamu nazo, era nga zo, ennyumba ya Isirayiri, bantu bange, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda." Ezeekyeri 34:30

Okuba abantu ba Mukama ye kennyini mukisa gwa njawulo, naye okumanya nti tuli batyo mukisa gubudaabuza. Kimu kwe kusuubira nti Katonda ali naffe, ekirala kwe kumanya nti bw’ali. Okukkiriza kutulokola, naye obukakafu bwe butumatiza. Tutwala Katonda okuba Katonda waffe bwe tumukkiririza; naye tufuna essanyu erimuvaamu bwe tumanya nti wa ffe, era nga ffe tuli babe. Tewali mukkiriza asaanidde kumatira na kusuubira n’okwesiga kwokka, asaanidde okusaba Mukama okumutuusa ku bukakafu obujjuvu, ebintu eby’essuubi bifuuke ebintu ebya kakafu.

Bwe tuba nga tusanyukira emikisa egy’endagaano, era nga tulaba Mukama waffe Yesu ng’atuyimusizza ng’ekimera eky’ettutumu, awo lwe tutuuka ku kumanya okulambulukufu okw’ekisa kya Katonda gye tuli. Si lwa mateeka, wabula lwa kisa, kwe tuyigira nti tuli bantu ba Mukama. Bulijjo ka tukyuse amaaso gaffe eri ekisa ekyereere. Obukakafu obw’okukkiriza tebuyinza kujja lwa mirimu gya mateeka. Bwe butukuvu obw’Enjiri, era busobola kututuukako mu ngeri ya Njiri yokka. Tuleme kwekaliriza munda waffe. Ka tutunuulire Mukama yekka. Nga bwe tulaba Yesu bwe tutyo tuliraba obulokozi bwaffe.

Ayi Mukama, tuweereze amazzi amangi ag’okwagala kwo agakulukuta ne gatutwala okusukka ettosi ery’okubuusabuusa n’okutya.

Novemba 10

OKUTAMBULA AWATALI KWESITTALA

"Taliganya kigere kyo kusagaasagana." Zabbuli 121:3

Mukama bw’ataliganya, tewali bantu wadde baddayimooni abasobola okukikola. Nga bandisanyuse nnyo singa baasobola okutuleetera okugwa okw’ensonyi, ne batugoba mu bifo byaffe, ne batuziika ne twerabirwa! Bandikikoze nga bwe baagala singa tewaali kiziyiza kimu, era kimu kyokka: Mukama taliganya; era bw’ataliganya, naffe tekitutuukako.

Olugendo lw’obulamu luli ng’okutambula mu nsozi za Alps. Ku makubo g’ensozi omuntu bulijjo ali mu kabi k’okuseerera. Ekkubo we liba erya waggulu ennyo omutwe gutera okuzunga, n’ebigere ne biseerera mangu: waliwo ebifo ebiweweevu ng’endabirwamu, n’ebirala ebijjudde amayinja agatanywezeddwa, era mu buli kimu ku ebyo okugwa kizibu okwewala. Oyo asobozesebwa okwesimba obulungi obulamu bwe bwonna n’okutambula awatali kwesittala alina ensonga ennungi ennyo ez’okwebaza. Olw’obunnya n’emitego, amaviivi amanafu, ebigere ebikooye, n’abalabe abakujjukujju, tewali mwana wa Katonda ayinza okuyimirira nnywevu n’akaseera akamu singa tewaali kwagala okwesigwa okutaliganya kigere kye kusagaasagana. "Wakati mu mitego olukumi nnyimirira, Nga nkwatiddwa era nga nkuumibwa omukono gwo; Omukono ogwo ogutalabika gulinnywereza, Ne gunkulembera okuntuusa ku lusozi lwo olutukuvu."

Novemba 11

ABANTU BA MUKAMA AB’EDDEMBE

"Temukkiriza kibi kwongera kubafuga, kubanga temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda." Abaruumi 6:14

Ekibi kirifuga singa kisobola: tekimatira na kifo kyonna wansi w’entebe ey’obwakabaka bw’omutima. Oluusi tutya nti kirituwangula, ne kaabbi tukaabira Mukama nti, "Tokkiriza kibi kyonna kunfuga." Kuno kwe kuddamu kwe okuzzaamu amaanyi nti, "Ekibi tekirikufuga. Kiyinza okukulumba, ne kikutuusaako n’ekiwundu; naye tekirikuteekawo bufuzi ku ggwe emirembe gyonna."

Singa twali wansi w’amateeka, ekibi kyaffe kyandyeyongedde amaanyi ne kitunyweza mu buyinza bwakyo; kubanga kibonerezo kya kibi omuntu okujja wansi w’obuyinza bw’ekibi. Naye nga bwe tuli wansi w’endagaano ey’ekisa, tukuumibwa tuleme kuva ku Katonda omulamu olw’ekigambo eky’endagaano eky’amazima. Tusuubizibwa ekisa, kye tuzzibwa nakyo okuva mu kubula kwaffe, ne tunaazibwa obutali bulongoofu bwaffe, ne tuweebwa eddembe okuva mu njegere ez’empisa embi.

Twandigalamidde mu kuggwaamu essuubi ne "tumatira okukolera Abamisiri" singa twakyali baddu abakolera obulamu obutaggwaawo; naye kubanga tuli bantu ba Mukama ab’eddembe, tuguma omwoyo okulwana n’obwonoonefu bwaffe n’okukemebwa, nga tukakasibwa nti ekibi tekirituvuganga nate. Katonda yennyini y’atuwa obuwanguzi ku bwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, ekitiibwa kibe gy’ali emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina.

Novemba 12

EMMEEME ENTUKUZE ZE ZIMATIVU

"Abantu bange mbajjuze ebintu, bw’ayogera Mukama." Yeremiya 31:14

Weetegereze "wange" eryeddamu emirundi ebiri: "Abantu bange balikkusibwa obulungi bwange."

Abantu abamativu ku Katonda balagibwa nga bantu ba Katonda yennyini. Abasanyusa, kubanga nabo bamusanyusa. Bamuyita Katonda waabwe, naye n’abayita abantu be; asanyuka okubatwala okuba omugabo gwe, nabo basanyuka nga ye mugabo gwabwe. Waliwo enkolagana ey’essanyu wakati wa Isirayiri owa Katonda ne Katonda wa Isirayiri.

Abantu bano bamativu. Kino kintu kikulu nnyo. Batono nnyo ku baana b’abantu abamativu, ne bwe kiba nti omugabo gwabwe guli gutya; bamize ekinoso, era kyeyongera okuleekaana nti, "Mpa! Mpa!" Emmeeme entukuze zokka ze mmeeme ezimativu. Katonda yennyini kimugwanira okutukyusa era n’okutumatiza.

Si kya kwewuunya nti abantu ba Mukama basaanidde okumatira obulungi bwa Mukama waabwe. Buno bulungi obutali na kutabulwamu, obugabi obutaliiko kkomo, okusaasira okutaliimu kunenya, okwagala okutakyukakyuka, ekisa ekitaliiko kye kikweka. Obanga obulungi bwa Katonda tebutumatiza, kiki ekirikutumatiza? Ki! Tukyasinda? Mazima ddala waliwo okwegomba okukyamu munda singa kuba kwe kumu obulungi bwa Katonda kwe butamatiza.

Mukama, ndi mumativu. Erinnya lyo litenderezebwe.

Novemba 13

OBUKUUMI OBUTAGGWAAWO

"Laba, oyo akuuma Isirayiri taabongootenga so teyeebakenga." Zabbuli 121:4

Yakuwa ye "oyo akuuma Isirayiri." Tewali ngeri ya kutabikako amagezi eyinza okumukwata, wadde otulo otungi wadde otulo otutono. Talemererwa kukuuma nnyumba n’omutima gw’abantu be. Eno nsonga emala okutuleetera okuwummulira mu mirembe ejjuvu. Alexander yagamba nti yeebaka kubanga mukwano gwe Parmenio yali akuuma; naffe okusinga wandiyeebase kubanga Katonda waffe ye mukuumi waffe.

"Laba" wano lyateekebwawo okukyusa obulowoozo bwaffe eri amazima agasanyusa. Isirayiri, bwe yeezizika ejjinja ne yeebaka; naye Katonda we yali muzuukufu, n’ajjira omuweereza we mu kwolesebwa. Bwe tugalamira nga tetulina kwerinda, Yakuwa yennyini alibikka ku mutwe gwaffe.

Mukama akuuma abantu be ng’omugagga bw’akuuma eby’obugagga bye, nga kaptenne bw’akuuma ekibuga n’eggye eririkuumira, nga omukuumi bw’akuuma kabaka we. Tewali ayinza kukola kabi eri abo abakuumibwa bwe batyo. Ka nteeke emmeeme yange mu mikono gye egy’omuwendo. Tatwerabira, talekayo kutulabirira, so tasangibwa nga tasobola kutukuuma.

Ai Mukama wange, nkuuma, si kulwa nga mbula ne ngwa ne nzikirira. Nkuuma, ndyoke nkuume amateeka go. Olw’obulabirizi bwo obutabongoota, nziyiza okwebaka ng’omugayaavu, n’okuzikirira ng’abo abeebaka otulo otw’okufa.

Novemba 14

ERINNYA ERY’OKUKOZESA

"Bwe munaasabanga ekintu kyonna mu linnya lyange nnaakikolanga." Yokaana 14:14

Nga kino kisuubizo kigazi! Ekintu kyonna! Oba kinene oba kitono, byonna bye nneetaaga bibikkiddwa ekigambo ekyo "ekintu kyonna." Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, weeyagalire ku ntebe ey’okusaasira, owulire Mukama wo ng’akugamba nti, "Yasamya akamwa ko, nange nnaakajjuza."

Nga kino kisuubizo kya magezi! Bulijjo tusaana okusaba mu linnya lya Yesu. Kino nga bwe kituzzaamu amaanyi, era kimuwa ekitiibwa. Kuno kwe kwegayirira okutaggwaawo. Oluusi buli kwegayirira okulala kufuuka ekizikiza, naddala okwo kwe twandiggye mu nkolagana yaffe ne Katonda, oba mu bumanyirivu bwaffe obw’ekisa kye; naye mu biseera ng’ebyo erinnya lya Yesu liba lya maanyi ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka nga bulijjo, era tuyinza okulyegayiririza n’obukakafu obujjuvu.

Nga kuno kwe kusaba okuyigiriza! Siyinza kusaba kintu kyonna kye siyinza kutekako mukono gwa Kristo n’akabonero ke. Sirina buvumu bwa kukozesa linnya lya Mukama wange mu kusaba okw’omululu oba okw’obukakanyavu. Nnyinza kukozesa linnya lya Mukama wange mu kusaba kwokka Ye kennyini kw’andisabye singa aba mu mbeera yange. Kya kitiibwa kingi okuweebwa obuyinza okusaba mu linnya lya Yesu ng’asaba Yesu yennyini; naye okumwagala kwaffe tekulituganya kuteeka linnya eryo we yandiritaddewo.

Nsaba ekyo Yesu ky’asiima? Nnyinza okuteeka akabonero ke ku kusaba kwange? Kale nnina kye nnoonya eri Kitaffe.

Novemba 15

OBUGAGGA OBUTALIIKO KKOMO

"Kale ne Katonda wange alibawa buli kye mwetaaga ng’obugagga bwe obungi obuli mu Kristo Yesu bwe buli." Abafiripi 4:19

Katonda wa Pawulo ye Katonda waffe, era alituwa buli kye twetaaga. Pawulo yali akakasa kino ku Abafiripi, naffe tukakasa kino ku ffe ffennyini. Katonda alikikola, kubanga kiri nga Ye: atwagala, asanyukira okutuwa omukisa, era kirimuweesa ekitiibwa okukola bw’atyo. Okusaasira kwe, amaanyi ge, okwagala kwe, obwesigwa bwe, byonna bikolagana ffe tuleme kufa njala.

Laba ekigera Mukama ky’akozesa: "ng’obugagga bwe obungi obuli mu Kristo Yesu bwe buli." Obugagga bw’ekisa kye bunene, naye tunaayogera ki ku bugagga bw’ekitiibwa kye? "Obugagga bwe obw’ekitiibwa obuli mu Kristo Yesu," ani ayinza okubugera? Ng’ekigera kino ekitagerageranyizika Katonda bw’alijjuza obunnya obunene obw’obwetaavu bwaffe. Afuula Mukama Yesu ekifo eky’okujjuza kwe n’omukutu ogugujja, n’oluvannyuma n’atugabira obugagga bwe obw’okwagala mu ngeri yaakyo esingayo obukulu. Aleruuya!

Omuwandiisi w’ekitabo kino amanyi kye kitegeeza okugezesebwa mu mulimu gwa Mukama. Obwesigwa busasuddwa n’obusungu, n’abagabi ab’ekigabi baalekera awo okuwaayo kwabwe; naye oyo gwe baagezaako okujoba tabuliddwa wadde essente emu, si kyo kyokka, wabula afuuse mugagga okusinga; kubanga ekisuubizo kino kibadde kya mazima nti, "Katonda wange alituwa buli kye twetaaga." Ebigabirwa bya Katonda bya kakafu okusinga bbanka yonna.

Novemba 16

EBYOKULWANYISA EBIGENDA OKULEMERERWA

"Teri kyakulwanyisa kye baliweesa ekirikwolekera ne kikusobola, era oliwangula buli lulimi olulikuvunaana era oluwoza naawe." Isaaya 54:17

Waliwo oluyoogaano lunene mu masasa n’ebisaasi by’omulabe. Baweesa ebyokulwanyisa bye baakukubya abatukuvu. Tebandisobodde na kukola kino singa Mukama w’abatukuvu teyabakkiriza; kubanga ye yatonda omuweesi awujja amanda agaliko omuliro. Naye laba nga bwe bakola n’obunyiikivu! Ebitala n’amafumu bimeka bye bakola! Tekiriimu nsonga, kubanga ku bwogi bwa buli kyokulwanyisa oyinza okusoma ebigambo bino: Tekirikulaakulana.

Naye kaakano wuliriza oluyoogaano olulala: kwe kuyomba kw’ennimi. Ennimi bye byuma ebyentiisa okusinga ebiyinza okuweesebwa n’ennyondo n’amayinja ag’okuweesesaako, n’akabi ke zileeta kasala nnyo era kasaasaana wala. Kaakano tulifuuka tutya? Okuwaayiriza, obulimba, okukisakisa, okuduulira -- zino miyinja gya busagwa; tuyinza tutya okuzaanjula? Mukama Katonda atusuubiza nti, ne bwe tutasobola kuzisirisa, wano waakiri tuliwona okuzikirizibwa zo. Zitusalira omusango kaakati, naye ffe tulizisalira omusango ku nkomerero, era emirembe gyonna. Akamwa k’abo aboogera eby’obulimba kalibuniikirizibwa, n’obulimba bwabwe bulikyusibwa okufuuka ekitiibwa ky’abantu abalungi abaabonyaabonyezebwa bo.

Novemba 17

KATONDA TAABULIRA BANTU BE

"Kubanga Mukama talireka bantu be; talyabulira zzadde lye." Zabbuli 94:14

Nedda, so talisuula na n’omu ku bo. Omuntu alina b’asuula, naye Katonda talina n’omu; kubanga okulonda kwe tekukyukakyuka, n’okwagala kwe kwa mirembe gyonna. Tewali ayinza kuzuula muntu n’omu Katonda gw’aabulira ng’amaze okwolesa gy’ali obulokozi.

Amazima gano amakulu gayogerwako mu zabbuli okusanyusa omutima gw’oyo abonyaabonyezebwa. Mukama akangavvula ababe; naye tabaabulira. Ekiva mu mulimu ogw’emirundi ebiri ogw’amateeka n’oluga kwe kuyigirizibwa kwaffe, n’ekibala ky’okuyigirizibwa okwo kwe kuteeka omwoyo, obutebenkevu bw’ebirowoozo, mwe muva okuwummula. Abatatya Katonda balekebwa okutuusa ng’obunnya busimiddwa mwe baligwira ne bawambibwa; naye abatya Katonda batumibwa ku ssomero okubateekerateekera omukisa gwabwe ogw’ekitiibwa ogunaajja. Omusango gulikomawo ne gumaliriza omulimu gwagwo ku bajeemu, naye era gulikomawo okwejjeereza abeesigwa n’abatya Katonda. Noolwekyo tuyinza okugumira oluga olw’okukangavvulwa n’okuwuliriza okuteefu; tekitegeeza busungu, wabula kwagala.

"Katonda ayinza okukangavvula n’okutereeza,

Naye tayinza kutulagajjalira;

Ayinza mu bwesigwa okunenya,

Naye tayinza kulekayo kwagala."

Novemba 18

EKYAMAGERO EKIRABIKIRA DDALA

"Ku lunaku olwo Mukama aliteeka obukuumi ku batuuze b’omu Yerusaalemi; abo abasembayo obunafu ku lunaku olwo babeere nga Dawudi, era ennyumba ya Dawudi ebeere ng’ennyumba ya Katonda, nga malayika wa Mukama abakulembeddemu." Zekkaliya 12:8

Ekimu ku bikolwa Mukama ebisinga obulungi eby’okukuuma abantu be kwe kubawa amaanyi mu munda. Abantu basinga bbugwe, era okukkiriza kunywevu okusinga ebigo.

Mukama ayinza okutwala asinga obunafu mu ffe n’amufuula nga Dawudi, omuzira wa Isirayiri. Mukama, kino kikole ku nze! Nfukamu amaanyi go, onjijuze obuvumu obutukuvu ndyoke nsisinkane omusajja omuwanvu ennyo n’envuumuulo n’ejjinja, nga neesiga Katonda.

Mukama ayinza okufuula abazira be abasingayo obukulu ab’amaanyi okusinga bwe bali: Dawudi ayinza okuba nga Katonda, nga malayika wa Yakuwa. Kino kyandibadde kya kyewuunyo, naye kisoboka, singa si bwe kityo tekyandyogeddwako. Ai Mukama, kola bw’otyo ku bakulembeze baffe abasinga obulungi! Tulage kye osobola okukola -- kwe kuyimusa abaweereza bo abeesigwa okutuuka ku ntikko ey’ekisa n’obutukuvu eneeba ng’eky’ekyamagero mu bulambulukufu!

Mukama, beera mu batukuvu bo, nabo balibeera nga Katonda; teeka amaanyi go mu bo, nabo balibeera ng’ebitonde ebiramu ebibeera mu maaso ga Yakuwa. Tuukiriza ekisuubizo kino eri ekkanisa yo yonna mu biro bino ebyaffe, ku bwa Yesu. Amiina.

Novemba 19

OKUVA MU KUGONDERA OKUTUUKA MU MUKISA

"Okuva ne leero ndibawa omukisa" Kaggayi 2:19

Ebintu eby’omu maaso bitukwekeddwa. Naye wano waliwo endabirwamu mwe tusobola okulaba emyaka egitannaba kujja. Mukama agamba nti, "Okuva ne leero ndibawa omukisa."

Kigasa okwetegereza olunaku olwogerwako mu kisuubizo kino. Ebirime byali bigudde, ng’ebikuubiridde era nga birwadde, era byonna olw’ekibi ky’abantu. Kaakano, Mukama yalaba abo abaakangavvulwa nga batandika okugondera ekigambo kye, n’okuzimba yeekaalu ye, era kyeyava agamba nti, "Okuva ku lunaku lwe baazimba omusingi gwa yeekaalu ya Mukama, mujjukire. Okuva ne leero ndibawa omukisa." Bwe tuba nga twabeeranga mu kibi kyonna, Omwoyo n’atuluŋŋamya okwerongoosaako, tusobola okwesiga omukisa gwa Mukama. Akamwenyumwenyu ke, Omwoyo we, ekisa kye, n’okubikkulirwa kwe okujjuvu okw’amazima ge, byonna binaatuweera omukisa omunene. Tuyinza okugwa mu kuziyizibwa okusingako okuva mu bantu olw’obwesigwa bwaffe, naye tuligulumira mu nkolagana ey’oku lusegere ne Mukama Katonda waffe, era ne mu kutegeera obulungi okukkirizibwa kwaffe mu ye.

Mukama, nsazeewo okuba omwesigwa gy’oli okusingawo, era omunywevu mu kugoberera enjigiriza yo n’ebiragiro byo; kyenva nkusaba, ku bwa Kristo Yesu, ongeze omukisa mu bulamu bwange obwa buli lunaku okuva kaakano n’emirembe gyonna.

Novemba 20

ENJALA ERIKKUSIBWA

"Kubanga abalina ennyonta abanywesa, n’abayala abakkusa ebirungi" Zabbuli 107:9

Kirungi okuba n’okwegomba, era gye kweyongera okuba okungi, gye kusinga okuba okulungi. Mukama alikkusa okwegomba kw’emmeeme, ne bwe kuba nga kunene era nga kutwala omutima gwonna. Twegombe nnyo, kubanga Katonda aliwa nnyo. Tetubeera mu mbeera ntuufu ey’omutima bwe tuba nga tumatidde nga twekkiriza, era nga tetulina kwegomba. Okwegomba ekisa okusingawo, n’okusinda okutayogerekeka, kwe kukula, era twandyagadde okukuwulira okweyongera. Ggwe Omwoyo Omutukuvu, otuleetere okussa ebikkowe n’okukaabira ebintu ebisingako obulungi, era n’okwegomba ebisingira ddala obulungi!

Enjala si kintu kya ssanyu n’akatono. Naye balina omukisa abalumwa enjala n’ennyonta olw’obutuukirivu. Abantu ng’abo enjala yaabwe tejja kukendeezebwa buseerezi n’emmere ntono, wabula balikkusibwa. Tebalikkusibwa mmere ya kabi yonna, wabula emmere yaabwe eneesaanira Mukama waabwe omulungi, kubanga balikkusibwa ebirungi Yakuwa yennyini.

Jjangu, tuleme okweraliikirira olw’okwegomba n’enjala yaffe, wabula tuwulire eddoboozi ly’omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli, nga naye yeegomba era alumwa enjala okulaba Katonda ng’agulumizibwa. "Kale singa beebazanga Mukama olw’okwagala kwe okutaggwaawo, n’olw’eby’ekitalo by’akolera abaana b’abantu!"

Novemba 21

OKUTUNULA EBWEERU NE WAGGULU

"Mudde gye ndi, mulokoke, mmwe mwenna abali ku nkomerero z’ensi, kubanga nze Katonda so tewali mulala" Isaaya 45:22

Kino kye kisuubizo ekisinga ebisuubizo byonna. Kye musingi gw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo. Obulokozi bujja okuyita mu kutunula oyo ali "Katonda omutuukirivu era Omulokozi." Obulagirizi nga bwangu! "Mudde gye ndi. Ekyetaagisa nga kya magezi! Mazima ekitonde kisaanidde okutunula eri Omutonzi. Twatunula awalala ebbanga ddene, kaakano kye kiseera okutunula oyo yekka ayita okusuubira kwaffe, era asuubiza okutuwa obulokozi bwe.

Kutunula kwokka! Tetujja kutunula mangwago? Tetuteekwa kuleeta kantu konna mu ffe, wabula okutunula ebweeru ne waggulu eri Mukama waffe ali ku ntebe ye ey’obwakabaka, gye yalinnya okuva ku musaalaba. Okutunula tekwetaaga kwetegeka, so tekwetaaga kufuba kwa maanyi: tekwetaaga magezi wadde okumanya, bugagga wadde amaanyi. Byonna bye twetaaga biri mu Mukama Katonda waffe, era bwe tumutunuulira olwa buli kimu, ekyo kyonna kinaaba kyaffe, era tunaalokolebwa.

Mujje, mmwe abali ewala, mutunule wano! Mmwe abali ku nkomerero z’ensi, mukyuse amaaso gammwe wano! Nga bwe kiri nti okuva mu bitundu ebisinga okuba ewala abantu basobola okulaba enjuba n’okusanyukira ekitangaala kyayo, bwe mutyo mmwe abagalamidde ku nsalo z’okufa ku miryango gennyini egya ggeyeena, musobola okuyita mu kutunula okufuna ekitangaala kya Katonda, obulamu obw’Eggulu, obulokozi bwa Mukama Yesu Kristo, ali Katonda, era noolwekyo asobola okulokola.

Novemba 22

TEWALI KUSINGIBWA MUSANGO

"Mu nnaku ezo, era mu biseera ebyo, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda, omusango ku Isirayiri gulinoonyezebwa, naye tegulibaawo, era n’ebibi bya Yuda birinoonyezebwa, naye tewaliba na kimu, kubanga ndisonyiwa abo bendeseewo" Yeremiya 50:20

Kigambo kya kitiibwa ddala! Nga wano wasuubizibwa okusonyiyibwa okutuukiridde eri amawanga g’aboonoonyi aga Isirayiri ne Yuda! Ekibi kijja kuggyibwawo n’engeri nga tekijja kuzuulibwa, kisangulibwe ne watabaawo na kimu. Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda asonyiwa!

Setaani anoonya ebibi by’asobola okutuwawaabira, abalabe baffe babinoonya balyoke babituteekeko, n’omuntu waffe ow’omunda abinoonya n’obunyiikivu obw’endwadde. Naye Mukama bw’assaako omusaayi gwa Yesu ogw’omuwendo omungi, tetutya ngeri yonna ey’okunoonyezebwa, kubanga "tegulibaawo," "tewaliba na kimu." Mukama yaggyawo ebibi by’abantu be ne bitabaawo: yamaliriza obwonoonyi, era yakomya ekibi. Ssaddaaka ya Yesu ekasudde ebibi byaffe mu buziba bw’ennyanja. Kino kituleetera okuzina olw’essanyu.

Ensonga lwaki ekibi kizikirizibwa eri mu kuba nti Yakuwa yennyini asonyiwa abalonde be. Ekigambo kye eky’ekisa si kya bwakabaka kyokka, wabula kya bwakatonda. Ayogera okusonyiyibwa, ne tusonyiyibwa. Assaako okutangirira, era okuva mu ssaawa eyo abantu be tebakyatya kusalirwa musango. Erinnya lya Katonda azikiriza ekibi liweebwe ekitiibwa!

Novemba 23

OKUFUNA OBUGUMIIKIRIZA

"Mukama Katonda wo amawanga ago anaagendanga agaggyawo linnalimu, mpola mpola" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 7:22

Tetusaanidde kusuubira kuwangula ku lwa Mukama Yesu mu kikonde kimu. Ennono n’empisa embi zifa nnaku. Mu bifo ebimu kitwala emyaka mingi egy’okukola okugoba newaakubadde kimu ku bibi ebingi ebyonoona abatuuze. Tuteekwa okweyongera n’olutalo n’amaanyi gaffe gonna, ne bwe tuba nga tufunye obuwanguzi butono obweraga.

Omulimu gwaffe mu nsi eno kwe kugiwangulira Yesu. Tetusaanidde kukola ndagaano za kkabbo, wabula okumalirawo ddala ebibi. Tetusaanidde kunoonya ttendo, wabula okulwana olutalo olutakoma n’obutali butuukirivu. Obutakkiriza, enzikiriza ya Papa, okutamiira, obutali bulongoofu, okujooga, okwagala ensi, n’obukyamu; bino byonna biteekwa "okuggyibwawo."

Mukama Katonda waffe yekka y’asobola okukituukiriza. Akolera mu baweereza be abeesigwa; era, erinnya lye liweebwe ekitiibwa, asuubiza nti bw’atyo bw’aliba akola. "Mukama Katonda wo amawanga ago anaagendanga agaggyawo." Kino alikikola mpola mpola, tulyoke tuyige obugumiikiriza, tweyongere mu kukkiriza, tutunule n’obunyiikivu, era twewale obukuumi obw’omubiri. Twebaze Katonda olw’obuwanguzi obutono, era tusabe obungi. Tuleme kuzza kitala mu kiraato okutuusa ensi yonna lw’eneewangulirwa Yesu.

Guma omwoyo, ggwe omutima gwange! Weeyongereyo mpola mpola, kubanga obutono obungi bulikola ekintu ekinene ekijjuvu.

Novemba 24

OKUSONYIYIBWA N’OKUGANYIBWA

"Taasibenga busungu ku mwoyo, era tasunguwala kumala bbanga lyonna" Zabbuli 103:9

Anaanenyanga oluusi, kubanga singa si bw’atyo teyandibadde Kitaffe ow’amagezi eri abaana ng’affe abeeyisa obubi. Okunenya kwe kunyiiza nnyo abo abeesigwa, kubanga bawulira nga bwe bakisaanira ennaku, era nga bwe kitali kirungi ku bwabwe okumunakuwaza. Tumanyi amakulu g’okunenya kuno, era tuvuunama mu maaso ga Mukama, nga tunakuwadde nti tumuleetedde okutusunguwalira.

Naye nga tuzuula okubudaabudibwa okunene mu bigambo bino! "Si bulijjo" ky’anaanenyanga. Bwe twenenya ne tudda gy’ali n’emitima egimenyeddwa olw’ekibi era egyawukanye n’ekibi, anaatumwenyera amangwago. Tekimusanyusa kukyusa maaso ge okusongako obusungu eri abo b’ayagala n’omutima gwe gwonna: essanyu lye kwe kuba nti essanyu lyaffe libe lijjuvu.

Jjangu, tunoonye amaaso ge. Tewali nsonga ya kuggwaamu ssuubi, wadde okwennyamira. Twagale Katonda anenya, era mu bbanga ttono tunaayimba nti: "obusungu bwo bwaggwaawo era onzizizzaamu amaanyi." Muveewo, mmwe okuteebereza okw’ekizikiza, mmwe bannamuŋŋoona b’emmeeme! Muyingire, mmwe essuubi eryetoowaze n’okujjukira okw’okwebaza, mmwe amayiba g’omutima! Oyo eyatusonyiwa edda ng’omulamuzi, alituganyira nate nga kitaffe, era tunaasanyukira okwagala kwe okuwoomerera era okutakyukakyuka.

Novemba 25

ENSOZI EZIFUUKA ENSENYI

"Ggwe olusozi olunene weyita ki? Mu maaso ga Zerubbaberi olibeera lusenyi, era alireeta ejjinja erya waggulu mu mizira n’okwogerera mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka ng’agamba nti, Liweebwe omukisa, liweebwe omukisa!" Zekkaliya 4:7

Mu ssaawa eno olusozi olw’ebuzibu, olw’ennaku, oba olw’obwetaavu, luyinza okuba mu kkubo lyaffe, n’amagezi ag’obuntu tegalaba kkubo lya kulusukka, oba lya kuluyita wakati, oba lya kulwetooloola. Ka okukkiriza kuyingire, era amangu ago olusozi lubulawo ne lufuuka olusenyi. Naye okukkiriza kusooka kuwulira kigambo kya Mukama -- "Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange, bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye." Amazima gano amakulu kye kyetaagisa ennyo mu kwolekagana n’ebigezo eby’obulamu ebitayinzika kuwangulwa.

Ndaba nti sisobola kukola kantu konna, era nti okwesiga omuntu kwonna butaliimu. "Si lwa maanyi." Ndaba nti tewali kakodyo kalabika ku kesigibwa, wabula amaanyi gali mu Mwoyo atalabika. Katonda yekka y’ateekwa okukola, n’abantu n’obukodyo tebiteekwa kubalibwako kantu. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, nti Katonda Ayinzabyonna atwala ensonga z’abantu be, olwo ensozi ennene si kantu. Asobola okuggyawo ensi ng’abalenzi bwe bakasuka emipiira, oba bwe bagigoba n’ekigere. Amaanyi gano asobola okugampa. Mukama bw’andagira okuggyawo olusozi Alupe nsobola okukikola mu linnya lye. Luyinza okuba olusozi olunene, naye ne mu maaso g’obunafu bwange lulifuuka olusenyi; kubanga Mukama y’akyogedde. Kiki kye nnyinza okutya nga Katonda ali ku ludda lwange?

Novemba 26

OKUKYUSA OKW’OMU GGULU

"okunakuwala kwammwe kulifuuka essanyu" Yokaana 16:20

Okunakuwala kwabwe okw’enjawulo kwe kufa n’obutabaawo bwa Mukama waabwe, era kwafuuka essanyu bwe yazuukira mu bafu n’aweeyolekera wakati mu bo. Okunakuwala kwonna okw’abatukuvu bwe kutyo bwe kulikyusibwa; ne kwe kusinga obubi, okulabika ng’okuteekwa okusigala ennyo nga nsulo z’obukaawu emirembe gyonna.

Kale okunakuwala gye kweyongera, essanyu gye lyeyongera. Bwe tuba n’emigugu gy’ennaku, olwo amaanyi ga Mukama galigifuula ttani z’essanyu. Kale ekizibu gye kyeyongera obukaawu, essanyu gye lyeyongera obuwoomu: ekyuma ekiwuuba bwe kiwuuba nnyo ku ludda olwa kkono, kirisembeza okusingako ku ludda olwa ddyo. Okujjukira ennaku kulyongera ku kawoowo k’essanyu: tuliraga ekimu nga tukigeraageranya n’ekirala, era okumasamasa kwa daayimondi kulirabika bulungi olw’ekintu ekiddugavu ekiri emabega waayo.

Jjangu, ggwe omutima gwange, sanyuka! Mu bbanga ttono nnaaba omusanyufu nga bwe ndi kaakano omunakuwavu. Yesu aŋŋamba nti mu kukyusa okw’omu ggulu okunakuwala kwange kulifuuka essanyu. Siraba ngeri gye kirituukirira, naye nkikkiriza, era ntandika okuyimba nga nkisuubira. Okwennyamira kuno okw’omwoyo si kwa bbanga ddene, mangu ago nnaabeera mu abo abasanyufu abatendereza Mukama emisana n’ekiro, era eyo gye nnaayimbira ku kusaasira okwamponya mu kubonaabona okunene.

Novemba 27

OKUWUMMULA MU MATAMBULA GO GONNA

"Mukama n’addamu nti, Nnaagendanga naawe, era nnaakuwummuzanga" Okuva 33:14

Kisuubizo kya muwendo! Mukama, ompe amaanyi okukyefunira nga kyange kyonna.

Waliwo ebiseera lwe tuteekwa okuva mu maka gaffe, kubanga wano tetulina kibuga kya lubeerera. Kitera okubaawo nti bwe tusinga okuwulira nga tuli awaka mu kifo, amangwago tuyitibwa okukivaamu. Wano we wali eddagala eriwonya obulwadde buno. Mukama yennyini y’anaabeeranga naffe. Okubeerawo kwe, okuli okuganja kwe, obumu bwe, okulabirira kwe, n’obuyinza bwe, kunaabeeranga naffe bulijjo mu buli lugendo lwaffe. Kino kitegeeza ebisingako ennyo ku by’ekyogera; kubanga, mu mazima, kitegeeza ebintu byonna. Bwe tuba ne Katonda ng’ali naffe, tuba tufunye Eggulu n’ensi. Genda nange, Mukama, olwo ondagire gy’oyagala yonna!

Naye tusuubira okufuna ekifo eky’okuwummuliramu. Ekyawandiikibwa kikisuubiza. Tugenda kufuna okuwummula Katonda kwennyini kw’awa, kw’akola, era kw’akuuma. Okubeerawo kwe kunaatuwummuza ne bwe tuba nga tuli mu lugendo, weewaawo, ne wakati mu lutalo. Okuwummula! Kigambo eky’omukisa emirundi esatu. Abantu abafa kiyinzika okukyeyagalira? Yee, ekisuubizo kiriwo, era olw’okukkiriza tukyegayirira. Okuwummula kuva eri Omubudaabudi, eri Omulangira ow’Emirembe, era eri Kitaffe ow’ekitiibwa eyawummula ku lunaku olw’omusanvu okuva ku mirimu gye gyonna. Okubeera ne Katonda kwe kuwummula mu ngeri esingayo obulungi.

Novemba 28

OKUKOLA EKYO KATONDA KY’ASOBOLA OKUWA OMUKISA

"Mukama anaawanga amawanika go omukisa, ne buli ky’onookwatangako engalo zo okukikola anaakiwanga omukisa" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:8

Bwe tugondera Mukama Katonda waffe anaawa omukisa ku ekyo ky’atuwa. Obugagga si kikolimo bwe buweebwa omukisa Mukama. Abantu bwe baba n’ebisukka ku ebyo bye beetaaga mu kaseera ako, ne batandika okuterekera mu mawanika, obuvundu obw’omululu oba ekikuubiro eky’omutima omukakanyavu kitera okugoberera okukuŋŋaanya; naye n’omukisa gwa Katonda si bwe kiri. Amagezi galongoosa okutereka, obugabi buluuŋŋamya okusaasaanya, okwebaza kukuuma okwewaayo, n’ettendo liwoomya okwesanyusa. Kya kisa kinene okuba n’omukisa gwa Katonda mu ttereka ery’ekyuma, ne ku akawunti y’omuntu ey’ebbanka.

Nga twaweebwa ekyengera kinene mu kigambo ekisembayo! "buli ky’onookwatangako engalo zo okukikola anaakiwanga omukisa." Tetwandissizza mukono gwaffe ku kintu kyonna kye tutayinza kusabira mukisa gwa Katonda, so tetwandikikoze awatali kusaba na kukkiriza. Naye nga kya nkizo okusobola okunoonya obuyambi bwa Mukama mu buli mulimu! Abamu boogera ku muntu ow’omukisa: omukisa gwa Mukama gusinga omukisa ogw’akabi. Okukuumibwa ab’ekitiibwa si kantu bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n’ekisa kya Katonda. Okwesiga wekka kirungi nnyo; naye omukisa gwa Mukama gusukkiridde nnyo ebibala byonna eby’obukugu, oba obwenkulu, oba amagezi.

Novemba 29

OKUMANYA OKULINDIRIRA

"oyo alyesiga taliterebuka" Isaaya 28:16

Anaayanguyirizanga okukuuma ebiragiro bya Mukama; naye taayanguyirizenga mu ngeri yonna ey’obutagumiikiriza oba etatuufu.

Taayanguyirizenga kudduka, kubanga taawangulwenga entiisa ereeta okwekanga. Abalala bwe baba badduka eno n’eri ng’amagezi gaabwe gabaweddemu, omukkiriza anaabeeranga muteefu, mukkakkamu, era ateeberezza, era bw’atyo anaasobolanga okukola n’amagezi mu ssaawa ey’okugezesebwa.

Taayanguyirizenga mu bye asuubira, ng’ayaayaanira ebirungi bye mu kaseera kamu era awo wennyini; wabula anaalindiriranga ekiseera kya Katonda. Abamu banguwa nnyo okuba n’ekinyonyi mu ngalo; kubanga balowooza ekisuubizo kya Mukama okuba ng’ekinyonyi ekiri mu kisaka, ekitalabika kuba kyabwe. Abakkiriza bamanyi okulindirira.

Taayanguyirizenga ng’abbira mu bikolwa ebikyamu oba ebibuusibwabuusibwa. Obutakkiriza buteekwa okuba nga bukola ekintu, era bwe butyo bwereetera okuzikirira; naye okukkiriza tekwanguyiriza kusukka ku mbiro ennungi, era bwe kutyo tekuwalirizibwa kudda nnyuma nga kunakuwadde mu kkubo lye kwagoberera awatali kwegendereza.

Nze mbeera ntya? Nkkiriza, era noolwekyo ntambula mu lugendo lw’omukkiriza, lwe kutambula ne Katonda? Teeka emirembe, ggwe omwoyo ogutebenkeddwa! Ayi, wummulira mu Mukama, era mulindirire n’obugumiikiriza! Ggwe omutima, laba nga kino okikola kaakano!

Novemba 30

KATONDA ALI MU MAASO G’OLUTALO

"Mukama Katonda yennyini y’ajjanga okukukulemberanga. Anaabanga naawe bulijjo, taakulekenga so taakwabulirenga. Totya so totekemuka" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 31:8

Mu maaso g’omulimu omunene oba olutalo olunene, wano waliwo ekyawandiikibwa ekitusaanidde okutuyamba okwesiba ebyokulwanyisa byaffe. Bwe kiba nti Yakuwa yennyini atukulembera, kiba kya bukuumi okumugoberera. Ani ayinza okuziyiza okugenda kwaffe mu maaso singa Mukama yennyini y’ali mu mase? Mujje, mmwe abaserikale bannaffe, tugende mu maaso mangu! Lwaki tuteebwatteebwa okulaga eri obuwanguzi?

So si nti Mukama ali mu maaso gaffe gokka; ali naffe. Waggulu, wansi, okwetooloola, ne munda ali Oyo Ayinzabyonna era abeera wonna. Mu biseera byonna, ne mu mirembe gyonna, anaabeeranga naffe nga bw’abadde bulijjo. Kino nga bwe kyandinywezezza omukono gwaffe! Mukirumbe n’obuvumu, mmwe abaserikale b’omusaalaba, kubanga Mukama ow’Eggye ali naffe!

Nga ali mu maaso gaffe era ng’ali naffe, taajjulukukenga buyambi bwe. Tayinza kulemererwa mu ye yennyini, so taatulemererwenga. Anaayongeranga okutuyamba ng’obwetaavu bwaffe bwe buli, okutuusa ku nkomerero. Nga bw’atayinza kutulemererwa, bw’atyo taatulekenga. Bulijjo anaabanga asobola era ayagala okutuwa amaanyi n’obuyambi okutuusa ennaku ez’okulwana lwe zinaggwaawo.

Tuleme kutya so tuleme kutekemuka; kubanga Mukama ow’Eggye anaaserengeta mu lutalo naffe, anaatwalira omugugu gw’olutalo, era anaatuwa obuwanguzi.
fields.body_text: Novemba 1 OKUTUUKIRIRA N’OKUKUUMIBWA "Oyo eyabayita mwesigwa era alikituukiriza." 1 Basessaloniika 5:24 Alikola ki? Alitutukuza ddala. Laba olunyiriri olukulembera. Alyeeyongera n’omulimu ogw’okututukuza okutuusa lwe tulituukirira mu buli kitundu. Alikuuma "omwoyo gwaffe gwonna, n’emmeeme yaffe n’omubiri gwaffe, nga tebiriiko kya kunenyezebwa okutuusa ku lunaku olw’okujja kwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo." Talituleka kugwa mu kisa, wadde okufugibwa ekibi. Nga bino birungi bya kitalo! Kituufu tusaanidde okusinza oyo agaba ebirabo ebitayogerekeka ng’ebyo. Ani alikola kino? Mukama eyatuyita okutuggya mu kizikiza n’okutuyingiza mu kitangaala kye eky’ekitalo, okutuggya mu kufa okw’ekibi n’okutuyingiza mu bulamu obutaggwaawo mu Kristo Yesu. Ye yekka y’asobola okukola kino: okutuukirira n’okukuumibwa okwenkana awo kuyinza kuva eri Katonda ow’ekisa kyonna. Lwaki alikikola? Kubanga "mwesigwa" -- mwesigwa eri ekisuubizo kye ye kennyini kye yeeyama okulokola omukkiriza; mwesigwa eri Omwana we, empeera ye nga kwe kuleeta abantu be gy’ali nga tebaliiko kamogo; mwesigwa eri omulimu gwe yatandika mu ffe olw’okuyitibwa kwaffe okw’amaanyi. Si bwesigwa bwabwe bo, wabula bwe bwesigwa bwa Mukama, abatukuvu kwe beesiga. Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, wano waliwo embaga ennene ey’okutandikirako omwezi omunyivu. Ebweru wayinza okubaawo olufu, naye munda musaanidde okubaawo omusana. Novemba 2 OBUGAGGA OBW’OMU GGULU "Tewaliiwo kirungi na kimu ky’ataawa abo abatambulira mu makubo ge nga tebaliiko kyakunenyezebwa." Zabbuli 84:11 Waliwo ebintu bingi ebisanyusa Mukama by’ayinza okutuggyako, naye "tewaliiwo kirungi na kimu." Ye y’asinga bonna okumanya ekitugasa. Ebintu ebimu mazima birungi, era bino tuyinza okubifuna nga tubisabira mu Yesu Kristo Mukama waffe. Obutukuvu kirungi, era buno alibukolera mu ffe awatali muwendo. Obuwanguzi ku mpisa embi, obusungu obungi, n’empisa ez’ekibi, aligituwa n’essanyu, era tetusaanidde kusigala nga tetulina buwanguzi obwo. Obukakafu obujjuvu alibutuwa, n’enkolagana ey’oku lusegere naye ye kennyini, n’okuyingira mu mazima gonna, n’obuvumu awamu n’obuwanguzi ku ntebe ey’okusaasira. Bwe tuba nga tetulina bino, kiva mu kubulwa okukkiriza okubifuna, so si mu kutayagala kwa Katonda kutuwa.
