Emirembe, omwoyo ogw’omu ggulu, obugumiikiriza obungi, n’okwagala okwaka -- byonna bino alibiwa abo abanyiikira mu butukuvu. Naye tegeera bulungi nti kitugwanira "kutambula mu bugolokofu." Tewaba kukyamu na nkola nkyamu; tewaba bukuusa wadde bulimba. Bwe tutambula mu bukyamu Katonda tasobola kutuwa mikisa, kubanga ekyo kyandibadde kusiima kibi. Ekkubo ery’obugolokofu lye kkubo ery’obugagga obw’omu ggulu -- obugagga obunene ennyo ne butwalira mu kirungi kyonna. Nga kino kisuubizo kya kwegayirira mu kusaba! Tufukamire. Novemba 3 MU KISEERA KYA KATONDA "Kubanga okwolesebwa okwo kujja mu kiseera kyakwo ekigere. Kwogera ku by’enkomerero ate si kwa bulimba. Bwe kunaaba ng’okuluddewo, mukulindirire, kujja kutuukirira, tekugya kulwa." Kaabakuuku 2:3 Okusaasira kuyinza okulabika ng’okuluddewo, naye kwa kakafu. Mukama, mu magezi ge agatalema, yateekawo ekiseera eky’okufuluma kw’amaanyi ge ag’ekisa, era ekiseera kya Katonda kye kisinga obulungi. Ffe tuli ba bwangu; okwolesebwa okw’omukisa kusiikuula okwegomba kwaffe, ne kwanguya okuyaayaana kwaffe; naye Mukama ajja kukwata ku biseera bye yateekawo. Tasooka kiseera kye; tasembera nnyuma. Ekigambo kya Katonda wano kyogerwako ng’ekintu ekiramu ekigenda okwogera, era ekigenda okujja. Tekiba nnukuta nfu, nga bwe tukemebwa okutya nga tumaze ebbanga ddene nga tulindirira okutuukirira kwakyo. Ekigambo ekiramu kiri mu kkubo nga kiva eri Katonda omulamu, era wadde nga kiyinza okulabika ng’ekiroddewo, mu butuufu tekiroddewo. Eggaali y’omukka ya Katonda teekwerererwa. Nsonga ya kugumiikiriza bugumiikiriza, era mangu ago tuligenda okwerolera ffe bennyini obwesigwa bwa Mukama. Tewali kisuubizo kye na kimu ekiryagwa; "si kwa bulimba." Tewali kisuubizo kye ekirisirikira; "kwogera." Nga kiryogera ebizzaamu amaanyi eri okutu olukkiriza! Tewali kisuubizo kye ekyetaaga kuzzibwa buggya ng’ebbaluwa etasoboddwa kusasulwa ku lunaku lwe yagwiririra -- "tekugya kulwa." Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, toyinza kulindirira Katonda wo? Wummuliranga mu ye era sirikira mu mirembe egitayogerekeka. Novemba 4 SIMA ENSALOSALO "N’ayogera nti, Bw’ati bw’ayogera Mukama nti, Musime ensalosalo mu kiwonvu kino. Mukama agamba nti, Temuulabe mbuyaga wadde enkuba, naye ekiwonvu kino kijja kujjula amazzi, era mmwe munaanywa, n’ente zammwe zinaanywa, n’ebisolo byammwe ebirala nabyo binywe." 2 Bassekabaka 3:16, 17 Amaggye asatu gaali gagenda kufa nnyonta, Mukama n’ayingira wakati. Newaakubadde nga teyaweereza kire wadde nkuba, kyokka yawa amazzi mangi. Taleeta bugagga bwe ku nkola za bulijjo, naye asobola okwewuunyisa abantu be n’ebipya eby’amagezi n’amaanyi. Bwe tutyo tuleetebwa okulaba Katonda okusinga ku ekyo enkola eza bulijjo kye zandyoledde. Newaakubadde nga Mukama tayinza kutulabikira mu ngeri gye tusuubira, oba gye twagala, oba gye tulowooza, kyokka mu ngeri emu oba endala ajja kutulabirira. Kya mukisa mungi gye tuli okugulumizibwa okusinga okutunuulira ensibuko ez’oku bbali, tulyoke tutunuulire amaaso g’Ensibuko Ennene Esooka. Olwa leero tulina ekisa ekimala okusima ensalosalo omukisa gwa Katonda mwe guyinza okukulukutira? Zisanze! Emirundi mingi tulemwa okwoleka okukkiriza okwa mazima era okukolebwako. Olwa leero tubeere beetegefu okulindirira okuddibwamu okusaba kwaffe. Ng’omwana eyagenda mu lukuŋŋaana okusabira enkuba bwe yatwala eky’okwewogomamu enkuba; bwe tutyo naffe mu mazima era mu ngeri ey’okukolebwako tusuubire Mukama okutuwa omukisa. Tujjuze ekiwonvu ensalosalo era tusuubire okuzirabako zonna nga zijjudde. Novemba 5 EBIRUMYA BIJJA KUKOMA "Kubanga sirirumiriza bantu bange emirembe n’emirembe era siribasunguwalira bbanga lyonna. Kubanga omutima gw’omuntu gwandigwereddewo mu maaso gange nga ndaba, emmeeme y’omuntu nze gye nakola." Isaaya 57:16 Kitaffe ali mu ggulu anoonya kutuyigiriza, so si kutuzikiriza. Okutunyiigira kwe kulina ekigendererwa eky’ekisa gye tuli. Talibeera bulijjo ng’atulwanyisa. Tulowooza nti Mukama alwawo mu kutukangavvula kwe, naye ekyo kiva ku kubanga ffe tetugumiikiriza. Okusaasira kwe kubeerera emirembe gyonna, naye okunyiiga kwe si kutyo. Ekiro kiyinza okulwawo nga kizitowa, naye ku nkomerero kiteekwa okuwa ekifo emisana emisanyufu. Ng’okunyiiga bwe kuba kwa kiseera buseera, bwe kutyo n’obusungu obukuvaamu bwa kaseera katono. Mukama ayagala abalonde be ennyo n’atayinza kubasunguwalira bulijjo. Singa yatukolanga bulijjo nga bw’atukola oluusi, twandizirikidde ddala, ne tuserengeta awatali ssuubi eri emiryango gy’okufa. Guma omwoyo, ggwe omutima omwagalwa! Mukama anaatera okukomya okunenya kwe. Gumira, kubanga Mukama anaakuwanirira, era anaakuyisa. Oyo eyakukola amanyi nga bw’oli omunafu, ne nga bw’osobola okugumira ebitono. Anaakwata mpola ekyo kye yabumba n’obwegendereza obungi. Noolwekyo, totya olw’okubonaabona okw’omu kaseera kano, kubanga kwanguwa okutuuka ku biseera eby’essanyu ebijja. Oyo eyakukuba y’anaakuwonya; obusungu bwe obutono bunaddirirwa okusaasira okungi. Novemba 6 OKUSANYUKA N’OKWEGOMBA "Sanyukiranga mu Mukama, anaakuwanga omutima gwo bye gwetaaga." Zabbuli 37:4 Okusanyukira mu Katonda kulina amaanyi agakyusa, era kugulumiza omuntu okusukka okwegomba okw’ensonyi okw’obuzaale bwaffe obwagwa. Okusanyukira mu Yakuwa si kuwoomerera kwokka mu kwokka, naye kuwoomya emmeeme yonna, okutuusa okwegomba kw’omutima lwe kufuuka kwenkanidde Mukama okusobola okusuubiza awatali kubuusabuusa okukutuukiriza. Kuno si kwe kusanyuka okukulu okubumba okwegomba kwaffe okutuusa lwe kufaanana ng’okwegomba kwa Katonda? Enkola yaffe ey’obusirusiru kwe kwegomba, oluvannyuma ne tutandika okukola kufuna kye twegomba. Tetukola mu ngeri ya Katonda, y’okumusooka okunoonya, oluvannyuma ne tusuubira ebintu byonna okwongerwako. Bwe tunaaleka omutima gwaffe okujjuzibwa Katonda okutuusa lwe gunaakuluka essanyu, awo Mukama yennyini y’anaalabirira nti tetuubuleko kirungi kyonna. Mu kifo ky’okugenda ebweru okunoonya essanyu, tusigale eka ne Katonda, era tunywe amazzi okuva mu luzzi lwaffe ffe. Asobola okutukolera ebisukka nnyo ku mikwano gyaffe gyonna. Kirungi okumatira ne Katonda yekka okusinga okutambulatambula nga tweraliikirira era nga twegomba ebintu ebitono eby’ekiseera n’eby’ensi. Okumala akaseera tuyinza okufuna okumenyeka kw’emitima; naye singa bino bituleeta okumpi ne Mukama, biba bintu bya kusiimibwa nnyo, kubanga ku nkomerero binaatufunira okutuukirira kw’okwegomba kwaffe kwonna okutuufu. Novemba 7 OKWETOOWAZA OKW’AMAZIMA KUWEEBWA EMPEERA "Oyo eyeetoowaza aligulumizibwa." Lukka 18:14 Tekyandibadde kizibu gye tuli okwetoowaza, kubanga kiki kye tulina okwenyumiririza? Tusaanidde okutwala ekifo ekya wansi ennyo nga tetulagiddwa kukikola. Bwe tuba abategeevu era abeesimbu tunaaba batono mu maaso gaffe ffe. Naddala mu maaso ga Mukama nga tusaba tunaafuuka ekitaliimu. Awo tetusobola kwogera ku birungi bye tukoze, kubanga tetuliiko: okwegayirira kwaffe kwokka kuteekwa kudda eri okusaasira: "Katonda, onsaasire, nze omwonoonyi." Wano waliwo ekigambo ekisanyusa okuva ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka. Tuligulumizibwa Mukama singa twetoowaza. Gye tuli ekkubo eridda waggulu lya kuserengeta. Bwe twambulwa obweyagalize, tunaabikkibwa okwetoowaza, era kino kye kyambalo ekisinga obulungi. Mukama anaatugulumiza mu mirembe n’essanyu ery’omu mutima; anaatugulumiza okutuyingiza mu kumanya Ekigambo kye n’enkolagana naye ye kennyini; anaatugulumiza mu kusanyukira okusonyiyibwa okwa kakafu n’okuweebwa obutuukirivu. Mukama assa ekitiibwa kye ku abo abasobola okukyambala olw’ekitiibwa ky’Oyo akiwa. Awa okuba ow’omugaso, okukkirizibwa, n’obuyinza eri abo abataakwewaanirize, naye abanaatoowazibwa olw’okutegeera obuvunaanyizibwa obunene. Newaakubadde Katonda newaakubadde omuntu tabaako gw’ayagala kugulumiza asituka yekka; naye Katonda n’abantu abalungi bombi begatta okussa ekitiibwa ku muntu omuwombeefu ow’omuwendo. Ayi Mukama, nzike mu bwange nnyini ndyoke nsituke mu ggwe. Novemba 8 OBUNENE BW’EKISA "Ekisa kyange kikumala, kubanga amaanyi gange gatuukirira mu bunafu." 2 Abakkolinso 12:9 Obunafu bwaffe tusaanidde okubutwala nga bwa muwendo kubanga bugulawo ekifo eri amaanyi ga Katonda. Twandibadde tetumanyanga maanyi ga kisa singa tetwawulira bunafu bw’obuzaale bwaffe. Mukama atenderezebwe olw’eriggwa erittwa mu mubiri, n’omubaka wa Setaani, bwe bitutwala eri amaanyi ga Katonda. Kino kigambo kya muwendo okuva ku mimwa gya Mukama waffe ye kennyini. Kiseseza omuwandiisi w’ekitabo kino olw’essanyu. Ekisa kya Katonda kimmala nze! Ndowooza mazima kimmala. Eggulu terimala kinyonyi, n’ennyanja teemala kyennyanja? Oyo Amala byonna amala okwetaaga kwange okusinga obunene. Oyo amala ensi n’Eggulu mazima asobola okutuukiriza embeera y’envunyu emu enaku nga nze. Kale, ka twesigame ku Katonda waffe n’ekisa kye. Bw’ataggyaawo nnaku yaffe, anaatusobozesa okugigumira. Amaanyi ge ganaatuyiwibwamu okutuusa envunyu lw’eneewuula ensozi; era ekitaliimu kinaawangula abo bonna abagulumivu era ab’amaanyi. Kirungi gye tuli okuba n’amaanyi ga Katonda okusinga agaffe ffe; kubanga singa twabadde ba maanyi emirundi lukumi okusinga bwe tuli, byonna byandivuddemo bwereere mu maaso g’omulabe; ne singa twandisobodde okuba abanafu okusinga bwe tuli, ekitasoboka nnyo, kyokka twandisobodde okukola byonna mu Kristo. Novemba 9 OKUMANYA OKWETAAGISA "Era zirimanya nga nze Mukama Katonda waazo, ndi wamu nazo, era nga zo, ennyumba ya Isirayiri, bantu bange, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda." Ezeekyeri 34:30 Okuba abantu ba Mukama ye kennyini mukisa gwa njawulo, naye okumanya nti tuli batyo mukisa gubudaabuza. Kimu kwe kusuubira nti Katonda ali naffe, ekirala kwe kumanya nti bw’ali. Okukkiriza kutulokola, naye obukakafu bwe butumatiza. Tutwala Katonda okuba Katonda waffe bwe tumukkiririza; naye tufuna essanyu erimuvaamu bwe tumanya nti wa ffe, era nga ffe tuli babe. Tewali mukkiriza asaanidde kumatira na kusuubira n’okwesiga kwokka, asaanidde okusaba Mukama okumutuusa ku bukakafu obujjuvu, ebintu eby’essuubi bifuuke ebintu ebya kakafu. Bwe tuba nga tusanyukira emikisa egy’endagaano, era nga tulaba Mukama waffe Yesu ng’atuyimusizza ng’ekimera eky’ettutumu, awo lwe tutuuka ku kumanya okulambulukufu okw’ekisa kya Katonda gye tuli. Si lwa mateeka, wabula lwa kisa, kwe tuyigira nti tuli bantu ba Mukama. Bulijjo ka tukyuse amaaso gaffe eri ekisa ekyereere. Obukakafu obw’okukkiriza tebuyinza kujja lwa mirimu gya mateeka. Bwe butukuvu obw’Enjiri, era busobola kututuukako mu ngeri ya Njiri yokka. Tuleme kwekaliriza munda waffe. Ka tutunuulire Mukama yekka. Nga bwe tulaba Yesu bwe tutyo tuliraba obulokozi bwaffe. Ayi Mukama, tuweereze amazzi amangi ag’okwagala kwo agakulukuta ne gatutwala okusukka ettosi ery’okubuusabuusa n’okutya. Novemba 10 OKUTAMBULA AWATALI KWESITTALA "Taliganya kigere kyo kusagaasagana." Zabbuli 121:3 Mukama bw’ataliganya, tewali bantu wadde baddayimooni abasobola okukikola. Nga bandisanyuse nnyo singa baasobola okutuleetera okugwa okw’ensonyi, ne batugoba mu bifo byaffe, ne batuziika ne twerabirwa! Bandikikoze nga bwe baagala singa tewaali kiziyiza kimu, era kimu kyokka: Mukama taliganya; era bw’ataliganya, naffe tekitutuukako. Olugendo lw’obulamu luli ng’okutambula mu nsozi za Alps. Ku makubo g’ensozi omuntu bulijjo ali mu kabi k’okuseerera. Ekkubo we liba erya waggulu ennyo omutwe gutera okuzunga, n’ebigere ne biseerera mangu: waliwo ebifo ebiweweevu ng’endabirwamu, n’ebirala ebijjudde amayinja agatanywezeddwa, era mu buli kimu ku ebyo okugwa kizibu okwewala. Oyo asobozesebwa okwesimba obulungi obulamu bwe bwonna n’okutambula awatali kwesittala alina ensonga ennungi ennyo ez’okwebaza. Olw’obunnya n’emitego, amaviivi amanafu, ebigere ebikooye, n’abalabe abakujjukujju, tewali mwana wa Katonda ayinza okuyimirira nnywevu n’akaseera akamu singa tewaali kwagala okwesigwa okutaliganya kigere kye kusagaasagana. "Wakati mu mitego olukumi nnyimirira, Nga nkwatiddwa era nga nkuumibwa omukono gwo; Omukono ogwo ogutalabika gulinnywereza, Ne gunkulembera okuntuusa ku lusozi lwo olutukuvu." Novemba 11 ABANTU BA MUKAMA AB’EDDEMBE "Temukkiriza kibi kwongera kubafuga, kubanga temukyafugibwa mateeka, wabula ekisa kya Katonda." Abaruumi 6:14 Ekibi kirifuga singa kisobola: tekimatira na kifo kyonna wansi w’entebe ey’obwakabaka bw’omutima. Oluusi tutya nti kirituwangula, ne kaabbi tukaabira Mukama nti, "Tokkiriza kibi kyonna kunfuga." Kuno kwe kuddamu kwe okuzzaamu amaanyi nti, "Ekibi tekirikufuga. Kiyinza okukulumba, ne kikutuusaako n’ekiwundu; naye tekirikuteekawo bufuzi ku ggwe emirembe gyonna." Singa twali wansi w’amateeka, ekibi kyaffe kyandyeyongedde amaanyi ne kitunyweza mu buyinza bwakyo; kubanga kibonerezo kya kibi omuntu okujja wansi w’obuyinza bw’ekibi. Naye nga bwe tuli wansi w’endagaano ey’ekisa, tukuumibwa tuleme kuva ku Katonda omulamu olw’ekigambo eky’endagaano eky’amazima. Tusuubizibwa ekisa, kye tuzzibwa nakyo okuva mu kubula kwaffe, ne tunaazibwa obutali bulongoofu bwaffe, ne tuweebwa eddembe okuva mu njegere ez’empisa embi. Twandigalamidde mu kuggwaamu essuubi ne "tumatira okukolera Abamisiri" singa twakyali baddu abakolera obulamu obutaggwaawo; naye kubanga tuli bantu ba Mukama ab’eddembe, tuguma omwoyo okulwana n’obwonoonefu bwaffe n’okukemebwa, nga tukakasibwa nti ekibi tekirituvuganga nate. Katonda yennyini y’atuwa obuwanguzi ku bwa Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo, ekitiibwa kibe gy’ali emirembe n’emirembe. Amiina. Novemba 12 EMMEEME ENTUKUZE ZE ZIMATIVU "Abantu bange mbajjuze ebintu, bw’ayogera Mukama." Yeremiya 31:14 Weetegereze "wange" eryeddamu emirundi ebiri: "Abantu bange balikkusibwa obulungi bwange." Abantu abamativu ku Katonda balagibwa nga bantu ba Katonda yennyini. Abasanyusa, kubanga nabo bamusanyusa. Bamuyita Katonda waabwe, naye n’abayita abantu be; asanyuka okubatwala okuba omugabo gwe, nabo basanyuka nga ye mugabo gwabwe. Waliwo enkolagana ey’essanyu wakati wa Isirayiri owa Katonda ne Katonda wa Isirayiri. Abantu bano bamativu. Kino kintu kikulu nnyo. Batono nnyo ku baana b’abantu abamativu, ne bwe kiba nti omugabo gwabwe guli gutya; bamize ekinoso, era kyeyongera okuleekaana nti, "Mpa! Mpa!" Emmeeme entukuze zokka ze mmeeme ezimativu. Katonda yennyini kimugwanira okutukyusa era n’okutumatiza. Si kya kwewuunya nti abantu ba Mukama basaanidde okumatira obulungi bwa Mukama waabwe. Buno bulungi obutali na kutabulwamu, obugabi obutaliiko kkomo, okusaasira okutaliimu kunenya, okwagala okutakyukakyuka, ekisa ekitaliiko kye kikweka. Obanga obulungi bwa Katonda tebutumatiza, kiki ekirikutumatiza? Ki! Tukyasinda? Mazima ddala waliwo okwegomba okukyamu munda singa kuba kwe kumu obulungi bwa Katonda kwe butamatiza. Mukama, ndi mumativu. Erinnya lyo litenderezebwe. Novemba 13 OBUKUUMI OBUTAGGWAAWO "Laba, oyo akuuma Isirayiri taabongootenga so teyeebakenga." Zabbuli 121:4 Yakuwa ye "oyo akuuma Isirayiri." Tewali ngeri ya kutabikako amagezi eyinza okumukwata, wadde otulo otungi wadde otulo otutono. Talemererwa kukuuma nnyumba n’omutima gw’abantu be. Eno nsonga emala okutuleetera okuwummulira mu mirembe ejjuvu. Alexander yagamba nti yeebaka kubanga mukwano gwe Parmenio yali akuuma; naffe okusinga wandiyeebase kubanga Katonda waffe ye mukuumi waffe. "Laba" wano lyateekebwawo okukyusa obulowoozo bwaffe eri amazima agasanyusa. Isirayiri, bwe yeezizika ejjinja ne yeebaka; naye Katonda we yali muzuukufu, n’ajjira omuweereza we mu kwolesebwa. Bwe tugalamira nga tetulina kwerinda, Yakuwa yennyini alibikka ku mutwe gwaffe. Mukama akuuma abantu be ng’omugagga bw’akuuma eby’obugagga bye, nga kaptenne bw’akuuma ekibuga n’eggye eririkuumira, nga omukuumi bw’akuuma kabaka we. Tewali ayinza kukola kabi eri abo abakuumibwa bwe batyo. Ka nteeke emmeeme yange mu mikono gye egy’omuwendo. Tatwerabira, talekayo kutulabirira, so tasangibwa nga tasobola kutukuuma. Ai Mukama wange, nkuuma, si kulwa nga mbula ne ngwa ne nzikirira. Nkuuma, ndyoke nkuume amateeka go. Olw’obulabirizi bwo obutabongoota, nziyiza okwebaka ng’omugayaavu, n’okuzikirira ng’abo abeebaka otulo otw’okufa. Novemba 14 ERINNYA ERY’OKUKOZESA "Bwe munaasabanga ekintu kyonna mu linnya lyange nnaakikolanga." Yokaana 14:14 Nga kino kisuubizo kigazi! Ekintu kyonna! Oba kinene oba kitono, byonna bye nneetaaga bibikkiddwa ekigambo ekyo "ekintu kyonna." Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, weeyagalire ku ntebe ey’okusaasira, owulire Mukama wo ng’akugamba nti, "Yasamya akamwa ko, nange nnaakajjuza." Nga kino kisuubizo kya magezi! Bulijjo tusaana okusaba mu linnya lya Yesu. Kino nga bwe kituzzaamu amaanyi, era kimuwa ekitiibwa. Kuno kwe kwegayirira okutaggwaawo. Oluusi buli kwegayirira okulala kufuuka ekizikiza, naddala okwo kwe twandiggye mu nkolagana yaffe ne Katonda, oba mu bumanyirivu bwaffe obw’ekisa kye; naye mu biseera ng’ebyo erinnya lya Yesu liba lya maanyi ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka nga bulijjo, era tuyinza okulyegayiririza n’obukakafu obujjuvu. Nga kuno kwe kusaba okuyigiriza! Siyinza kusaba kintu kyonna kye siyinza kutekako mukono gwa Kristo n’akabonero ke. Sirina buvumu bwa kukozesa linnya lya Mukama wange mu kusaba okw’omululu oba okw’obukakanyavu. Nnyinza kukozesa linnya lya Mukama wange mu kusaba kwokka Ye kennyini kw’andisabye singa aba mu mbeera yange. Kya kitiibwa kingi okuweebwa obuyinza okusaba mu linnya lya Yesu ng’asaba Yesu yennyini; naye okumwagala kwaffe tekulituganya kuteeka linnya eryo we yandiritaddewo. Nsaba ekyo Yesu ky’asiima? Nnyinza okuteeka akabonero ke ku kusaba kwange? Kale nnina kye nnoonya eri Kitaffe. Novemba 15 OBUGAGGA OBUTALIIKO KKOMO "Kale ne Katonda wange alibawa buli kye mwetaaga ng’obugagga bwe obungi obuli mu Kristo Yesu bwe buli." Abafiripi 4:19 Katonda wa Pawulo ye Katonda waffe, era alituwa buli kye twetaaga. Pawulo yali akakasa kino ku Abafiripi, naffe tukakasa kino ku ffe ffennyini. Katonda alikikola, kubanga kiri nga Ye: atwagala, asanyukira okutuwa omukisa, era kirimuweesa ekitiibwa okukola bw’atyo. Okusaasira kwe, amaanyi ge, okwagala kwe, obwesigwa bwe, byonna bikolagana ffe tuleme kufa njala. Laba ekigera Mukama ky’akozesa: "ng’obugagga bwe obungi obuli mu Kristo Yesu bwe buli." Obugagga bw’ekisa kye bunene, naye tunaayogera ki ku bugagga bw’ekitiibwa kye? "Obugagga bwe obw’ekitiibwa obuli mu Kristo Yesu," ani ayinza okubugera? Ng’ekigera kino ekitagerageranyizika Katonda bw’alijjuza obunnya obunene obw’obwetaavu bwaffe. Afuula Mukama Yesu ekifo eky’okujjuza kwe n’omukutu ogugujja, n’oluvannyuma n’atugabira obugagga bwe obw’okwagala mu ngeri yaakyo esingayo obukulu. Aleruuya! Omuwandiisi w’ekitabo kino amanyi kye kitegeeza okugezesebwa mu mulimu gwa Mukama. Obwesigwa busasuddwa n’obusungu, n’abagabi ab’ekigabi baalekera awo okuwaayo kwabwe; naye oyo gwe baagezaako okujoba tabuliddwa wadde essente emu, si kyo kyokka, wabula afuuse mugagga okusinga; kubanga ekisuubizo kino kibadde kya mazima nti, "Katonda wange alituwa buli kye twetaaga." Ebigabirwa bya Katonda bya kakafu okusinga bbanka yonna. Novemba 16 EBYOKULWANYISA EBIGENDA OKULEMERERWA "Teri kyakulwanyisa kye baliweesa ekirikwolekera ne kikusobola, era oliwangula buli lulimi olulikuvunaana era oluwoza naawe." Isaaya 54:17 Waliwo oluyoogaano lunene mu masasa n’ebisaasi by’omulabe. Baweesa ebyokulwanyisa bye baakukubya abatukuvu. Tebandisobodde na kukola kino singa Mukama w’abatukuvu teyabakkiriza; kubanga ye yatonda omuweesi awujja amanda agaliko omuliro. Naye laba nga bwe bakola n’obunyiikivu! Ebitala n’amafumu bimeka bye bakola! Tekiriimu nsonga, kubanga ku bwogi bwa buli kyokulwanyisa oyinza okusoma ebigambo bino: Tekirikulaakulana. Naye kaakano wuliriza oluyoogaano olulala: kwe kuyomba kw’ennimi. Ennimi bye byuma ebyentiisa okusinga ebiyinza okuweesebwa n’ennyondo n’amayinja ag’okuweesesaako, n’akabi ke zileeta kasala nnyo era kasaasaana wala. Kaakano tulifuuka tutya? Okuwaayiriza, obulimba, okukisakisa, okuduulira -- zino miyinja gya busagwa; tuyinza tutya okuzaanjula? Mukama Katonda atusuubiza nti, ne bwe tutasobola kuzisirisa, wano waakiri tuliwona okuzikirizibwa zo. Zitusalira omusango kaakati, naye ffe tulizisalira omusango ku nkomerero, era emirembe gyonna. Akamwa k’abo aboogera eby’obulimba kalibuniikirizibwa, n’obulimba bwabwe bulikyusibwa okufuuka ekitiibwa ky’abantu abalungi abaabonyaabonyezebwa bo. Novemba 17 KATONDA TAABULIRA BANTU BE "Kubanga Mukama talireka bantu be; talyabulira zzadde lye." Zabbuli 94:14 Nedda, so talisuula na n’omu ku bo. Omuntu alina b’asuula, naye Katonda talina n’omu; kubanga okulonda kwe tekukyukakyuka, n’okwagala kwe kwa mirembe gyonna. Tewali ayinza kuzuula muntu n’omu Katonda gw’aabulira ng’amaze okwolesa gy’ali obulokozi. Amazima gano amakulu gayogerwako mu zabbuli okusanyusa omutima gw’oyo abonyaabonyezebwa. Mukama akangavvula ababe; naye tabaabulira. Ekiva mu mulimu ogw’emirundi ebiri ogw’amateeka n’oluga kwe kuyigirizibwa kwaffe, n’ekibala ky’okuyigirizibwa okwo kwe kuteeka omwoyo, obutebenkevu bw’ebirowoozo, mwe muva okuwummula. Abatatya Katonda balekebwa okutuusa ng’obunnya busimiddwa mwe baligwira ne bawambibwa; naye abatya Katonda batumibwa ku ssomero okubateekerateekera omukisa gwabwe ogw’ekitiibwa ogunaajja. Omusango gulikomawo ne gumaliriza omulimu gwagwo ku bajeemu, naye era gulikomawo okwejjeereza abeesigwa n’abatya Katonda. Noolwekyo tuyinza okugumira oluga olw’okukangavvulwa n’okuwuliriza okuteefu; tekitegeeza busungu, wabula kwagala. "Katonda ayinza okukangavvula n’okutereeza, Naye tayinza kutulagajjalira; Ayinza mu bwesigwa okunenya, Naye tayinza kulekayo kwagala." Novemba 18 EKYAMAGERO EKIRABIKIRA DDALA "Ku lunaku olwo Mukama aliteeka obukuumi ku batuuze b’omu Yerusaalemi; abo abasembayo obunafu ku lunaku olwo babeere nga Dawudi, era ennyumba ya Dawudi ebeere ng’ennyumba ya Katonda, nga malayika wa Mukama abakulembeddemu." Zekkaliya 12:8 Ekimu ku bikolwa Mukama ebisinga obulungi eby’okukuuma abantu be kwe kubawa amaanyi mu munda. Abantu basinga bbugwe, era okukkiriza kunywevu okusinga ebigo. Mukama ayinza okutwala asinga obunafu mu ffe n’amufuula nga Dawudi, omuzira wa Isirayiri. Mukama, kino kikole ku nze! Nfukamu amaanyi go, onjijuze obuvumu obutukuvu ndyoke nsisinkane omusajja omuwanvu ennyo n’envuumuulo n’ejjinja, nga neesiga Katonda. Mukama ayinza okufuula abazira be abasingayo obukulu ab’amaanyi okusinga bwe bali: Dawudi ayinza okuba nga Katonda, nga malayika wa Yakuwa. Kino kyandibadde kya kyewuunyo, naye kisoboka, singa si bwe kityo tekyandyogeddwako. Ai Mukama, kola bw’otyo ku bakulembeze baffe abasinga obulungi! Tulage kye osobola okukola -- kwe kuyimusa abaweereza bo abeesigwa okutuuka ku ntikko ey’ekisa n’obutukuvu eneeba ng’eky’ekyamagero mu bulambulukufu! Mukama, beera mu batukuvu bo, nabo balibeera nga Katonda; teeka amaanyi go mu bo, nabo balibeera ng’ebitonde ebiramu ebibeera mu maaso ga Yakuwa. Tuukiriza ekisuubizo kino eri ekkanisa yo yonna mu biro bino ebyaffe, ku bwa Yesu. Amiina. Novemba 19 OKUVA MU KUGONDERA OKUTUUKA MU MUKISA "Okuva ne leero ndibawa omukisa" Kaggayi 2:19 Ebintu eby’omu maaso bitukwekeddwa. Naye wano waliwo endabirwamu mwe tusobola okulaba emyaka egitannaba kujja. Mukama agamba nti, "Okuva ne leero ndibawa omukisa." Kigasa okwetegereza olunaku olwogerwako mu kisuubizo kino. Ebirime byali bigudde, ng’ebikuubiridde era nga birwadde, era byonna olw’ekibi ky’abantu. Kaakano, Mukama yalaba abo abaakangavvulwa nga batandika okugondera ekigambo kye, n’okuzimba yeekaalu ye, era kyeyava agamba nti, "Okuva ku lunaku lwe baazimba omusingi gwa yeekaalu ya Mukama, mujjukire. Okuva ne leero ndibawa omukisa." Bwe tuba nga twabeeranga mu kibi kyonna, Omwoyo n’atuluŋŋamya okwerongoosaako, tusobola okwesiga omukisa gwa Mukama. Akamwenyumwenyu ke, Omwoyo we, ekisa kye, n’okubikkulirwa kwe okujjuvu okw’amazima ge, byonna binaatuweera omukisa omunene. Tuyinza okugwa mu kuziyizibwa okusingako okuva mu bantu olw’obwesigwa bwaffe, naye tuligulumira mu nkolagana ey’oku lusegere ne Mukama Katonda waffe, era ne mu kutegeera obulungi okukkirizibwa kwaffe mu ye. Mukama, nsazeewo okuba omwesigwa gy’oli okusingawo, era omunywevu mu kugoberera enjigiriza yo n’ebiragiro byo; kyenva nkusaba, ku bwa Kristo Yesu, ongeze omukisa mu bulamu bwange obwa buli lunaku okuva kaakano n’emirembe gyonna. Novemba 20 ENJALA ERIKKUSIBWA "Kubanga abalina ennyonta abanywesa, n’abayala abakkusa ebirungi" Zabbuli 107:9 Kirungi okuba n’okwegomba, era gye kweyongera okuba okungi, gye kusinga okuba okulungi. Mukama alikkusa okwegomba kw’emmeeme, ne bwe kuba nga kunene era nga kutwala omutima gwonna. Twegombe nnyo, kubanga Katonda aliwa nnyo. Tetubeera mu mbeera ntuufu ey’omutima bwe tuba nga tumatidde nga twekkiriza, era nga tetulina kwegomba. Okwegomba ekisa okusingawo, n’okusinda okutayogerekeka, kwe kukula, era twandyagadde okukuwulira okweyongera. Ggwe Omwoyo Omutukuvu, otuleetere okussa ebikkowe n’okukaabira ebintu ebisingako obulungi, era n’okwegomba ebisingira ddala obulungi! Enjala si kintu kya ssanyu n’akatono. Naye balina omukisa abalumwa enjala n’ennyonta olw’obutuukirivu. Abantu ng’abo enjala yaabwe tejja kukendeezebwa buseerezi n’emmere ntono, wabula balikkusibwa. Tebalikkusibwa mmere ya kabi yonna, wabula emmere yaabwe eneesaanira Mukama waabwe omulungi, kubanga balikkusibwa ebirungi Yakuwa yennyini. Jjangu, tuleme okweraliikirira olw’okwegomba n’enjala yaffe, wabula tuwulire eddoboozi ly’omuwandiisi wa Zabbuli, nga naye yeegomba era alumwa enjala okulaba Katonda ng’agulumizibwa. "Kale singa beebazanga Mukama olw’okwagala kwe okutaggwaawo, n’olw’eby’ekitalo by’akolera abaana b’abantu!" Novemba 21 OKUTUNULA EBWEERU NE WAGGULU "Mudde gye ndi, mulokoke, mmwe mwenna abali ku nkomerero z’ensi, kubanga nze Katonda so tewali mulala" Isaaya 45:22 Kino kye kisuubizo ekisinga ebisuubizo byonna. Kye musingi gw’obulamu bwaffe obw’omwoyo. Obulokozi bujja okuyita mu kutunula oyo ali "Katonda omutuukirivu era Omulokozi." Obulagirizi nga bwangu! "Mudde gye ndi. Ekyetaagisa nga kya magezi! Mazima ekitonde kisaanidde okutunula eri Omutonzi. Twatunula awalala ebbanga ddene, kaakano kye kiseera okutunula oyo yekka ayita okusuubira kwaffe, era asuubiza okutuwa obulokozi bwe. Kutunula kwokka! Tetujja kutunula mangwago? Tetuteekwa kuleeta kantu konna mu ffe, wabula okutunula ebweeru ne waggulu eri Mukama waffe ali ku ntebe ye ey’obwakabaka, gye yalinnya okuva ku musaalaba. Okutunula tekwetaaga kwetegeka, so tekwetaaga kufuba kwa maanyi: tekwetaaga magezi wadde okumanya, bugagga wadde amaanyi. Byonna bye twetaaga biri mu Mukama Katonda waffe, era bwe tumutunuulira olwa buli kimu, ekyo kyonna kinaaba kyaffe, era tunaalokolebwa. Mujje, mmwe abali ewala, mutunule wano! Mmwe abali ku nkomerero z’ensi, mukyuse amaaso gammwe wano! Nga bwe kiri nti okuva mu bitundu ebisinga okuba ewala abantu basobola okulaba enjuba n’okusanyukira ekitangaala kyayo, bwe mutyo mmwe abagalamidde ku nsalo z’okufa ku miryango gennyini egya ggeyeena, musobola okuyita mu kutunula okufuna ekitangaala kya Katonda, obulamu obw’Eggulu, obulokozi bwa Mukama Yesu Kristo, ali Katonda, era noolwekyo asobola okulokola. Novemba 22 TEWALI KUSINGIBWA MUSANGO "Mu nnaku ezo, era mu biseera ebyo, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda, omusango ku Isirayiri gulinoonyezebwa, naye tegulibaawo, era n’ebibi bya Yuda birinoonyezebwa, naye tewaliba na kimu, kubanga ndisonyiwa abo bendeseewo" Yeremiya 50:20 Kigambo kya kitiibwa ddala! Nga wano wasuubizibwa okusonyiyibwa okutuukiridde eri amawanga g’aboonoonyi aga Isirayiri ne Yuda! Ekibi kijja kuggyibwawo n’engeri nga tekijja kuzuulibwa, kisangulibwe ne watabaawo na kimu. Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda asonyiwa! Setaani anoonya ebibi by’asobola okutuwawaabira, abalabe baffe babinoonya balyoke babituteekeko, n’omuntu waffe ow’omunda abinoonya n’obunyiikivu obw’endwadde. Naye Mukama bw’assaako omusaayi gwa Yesu ogw’omuwendo omungi, tetutya ngeri yonna ey’okunoonyezebwa, kubanga "tegulibaawo," "tewaliba na kimu." Mukama yaggyawo ebibi by’abantu be ne bitabaawo: yamaliriza obwonoonyi, era yakomya ekibi. Ssaddaaka ya Yesu ekasudde ebibi byaffe mu buziba bw’ennyanja. Kino kituleetera okuzina olw’essanyu. Ensonga lwaki ekibi kizikirizibwa eri mu kuba nti Yakuwa yennyini asonyiwa abalonde be. Ekigambo kye eky’ekisa si kya bwakabaka kyokka, wabula kya bwakatonda. Ayogera okusonyiyibwa, ne tusonyiyibwa. Assaako okutangirira, era okuva mu ssaawa eyo abantu be tebakyatya kusalirwa musango. Erinnya lya Katonda azikiriza ekibi liweebwe ekitiibwa! Novemba 23 OKUFUNA OBUGUMIIKIRIZA "Mukama Katonda wo amawanga ago anaagendanga agaggyawo linnalimu, mpola mpola" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 7:22 Tetusaanidde kusuubira kuwangula ku lwa Mukama Yesu mu kikonde kimu. Ennono n’empisa embi zifa nnaku. Mu bifo ebimu kitwala emyaka mingi egy’okukola okugoba newaakubadde kimu ku bibi ebingi ebyonoona abatuuze. Tuteekwa okweyongera n’olutalo n’amaanyi gaffe gonna, ne bwe tuba nga tufunye obuwanguzi butono obweraga. Omulimu gwaffe mu nsi eno kwe kugiwangulira Yesu. Tetusaanidde kukola ndagaano za kkabbo, wabula okumalirawo ddala ebibi. Tetusaanidde kunoonya ttendo, wabula okulwana olutalo olutakoma n’obutali butuukirivu. Obutakkiriza, enzikiriza ya Papa, okutamiira, obutali bulongoofu, okujooga, okwagala ensi, n’obukyamu; bino byonna biteekwa "okuggyibwawo." Mukama Katonda waffe yekka y’asobola okukituukiriza. Akolera mu baweereza be abeesigwa; era, erinnya lye liweebwe ekitiibwa, asuubiza nti bw’atyo bw’aliba akola. "Mukama Katonda wo amawanga ago anaagendanga agaggyawo." Kino alikikola mpola mpola, tulyoke tuyige obugumiikiriza, tweyongere mu kukkiriza, tutunule n’obunyiikivu, era twewale obukuumi obw’omubiri. Twebaze Katonda olw’obuwanguzi obutono, era tusabe obungi. Tuleme kuzza kitala mu kiraato okutuusa ensi yonna lw’eneewangulirwa Yesu. Guma omwoyo, ggwe omutima gwange! Weeyongereyo mpola mpola, kubanga obutono obungi bulikola ekintu ekinene ekijjuvu. Novemba 24 OKUSONYIYIBWA N’OKUGANYIBWA "Taasibenga busungu ku mwoyo, era tasunguwala kumala bbanga lyonna" Zabbuli 103:9 Anaanenyanga oluusi, kubanga singa si bw’atyo teyandibadde Kitaffe ow’amagezi eri abaana ng’affe abeeyisa obubi. Okunenya kwe kunyiiza nnyo abo abeesigwa, kubanga bawulira nga bwe bakisaanira ennaku, era nga bwe kitali kirungi ku bwabwe okumunakuwaza. Tumanyi amakulu g’okunenya kuno, era tuvuunama mu maaso ga Mukama, nga tunakuwadde nti tumuleetedde okutusunguwalira. Naye nga tuzuula okubudaabudibwa okunene mu bigambo bino! "Si bulijjo" ky’anaanenyanga. Bwe twenenya ne tudda gy’ali n’emitima egimenyeddwa olw’ekibi era egyawukanye n’ekibi, anaatumwenyera amangwago. Tekimusanyusa kukyusa maaso ge okusongako obusungu eri abo b’ayagala n’omutima gwe gwonna: essanyu lye kwe kuba nti essanyu lyaffe libe lijjuvu. Jjangu, tunoonye amaaso ge. Tewali nsonga ya kuggwaamu ssuubi, wadde okwennyamira. Twagale Katonda anenya, era mu bbanga ttono tunaayimba nti: "obusungu bwo bwaggwaawo era onzizizzaamu amaanyi." Muveewo, mmwe okuteebereza okw’ekizikiza, mmwe bannamuŋŋoona b’emmeeme! Muyingire, mmwe essuubi eryetoowaze n’okujjukira okw’okwebaza, mmwe amayiba g’omutima! Oyo eyatusonyiwa edda ng’omulamuzi, alituganyira nate nga kitaffe, era tunaasanyukira okwagala kwe okuwoomerera era okutakyukakyuka. Novemba 25 ENSOZI EZIFUUKA ENSENYI "Ggwe olusozi olunene weyita ki? Mu maaso ga Zerubbaberi olibeera lusenyi, era alireeta ejjinja erya waggulu mu mizira n’okwogerera mu ddoboozi ery’omwanguka ng’agamba nti, Liweebwe omukisa, liweebwe omukisa!" Zekkaliya 4:7 Mu ssaawa eno olusozi olw’ebuzibu, olw’ennaku, oba olw’obwetaavu, luyinza okuba mu kkubo lyaffe, n’amagezi ag’obuntu tegalaba kkubo lya kulusukka, oba lya kuluyita wakati, oba lya kulwetooloola. Ka okukkiriza kuyingire, era amangu ago olusozi lubulawo ne lufuuka olusenyi. Naye okukkiriza kusooka kuwulira kigambo kya Mukama -- "Si lwa maanyi so si lwa buyinza naye lwa Mwoyo wange, bw’ayogera Mukama ow’Eggye." Amazima gano amakulu kye kyetaagisa ennyo mu kwolekagana n’ebigezo eby’obulamu ebitayinzika kuwangulwa. Ndaba nti sisobola kukola kantu konna, era nti okwesiga omuntu kwonna butaliimu. "Si lwa maanyi." Ndaba nti tewali kakodyo kalabika ku kesigibwa, wabula amaanyi gali mu Mwoyo atalabika. Katonda yekka y’ateekwa okukola, n’abantu n’obukodyo tebiteekwa kubalibwako kantu. Bwe kiba bwe kityo, nti Katonda Ayinzabyonna atwala ensonga z’abantu be, olwo ensozi ennene si kantu. Asobola okuggyawo ensi ng’abalenzi bwe bakasuka emipiira, oba bwe bagigoba n’ekigere. Amaanyi gano asobola okugampa. Mukama bw’andagira okuggyawo olusozi Alupe nsobola okukikola mu linnya lye. Luyinza okuba olusozi olunene, naye ne mu maaso g’obunafu bwange lulifuuka olusenyi; kubanga Mukama y’akyogedde. Kiki kye nnyinza okutya nga Katonda ali ku ludda lwange? Novemba 26 OKUKYUSA OKW’OMU GGULU "okunakuwala kwammwe kulifuuka essanyu" Yokaana 16:20 Okunakuwala kwabwe okw’enjawulo kwe kufa n’obutabaawo bwa Mukama waabwe, era kwafuuka essanyu bwe yazuukira mu bafu n’aweeyolekera wakati mu bo. Okunakuwala kwonna okw’abatukuvu bwe kutyo bwe kulikyusibwa; ne kwe kusinga obubi, okulabika ng’okuteekwa okusigala ennyo nga nsulo z’obukaawu emirembe gyonna. Kale okunakuwala gye kweyongera, essanyu gye lyeyongera. Bwe tuba n’emigugu gy’ennaku, olwo amaanyi ga Mukama galigifuula ttani z’essanyu. Kale ekizibu gye kyeyongera obukaawu, essanyu gye lyeyongera obuwoomu: ekyuma ekiwuuba bwe kiwuuba nnyo ku ludda olwa kkono, kirisembeza okusingako ku ludda olwa ddyo. Okujjukira ennaku kulyongera ku kawoowo k’essanyu: tuliraga ekimu nga tukigeraageranya n’ekirala, era okumasamasa kwa daayimondi kulirabika bulungi olw’ekintu ekiddugavu ekiri emabega waayo. Jjangu, ggwe omutima gwange, sanyuka! Mu bbanga ttono nnaaba omusanyufu nga bwe ndi kaakano omunakuwavu. Yesu aŋŋamba nti mu kukyusa okw’omu ggulu okunakuwala kwange kulifuuka essanyu. Siraba ngeri gye kirituukirira, naye nkikkiriza, era ntandika okuyimba nga nkisuubira. Okwennyamira kuno okw’omwoyo si kwa bbanga ddene, mangu ago nnaabeera mu abo abasanyufu abatendereza Mukama emisana n’ekiro, era eyo gye nnaayimbira ku kusaasira okwamponya mu kubonaabona okunene. Novemba 27 OKUWUMMULA MU MATAMBULA GO GONNA "Mukama n’addamu nti, Nnaagendanga naawe, era nnaakuwummuzanga" Okuva 33:14 Kisuubizo kya muwendo! Mukama, ompe amaanyi okukyefunira nga kyange kyonna. Waliwo ebiseera lwe tuteekwa okuva mu maka gaffe, kubanga wano tetulina kibuga kya lubeerera. Kitera okubaawo nti bwe tusinga okuwulira nga tuli awaka mu kifo, amangwago tuyitibwa okukivaamu. Wano we wali eddagala eriwonya obulwadde buno. Mukama yennyini y’anaabeeranga naffe. Okubeerawo kwe, okuli okuganja kwe, obumu bwe, okulabirira kwe, n’obuyinza bwe, kunaabeeranga naffe bulijjo mu buli lugendo lwaffe. Kino kitegeeza ebisingako ennyo ku by’ekyogera; kubanga, mu mazima, kitegeeza ebintu byonna. Bwe tuba ne Katonda ng’ali naffe, tuba tufunye Eggulu n’ensi. Genda nange, Mukama, olwo ondagire gy’oyagala yonna! Naye tusuubira okufuna ekifo eky’okuwummuliramu. Ekyawandiikibwa kikisuubiza. Tugenda kufuna okuwummula Katonda kwennyini kw’awa, kw’akola, era kw’akuuma. Okubeerawo kwe kunaatuwummuza ne bwe tuba nga tuli mu lugendo, weewaawo, ne wakati mu lutalo. Okuwummula! Kigambo eky’omukisa emirundi esatu. Abantu abafa kiyinzika okukyeyagalira? Yee, ekisuubizo kiriwo, era olw’okukkiriza tukyegayirira. Okuwummula kuva eri Omubudaabudi, eri Omulangira ow’Emirembe, era eri Kitaffe ow’ekitiibwa eyawummula ku lunaku olw’omusanvu okuva ku mirimu gye gyonna. Okubeera ne Katonda kwe kuwummula mu ngeri esingayo obulungi. Novemba 28 OKUKOLA EKYO KATONDA KY’ASOBOLA OKUWA OMUKISA "Mukama anaawanga amawanika go omukisa, ne buli ky’onookwatangako engalo zo okukikola anaakiwanga omukisa" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 28:8 Bwe tugondera Mukama Katonda waffe anaawa omukisa ku ekyo ky’atuwa. Obugagga si kikolimo bwe buweebwa omukisa Mukama. Abantu bwe baba n’ebisukka ku ebyo bye beetaaga mu kaseera ako, ne batandika okuterekera mu mawanika, obuvundu obw’omululu oba ekikuubiro eky’omutima omukakanyavu kitera okugoberera okukuŋŋaanya; naye n’omukisa gwa Katonda si bwe kiri. Amagezi galongoosa okutereka, obugabi buluuŋŋamya okusaasaanya, okwebaza kukuuma okwewaayo, n’ettendo liwoomya okwesanyusa. Kya kisa kinene okuba n’omukisa gwa Katonda mu ttereka ery’ekyuma, ne ku akawunti y’omuntu ey’ebbanka. Nga twaweebwa ekyengera kinene mu kigambo ekisembayo! "buli ky’onookwatangako engalo zo okukikola anaakiwanga omukisa." Tetwandissizza mukono gwaffe ku kintu kyonna kye tutayinza kusabira mukisa gwa Katonda, so tetwandikikoze awatali kusaba na kukkiriza. Naye nga kya nkizo okusobola okunoonya obuyambi bwa Mukama mu buli mulimu! Abamu boogera ku muntu ow’omukisa: omukisa gwa Mukama gusinga omukisa ogw’akabi. Okukuumibwa ab’ekitiibwa si kantu bwe kigeraageranyizibwa n’ekisa kya Katonda. Okwesiga wekka kirungi nnyo; naye omukisa gwa Mukama gusukkiridde nnyo ebibala byonna eby’obukugu, oba obwenkulu, oba amagezi. Novemba 29 OKUMANYA OKULINDIRIRA "oyo alyesiga taliterebuka" Isaaya 28:16 Anaayanguyirizanga okukuuma ebiragiro bya Mukama; naye taayanguyirizenga mu ngeri yonna ey’obutagumiikiriza oba etatuufu. Taayanguyirizenga kudduka, kubanga taawangulwenga entiisa ereeta okwekanga. Abalala bwe baba badduka eno n’eri ng’amagezi gaabwe gabaweddemu, omukkiriza anaabeeranga muteefu, mukkakkamu, era ateeberezza, era bw’atyo anaasobolanga okukola n’amagezi mu ssaawa ey’okugezesebwa. Taayanguyirizenga mu bye asuubira, ng’ayaayaanira ebirungi bye mu kaseera kamu era awo wennyini; wabula anaalindiriranga ekiseera kya Katonda. Abamu banguwa nnyo okuba n’ekinyonyi mu ngalo; kubanga balowooza ekisuubizo kya Mukama okuba ng’ekinyonyi ekiri mu kisaka, ekitalabika kuba kyabwe. Abakkiriza bamanyi okulindirira. Taayanguyirizenga ng’abbira mu bikolwa ebikyamu oba ebibuusibwabuusibwa. Obutakkiriza buteekwa okuba nga bukola ekintu, era bwe butyo bwereetera okuzikirira; naye okukkiriza tekwanguyiriza kusukka ku mbiro ennungi, era bwe kutyo tekuwalirizibwa kudda nnyuma nga kunakuwadde mu kkubo lye kwagoberera awatali kwegendereza. Nze mbeera ntya? Nkkiriza, era noolwekyo ntambula mu lugendo lw’omukkiriza, lwe kutambula ne Katonda? Teeka emirembe, ggwe omwoyo ogutebenkeddwa! Ayi, wummulira mu Mukama, era mulindirire n’obugumiikiriza! Ggwe omutima, laba nga kino okikola kaakano! Novemba 30 KATONDA ALI MU MAASO G’OLUTALO "Mukama Katonda yennyini y’ajjanga okukukulemberanga. Anaabanga naawe bulijjo, taakulekenga so taakwabulirenga. Totya so totekemuka" Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 31:8 Mu maaso g’omulimu omunene oba olutalo olunene, wano waliwo ekyawandiikibwa ekitusaanidde okutuyamba okwesiba ebyokulwanyisa byaffe. Bwe kiba nti Yakuwa yennyini atukulembera, kiba kya bukuumi okumugoberera. Ani ayinza okuziyiza okugenda kwaffe mu maaso singa Mukama yennyini y’ali mu mase? Mujje, mmwe abaserikale bannaffe, tugende mu maaso mangu! Lwaki tuteebwatteebwa okulaga eri obuwanguzi? So si nti Mukama ali mu maaso gaffe gokka; ali naffe. Waggulu, wansi, okwetooloola, ne munda ali Oyo Ayinzabyonna era abeera wonna. Mu biseera byonna, ne mu mirembe gyonna, anaabeeranga naffe nga bw’abadde bulijjo. Kino nga bwe kyandinywezezza omukono gwaffe! Mukirumbe n’obuvumu, mmwe abaserikale b’omusaalaba, kubanga Mukama ow’Eggye ali naffe! Nga ali mu maaso gaffe era ng’ali naffe, taajjulukukenga buyambi bwe. Tayinza kulemererwa mu ye yennyini, so taatulemererwenga. Anaayongeranga okutuyamba ng’obwetaavu bwaffe bwe buli, okutuusa ku nkomerero. Nga bw’atayinza kutulemererwa, bw’atyo taatulekenga. Bulijjo anaabanga asobola era ayagala okutuwa amaanyi n’obuyambi okutuusa ennaku ez’okulwana lwe zinaggwaawo. Tuleme kutya so tuleme kutekemuka; kubanga Mukama ow’Eggye anaaserengeta mu lutalo naffe, anaatwalira omugugu gw’olutalo, era anaatuwa obuwanguzi.

fields.title: Omwezi gwa Desemba
fields.body_html:
Desemba 1

ENGERI Y’OKUTAMBULA EY’AMAZIMA

"Atambulira mu bwesimbu y’atambula emirembe" Engero 10:9

Okutambula kwe kuyinza okuba okw’empola, naye kwa kakafu. Oyo ayanguyiriza okugaggawala taabeere mutuukirivu wadde ow’obukakafu; naye okunyiikira n’obwesimbu, ne bwe kutaaleeta bugagga, mazima kulireeta emirembe. Bwe tukola ekituufu era eky’ensonga, tuba ng’omuntu atambulira ku lwazi, kubanga tulina obwesige nti buli kigere kye tuteeka kibeera ku ttaka eggumu era eddamu. Ku luuyi olulala, obuwanguzi obusingira ddala obungi obuvudde mu nkola ez’enkwe bulina okubeeranga obw’obwereere era obutaliimu bwesigwa, era omuntu abufunye ateekwa okutyanga bulijjo nti walijja olunaku olw’okubuuzibwa, olwo amagoba ge ne gamusalira omusango.

Ka tunywerere ku mazima n’obutuukirivu. Olw’ekisa kya Katonda, ka tukoppe Mukama waffe era Omuyigiriza waffe, ataali na bukuusa mu kamwa ke n’akatono. Tuteetyanga kuba baavu, wadde okunyoomebwa. Tetuukolanga, ku nsonga yonna, ekyo emmeeme yaffe ky’etayinza kukkiriza. Bwe tufiirwa emirembe egy’omunda, tufiirwa ekisinga ekyo obugagga bye buyinza okugula. Bwe tunywerera mu kkubo lya Mukama, ne tutayonoona ku mmeeme yaffe, ekkubo lyaffe liba lya kakafu eri buli alwana naffe. Ani ayinza okutukola akabi bwe tuba abagoberezi b’ekirungi? Tuyinza okulowoozebwa okuba abasirusiru abasirusiru bwe tunywerera mu bwesimbu bwaffe; naye mu kifo omusango we gusalirwa awatali kusobya, tuliweebwa ekitiibwa.

Desemba 2

EKYOKULABIRAKO KYAFFE EKISINGA OBUTUKUVU

"Nkulembeza Mukama buli kiseera, era ali ku mukono gwange ogwa ddyo, siinyeenyezebwenga" Zabbuli 16:8

Eno y’engeri ey’okubeeramu obulamu. Nga Katonda ali mu maaso gaffe bulijjo, tujja kuba n’omukwano ogusinga ekitiibwa, n’ekyokulabirako ekisinga obutukuvu, n’essanyu ery’okubudaabudibwa erisinga obuwoomi, n’obuyinza obusinga amaanyi. Kino kiteekwa okuba ekikolwa eky’obumalirivu bw’omutima. "Nkulembeza," era kiteekwa okunywezebwa nga ekintu ekigereke era ekinywevu. Okubeeranga n’eriiso ku liiso lya Mukama, n’okutu ku ddoboozi lya Mukama -- eno ye mbeera entuufu ey’omuntu atya Katonda. Katonda we ali kumpi naye, ng’ajjuza wonna w’atunula, ng’amukulembera mu kkubo ery’obulamu bwe, era ng’amuwa omulamwa gw’okufumiitiriza kwe. Bino eby’obutaliimu ki bye twandyewaliddeko, ebibi ki bye twandiwangudde, empisa ki ennungi ze twandiragidde, essanyu ki lye twandifunye singa ddala twateeka Mukama mu maaso gaffe bulijjo! Lwaki nedda?

Eno y’engeri ey’okubeera mu bukuumi. Nga Mukama abeera bulijjo mu birowoozo byaffe, tutuuka okuwulira obukuumi n’obukakafu olw’okuba ali kumpi bw’atyo. Ali ku mukono gwaffe ogwa ddyo okutuluŋŋamya n’okutubeera; era bwe kityo tetunyeenyezebwa kutya, wadde amaanyi, wadde obukuusa, wadde obutali bunywevu. Katonda bw’ayimirira ku mukono gw’omuntu ogwa ddyo, omuntu oyo yennyini aba wa kakafu okuyimirira. Kale, mujje, mmwe abalabe b’amazima! Munfubutukireko ng’omuyaga ogw’amaanyi, bwe muba muyagala. Katonda ampanirira. Katonda abeera nange. Ani gwe nnaatya?

Desemba 3

EMIREMBE MU BULABE BWONNA

"Ndikola endagaano yange ezisuubiza emirembe, era ndigoba mu nsi ensolo enkambwe, zibeerenga mu ddungu era zeebakenga mu bibira mirembe nga tezirumbibwa" Ezeekyeri 34:25

Kya kisa kya waggulu ennyo nti Yakuwa abeere mu ndagaano n’omuntu, ekitonde ekinafu, ekyonoonyi era ekifa. Naye Mukama yeeyunze mu ndagaano ey’obwesigwa n’effe mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa, era endagaano eyo taagiveeko n’akatono. Olw’endagaano eno tuli mu bukuumi. Ng’empologoma n’emisege bwe bigobebwa abasumba, bwe bityo n’ebintu byonna ebyonoonyi bijja kugobebwawo. Mukama alituwa okuwummula okuva eri abo abateganya n’abazikiriza; ensolo embi zirivaawo mu nsi. Ayi Mukama, tuukiriza ekisuubizo kyo kino ne kaakano!

Abantu ba Mukama basaanira okusanyukira obukuumi mu bifo ebisinga okubeera mu bulabe: amalungu n’ebibira bijja kubeera ng’omuddo n’ebisibo eri ekisibo kya Kristo. Mukama bw’atakyusa kifo ne kiba ekirungi, ajja kutufuula abalungi mu kifo omwo. Eddungu si kifo kya kubeeramu, naye Mukama ayinza okulifuula ekifo eky’okubeeramu; mu bibira omuntu awulira ng’ateekwa okutunula obutali kwebaka, kyokka Mukama awa gw’ayagala otulo n’eyo. Tewali kintu kya kungulu wadde eky’omunda ekisaanira kuleetera mwana wa Katonda kutya. Olw’okukkiriza, eddungu liyinza okufuuka enkalu z’Eggulu, n’ebibira ne bifuuka omuryango gw’ekitiibwa.

Desemba 4

OKUBIKKIBWA N’OKUKUUMIBWA

"Alikubikka n’ebyoya bye, era mu biwaawaatiro bye mw’onoddukiranga; obwesigwa bwe bunaabanga ngabo yo okukukuumanga" Zabbuli 91:4

Olugero olw’okwetoowaza olw’ekitalo ddala! Nga enkoko bw’ekuuma obwana bwayo n’ebuganya okwekweka wansi w’ebiwaawaatiro byayo, bw’atyo Mukama bw’alirwanirira abantu be, n’abaganya okwekweka mu ye. Tetulaba obwana obw’enkoko obutono nga bulingiza okuva wansi w’ebyoya bya nnyina waabwo? Tetuwulira kaaba kaabwo akatono ak’essanyu eryamatira? Mu ngeri eno ka twekweke mu Katonda waffe, era tuwulire emirembe egyamatira olw’okumanya nti atukuuma.

Mukama bw’atubikka, twesiga. Kyandibadde kya kitalo singa tetwesiga. Tuyinza tutya obutesiga, ng’ate Yakuwa yennyini afuuka nnyumba n’awaka, obuddukiro n’okuwummula gye tuli?

Kino nga kikoleddwa, tufuluma okulwana mu linnya lye era tusanyukira obulabirizi bwe bumu obw’okukuuma. Twetaaga engabo n’engabo entono, era bwe twesiga Katonda awatali kubuusabuusa, nga akaana bwe keesiga enkoko, tulaba ng’amazima ge gatwambaza okuva ku mutwe okutuuka ku bigere. Mukama tayinza kulimba; ateekwa okuba omwesigwa eri abantu be; ekisuubizo kye kiteekwa okunywera. Amazima gano aga kakafu ge ngabo yonna gye twetaaga. Emabega waago tuwakanya obusaale obw’omuliro obw’omulabe.

Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, weekweke wansi w’ebiwaawaatiro ebyo ebinene, weebulire mu byoya ebyo ebigonvu! Nga oli wa ssanyu!

Desemba 5

EBIFO EBYA WAGGULU EBY’OKWEKUUMA

"ye muntu alituula waggulu mu bifo ebya waggulu, n’obuddukiro bwe buliba ebigo eby’omu nsozi. Aliweebwa emmere, n’amazzi tegalimuggwaako" Isaaya 33:16

Omuntu Katonda gw’awadde ekisa okuba n’obulamu obutaliiko kya kunenyezebwa abeera mu bukuumi obutuukiridde.

Abeera waggulu, okusukka ensi, ewala n’essasi ly’omulabe, era kumpi n’Eggulu. Alina ebigendererwa n’ensonga ezisukkulumu, era afuna okusanyusibwa n’omukwano ebya waggulu. Asanyukira mu nsozi ez’okwagala okutaggwaawo, gy’alina ekifo kye eky’okubeeramu.

Akuumibwa ebigo eby’olwazi olw’ekitalo. Ebintu ebisinga obunywevu mu nsi yonna bye bisuubizo n’ebigendererwa bya Katonda atakyukakyuka, era bino bye bukuumi bw’omukkiriza omuwulize.

Aweebwa olw’ekisuubizo kino ekikulu, "Aliweebwa emmere." Ng’omulabe bw’atayinza kulinnya kigo, wadde okumenya bbugwe, bwe kityo ekigo tekiyinza kuwambibwa lwa kuzingizibwa na njala. Mukama, eyatonnyesa maanu mu ddungu, alikuuma abantu be nga balina eby’okulya ebimala ne bwe baba bazingiziddwa abo abaagala okubasaanyaawo n’enjala.

Naye singa amazzi gaggwaawo? Ekyo tekiyinza kubaawo, "amazzi tegalimuggwaako." Waliwo oluzzi olutaggwaawo munda mu kigo ekitawangulwa. Mukama alaba nga tewali kibulako. Tewali ayinza kukwatako mutuuze wa Sayuuni ow’amazima. Omulabe ka abe omukambwe atya, Mukama alikuuma abalonde be.

Desemba 6

"OKUYITAMU" SO SI OKUSAANYIZIBWAWO

"Bw’onooyitanga mu mazzi amawanvu nnaabeeranga naawe, ne bw’onooyitanga mu migga tegirikusaanyaawo; bw’onooyitanga mu muliro tegukwokyenga, ennimi z’omuliro tezirikwokya" Isaaya 43:2

Tewali ttatto: kitugwanidde okuyita mu mazzi, n’okuwulira okufubutuka kw’emigga. Okubeerawo kwa Katonda mu mataba kusinga eryato ery’okusomokera. Kitugwanidde okugezesebwa, naye tuliwangula; kubanga Yakuwa yennyini, asinga amaanyi amazzi amangi, alibeera naffe. Ne bw’ayinza okuba ewala n’abantu be mu biseera ebirala, Mukama mazima alibeera nabo mu buzibu ne mu kabi. Ennaku ez’obulamu ziyinza okwewanika waggulu ennyo, naye Mukama akwatagana na buli mbeera.

Abalabe ba Katonda basobola okututeekera mu kkubo akabi ke beekoledde bo, kwe kuyigganyizibwa n’okuduulirwa okukambwe, ebiri ng’ekikoomi ekyaka omuliro. Kale kiki? Tulyita mu miliro. Nga Katonda ali naffe, tetulyokebwa; weewaawo, n’akawoowo k’omuliro tekalisigala ku ffe.

Ayi, obukuumi obw’ekyewuunyo obw’omutambuze eyazaalirwa mu ggulu era alaga mu ggulu! Amataba tegayinza kumuzikiza, wadde emiliro okumwokya. Okubeerawo kwo, Ayi Mukama, kwe kukuuma abatukuvu bo okuva mu kabi ak’enjawulo ak’oluguudo. Laba, mu kukkiriza neewaayo gy’oli, era omwoyo gwange guyingira mu kuwummula.

Desemba 7

EKIRABO EKY’AMAANYI; EMIREMBE OKUWA OMUKISA

"Mukama awa abantu be amaanyi; Mukama awa abantu be emirembe" Zabbuli 29:11

Dawudi yali yakawulira eddoboozi lya Mukama mu kibuyaga eky’okubwatuka, era yali alabye amaanyi ge mu muyaga omukambwe ogw’ekkubo lye yali annyonnyodde; ne kaakano, mu kutebenkera okuwewuka oluvannyuma lw’omuyaga, amaanyi ago agasukkiridde Eggulu n’ensi bye ganyeenya gasuubizibwa okuba amaanyi g’abalonde. Oyo awa obusaale bwe ebiwaawaatiro obutakyama, aliwa abanunule ebiwaawaatiro ng’eby’empungu; oyo anyeenya ensi n’eddoboozi lye alitiisatiisa abalabe b’abatukuvu be, n’awa abaana be emirembe. Lwaki tunafuwa ate nga tulina amaanyi aga Katonda ge tuyinza okuddukira? Lwaki tweraliikirira ate nga emirembe gya Mukama yennyini gyaffe? Yesu, Katonda Ow’amaanyi, ye maanyi gaffe; ka tumwambale tugende mu buweereza bwaffe. Yesu, Mukama waffe eyaweebwa omukisa, era ye mirembe gyaffe; ka tuwummulire mu ye leero, tumalire awo okutya kwaffe. Nga kya mukisa okumufuna okuba amaanyi n’emirembe gyaffe kaakano era emirembe gyonna!

Katonda oyo omu eyeebagala omuyaga mu nnaku ez’ebibuyaga alifuga n’omuyaga omukambwe ogw’okubonaabona kwaffe, n’atuweereza, mu bbanga ttono, ennaku ez’emirembe. Tuliba n’amaanyi ag’okugumira ebibuyaga, n’ennyimba olw’obudde obulungi. Ka tutandike okuyimbira Katonda amaanyi gaffe n’emirembe gyaffe kaakano kaakano. Muveewo, mmwe ebirowoozo ebizikiza! Muyimuke, ggwe okukkiriza n’essuubi!

Desemba 8

OKUGOBERERA KUVAAMU EKITIIBWA

"Oyo ampeereza, angoberere. Nze w’endi n’omuweereza wange w’anaabeeranga era Kitange alimuwa ekitiibwa oyo ampeereza" Yokaana 12:26

Obuweereza obusinga obukulu kwe kukoppa. Bwe mba nga njagala kuba muweereza wa Kristo, nteekwa okuba omugoberezi we. Okukola nga Yesu bwe yakola y’engeri esinga obukakafu ey’okuleeta ekitiibwa eri erinnya lye. Ka nkifeeko buli lunaku.

Bwe nkoppa Yesu nnaabeera naye: bwe mba nga nfaanana naye nnaabeera naye. Mu kiseera ekituufu alintwala waggulu okubeera naye, singa mu kiseera kino mba nfubye okumugoberera wano wansi. Oluvannyuma lw’okubonaabona kwe, Mukama waffe yatuuka ku ntebe ye ey’obwakabaka, era bwe kityo, oluvannyuma lw’okubonaabona naye akaseera wano wansi, naffe tulituuka mu kitiibwa. Enkomerero y’obulamu bwa Mukama waffe eriba nkomerero ya bwaffe: bwe tuba naye mu kutoowazibwa kwe, tuliba naye mu kitiibwa kye. Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, gguma omwoyo, oteeke ebigere byo mu bigere ebirambiddwa omusaayi Mukama wo by’akulekedde.

Nneme kwerabira nti Kitaffe alissaamu ekitiibwa abo abagoberera Omwana we. Bw’andaba nga ndi mwesigwa eri Yesu alintekako obubonero obw’ekisa n’ekitiibwa ku lwa Mwana we. Tewali kitiibwa kiyinza kuba nga kino. Abalangira n’abakabaka abakulu bawa bisiikirize byokka eby’ekitiibwa; ekintu ekituufu eky’ekitiibwa kiva eri Kitaffe. Kyekivudde, ggwe emmeeme yange, nywerera ku Mukama wo Yesu ennyo okusinga bulijjo.

Desemba 9

"BULI KIMU" EKY’OKUKKIRIZA

"Yesu n’amuddamu nti, Obanga osobola! Buli kimu kisoboka eri oyo akkiriza" Makko 9:23

Obutakkiriza bwaffe kye kiziyiza ekisinga obunene mu kkubo lyaffe; mazima ddala, tewali kizibu kirala kya nnamaddala ku by’okukula n’okukulaakulana kwaffe okw’omwoyo. Mukama ayinza okukola buli kimu; naye bw’ateeka etteeka nti ng’okukkiriza kwaffe bwe kuli bwe kityo bwe kiruba gye tuli, obutakkiriza bwaffe busiba emikono gy’Oyo Ayinzabyonna.

Weewaawo, enkolagana ez’ekibi zirisaasaanyizibwa singa tusobola okukkiriza. Amazima aganyoomebwa galiyimusa omutwe gwago singa tuba n’obwesige mu Katonda ow’amazima. Tusobola okwetikka omugugu gwaffe ogw’obuzibu, oba okuyita mu mayengo ag’ennaku nga tetulumizibwa, singa tusobola okwesiba mu kiwato n’olukoba lw’emirembe, olukoba luli olusibibwa n’emikono egy’obwesige.

Kiki kye tutayinza kukkiriza? Buli kimu kisoboka okuggyako okukkiriza Katonda? Kyokka bulijjo wa mazima; lwaki tetumukkiriza? Bulijjo mwesigwa eri ekigambo kye; lwaki tetuyinza kumwesiga? Bwe tuba mu mbeera y’omutima entuufu, okukkiriza tekutwetaagisa maanyi: mu kiseera ekyo kituba kya buzaaliranwa gye tuli okwesiga Katonda ng’omwana bw’eyesiga kitaawe.

Ekisinga obubi kiri nti, tusobola okukkiriza Katonda ku buli kintu okuggyako okugezesebwa okw’ekiseera kino okutunyiga. Kino busirusiru. Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, kunkumula ekibi ekifaanana bwe kityo, weesigire Katonda wo omugugu, omulimu, n’okwegomba okw’ekiseera kino. Kino nga kikoleddwa, byonna nga bikoleddwa.

Desemba 10

KATONDA YE MUNNAFFE MU LUTALO

"Naye bw’onoowulirizanga eddoboozi lye, n’okola nga bwe ŋŋamba, kale nnaakyawanga abakukyawa, n’abalabe bo banaabanga balabe bange." Okuva 23:22

Mukama Kristo ng’ali wakati mu bantu be asaanira okukkirizibwa n’okugonderwa. Ye mumyuka wa Katonda, era ayogera mu linnya lya Kitaawe, era kitugwanira okukola nga bw’alagira awatali kubuusabuusa era mangwago. Tujja kufiirwa ekisuubizo bwe tunaanyooma ekiragiro.

Nga omukisa munene ku okugondera okutuukiridde! Mukama akola endagaano n’abantu be, ey’okulumba n’ey’okwerwanako. Anaawanga omukisa abo abatuwa omukisa, n’akolimira abo abatukolimira. Katonda anaatambulanga n’abantu be n’omutima gwe gwonna n’emmeeme ye yonna, era anaabeeranga mu mbeera yaabwe n’okusaasira okungi. Nga buno bukuumi bwe butuwa! Tetwetaaga kweraliikirira olw’abalabe baffe, nga tukakasiddwa nti bafuuse abalabe ba Katonda. Yakuwa bw’aba yeetutte olutalo lwaffe, tuyinza okuleka abalabe mu mikono gye.

Bwe kituuka ku byetuvaamu ffe ffennyini, tetulina balabe; naye olw’ensonga ey’amazima n’obutuukirivu tukwata ebyokulwanyisa ne tugenda mu lutalo. Mu lutalo luno olutukuvu twegasse ne Katonda Ataggwaawo, era bwe tugondera n’obwegendereza etteeka lya Mukama waffe Yesu, yeewaddeyo okukozesa amaanyi ge gonna ku lwaffe. Kyetuva tutatya muntu n’omu.

Desemba 11

WEESIGA OKOLE; KOLA OWEESIGE

"Weesigenga Mukama okolenga bulungi, onoobeeranga n’emirembe mu nsi n’ofuna ebirungi." Zabbuli 37:3

Weesiga ne kola bigambo ebitabagana bulungi, mu ntegeka Omwoyo Omutukuvu gye yabissaamu. Tusaanidde okuba n’okukkiriza, era okukkiriza okwo kusaanidde okukola. Okwesiga Katonda kututeeka ku bikolwa ebitukuvu: twesiga Katonda tufune ebirungi, ne tulyoka tukola obulungi. Tetutuula busizze olw’okuba nga twesiga, wabula twegumya, ne tusuubira Mukama okukolera mu ffe ne ku lwaffe. Si kya ffe kweraliikirira na kukola bubi, wabula kwesiga na kukola bulungi. Tetwesiga awatali kukola, so tetukola awatali kwesiga.

Abalabe baffe bandyagadde okutusimbula, singa baali basobola; naye olw’okwesiga n’okukola tubeera mu nsi. Tetugenda kudda mu Misiri, wabula tunaasigala mu nsi ya Emmanweri -- obulabirizi bwa Katonda, Kanani ow’okwagala okw’endagaano. Tetuyinza kumalibwawo mangu nga abalabe ba Mukama bwe balowooza. Tebasobola kutusindiikiriza bweru, wadde okututta: Katonda gy’atuwadde erinnya n’ekifo, awo we tubeera.

Naye tugambe ki ku by’okuliisa kwaffe kwe twetaaga? Mukama assizza ekigambo "mazima ddala" mu kisuubizo kino. Nga Katonda bw’ali ow’amazima, bw’atyo bwe kiri nti abantu be banaaliisibwanga. Kya bo okwesiga n’okukola, era kya Mukama okukola ng’okwesiga kwabwe bwe kuli. Bwe bataaliisibwe bannamuŋoona, oba okuliisibwa Obadiya, oba okuliisibwa nnamwandu, kyokka banaaliisibwanga mu ngeri emu. Muveewo, mmwe entiisa!

Desemba 12

OMUTIMA OMUTEEFU

"Mu kusiriikirira ne mu kwesiga mwe muli amaanyi gammwe" Isaaya 30:15

Bulijjo bunafu okweraliikirira n’okweraliikiriza, okubuusabuusa n’obutakkiriza. Kiki kye tusobola okukola bwe tumalamu amaanyi gaffe ne tusigala magumba mwereere? Tulina kye tuganyulwa olw’okutya n’okunyiiga? Tetwefuula abatasobola kukola, ne tutabula ebirowoozo byaffe okusalawo n’amagezi? Tubbira mu kulwana kwaffe so nga twandiseeyeeyereddemu olw’okukkiriza.

Ayi, singa tuweebwa ekisa okusirika! Lwaki tudduka okuva mu nnyumba okudda mu nnyumba nga tuddiŋŋana olugero olukooya olweyongera okutulwaza omutima nga bwe tulugera? Lwaki n’okusigala eka ne tukaaba mu nnaku olw’okuteebereza okubi okuyinza obutatuukirira n’akatono? Kirungi okukuuma olulimi olusirise, naye kyandisinze obulungi singa tubadde n’omutima ogusirise. Ayi, okusirika ne tumanya nti Yakuwa ye Katonda!

Ayi, singa tuweebwa ekisa okwesiga Katonda! Omutukuvu wa Isirayiri ateekwa okulwanirira n’okununula ababe. Tayinza kudda nnyuma ku bigambo bye eby’amazima. Tuyinza okukakasa nti buli kigambo kye kinaanywera newaakubadde ng’ensozi zeggyeewo. Asaanira okwesigibwa; era singa twoleka okwesiga n’obusirifu obuvaamu, twandibadde basanyufu ng’emyoyo egiri mu maaso g’entebe ey’obwakabaka.

Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, ddayo mu kiwummulo kyo, oteeke omutwe gwo ku kifuba kya Mukama Yesu.

Desemba 13

AKAWUNGEEZI KAFUUKA OMUSANA

"Obudde bwe buliwungeera walibaawo ekitangaala." Zekkaliya 14:7

Kya kwewuunya nti kiba bwe kityo; kubanga ebintu byonna bitiisa nti obudde bwe buliwungeera waliba ekizikiza. Katonda ayagala okukola mu ngeri esukkirira ennyo okutya kwaffe n’esukka essuubi lyaffe, ne tuwuniikirira nnyo, ne tuleetebwa okutendereza ekisa kye eky’obwakabaka. Nedda, tekiribeera gye tuli nga emitima gyaffe bwe giragula: ekizikiza tekiryeyongera kutuuka mu ttumbi, wabula amangwago buliyakaayakana ne bufuuka omusana. Tuleme kuggwaamu ssuubi n’akatono. Mu biseera ebisinga obubi ka twesige Mukama afuula ekizikiza eky’ekisiikirize eky’okufa okuba enkya. Amatoffaali bwe gaakubisibwa emirundi ebiri, Musa n’alabika, era ennaku bwe zeeyongera kwe kuba nga ziri kumpi n’okukoma.

Ekisuubizo kino kisaanidde okuyamba obugumiikiriza bwaffe. Ekitangaala kiyinza obutajja mu bujjuvu okutuusa essuubi lyaffe nga liweddewo olw’okulinda olunaku lwonna awatali kigendererwa. Eri ababi enjuba egwa nga bukyali misana: eri abatuukirivu enjuba evaayo nga obudde buli kumpi kuziba. Tetuyinza na bugumiikiriza kulindirira kitangaala ekyo eky’omu ggulu, ekiyinza okulwawo okujja, naye nga kya kakafu okwerimbulula nti kisaanira ddala okulindirirwa?

Jjangu, ggwe emmeeme yange, situla olugero lwo oyimbire Oyo anaakuwa omukisa mu bulamu ne mu kufa, mu ngeri esukkuluma byonna obutonde bye bwali bulabyeko ne bwe bubadde mu mbeera yaabwo esinga obulungi.

Desemba 14

TEWALI KYA DDA

"Oyo eyali atudde ku ntebe ey’obwakabaka n’agamba nti, Laba, ebintu byonna mbizzizza buggya." Okubikkulirwa 21:5

Ekitiibwa kibeere eri erinnya lye! Ebintu byonna byetaaga okuzzibwa obuggya, kubanga byonoonese nnyo era bikaddiye olw’ekibi. Kaakati kye kiseera ekyambalo eky’edda okuzingibwa ne kissibwa wa bbali, n’obutonde okwambala ekyambalo kyabwo ekya Ssande. Naye tewali mulala ayinza kuzza bintu byonna buggya okuggyako Mukama eyabikola okusooka; kubanga kyetaagisa amaanyi mangi okukola ekintu okuva mu kibi nga bwe kyetaagisa okukola okuva mu bwereere. Mukama waffe Yesu yeetisse omulimu guno, era asobola bulungi okugutuukiriza. Amaze okutandika omulimu gwe, era okumala ebyasa abadde agumiikiriza mu kuzza obuggya emitima gy’abantu, n’enteekateeka ey’ekibiina ky’abantu. Mu kiseera tejja kuzza buggya enteekateeka yonna ey’obufuzi bw’abantu, era obuntu bw’abantu bulikyusibwa olw’ekisa kye; era waliba olunaku omubiri lwe gulizzibwa obuggya, ne guzuukizibwa okufaanana ng’omubiri gwe ogw’ekitiibwa.

Nga ssanyu ki okuba mu bwakabaka omuli buli kintu ekizzibwa obuggya olw’amaanyi ga Kabaka waakyo! Tetuggwaawo: twanguya okutuuka ku bulamu obw’ekitiibwa okusingawo. Newaakubadde ng’amaanyi g’obubi galwanyisa, Mukama waffe ow’ekitiibwa Yesu atuukiriza ekigendererwa kye, era atufuula ffe, n’ebintu byonna ebitwetoolodde, "biggya," era nga bijjudde obulungi nga bwe byava mu mukono gwa Mukama okusooka.

Desemba 15

EMIREMBE MU NSI YONNA

"era ebitala byabwe balibiwesaamu enkumbi, n’amafumu gaabwe bagaweeseemu ebiwabyo. Eggwanga teririyimusa kitala ku ggwanga linnaalyo, so tebalyetegeka kulwana ntalo nate. Isaaya 2:4

Ayi, singa ebiseera bino eby’essanyu bituuse! Kaakati amawanga geeteeseteese n’ebyokulwanyisa bingi, era gayiiya ebyokulwanyisa ebyeyongera obutiisa, ng’ekigendererwa ekikulu eky’omuntu kyandituukiriziddwa kwokka olw’okuzikiriza obukadde bw’abantu banne. Kyokka emirembe girivaayo olunaku lumu; weewaawo, era girivaayo nnyo n’ebyuma eby’okuzikiriza ne bikubibwa ne bifuuka ebintu ebirala ne bikozesebwa mu bigendererwa ebirungi.

Kino kirituuka kitya? Olw’obusuubuzi? Olw’obugunjufu? Olw’okusalira emisango? Tetukikkiriza. Ebyafaayo ebyayita bitugaana okwesiga eby’obunafu bwe bityo. Emirembe girinywezebwa olw’obufuzi bwa Omulangira ow’Emirembe bwokka. Ateekwa okuyigiriza abantu olw’Omwoyo we, okuzza obuggya emitima gyabwe olw’ekisa kye, n’okubafuga olw’amaanyi ge amasukkulumu, ne balyoka balekeraawo okussa n’okutta. Omuntu afuuka ekisolo eky’entiisa ng’omusaayi gwe gumaze okwaka, era Mukama Yesu yekka y’asobola okufuula empologoma eno okuba omwana gw’endiga. Ng’akyusa omutima gw’omuntu, okwegomba kwe okwennyini omusaayi kuggyibwawo. Buli asoma ekitabo kino eky’ebisuubizo asabe essaala ey’enjawulo leero eri Mukama era Omuwi w’Emirembe, alyoke akomye entalo mangu, era anyweze emirembe mu nsi yonna.

Desemba 16

OKUGOBA OKW’OBWAKATONDA

"Muligobamu Abakanani newaakubadde nga balina amagaali ag’ebyuma era nga baamaanyi." Yoswa 17:18

Kya kuzzaamu amaanyi nnyo eri obuvumu okukakasibwa obuwanguzi, kubanga olwo omuntu agenda mu lutalo n’obwesige, era n’akoona we yanditidde okugenda. Olutalo lwaffe lwa kulwana n’obubi obuli munda yaffe n’obutwetoolodde, era tusaanidde okukakasibwa nti tusobola okuwangula, era nti tunaakikola mu linnya lya Mukama Yesu. Tetugenda mu lutalo okugwa, wabula okuwangula; era tujja kuwangula. Ekisa kya Katonda mu maanyi gaakyo agatakoma kiweebwayo okumegga obubi mu ngeri zonna: kyeriva obuwanguzi bubeera bwa kakafu.

Ebimu ku bibi byaffe biraba amagaali ag’ebyuma mu mbeera yaffe ey’obuzaale, mu mpisa zaffe ez’edda, mu mikwano gyaffe, ne mu mirimu gyaffe. Naye newaakubadde bwe kityo tuteekwa okubiwangula. Bya maanyi nnyo, era gye biri ffe tuli banafu nnyo; kyokka mu linnya lya Katonda tuteekwa okubifuga, era tujja kubifuga. Singa ekibi ekimu kitufuga, tetuli bantu ba Mukama ab’eddembe. Omuntu asibiddwa n’olujegere lumu lwokka akyali musibe. Tewali kugenda mu Ggulu ng’ekibi kimu kitufuga munda yaffe, kubanga eri abatukuvu kigambibwa nti, "Temukkiriza kibi kwongera kubafuga." Situka, kale, otte buli Mukanani, era omenyeemenye buli gaali ery’ebyuma! Mukama ow’Eggye ali naffe, era ani anaaziyiza obuyinza bwe obuzikiriza ekibi?

Desemba 17

ENKOLAGANA ESINGA OKUMPI N’OKWAGALWA

"Bwe tutyo tunaabeeranga ne Mukama waffe ennaku zonna." 1 Basessaloniika 4:17

Nga tukyali wano Mukama ali naffe, era bwe tuyitibwa okuva wano tuba naye. Tewali kwawula mutukuvu ku Mulokozi we. Bali bumu, era bulijjo bateekwa okuba bumu: Yesu tayinza kubeerawo nga talina bantu be, kubanga yandibadde Mutwe ogutalina mubiri. Oba nga tusituliddwa mu bbanga, oba nga tuwummulira mu Paradiso, oba nga tuli batambuze wano, tuli ne Yesu; era ani anaatwawula ku ye?

Nga ssanyu ki lino! Ekitiibwa kyaffe ekisinga, okuwummula, okubudaabudibwa, essanyu, kwe kubeera ne Mukama. Tetuyinza kutebereza kintu kyonna ekiyinza okusinga oba n’okwenkanankana n’enkolagana eno ey’obwakatonda. Olw’enkolagana entukuvu tuteekwa okubeera naye mu kwetoowaza kwe, mu kugaanibwa kwe, ne mu kutegana kwe, ne tulyoka tubeera naye mu kitiibwa kye. Mu bbanga ttono tunaabeera naye mu kuwummula kwe ne mu bwakabaka bwe, mu kusuubira kwe ne mu kwolesebwa kwe. Tunaafuna nga bw’afuna, era tunaawangula nga bw’awangula.

Ayi Mukama wange, obanga nnaabeeranga naawe emirembe gyonna, nnina ebeetuseewo etariiko kyenkanankana. Sirikwatirwa buggya malayika omukulu. Okubeera ne Mukama emirembe gyonna kye kirowoozo kyange ku Ggulu mu bulungi bwakyo obusinga. Si nnanga eza zaabu, wadde engule ezitakaddiwa, wadde ekitangaala ekitaliiko bire, bye kitiibwa gye ndi; wabula Yesu, Yesu yennyini, nga nange ndi naye emirembe gyonna mu nkolagana esinga okumpi n’okwagalwa.

Desemba 18

OKULWANIRIRWA N’OKUSAANIKIRWA

"Ng’ebinyonyi bwe bibuukira waggulu, bw’atyo Mukama Katonda ow’Eggye bw’alisaanikira Yerusaalemi." Isaaya 31:5

N’ekiwaawaatiro ekyanguwa ennyonyi ennyina yanguwa okudda okukuuma abaana baayo. Tefeerezaawo budde ku kkubo ng’ejja okubaleetera emmere, oba okubakuuma eri akabi. Bw’atyo ng’ali ku biwaawaatiro by’empungu Mukama bw’alijja okulwanirira abalonde be; weewaawo, alyebagala ku biwaawaatiro by’empewo.

N’ekiwaawaatiro ekyanjuluze ennyina abikka abaana baayo abato mu kisu. Abakweka ng’ateeka omubiri gwe wakati. Enkoko ewa obwana bwayo obbugumu bwayo, n’efuula ebiwaawaatiro byayo enju, mwe bibeerera eka. Bw’atyo Yakuwa yennyini bw’afuuka obukuumi bw’abalonde be. Ye kennyini kye kiddukiro kyabwe, ekifo kyabwe eky’okubeeramu, era bye byonna byabwe.

Ng’ebinyonyi ebibuuka, n’ebinyonyi ebisaanikira (kubanga ekigambo kitegeeza byombi), bw’atyo Mukama bw’alibeera gye tuli: era kino alikikola emirundi mingi n’obuwanguzi. Tulikuumibwa ne tulwanirirwa okuva mu bubi bwonna: Mukama eyefaananya n’ebinyonyi tagenda kubifaanana mu bunafu bwabyo, kubanga ye Yakuwa ow’Eggye. Kino kibeere kubudaabudibwa kwaffe, nti okwagala okw’amaanyi kunaayanguwa okudduukirira, era kwa kakafu okusaanikira. Ekiwaawaatiro kya Katonda kikola mangu era kya bulungi okusinga ekiwaawaatiro ky’ennyonyi, era tuliteeka obwesige bwaffe wansi w’ekisiikirize kyakyo okuva kaakano n’emirembe gyonna.

Desemba 19

OKUBONAABONA, NAYE TEWALI MAGUMBA GAMENYESE

"Amagumba ge gonna Mukama agakuuma, ne watabaawo na limu limenyeka." Zabbuli 34:20

Ekisuubizo kino, okusinziira ku bigambo ebikyetoolodde, kyogera ku muntu omutuukirivu abonaabona ennyo: "Omuntu omutuukirivu ayinza n’okuba n’ebizibu bingi, naye byonna Mukama abimuyisaamu." Ayinza okufuna ebiwundu ku lususu ne mu mubiri, naye tewali kabi kanene kanaakolebwa, "ne watabaawo na limu limenyeka."

Kuno kubudaabuda kunene eri omwana wa Katonda agezesebbwa, era kubudaabuda kwe nsobola okukkiriza; kubanga okutuusa mu saawa eno sirina kabi ka nnamaddala kanfunye olw’okubonaabona kwange okungi. Sindese kukkiriza, wadde essuubi, wadde okwagala. Nedda, mu kifo ky’okufiirwa amagumba gano ag’empisa, gazzeeko amaanyi n’obunyiikivu. Nnina okumanya okusingako, obumanyirivu obusingako, obugumiikiriza obusingako, n’obunywevu obusingako okusinga bwe nnali nga ebigezo tebinnajja. Wadde essanyu lyange terizikiridde. Emenyeka nnyingi nfunye olw’endwadde, okufiirwa, okwennyamira, okuwaayirizibwa, n’okuziyizibwa; naye ekifo ekyamenyeka kiwonye, era tewabaddewo gumba limenyese kabiri wadde limu ery’angu. Ensonga tekweralikirira. Bwe twesiga Mukama, akuuma amagumba gaffe gonna; era bw’agakuuma, tuyinza okukakasa nti tewali na limu limenyese.

Jjangu, mutima gwange, tonakuwala. Olumwa, naye tewali magumba gamenyese. Gumira obuzibu, era osomooze okutya.

Desemba 20

ABANTU NG’ABANTU; KATONDA NGA KATONDA

"Nze, nze mwene, nze nzuuno abawa amaanyi. Mmwe baani abatya omuntu alifa, n’omwana w’omuntu ali ng’omuddo, ne weerabira Mukama Omutonzi wo eyabamba eggulu, n’ateekawo n’emisingi gy’ensi, ebbanga lyonna ne mubeera mu kutya obusungu bw’abo abakunyigiriza, oyo eyemalidde mu kuzikiriza? Kubanga kale buliruddawa obulabe bw’oyo abanyigiriza?" Isaaya 51:12, 13

Ekyawandiikibwa kino kkennyini kitwalibwe ng’omugabo gwa leero. Tewali kyetaagisa kukyongerako bigambo. Ggwe akankana, kisome, kikkirize, kirye, era okiwoze mu maaso ga Mukama. Oyo gw’otya muntu buntu; ate Oyo akusuubiza okukubudaabuda ye Katonda, Omutonzi wo, era Omutonzi w’eggulu n’ensi. Okubudaabuda okutaliiko kkomo kusinga nnyo okubuutikira akabi akatono ennyo.

"Buliruddawa obulabe bw’oyo abanyigiriza?" Buli mu mukono gwa Mukama. Bwe busungu bw’ekitonde ekifa; busungu obunaakoma amangu ddala omukka nga guggwa mu nnyindo. Kale lwaki twandisse omu ekitiibwa nga naffe bwe tuli ab’obunafu? Tuleme okuswaza Katonda waffe nga tufuula omuntu omunafu katonda. Tuyinza okufuula omuntu ekifaananyi ekisinzibwa nga tumutya okuyitiridde nga bwe tuyinza okumuwa okwagala okuyitiridde. Ka tuyise abantu ng’abantu, ne Katonda nga Katonda; olwo tunaatambula bulungi mu kkubo ery’obuvunaanyizibwa, nga tutya Mukama, nga tetutya n’omu omulala.

Desemba 21

OKUVA MU BUSUNGU OKUDDA MU KWAGALA

"Alikyuka n’atukwatirwa ekisa nate; alirinnyirira ebibi byaffe, n’asuula ebyonoono byaffe byonna mu buziba bw’ennyanja." Mikka 7:19

Katonda tava ku kwagala kwe, naye mangu ddala ava ku busungu bwe. Okwagala kwe eri abalonde be kuli ng’obuzaaliranwa bwe, obusungu bwe buli ng’omulimu gwe gwokka: ayagala kubanga ye kwagala, akaluubirira kubanga kyetaagisa olw’obulungi bwaffe. Alidda mu kifo omutima gwe mwe guwummulira, kwe kugamba, okwagala kwe eri ababe, n’alyoka atusaasira mu nnaku zaffe n’azikomya.

Nga kino kisuubizo kya muwendo -- "Alirinnyirira ebibi byaffe"! Alibiwangula. Byo bikaaba okutufuula abaddu, naye Mukama alituwa obuwanguzi ku byo n’omukono gwe ogwa ddyo. Ng’Abakanani, biriwangulwa, ne biteekebwa mu kikoligo, era ku nkomerero ne bittibwa.

Ate ku musango gw’ebibi byaffe, nga gijjibwawo mu ngeri ey’ekitiibwa! "ebyonoono byaffe byonna," -- weewaawo, ekibinja kyabyo kyonna; "asuula" -- mukono gwa Ayinzabyonna gwokka gwe guyinza okukola ekyamagero bwe kityo; 'mu buziba bw’ennyanja"--Falaawo n’amagaali ge gye baagwa. Si mu mazzi amayifuyifu ebibi byaffe mwe biyinza okuddizibwa amayengo, wabula mu "buziba" mwe binaasuulibwa. Byonna biweddewo. Byasaanawo emmanga ng’ejjinja. Aleruuya! Aleruuya!

Desemba 22

ALIWO KAAKANO DDALA

"Katonda kye kiddukiro kyaffe, era ge maanyi gaffe; omubeezi ddala atabulawo mu kulaba ennaku." Zabbuli 46:1

Obuyambi obutabaawo mu kiseera lwe tubwetaaga tebulina mugaso munene. Ekyuma ekyesigamiza eryato bwe kiba kirekeddwa eka tekigasa muvubi mu kiseera ky’omuyaga; ssente omuntu ze yalinako tezigasa mubanja ng’ekiwandiiko eky’omusango kimuvuddeko. Obuyambi obw’oku nsi butono nnyo obuyinza okuyitibwa "buliwo ddala": kizibu okubufuna, kizibu okubukozesa, era kisingawo okubula bwe bumaze okukozesebwa. Naye ku Mukama Katonda waffe, aliwo bwe tumunoonya, aliwo bwe tumwetaaga, era aliwo ne bwe tumaze okuganyulwa mu buyambi bwe.

Asinga okuba nga "aliwo," ye aliwo ddala. Aliwo okusinga mukwano gwaffe asemberayo, kubanga ali mu ffe mu kulaba ennaku kwaffe; aliwo okusinga ffe bwe tuli eri ffekka, kubanga oluusi tetuba na butebenkevu bwa birowoozo. Bulijjo aliwo, aliwo mu bukuufu, aliwo mu kusaasira, aliwo mu bujjuvu. Aliwo kaakano bwe kino kiba kiseera kya kizikiza. Ka tumwesigamireko. Ye kiddukiro kyaffe, ka twekweke mu ye; ye maanyi gaffe, ka tweyambaze ye; ye mubeezi waffe, ka tumwesigameko; ye mubeezi waffe ddala atabulawo, ka tuwummulire mu ye kaakano. Tetwetaaga kubeera n’okweraliikirira kw’akaseera, wadde okutya kw’akatikitiki. "Mukama ow’Eggye ali naffe, Katonda wa Yakobo kye kigo kyaffe."

Desemba 23

EBINTU EBY’OMUWENDO

"Yayogera bw’ati ku Yusufu: Ettaka lye Mukama Katonda aliwe omukisa, n’omusulo omulungi ennyo ogunaavanga waggulu mu ggulu n’amazzi mu nzizi empanvu mu ttaka wansi," Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 33:13

Tuyinza okuba abagagga mu bintu ng’ebyo Yusufu bye yafuna, era tuyinza okubibeera nabyo mu ngeri esingako. Woowe, singa tufuna "ebintu eby’omuwendo eby’omu ggulu!" Amaanyi wamu ne Katonda, n’okulaga kw’amaanyi agava eri Katonda, bya muwendo nnyo. Twandyagadde okusanyukira emirembe gya Katonda, essanyu lya Mukama, n’ekitiibwa kya Katonda waffe. Omukisa gw’Abantu Abasatu ab’obwakatonda mu kwagala, ne mu kisa, ne mu bumu tugukuza okusinga zaabu esingayo obulungi. Ebintu eby’oku nsi tebiriiko muwendo bwe bigeraageranyizibwa n’ebintu eby’omu Ggulu.

"Omusulo." Nga guno gwa muwendo! Nga tusaba era ne tutendereza, bwe tuba n’omusulo! Okuwewulwa, okukula, akaloosa, n’obulamu bwe biba mu ffe ng’omusulo guliwo! Okusinga ebintu ebirala byonna, nga tuli bimera ebyasimbibwa omukono gwa Mukama ogwa ddyo, twetaaga omusulo gw’Omwoyo we Omutukuvu.

"Amazzi mu nzizi empanvu mu ttaka wansi." Ddala kino kyogera ku nnyanja eri wansi w’ettaka etetulabika egabira ensulo zonna empya eziseeza ensi essanyu. Woowe, okusima ensulo ezitaggwaawo! Kino kirabo ekitayogerekeka; waleme kubaawo mukkiriza awummula okutuusa ng’akifunye. Obumaliriza bwa Yakuwa bwaffe emirembe gyonna. Ka tubudde eri bwo kaakano.

Desemba 24

OKUSOMOKA YOLUDAANI NGA TUYIMBA

"Abalabe bo banaakuvuunamiranga." Ekyamateeka Olwokubiri 33:29

Omulabe oyo omukulu, Setaani, mulimba okuva ku lubereberye; naye asendasenda nnyo, era nga maama Kaawa, tusendebwa okumukkiriza. Naye mu bye tuyitamu tujja kukakasa nti mulimba.

Agamba nti tujja kugwa okuva mu kisa, ne tuswaza okwatula kwaffe, ne tuzikirira ng’abo abaava mu kukkiriza; naye, nga twesiga Mukama Yesu, tujja kunywerera mu kkubo lyaffe ne tukakasa nti Yesu tafiirwa n’omu ku abo Kitaawe be yamuwa. Atugamba nti emmere yaffe ejja kuggwaawo, ne tulumwa enjala n’abaana baffe; naye Aliisa namuŋŋoona tannatwerabira, era talikikola, wabula anaatuteekerateekera emmeeza mu maaso g’abalabe baffe.

Awunyiriza nti Mukama talitununula mu kigezo ekyeyongera okusembera mu wala, era atutiisatiisa nti akatundu akasembayo ke kanaamenya omugongo gw’eŋŋamira. Nga mulimba! Kubanga Mukama talitulekera ddala wadde okutwabulira. "Kale amulokole kaakano!" bw’aleekaana omulyannyi omulimba: naye Mukama alimusirisa ng’ajja okututaasa.

Asanyukira nnyo okutugamba nti okufa kunaatusinga amaanyi. "Onoosobolayo otya mu nsiko y’oku Yoludaani?" Naye n’eyo alijja kutulimbira, era tulisomoka omugga nga tuyimba ennyimba ez’ekitiibwa.

Desemba 25

YAJJA; ERA AJJA

"Yesu oyo abaggiddwako n’atwalibwa mu ggulu, agenda kukomawo mu ngeri y’emu nga bwe mumulabye ng’agenda mu ggulu." Ebikolwa by’Abatume 1:11

Bangi abakuza okujja kwa Mukama waffe okusooka ku lunaku luno; ka tukyuse ebirowoozo byaffe eri ekisuubizo eky’okukomawo kwe omulundi ogw’okubiri. Kuno kwa kakafu nga bwe kwali okujja okusooka, era kuggya obukakafu bwakwo obungi okuva mu kwo. Oyo eyajja ng’omuntu omuwombeefu okuweereza mu butuufu ajja kujja okuggya empeera y’obuweereza bwe. Oyo eyajja okubonaabona talirwa kujja kufuga.

Kuno kwe ssuubi lyaffe ery’ekitiibwa, kubanga tujja kugabana ku ssanyu lye. Leero tuli mu kwekweka n’okutoowazibwa, nga naye bwe yali ng’akyali wano wansi; naye bw’alijja kirituba kulabisibwa kwaffe, nga bwe kiriba okubikkulirwa kwe. Abatukuvu abaafa balibeera balamu ku kulabika kwe. Abaawaayirizibwa n’abanyoomebwa balyaka ng’enjuba mu bwakabaka bwa Kitaabwe. N’olwo abatukuvu balirabika nga bakabaka era nga bakabona, era ennaku ez’okukungubaga kwabwe zirikoma. Okuwummula okuwanvu n’ekitiibwa ekitategeerekeka eky’obufuzi obw’emyaka olukumi biriba mpeera nnyingi olw’emirembe egy’okujulira n’okulwana.

Woowe, singa Mukama ajja! Ajja! Ali mu kkubo era atambula mangu. Eddoboozi ery’okusembera kwe lisaana okuba ng’ennyimba mu mitima gyaffe! Muvuge, mmwe ebide eby’essuubi!

Desemba 26

KATONDA YEKKA GW’OYINZA OKWESIGA

"Peetero n’amuddamu nti, Abalala bonna bwe banaakwabulira, nze sijja kukwabulira." Matayo 26:33

"Naye," omuntu omu bw’aleekaana, "kino si kisuubizo kya Katonda." Weewaawo, naye kyali kisuubizo kya muntu, kyekyava kifuuka bwereere. Peetero yalowooza nti ayogera ekyo ky’anaatuukiriza ddala; naye ekisuubizo ekitalina musingi musingako gw’okumalirira kw’omuntu kirigwa wansi. Amangu ddala ng’okukemebwa kutandise, Peetero yeegaana Mukama we, era n’akozesa ebirayiro okunyweza okwegaana kwe.

Kigambo kya muntu kiki? Nsuwa ya bbumba emenyeka n’ekikonde kimu. Okumalirira kwo ggwe kuki? Kimuli, ekiyinza, olw’okulabirira kwa Katonda, okubala ebibala, naye bwe kirekebwa kyokka, kirigwa wansi n’empewo esooka esesa ettabi.

Ku kigambo kya muntu tuulako ekyo kyokka kye kiyinza okusitula.

Ku kumalirira kwo ggwe teweesigamyeeko n’akatono.

Ku kisuubizo kya Katonda wo tuulako ebiro n’emirembe gyonna, ensi eno n’eri ejja, byonna byo n’ebya bonna abo b’oyagala.

Ekitabo kino kya cheeki eri abakkiriza, era olupapula luno lugendereddwamu okuba okulabula ku bbanka gye baggyaako ssente, n’ani gw’akkiriza omukono gwe. Weesige Yesu awatali kkomo. Teweesiganga wewekka wadde omuntu yenna eyazaalibwa omukazi okusukka ekigero ekituufu; naye weesige Mukama yekka era n’omutima gwo gwonna.

Desemba 27

EKISA KYE N’ENDAGAANO YE

"Kubanga ensozi ziyinza okuvaawo n’obusozi okuggyibwawo naye okwagala kwange okutaggwaawo tekulisagaasagana so n’endagaano yange ey’emirembe teriggyibwawo, bw’ayogera Mukama Katonda akusaasira." Isaaya 54:10

Ekimu ku bintu ebisinga okusanyusa mu kwagala kwa Katonda kwe kubeerawo kwakwo okutaggwaawo. Empagi z’ensi ziyinza okuggyibwa mu bifo byazo, naye ekisa n’endagaano bya Yakuwa waffe ow’ekisa tebivaawo ku bantu be. Emmeeme yange nga esanyufu nnyo mu kukkiriza okunywevu okw’ekigambo kino ekyaluulunkanyizibwa Omwoyo! Omwaka gunaatera okuggwaako, n’emyaka gy’obulamu bwange giri mitono, naye ebiro tebikyusa Mukama wange. Ettaala empya zisikira ez’edda, okukyukakyuka okutaggwaawo kuli ku bintu byonna; naye Mukama waffe wa lumu lwennyini. Amaanyi gavuunika ensozi, naye tewali maanyi gasoboka gayinza kukwatako Katonda ataggwaawo. Tewali kintu mu biseera ebyayita, eby’okaakano, wadde eby’omu maaso ekiyinza okuleetera Yakuwa okuba nga si wa kisa gye ndi.

Ggwe emmeeme yange, wummulira mu kisa kya Mukama ekitaggwaawo, akuyisa ng’ow’oluganda ali kumpi. Jjukira era n’endagaano etaggwaawo. Katonda agijjukira bulijjo -- laba nga naawe ogijjukira. Mu Kristo Yesu Katonda ow’ekitiibwa yeewaddeyo gy’oli okuba Katonda wo, n’okukukwata ng’omu ku bantu be. Ekisa n’endagaano -- fumiitiriza ku bigambo bino ng’ebintu ebya kakafu era ebituula obulamu bwonna, ebyo emirembe gyennyini bye gitalikuggyako.

Desemba 28

OBUKAKAFU OBW’AMAZIMA

"Katonda yagamba nti, Sirikuleka era sirikwabulira n’akatono." Abaebbulaniya 13:5

Emirundi mingi mu Byawandiikibwa Mukama akyogedde. Akiddiŋŋanye emirundi mingi, okunyweza obukakafu bwaffe okwongera okukakasa. Tuleme kubaako kubuusabuusa kwonna ku kino. Ekisuubizo kyennyini kya maanyi mu ngeri ey’enjawulo. Mu Luyonaani kirimu obugaana butaano, buli bumu nga bugaana ddala obusobozi bwa Mukama okuva ku omu ku bantu be, ne kimusobozesa okuwulira nga bw’amazima Katonda we amwabulidde. Ekyawandiikibwa kino eky’omuwendo tekitusuubiza kuwona kabi, naye kituukiriza okutukuuma obuteremwa. Tuyinza okuyitibwa okutambula mu makubo ageetaliddwa, naye bulijjo tunaabeeranga n’okubeera wamu ne Mukama waffe, obuyambi bwe, n’enkola ye. Tetwetaaga kwegomba ssente, kubanga bulijjo tunaabanga ne Katonda waffe, era Katonda asinga zaabu, okuganja kwe kusinga obugagga.

Ddala tusaanira okumatizibwa n’ebyo bye tulina, kubanga oyo alina Katonda alina ebisinga ensi yonna endala. Kiki kye tuyinza okuba nakyo okusukka Oyo Atageraageranyizika? Kiki ekirala kye tuyinza okwegomba okusinga Obulungi bwa Ayinzabyonna?

Jjangu, mutima gwange; Katonda bw’agamba nti talikuleka era talikwabulira, beeranga mu kusaba nnyingi olw’ekisa, oleme okuleka Mukama wo, wadde okuvaako amakubo ge n’akaseera katono.

Desemba 29

AJJA KUTUTWALA EWAFFE

"Ne mu bukadde bwammwe nzija kusigala nga ye nze Nzuuyo. Ne bwe muliba mulina envi nnaabasitulanga. Nze nabakola era nze nnaabawekanga. Nnaabasitulanga era nnaabanunulanga." Isaaya 46:4

Omwaka gukaddiye nnyo, era wano waliwo ekisuubizo eri mikwano gyaffe abakaddiye; weewaawo, era eri ffenna, obukadde nga butujjira. Bwe tunaawangaala, ffenna tunaakula envi; kale kyetuva tuyinza okusanyukira ekisuubizo kino ng’okukkiriza kubadde kutulengezza mu maaso.

Bwe tunaakaddiwa Katonda waffe anaabeera akyali Nze Nzuuyo, ng’asigala bulijjo wa lumu lwennyini. Envi zoogera ku kuvunda kwaffe, naye ye tavunda. Bwe tutaasobola kusitula mugugu, era nga tetusobola na kwesitula ffekka, Mukama y’anaatusitula. Nga bwe yatusitula mu buto bwaffe ng’abaana b’endiga mu kifuba kye, era bw’atyo bw’anaakola mu myaka gyaffe egy’obunafu.

Yatukola, era anaatulabirira. Bwe tunaafuuka omugugu eri mikwano gyaffe, era omugugu eri ffekka, Mukama talitusuula, wabula anaatusitula n’atutwala n’atununula mu bujjuvu okusinga bwe kyali. Mu mbeera nnyingi Mukama awa abaddu be akawungeezi akawanvu era akateefu. Baakola nnyo olunaku lwonna ne beemalako amaanyi mu buweereza bwa Mukama waabwe, kale n’abagamba nti, "Kaakano muwummule nga mulindirira Ssabbiiti eyo etaggwaawo gye mbategekedde." Tuleme kutya bukadde. Ka tukaddiwe mu ngeri ey’ekisa, kubanga Mukama yennyini ali naffe mu kisa ekijjuvu.

Desemba 30

OKWAGALWA OKUTUUKIRIDDE

"Yesu bwe yayagala ababe mu nsi, yabalagira ddala okwagala kwe kwonna okutuusiza ddala ku kiseera ekisembayo." Yokaana 13:1
